1.name: Palomino Horse
1.description: Handsome, strong, and swift, the palomino is favored by couriers and sportsmen.

2.hint: Acquired from the level up advisor.
2.name: Sorrel Horse
2.description: A hardy, well-rounded, and dependable beast.

3.hint: Purchased from the Stablemasters located in cities throughout Tamriel.
3.name: Brown Paint Horse
3.description: Favored by farmers and traders, this muscular horse is strong and patient.

4.hint: Purchased from the Stablemasters located in cities throughout Tamriel.
4.name: Bay Dun Horse
4.description: This energetic mount is well-liked by battlefield scouts.

5.hint: Purchased from the Stablemasters located in cities throughout Tamriel.
5.name: Midnight Steed
5.description: A luxurious black steed, often considered a point of pride and distinction by Tamrielic jockeys, cavalry, and couriers.

6.name: Imperial Horse
6.description: Impetuous and fierce, this all-purpose Imperial steed yields only to a capable master.

7.name: Nibenay Mudcrab
7.description: A frisky little crustacean pal, at home in the water or out of it.

8.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Mystery of Razak."
8.name: Razak's Opus
8.description: A loyal steam-powered Dwarven Spider, fueled by magicka from a soul gem that will last for eras.

9.name: Pony Guar
9.description: A favorite household pet in Morrowind, the Pony Guar is a glutton for affection.

10.name: Crony Scrib
10.description: The caramel scrib crony is a quiet companion, devoted and easily housebroken.

11.hint: Acquired by playing in The Elder Scrolls Online Beta.
11.name: Imgakin Monkey
11.description: The imgakin monkey pet is lively and cheerful, even in the grimmest of dungeons.

12.name: Whiterun Wolfhound
12.description: The hunting dog of the Nords of Skyrim, known to face down sabre cats for their masters.

13.name: Rufous Mudcrab
13.description: A perky crab buddy whose rust-colored shell covers a cheerful, inquisitive demeanor.

14.name: Bristlegut Piglet
14.description: This cross between a domestic pig and a Skyrim boar is as loyal as it is adorable.

15.name: Frisky Scrib
15.description: This lambent little larva loves crawling alongside valorous adventurers!

16.hint: This unique pet is granted as a token of appreciation to players who remained subscribed to The Elder Scrolls Online for three months.
16.name: High Hrothgar Wraith
16.description: An ice wraith from the slopes of the highest mountain in Tamriel.

17.hint: This unique pet is granted as a token of appreciation to players who remained subscribed to The Elder Scrolls Online for six months.
17.name: Loyal Dwarven Sphere
17.description: A Dwarven Sphere of the long-lost Dwemer.

18.name: Green Narsis Guar
18.description: The robust Green Narsis is the standard mount and dray-beast of central Morrowind.

19.name: Golden Eye Guar
19.description: A crossbreed of banded and wild guar, as fearsome as it is intelligent and difficult to control.

20.name: Banded Guar Charger
20.description: A breed of guar bred for cavalry use, able to carry an armored warrior into battle.

21.name: Tessellated Guar
21.description: A sturdy, multi-purpose guar, at home anywhere from swamps to the ashlands.

22.name: Senche-Leopard
22.description: A mount bred for bearing an armed warrior while slinking through the steamy jungles of Pellitine.

23.name: Clouded Senche-Leopard
23.description: A strong yet nimble mount, bred for hunting in the Tenmar forest.

24.name: Black Senche-Panther
24.description: A mount said to have been bred by Baandari Pedlars for ease in hastily leaving town after dark.

25.name: Senche-Lioness
25.description: These fierce and powerful mounts hail from the broad savannahs of Anequina.

26.name: Banekin
26.description: Though unwilling to fight, this Daedric minion will follow you loyallyâfor now.

27.name: Blackwood Monkey
27.description: This busy little buddy is sometimes mistaken for an imgakin monkey.

28.hint: Obtained by pre-purchasing the Explorer's Pack.
28.name: Vermilion Scuttler
28.description: A reptilian pal from Morrowind, where they're known for quickness, devotion, and a mildly offensive odor.

29.name: Bravil Retriever
29.description: The Bravil Retriever loves the water and is a favorite hunter's companion from Anvil to Gideon.

30.name: Helstrom Ancestor Lizard
30.description: Some scholars believe Argonians are descendedâor were upliftedâfrom these tree-dwelling swamp lizards. True or not, they make great pets, affectionate and low-maintenance.

31.name: Daedric Scamp
31.description: A foul-smelling Daedric minion, who will follow you loyally, though it won't fight for you.

32.name: Windhelm Wolfhound
32.description: Descended from royal hunting dogs, Windhelm Wolfhounds are known as steadfast companions.

33.name: Housecat
33.description: This green-eyed feline is a distant relative of the Alfiq Khajiit.

34.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Bargain's End."
34.name: Skeleton
34.description: This guise causes the user to take on the appearance of a living skeleton.

35.hint: This unique mount was granted as a token of appreciation to players who remained subscribed to The Elder Scrolls Online from April 2014 through June 2015.
35.name: Striped Senche-Tiger
35.description: A semi-domesticated version of the wild senche-tiger, this distant relative of the Khajiit has been bred for size and manageability.

37.name: Sea Sapphire Dovah-Fly
37.description: Often accompanying ships as they leave port, each blue-purple iridescent Dovah-Fly chooses a person to follow. Each night, the whirr of its gently flitting wings pull its chosen one to slumber, and at sunrise it lightly lands on its "pet" to wake them up.

38.name: Blacksmith
38.description: This heavy leather smith's apron and gauntlets denotes a master of the forge.

39.name: Chef
39.description: A high-end chef's outfit that indicates the wearer is a provisioner supreme.

40.name: Royal Court Jester
40.description: This jovial jester garb, including mask and bell-cap, could even make a zombie smile.

41.name: Regal Dovah-Fly
41.description: Many a Vvardenfell youngster growing up in the swamps of West Gash or the Bitter Coast remembers spending happy hours playing "dodge-dovah" with these hovering bug-buddies! If hand-raised from larval form, they can become devoted companion animals.

43.name: Daedrat
43.description: This scurrying vermin from Oblivion would be lost in the vastness of Nirn without a loyal companion and guide. Even a Daedric rodent needs a friend.

44.name: Imperial Chancellor
44.description: When a member of the Elder Council must go to war, he or she dons the traditional armor of the Imperial Chancellor.

46.name: Ordinator Night-Raid Armor
46.description: When rounding up criminal scum or raiding hives of heresy in the dark of night, the Temple's Ordinators don this night-dark armor.

47.hint: Acquired by becoming the Emperor of Cyrodiil.
47.name: Emperor's Regalia
47.description: All hail <<player{his/her}>> Imperial Majesty, Emperor of Cyrodiil!

48.name: Dark Seducer
48.description: This guise enables its wearer to assume the grim aspect of a Dark Seducer.

49.name: Golden Saint
49.description: The wearer of this guise looks exactly like one of Sheogorath's dreaded Golden Saints.

50.name: Mannimarco
50.description: One can sneer at lesser mortals when wearing this exact replica of the regalia of the King of Worms.

51.name: Draugr
51.description: This guise makes the wearer appear to have withered flesh beneath ancient Nord armorâperfect for lurking in tombs.

52.name: Knight of the Flame
52.description: Plate and chainmail armor with red accents, topped by an armet helm with open visor, as worn by the Breton Knights of the Flame.

53.name: Lion Guard Knight
53.description: Full plate armor with blue-black accents, topped by an armet helm with open visor, as worn by the Lion Guard of the Covenant.

54.name: Lion Guard Elite
54.description: Plate and scale mail armor of whitened steel with golden accents, with a heavy close-helm, as seen on the Lion Guard Elite.

55.name: White Mane Horse
55.description: A rare, highly sought cross between a midnight steed and a Skyrim ice-horse.

56.name: Dapple Gray Palfrey
56.description: Elegant and intelligent, this breed of horse is a favorite among the nobles of Cyrodiil.

57.name: Piebald Destrier
57.description: Staunch and vigorous, this patterned war-horse is known for its courage and tenacity.

58.name: Gray Yokudan Charger
58.description: These chargers are descended from the great gray war-horses of the Ra Gada.

59.name: Nightmare Courser
59.description: The origin of this horrific mount is obscure, but some see the hand of Mehrunes Dagon in it.

60.name: Imperial Race and Outfit Style
60.description: Unlocks the ability to choose the Imperial Race when creating your character. Also unlocks all Imperial outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

61.name: Bantam Guar
61.description: According to the calculations of the sages of the Cult of the Ancestor Moth, the Bantam Guar is the cutest creature in all Tamriel.

62.hint: Acquired from the level up advisor.
62.name: Alik'r Dune-Hound
62.description: The Dune-Hound is the loyal dog of the Redguard hunters of the Alik'r.

63.name: Striped Senche-Panther
63.description: This elegant senche-panther is a distant relative of the Khajiit, though it cannot speak like the cat-folk.

64.name: Crafty Lerisa's Thief Outfit
64.description: Lightweight thieving outfit of dark-gray padded cloth and leather, with a feature-concealing half-balaclava.

65.name: Naryu's Assassin's Armor
65.description: Black and gray armor of leather and boiled leather that won't interfere with mobility, as seen on agents of the Morag Tong.

66.name: Covenant Scout
66.description: Brown and black leather armor topped with a black leather cowl, like that worn by Breton Skirmisher Scouts.

67.name: Amber Ash Hopper
67.description: Native to the upper Ashlands and the slopes of Red Mountain, the perky Amber Ash Hopper is a favorite pet of Dunmer expatriates, as it's relatively low maintenance (it digs its own hole in the ground), and it reminds the Dark Elves of home.

68.name: Deep-Moss Ash Hopper
68.description: The Deep-Moss Ash Hopper is native to southern Vvardenfell, where it's most commonly found in the fungal-forested uplands and the coastal marshes. They've been adopted as mascot bugs by the Buoyant Armigers, who admire their green carapaces.

69.name: Ruby Shroom Shalk
69.description: The Ruby Shroom Shalk is a popular house pet on the Telvanni Coast; the sway of its warm red fungus caps as it waddles about in the firelight of a parlor hearth just says "I'm home" to Dark Elves of a sentimental nature.

70.name: Jaqspur
70.description: The outfit of the Jaqspurs, the legendary Bosmeri archers of Valenwood, made entirely of leather accented with bone.

71.name: Dominion Scout
71.description: Forest wear of the Aldmeri Dominion Forward Scouts, featuring High Elf avian motifs and a gilt balaclava.

72.name: Wood Elf Vanguard
72.description: Scouts wearing this Wood Elf outfit blend in with the forest, becoming almost invisible.

73.name: Black Marsh Keeper
73.description: This light outfit of tooled leather resembles those worn by the Keepers in Black Marsh, who assist at the Argonian Hatching Pools.

74.name: Valenwood Spinner
74.description: The Priests of Y'ffre in Valenwood wear outfits like this one, of leather, wool, bone, and antlers.

75.name: Tree-Minder
75.description: This patterned robe of leathers and feathers resembles those worn by those Argonians who commune with the Hist.

76.name: Evening Dress
76.description: A casual dress for evening wear, suitable for the marketplace, crafting center, or tavern.

77.name: Blue-Cap Shroom Shalk
77.description: For the Dark Elves, the Shroom Shalk is a companion animal that brings calm and serenity to the Dunmeri home. There's just something so soothing about the way the blue fungal sprouts on its back gently wave and puff out spores as the beast putters about.

78.name: Bitter Coast Cliff Strider
78.description: Thetys Ramarys of Balmora says, "I love our Bitter Coast Striders, but feel bad that they can't fly very well. So I'm selectively breeding them into a strain that, one day, will dominate the Vvardenfell skies, pursuing its prey for great distances!"

79.name: Wedding Dress
79.description: This white confection is perfect for exchanging Rings of Maraâor delving dungeons with the Undaunted.

80.name: Barbarian
80.description: This savage tribal outfit enables the wearer to express his or her inner barbarian.

81.name: Any Race, Any Alliance
81.description: The ability to play any race in any alliance.

82.name: Classic Ordinator Armor
82.description: The classic dark-gold armor worn by Ordinators of the Tribunal while keeping the peace and combating heresy in Mournhold and its surrounding regions.

83.name: Hand of Almalexia Uniform
83.description: The elite Ordinators who guard Mother Morrowind are the Hands of Almalexia, who wear distinctive armor of white and blue.

84.name: Battlemage Palatine Armor
84.description: This costume replicates the magnificent gilt armor of the Battlemage Palatine, commander of the Cohort of Imperial Battlemages.

85.name: Spirit of Memories
85.description: While mortal bodies fade, memories live on.

86.name: Shornhelm Shepherd
86.description: This hardy dog was bred for herding sheep in the rugged terrain of Rivenspire.

87.hint: This unique costume is granted as a token of appreciation to players who remained subscribed to The Elder Scrolls Online for nine months.
87.name: Mask of Cheerful Slaughter
87.description: This Sheogorath-approved jester outfit displays the three faces of madness.

88.name: Freckled Guar
88.description: Known in Deshaan as loyal pals, the Freckled is the most intelligent breed of guar.

89.name: Gold-Cap Shroom Shalk
89.description: It isn't well known outside financial circles, but somewhere in the basement or sub-level of every bank in Morrowind you'll find the institution's mascot, a sweet old waddling Gold-Cap Shroom Shalk. The symbolism, of course, is obvious.

90.name: Boralis Gray Wolf Pup
90.description: When the gray wolves of Rivenspire howl across the dismal moors of Boralis, it sends a chill down the spine and even the bravest look back over their shouldersâbut by Kynareth, their pups sure are cute! And adorably playful into the bargain.

91.name: Striated Pony Guar
91.description: A favorite household pet in Morrowind, the Striated Pony Guar is a glutton for affection.

92.name: White River Ice Wolf Pup
92.description: The Ice Wolves that lope along the White River of northeast Skyrim are associated with both the goddess Mara and the Wolf Totem of Atmoraâbut it's mighty hard to think of their mythic stature when you're rolling around in the snow with an Ice Wolf Puppy!

93.name: Frost Mare
93.description: With its icy gaze and steaming breath, the frigid Frost Mare seems carved from the very glaciers of Skyrim.

94.name: Battlemage Scout Captain Uniform
94.description: This costume replicates the pragmatic and functional working armor of a Battlemage Scout Captain, as worn when leading a troop of mounted scouts.

95.name: Wedding Suit
95.description: Formal yet undeniably dapper, this season's wedding ensemble will be gracing grooms at nuptials across Tamriel.

96.name: Noble Dress
96.description: This elegant satin dress is the last word in aristocratic sophistication. Suitable for all occasions where refined splendor is required.

97.name: Noble Suit
97.description: Show some class with this opulent yet restrained aristocrat's ensemble for the high-toned and the haughty.

98.name: Centurion Dress Armor
98.description: This costume replicates the dress armor of an Imperial Centurion of the Legions of Cyrodiil.

99.name: Centurion Field Armor
99.description: This costume replicates the field armor of an Imperial Centurion, the outfit worn on the battlefield.

100.name: Imperial Guard Centurion Uniform
100.description: This splendid costume replicates the armor worn by a Centurion of the Imperial Guard, the Emperor's personal bodyguards.

101.name: Battlemage Tribune Armor
101.description: This costume replicates the armor of a veteran Battemage Tribune, usually the highest ranking Imperial Battlemage to actually take the field and personally engage the enemy.

102.name: Doom Wolf Pup
102.description: When a Doom Wolf Pup looks at you with its big red eyes, you may just melt insideâbut as soon as you turn your back, that little rascal will be shredding your embroidered Arenthian pillows and digging up your herbal garden.

103.hint: Acquired by completing the "The Vampire Scholar" quest in Western Skyrim.
103.name: Solitude Silver Wolf
103.description: Common sights around Solitude, these steadfast and fierce wolves also adorn the heraldry of that city. All of them are, of course, good wolves, and befriending one brings you good fortune in the land of the Nords!

104.name: Skeletal Pony Guar
104.description: Shouldn't an animated skeleton always be a thing of fear and revulsion? This necromantic Pony Guar might change your mind about that!

108.name: Soul-Shriven Ragged Clothing
108.description: When the Soul-Shriven arrive in Coldharbour, they are garbed in cast-off rags taken from the dead.

109.name: Soul-Shriven Leather Outfit
109.description: When the Soul-Shriven arrive in Coldharbour, some are garbed in cast-off leathers taken from the dead.

110.name: Soul-Shriven Armor Outfit
110.description: When the Soul-Shriven arrive in Coldharbour, some are garbed in cast-off armor taken from the dead.

111.name: Fennec Fox
111.description: A native of Hammerfell, the Fennec Fox has been domesticated by many of its desert peoples, and makes an alert and loyal pet.

112.name: Purple Daggerback
112.description: The glowing Purple Daggerback boar is found only in Craglorn in the vicinity of the Spellscar, from which it seems to have absorbed some sort of magical aura.

113.name: Mind-Shriven Horse
113.description: With its equine psyche stolen by Daedric magic, the mind-shriven horse is a docile yet terrifying mount.

114.name: Red Pit Wolf Pup
114.description: The Red Pit Wolves of southern Skyrim are known for their aggression and ferocity, and you can see that even in their puppies, adorable as they are. They love to play, but that means play-fighting, so expect to get chewed on as you tussle!

115.name: East Skyrim Scout Outfit
115.description: This costume replicates the armor worn by the scouts of Eastern Skyrim, in the holds of the Rift, Eastmarch, and Winterhold.

116.name: Orcish Scout Armor
116.description: This costume replicates the armor worn by Orcish mountain scouts in Skyrim and northern High Rock.

117.name: West Skyrim Scout Outfit
117.description: This costume replicates the armor worn by the scouts of Western Skyrim, in the holds of Haafingar, Hjaalmarch, and Karthald.

118.name: Unknown Akaviri Assassin Outfit
118.description: This costume represents an Akaviri assassin's outfit of mysterious and unknown origin.

119.name: Tsaesci Akaviri Assassin Outfit
119.description: This costume represents the armor worn by the assassins who accompanied the Tsaesci Akaviri invasion.

120.name: Kamali Akaviri Assassin Outfit
120.description: This costume represents the armor worn by the assassins who accompanied the Kamali Akaviri invasion.

121.name: Ashlander Mabrigash Travel Wear
121.description: This costume represents the travel attire of the nomadic Ashlanders of the Mabrigash tribe.

122.name: Ashlander Mabrigash Hunt Clothes
122.description: This costume represents the hunting clothes of the nomadic Ashlanders of the Mabrigash tribe.

123.name: Ashlander Kagesh Tribe Armor
123.description: This costume represents the armor of the nomadic Ashlanders of the Kagesh tribe.

124.name: Nedic Keptu Armor
124.description: This costume replicates the simple but sturdy armor worn by the warriors of the ancient Keptu tribe of Nedes.

125.name: Nedic Duraki Armor
125.description: This costume replicates the armor of the warriors who followed the ancient Nedic king Durac.

126.name: Nedic Perena Armor
126.description: This costume replicates the full-helmed armor worn by the warriors of the ancient Perena tribe of Nedes.

127.name: Mages Guild Research Robes
127.description: This costume replicates the Mages Guild research robes.

128.name: Mages Guild Leggings Uniform
128.description: This costume is an example of the Mages Guild uniform with leggings.

129.name: Mages Guild Formal Robes
129.description: This costume replicates the Mages Guild formal robes.

130.name: Fighters Guild Warm-Weather Gear
130.description: This costume replicates the look of the Fighters Guild warm-weather uniform.

131.name: Fighters Guild Cool-Weather Gear
131.description: This costume replicates the look of the Fighters Guild cool-weather uniform.

132.name: Fighters Guild Combat Armor
132.description: This costume replicates the look of Fighters Guild combat armor.

133.hint: Acquired from the level up advisor.
133.name: Abecean Ratter Cat
133.description: The Abecean Ratter is famed from Hegathe to Woodhearth as a prime rodent-catcher.

134.name: Senchal Striped Cat
134.description: The Senchal Striped is a cat that is as cunning as it is elegant. It's both cursed at and admired for its ability to get into places it doesn't belong.

135.name: Necrom Ghostgazer Cat
135.description: The Necrom Ghostgazer is the favored feline companion of Telvanni wizards. They not only keep the skeevers down, but they can "see" intruding demons and spirits.

136.name: Markarth Bear-Dog
136.description: Fierce and courageous fighters, the hunters of Western Skyrim use small packs of these dogs to pursue bears. The Bear-Dogs track, corner, and harry the bears until the hunters can arrive with their spears.

137.name: Breton Hero Armor
137.description: This costume pays tribute to a legendary Breton hero of the Daggerfall Covenant. Now you can honor this nameless rogue by adopting his intimidating outfit.

138.name: Elven Hero Armor
138.description: This costume pays tribute to a legendary High Elven hero of the Aldmeri Dominion. Now you can honor this nameless Altmer by adopting her epic appearance.

139.name: Nord Hero Armor
139.description: This costume pays tribute to a legendary Nord hero of the Ebonheart Pact. Now you can honor this nameless warrior by adopting his savage appearance.

140.name: Dragon Warrior
140.description: Tales have come down to us from the legendary time of the Dragons, when it was said that some Nords were born with Dragon blood in their veins. Now you can wear the look of these legendary Dragon Warriors.

143.name: Baby Netch
143.description: Once this young Netch calf imprints on a master, it will follow him or her anywhere, floating along and tootling happily.

144.name: Ninendava Sacred Goat
144.description: The goats that come from the ruin of Ninendava in Cyrodiil are no mere domestic livestock. They have long been used in certain forbidden Daedric ritualsâand have even been known to lead mortals through those arcane rites.

145.name: Bal Foyen Nix-Hound
145.description: Who says a giant, aggressive, blood-sucking insect can't make a loveable pet? Not the Dark Elves of Bal Foyen, who breed them as trackers, watch-hounds, and netch-deflators.

146.hint: Found very rarely from Imperial Reward containers, purchased in the Imperial City.
146.name: Xivkyn Augur
146.description: Xivkyn with exceptional mystical talents are subject to the horrific mental intrusions of the God of Schemes, shattering their mind and making them conduits for his dark visions. The Augurs are chief among these ravaged sorcerers.

147.hint: Found very rarely from Imperial Reward containers, purchased in the Imperial City.
147.name: Xivkyn Tormentor
147.description: Tormentors are those among the Xivkyn schooled in the anatomies of both mortals and Daedra, studying the arts of inflicting pain over several lifetimes of men and mer.

148.hint: Found very rarely from Imperial Reward containers, purchased in the Imperial City.
148.name: Xivkyn Dreadguard
148.description: The dreadguards are the armor-clad shock troops of Molag Balâutterly loyal, fearless, and bereft of the pedantic attitudes of the lesser Dremora-kyn.

149.hint:
A rare reward from defeating the elite Daedric forces and their master in the Darkest Depths.

Can also be acquired from the Impresario during Guilds and Glory.
149.name: Stonefire Scamp
149.description: This gibbering, foul-smelling Daedric minion will follow you loyally, though it won't fight for you.

150.name: Imperial War Mastiff
150.description: Mastiffs are the most common breed used by the Imperial Legions as battle dogs. The Imperial War Mastiff in particular is the mascot and symbol of the storied Second Legion, headquartered in peacetime in the vicinity of Bruma.

151.name: Cave Bear
151.description: Found throughout Tamriel's northern mountains, the Cave Bear makes a hardy and imposing mount.

153.name: Copperback Bear-Dog
153.description: The Copperback variant of the Markarth Bear-Dog is renowned for its responsiveness to training, but keep an eye on it, or will get into all sorts of mischief. Especially keep an eye on its eyes, which are two different colors!

154.name: Imperial City
154.description: Daedric forces have taken the Imperial City, and all three alliances vie to take it back. Experience hours of all-new PvP and PvE gameplay, both above ground and below, plus two new dungeons, never-before-seen monsters, craftable item sets, and more!

155.name: Fiendroth
155.description: Who doesn't want to be followed around by a hulking, armored Daedric bug with steel mandibles and a venomous stinger? It eats nothing but the cries and lamentations of your enemies, so it's an easy keeper. Friendly, tooâin its way.

156.name: Pocket Mammoth
156.description: Pocket Mammoths were originally bred small in order to make them more manageable as livestock, but in Wrothgar some escaped and began breeding in the wild. However, they're easily domesticated, especially if you get one when it's young.

157.name: Dragontail Goat
157.description: The brown Goats of the Dragontail Mountains are stronger than they look. There's a saying in Hammerfell: "Hits as hard as a Dragontail ram!"

158.name: Sanguine's Black Goat
158.description: A goat bred to take part in Daedric rituals? Nonsense. It's just a goat. Isn't it? But why does it look at you like that? And did it just â¦ whisper? No. It's just a goat!

159.name: Chub Loon
159.description: A denizen of Tamriel's northern shores, the Chub Loon survives on the bounty of the sea, dining on small fish of all types. Though clumsy and awkward on shore, it flies gracefully and is a nimble swimmer. Best of all, they make affectionate pets.

160.hint: Acquired by traveling to Orsinium for the first time.
160.name: Echalette
160.description: Full-grown echateres may be stubborn and ornery, but the baby Echalettes are playful and, frankly, just plain adorable. Once a young Echalette bonds with its master, it becomes a devoted companion.

161.hint:
A very rare reward from defeating the elite Daedric forces and their master in the Darkest Depths.

Can also be acquired from the Impresario during Guilds and Glory.
161.name: Soul-Shriven
161.description: Donning this costume gives the wearer the guise of one of the Soul-Shriven, Molag Bal's slaves in his Oblivion plane of Coldharbour.

162.name: Mind-Shriven
162.description: This costume gives the wearer the appearance of those tragic mortals whose will and mentality have been stolen by Molag Bal.

163.hint: Acquired by completing the "Imperial City Challenger" achievement in the Imperial City.
163.name: Necrotic Hoarvor
163.description: Your new best friend is a giant blood-sucking insect bloated with pustulant, lethal contagion! It's bursting with both infection and affectionâfor you!

164.name: Skeletal Horse
164.description: Behold the Skeletal Horse! Mortal races are not the only creatures that can be re-animated by necromancers. The best part: no need to muck out the stable.

165.name: Skeletal Senche
165.description: The Skeletal Senche may be the most fearsome of all feline mounts. Expertly re-animated, even in undead form it retains all the lithe strength it possessed in life.

166.name: Skeletal Guar
166.description: The naked, grisly smile on the broad skull of the Skeletal Guar mount may be enough to send lesser opponents fleeing in terror when you ride into battle on its creaking, bony frame. The Worm Cult, of course, will just be jealous.

167.name: Scarecrow Spectre
167.description: The dark magic that makes a spectre animate a scarecrow is thought to be related to those spells that create lurchers from spriggans. Wherever they come from, this costume enables the wearer to appear to be one of these Scarecrow Spectres.

168.name: Pumpkin Spectre
168.description: A Pumpkin Spectre is like a horrific figure from a skooma-induced nightmare! And with this costume, the wearer can take on the semblance of these dread monsters.

173.name: Zombie Horse
173.description: Mannimarco's Order of the Black Worm must be responsible for the re-animated Zombie Horse, as it was first seen in Cyrodiil as a Worm Anchorite's mount.

174.name: Cadwell's Helm of Heroism
174.description: I say! What a jolly chapeau! That's good, solid Coldharbour ironâand at a pinch, one could use it to stew up a fine mulligatawny. Eh?

176.name: Werewolf Lord
176.description: Wear Hircine's Gift with pride as the leader of the lycanthrope pack with the Werewolf Lord polymorph. Time to howl!

177.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
177.name: Snow Bear
177.description: The Snow Bear makes a superior mount for northern climes, as it's undaunted by even the fiercest winter weather.

178.name: Black Bear
178.description: The Black Bear is common across Cyrodiil, but is also seen north into High Rock and Skyrim, where it is considered a warrior's mount.

189.name: Skeletal Bear
189.description: A re-animated Skeletal Bear makes a fearsome mount, and is a favorite of northern Tamriel's necromancers.

190.name: Black Bear Cub
190.description: The Black Bear Cub is both playful and affectionate, and is so adorable it's quickly forgiven for whatever trouble it gets into.

191.name: Cave Bear Cub
191.description: The Cave Bear Cub may miss its mountain home, but that just makes it twice as loyal to its mortal companion.

192.name: Psijic Domino Pig
192.description: Originally bred on the Isle of Artaeum, the black-and-white Domino Pig is so smart it can count to five and learn to recognize its name.

193.name: Snow Bear Cub
193.description: The Snow Bear is known for its fierceness, but its cub is as cute as a bug. Maybe even two bugs.

194.name: Corseted Riding Outfit
194.description: Lady Eloisse, the designer, says, "A Breton woman likes to add a touch of feminine flair to her otherwise practical clothing. She wants her attire to say she's a lady, no matter what she's doing."

195.name: Off-the-Shoulder Evening Dress
195.description: Lady Eloisse of House Manteau offers this traditional Breton evening dress. As she puts it, "Ostentation is vulgar, but true elegance never goes out of style!"

196.name: High-Collared Coin Ball Gown
196.description: Bretons like to display their wealth through their apparel, as shown by the rich fabric and glistening ornamentation of this outfit designed by Lady Eloisse of House Manteau.

197.name: High Rock Pioneer Outfit
197.description: "Even a rugged pioneer of the borderlands can show some distinctive Breton style," says Lady Eloisse of House Manteau. "Our traditional linen shirt is suitable for any occasion!"

198.name: Wayrest Suede Doublet Ensemble
198.description: "There's no reason why everyday wear has to look frumpy! A man likes to look good when he's at his trade, and what looks better than a suede doublet over velveteen breeches?" says Lady Eloisse, Couturier of House Manteau.

199.name: Soiree in Camlorn Evening Suit
199.description: Lady Eloisse says, "The highborn Breton prefers clothing that is elegant but austere, harkening back to the High Rock tradition of knightly orders, militant but chivalrous. Bright metallic points highlight the buckles and trim."

200.name: Sand-Kissed Salwar Ensemble
200.description: Designer Sar'aq says, "It's hot in the Alik'r Desert; in our environment, women prefer light clothing that lets cooling breezes reach the skin. But comfort and refinement are in no way incompatible!"

201.name: Whisperweft Gala Wear
201.description: "A Redguard lady's clothing can be elegant and ornamental, while still light enough to keep the wearer cool during the heat of the day," according to Sar'aq of Sentinel. "In this attire, you'll float through the room like a zephyr!"

202.name: Song of the Night Ensemble
202.description: A Redguard lady's formal wear, like this ensemble by Sar'aq of Sentinel, is made of light fabric designed to be both beautiful and impressive, a constant reminder of the wearer's heritage and grace. As Sar'aq says, "Glamor is for all of us!"

203.name: Eternity Tunic with Pants
203.description: In Orsinium these days, even the busiest tusker likes some flair in his clothingâand nothing says "modern Orc" like a bias-cut-placket tunic from Borzighu at Coldsnap Clothiers. "This outfit," he says, "is one for the ages!"

204.name: Summit Lord's Silken Robes
204.description: For the stylish town Orc, Borzighu the Tidy Tailor of Orsinium has decided the watchwords this season are "restrained elegance." As he puts it, "Strut your Orcish heritage with style!"

205.name: Brilliance Brocade Robes
205.description: For the Orc who aspires to impress, this season Borzighu of Coldsnap Clothiers offers rich fabrics in subtle shades, accented with gold and steel to convey an indelible image of wealth and power.

206.hint: Acquired by completing the main story in Orsinium.
206.name: Regalia of the Orsimer King
206.description: With a nod to tradition but clearly fashioned with the new sensibilities of a reinvigorated Orsinium in mind, the crown and armor of the Orsimer King makes a definite statement about strength, unity, and honor.

213.hint: Acquired by completing Maelstrom Arena on Veteran Mode.
213.name: Maelstrom Baron
213.description: The Barons-Who-Move-Like-This are paragons of the martial arts styles of Oblivion. They are also psycho-magical projections from the mind of Daedric Demiprince Fa-Nuit-Hen, his concept of perfect masters of combat.

215.name: Orsinium
215.description: Come to the homeland of the Orcs in ESO's first new PvE quest content DLC! Help King Kurog rebuild the city of Orsinium, and watch its walls and towers rise due to your deeds. Includes new armor, weapons, a solo challenge arena, and more!

220.hint: Acquired by successfully uncovering the Vosh Rakh plot.
220.name: Vosh Rakh Ceremonial Mask
220.description: Every member of the Vosh Rakh religious movement hides his or her identity behind a golden mask of Orcish visage patterned after Trinimac's own auric-tinged skin.

221.name: Black Mask Bear-Dog
221.description: This variant of the Bear-Dog is a favorite of the Markarth Watchâand of the thieves who attempt to evade them. The Watch uses them to sniff out trouble, while the outlaws employ them to keep an eye out for the Watch!

222.name: Mossy Netch Calf
222.description: The greenish, or "Mossy" Netches, are most commonly found in the West Gash region of northwest Vvardenfell. The calves are docile, even for Netches, and will happily follow along behind anyone who smells of their favorite fungi.

225.name: Winterborn Shaman's Costume
225.description: This shaman's costume is clothing of the savage Winterborn, a clan of raiders from the Reach who have invaded Orsinium.

226.name: Winterborn Hunter's Costume
226.description: This hunter's costume is clothing of the savage Winterborn, a clan of raiders from the Reach who have invaded Orsinium.

227.name: Winterborn Warrior's Costume
227.description: This warrior's costume is clothing of the savage Winterborn, a clan of raiders from the Reach who have invaded Orsinium.

228.hint: Acquired by filling the House of Orsimer Glories with historic relics.
228.name: Cavalier of the Sworn Oath
228.description: A mix of metal and leather melded with the hide of a great snow bear, fashioned to pay tribute to Malacath, the Furious One.

229.hint: Acquired by filling the House of Orsimer Glories with historic relics.
229.name: Trinimac's Penitent Knight
229.description: A mix of metal and leather melded with the hide of a great brown bear, fashioned to honor Trinimac, the warrior god.

230.hint: Acquired by filling the House of Orsimer Glories with historic relics.
230.name: Old Orsinium Sentry
230.description: A mix of metal and leather melded with the hide of a great black bear, fashioned in the ancient style of the Orsimer.

231.name: Pale Velothi Guar
231.description: This stalwart mount comes from the ashlands downwind of the volcanoes of the Velothi Mountains, and is well adapted to surviving under the harshest of conditions.

232.name: Moonlight Senche-Tiger
232.description: The Moonlight Senche-Tigers have been the sleek and silvery guardians of the Khajiiti temples of the moons ever since the revelation of the Riddle'Thar.

233.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
233.name: Hammerfell Camel
233.description: This is the stoic, hard-working beast that riders in the wastes of Hammerfell count on to survive. And if things come to a fight, it's just plain mean.

234.name: Zeht's Cloud Camel
234.description: The white camel is said to be sacred to Zeht, the Redguard god of food and farming. The devout folk of Hammerfell bow when a Cloud Camel rides past.

235.name: Black Camel of Ill Omen
235.description: Most riders consider Black Camels to be creatures of bad luck and misfortune. But if you're a thief riding off into the night with your ill-gotten gains, you might see things differently.

236.name: Jo-m'Athra Spellcaster Suit
236.description: Possibly the most feared of the dro-m'Athra are their spellcasters, the jo-m'Athra, Khajiiti wizards who became "bent" into Lost Cats.

237.name: Dar-m'Athra Stealth Outfit
237.description: The dar-m'Athra are the stealthiest of the dro-m'Athra, and therefore rarely seen, except for a final glimpse as one kills you.

238.name: Do-m'Athra Battle Armor
238.description: When warrior-dos are "bent" into dro-m'Athra, they become that fearsome variety the Khajiit call a do-m'Athra.

239.name: Abah's Watch Pursuit Suit
239.description: The guards of Abah's Watch dress lightly during the heat of the day, or when they know they're going to have to run down a fleeing perpetrator.

240.name: Abah's Watch Night Patrol
240.description: Come nightfall temperatures drop in the Landing, and Abah's Watch armors up for its night patrols. The alleys of town are dangerous after dark.

241.name: Abah's Watch Full Armor
241.description: The Abah's Watch opens the armor locker and gears up whenever a pirate ship ties up at the docks, because they know there's going to be trouble in the taverns and mayhem in the market.

242.name: Kindlespit Dragon Frog
242.description: The common or Kindlespit Dragon Frog is an engagingly preposterous little pal whose antics never fail to amuse. Hammerfell tales say the huge Dragons of ancient legend were all turned into these tiny flame-puffing hoppers.

243.name: Tangerine Dragon Frog
243.description: The slug-like Sloads of Thras bred the flame-hued Tangerine Dragon Frog so they could be spotted more easily in their archipelago's murky lagoons. Some say they were bred to be pets, but the Sload word for them translates as "snacks."

244.name: Blue Oasis Dragon Frog
244.description: The comical Blue Oasis Dragon Frog is native to Hew's Bane, and before they were bred as pets could be found only on that Hammerfell peninsula. These little bug-eaters are popular mascots at open-air taverns.

245.name: Pirate Swab Outfit
245.description: Ready for piratical action? You will be in this basic sea rover attire, which gives you plenty of opportunity to show off your buccaneer body art. Avast, and prepare to repel boarders!

246.name: Pirate Sash and Bandolier Garb
246.description: Wear this full pirate rig along with a fierce scowl, and no one will dare lay a hand on your booty. Suitable whether you're swaggering into a dockside tavern, sharpening your cutlass at the gangplank, or just hanging around the port looking dangerous.

247.name: Pirate First Mate's Outfit
247.description: The crew before the mast will heave to and follow your orders when you're geared up as the ship's First Mate. Display your rank and your nautical tattoos at one and the same time with this sea raider's outfit!

248.name: Treasure Hunter
248.description: The serious treasure hunter knows it's really all about the gear. Whether you're exploring subterranean catacombs, ancient ruins, or a shattered shipwreck, when you run into an obstacle, you want to have the right tool at hand.

249.name: Alliance Rider Outfit
249.description:
Wear the Alliance Rider Outfit and proudly display your army's bold heraldic symbol, whether it's the Eagle, the Lion, or the Dragon!

|cFFFFFFAppearance is specific to your character's alliance.|r

|cff0000This collectible is not dyeable.|r

250.name: Glenmoril Witch Robes
250.description: The witches of the Glenmoril Wyrd covens worship natural laws and nature, mostly in its darker aspectsâthough some also celebrate life and fertility, particularly in the spring of the year. These robes are specially woven for that spring festival.

251.name: Sheogorath Costume
251.description: "Sheogorath, whose sphere is Madness, and whose motives are unknowable." If you know the Daedric Prince called the Madgod, Sovereign of the Shivering Isles, Fourth Corner of the House of Troubles, then you already know this is the costume for you.

252.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Filling the Void."
252.name: Black Hand Robe
252.description: Only those who have been inducted into the deepest secrets of the mysterious Dark Brotherhood are authorized to wear the Black Hand Robe.

253.name: Rosy Netch Calf
253.description: The reddish, or "Rosy" Netches are native to the foyadas of the Molag Amur region of Vvardenfell, where they live in a semi-wild state subject to the occasional round-ups of the Netchimen. The calves, sulfurous odor aside, are quite adorable.

254.name: Hew's Bane Thieves Guild
254.description: Join the Thieves Guild in Hew's Bane, a never-before-seen area of Hammerfell! Explore Abah's Landing, a decadent port town ruled by corrupt merchant lords, who struggle with the Thieves Guild for power. New stories, delves, world bosses, and much more!

260.name: Senche-Lion Cub
260.description: If you domesticate a Senche-Lion Cub when it's young enough, it will follow you everywhere, no matter how dangerous. And your enemies will burn from the cuteness.

261.name: Dro-m'Athra Senche
261.description: The Senche-shaped dro-m'Athra are known to the Twilight Cantors as the sar-m'Athra, but everyone else just calls these eerie and uncanny mounts the Dro-m'Athra Senche.

262.name: Masked Bear
262.description: Both swift and strong, the Masked Bear of the Jerall Mountains is a popular mount along the high passes between Bruma and Falkreath.

263.name: Sabre Cat
263.description:
The sabre cats of northern Tamriel are possibly even more powerful than their southern Senche cousins. They are certainly more feral and difficult to train. 
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

264.name: Desert Garden Gala Overdress
264.description: "We Redguards are a hardy people," says designer Sar'aq of Sentinel, "and like to stage our ceremonies outsideâregardless of the weather. With this elegant overdress, a lady can celebrate the most festive of occasionsâeven in a sandstorm!"

265.name: Pride-King Lion
265.description: The Pride-King Lions are the top predators on the savannahs of Northern Elsweyr. No one but the Khajiit, with their feline intuitions, could have persuaded these proud beasts to serve as mounts.

266.name: Skeletal Camel
266.description: The Redguard hatred of necromancy means undead creatures are rare in Hammerfellâwhich will make you all the more special when you clatter into the oasis on the back of a terrifying Skeletal Camel!

267.name: Tythis Andromo, the Banker
267.description:
This aristocratic banker is on hand whenever he's needed, available for all personal banking servicesâexcept in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which are far too dangerous for this fellow.

When summoned, his services can be used by you and your groupmates.

268.name: Sylvan Nixad
268.description: Once a common sight in Cyrodiil's Great Forest, the Sylvan Nixad is now most often encountered in the glades and meadows of the Gold Coast. Once tamed, they make charming companions, loyal and easy to care for.

269.name: Turquoise Nixad
269.description: Scholars think the iridescent blue Turquoise Nixad must have inherent magical properties, because those wings certainly aren't big enough to enable it to fly. Yet fly it does, flitting about like a beautiful human-shaped hummingbird moth.

270.name: Orchid Nixad
270.description: The rarest of these fay creatures is the Orchid Nixad, said to be sacred to the goddess Dibella, and found only in wild places hallowed to her worship. It's known that the Empress Tavia had an Orchid Nixad as a friend and companion.

277.name: Ever Auridon Sateen Gown
277.description: "The clean traditional lines of this gown evoke the wakes of Torinaan's ships when they first discovered Auridon," says designer Estinwe Silkdancer. "Its classic majesty is a reminder that even the lowest-ranked Altmer is still a High Elf."

278.name: Alinor Twilight Dancing Dress
278.description: Estinwe the Muse of Shimmerene says, "Evening in Alinor, and starlight glistens from swirling sashes and silver circlets as Elf maidens prance through the time-hallowed steps of the First Founders' Fast Pavane. Say hey!"

279.name: Crystal Tower Sapiarchs' Gown
279.description: Inspired by the elegant formal gowns of the Sapiarchs of the Crystal Tower, designer Estinwe Silkdancer says, "Now you, too, can have the mysteries of the Dawn Era at your fingertipsâor at least look like you do!"

280.name: Budi-Shirt and Galligaskins
280.description: Samsu the Sleek says, "This season in Mistral we're tightening up the traditional billowing budi to give it a more streamlined silhouette, and shortening it the better to show off our breeze-catching galligaskin trousers. So comfy!"

281.name: Moon-Sugar Festival Suit
281.description: "When the Moon-Sugar cane is ripe for harvest, and Jone and Jode are both waning crescents, it's time for the sweetest festival of the year," says designer Samsu the Sleek. "This Festival Suit blends five different silks so you'll look shiny and sharp!"

282.name: Jarl's Deluxe Moot Regalia
282.description: "Someday East and West Skyrim will be reunited and the Jarls will gather in a Moot to select a new High King," says Jork of Windhelm. "But that day may be a long time coming, so you might as well wear this noble outfit now!"

283.name: Rimmen Fountain-Side Loungewear
283.description: Famed for their clear water, the fountains of Rimmen provide a place for locals to gather and catch up on the news of the day. If you seek a moment of refreshment, wear this elegant yet comfortable garb as you dangle your feet in the cool waters.

284.name: Moonlit Cove Sojourner's Wraps
284.description: Many moons ago, this elegant wrap served as the perfect garb for relaxing after soaking in the blessed sugar waters of Moonlit Cove. Given both its comfort and allure, Khajiit broadened its use and now wear it while traveling in style. Fragrant!

285.name: Pellitine Tea-Fete Gown
285.description: Originally worn during the ancient Pa'alatiin clan's tradition of taking tea, this classic garment's popularity has resurged in recent months, making it the perfect dress for any Khajiiti gathering.

286.name: Graht-Climber's Active Wear
286.description: Stitchmaster Moneriel says, "We all have days when we have to climb the graht-oak to clean the house-pod gutters. Does that mean you have to dress like a frump? Of course not! Look trim and stylish in my latest halter-and-skirt outfit from Elden Root!"

287.name: Doeskin-and-Chamois Woods Wear
287.description: "Covering yourself from head to toe makes perfect sense," says Moneriel of Elden Root, "if you're a Breton! Ha!" You'll feel free and easy in any social situation in this light doeskin-and-chamois affair accented with turquoise and sea-beads.

288.name: Treethane Ceremonial Dress
288.description: "Some occasions call for formal wear," says Stitchmaster Moneriel of Elden Root. "You may have to attend an important event, but you can still turn heads from trunk to treetop in my thousand-beaded ceremonial dress!"

289.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Signed in Blood."
289.name: Shrouded Armor
289.description: This distinctive armor of the Dark Brotherhood marks those assassins who have been welcomed into its secretive order.

290.name: Highland Wolf
290.description: The brown Highland Wolf is common in the Colovian hills and in Cyrodiil's Great Forest, where wild packs are feared by farmers and shepherds. But foresters have domesticated the beasts and, bred for size, use them as mounts.

291.name: Doom Wolf
291.description: Bred for size and savagery from the fierce timber wolves of the southern Jerall Mountains, the Doom Wolf has been adopted as the mount of choice by the secretive and deadly Dark Brotherhood.

292.name: Ice Wolf
292.description: The Ice Wolf of the far north can grow to tremendous sizeâwhich is probably why the Nords of Hjaalmarch decided to ride them. Domesticating giant Ice Wolves wasn't an easy task, but it's just the kind of challenge a Nord loves.

293.name: Wild Hunt Horse
293.description: When the Wood Elves invoke the Wild Hunt, creatures forget their Y'ffre-taught shapes and shift into unnatural forms. Such are the Wild Hunt Horses, mounts that occupy a space between flora and fauna.

294.name: Wild Hunt Guar
294.description: Wild Hunt Guar are mounts that have reverted to the shapeshifting chaos of the Dawn Era. They have become part plant and part animal, as wonderful as they are abominable.

295.name: Wild Hunt Senche
295.description: The Wild Hunt unravels the shapes Y'ffre established for creatures in the Dawn Era, transforming them into monstrous but vigorous hybrid beasts. Among these, both beautiful and abhorrent, is the Wild Hunt Senche-Mount.

296.name: Wild Hunt Bear
296.description: The Wild Hunt Bear is a forest beast that has lost its Y'ffre-given ability to choose between being plant or animal, reverting to the primal chaos of the Dawn Era.

297.name: Wild Hunt Camel
297.description: Y'ffre's Naming gave all the creatures of Nirn their shapes, even in the arid deserts of Tamriel. When its name comes magically unraveled, then a creature begins to forget its shape and devolve to a state between flora and fauna. Thus the Wild Hunt Camel.

298.name: Wild Hunt Wolf
298.description: Some say that Hircine meddled with the nature of wolves in a way that made them susceptible to shape-shifting, and from this Daedric interference came both the Werewolfâand the Wild Hunt Wolf. What is the truth of this? Y'ffre knows!

299.name: Skeletal Wolf
299.description: It's said that when King Styriche, the Vampire of Verkarth, led his Gray Host west to Bangkorai, his terrible Zombie Hussars were mounted on a great pack of Skeletal Wolves. Some escaped the massacre of the Gray Host, and survived to haunt the wastes.

300.hint: Acquired by completing the Thieves Guild questline.
300.name: Pirharri the Smuggler
300.description:
This Baandari Pedlar is on hand whenever she's needed (except in Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds), and will fence any of your goods for you.

When summoned, her services can only be used by you.

301.name: Nuzhimeh the Merchant
301.description:
This alert merchant is on hand whenever she's needed, and will buy any non-stolen goods you or your group offer her. She won't come to Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, thoughâtoo dangerous.

When summoned, her services can be used by you and your groupmates.

303.name: Sabre Leopard Cub
303.description: "For the Mages Guild, I devised an enchanted 'appealometer' that measures creatures' adorableness," says Researcher Neotenus. "After tests on other pets, I tried to take a reading on a Sabre Snow Leopard Cub, but the device overloaded and shattered."

304.name: Alliance War Dog
304.description:
War Dogs can be found in the armies of all three Alliances, mainly in the capacity of aides to the military police. They are as loyal to their masters as they are savage to their enemies.

|cFFFFFF(Appearance is specific to your character's alliance.)

305.name: Black Mane Lion
305.description: At the Palace of the Mane near Torval, by tradition the Bi-Lunar Guard are all mounted on matching Black Mane Lions, which are reserved for them alone. So be wary if you ride your Black Mane near Torval, lest you anger the Bi-Lunars!

306.name: Dark Brotherhood
306.description: Your talent for homicide has been noticed and an invitation has arrivedâto join the Dark Brotherhood! Come to the Gold Coast, westernmost region of the old Empire, where opportunities abound for intrigue, conspiracy â¦ and murder! It's one killer DLC.

311.name: Dominion War-Locks
311.description: Going to war may mean donning a helm, but beneath it an honored Dominion warrior is entitled to wear these official Alliance War-Locks, which keep long hair under control while still looking superb.

312.hint: Acquired for completing Veteran Maw of Lorkhaj.
312.name: Dro-m'Athra
312.description: One who wears this skin adopts the eerie appearance of a dro-m'Athra or Bent Cat, an evil ancestor spirit of the Khajiit.

313.name: White Lion
313.description: In Elsweyr, the White Lion is considered a highly prestigious mount. When King Keirgo married Queen Eshita, his Orcrest Honor Guard, twenty strong, were all mounted on mature White Lions.

314.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
314.name: Hearthfire Kagouti
314.description: The Hearthfire Kagouti appears to be a sort of magical hybrid, a wizard's experimental melding of a carnivorous reptile and a flame atronach. The fact that they were first sighted in the Telvanni Grazelands lends this theory some credence.

321.name: Drifting Sand Tunic and Sash
321.description: Sar'aq of Sentinel presents a comfortable, casual linen outfit that's suitable for both town and country. This billowing tunic and breeches ensemble will "flow wherever you go," as the designer puts it. Includes a broad and colorful sash!

322.name: Vested Interest Banquet Garb
322.description: You'll turn heads when you walk into the banquet hall in this ensemble of shining sateen, topped by a sharply tailored jacquard vest. "Who says casual can't be stylish?" says designer Sar'aq of Sentinel. "Not I!"

323.name: Majestic "Dune Rider" Ensemble
323.description: Sar'aq has outdone himself with this elegant outfit inspired by the legend of Prince Ahzzad the Dune Rider! Anyone would look princely in this ensemble of midnight linen and leather, accented with shining silver. Exquisite!

324.name: Northern Lynx
324.description: Native to Tamriel's northern forests, in the wild the Lynx lives on a diet of rabbits, hares, and skeevers. Domesticated, the Lynx makes a dignified and stylish animal companion, popular with the Nord aristocracy.

325.name: Colovian Badger
325.description: Though Badgers mainly eat burrowing rodents, farmers hate them because they'll take chickens, kwama scribs, and bantam guar if they get the chance. Cranky and irritable, they make terrible petsâwhich makes them a favorite among the Undaunted.

326.name: Red Pit Wolf
326.description: Pit Wolves are so called because they were bred by the Reachmen as fierce pit fighters, often matched against bears or bristlebacks. In order to make his guards more impressive, the Tyrant of Markarth was the first to have Red Pits trained as mounts.

327.name: City Isle Tunic Dress
327.description: Designer Diocletia says, "For a true Imperial, simple does not mean unsophisticated. Our City Isle Tunic Dress is inspired by the elegant lines of Second Empire attire, but updated with a contemporary bias cut."

328.name: Cyrod Gentry's Town Gown
328.description: "Tailored from sheerest linen, this aristocratic gown is as daring as it is discreet," says the renowned Diocletia of Skingrad. "Whether you're dining or dancing, shopping or just showing off, this is for you."

329.name: Cyrod Patrician Formal Gown
329.description: You'll look every inch the aristocrat in this formal wrap gown from Diocletia of Skingrad, paired with a splendid gorget of hammered gold dripping with Imperial diamonds. Get haughty!

330.name: Rumare Waterfront Casual Wear
330.description: Though inspired by the raffish attire of roustabouts on the Imperial Waterfront, this casual outfit is made of the finest materials, and according to designer Diocletia, it's a superior choice for daytime wear in any of the Imperial City's six districts.

331.name: Imperial City Temple Tunic
331.description: "In this shimmering satin confection, you'll look your best while pouring out a libation to the Divines," says Diocletia of Skingrad, "or just toasting your friends at the corner tavern. Class always tells!"

332.name: Elder Council Tunic and Sash
332.description: Inspired by the majestic and imposing attire of the Imperial Elder Council, this tunic and sash ensemble by Diocletia of Skingrad is suitable for high-profile occasions from the formal to the celebratory. Show off the proud heritage of the Empire!

333.name: Priest of the Green
333.description: In Valenwood they're called Spinners; in High Rock, Vicars of Jephre. Wherever they go, the traveling priests of Y'ffre the Storyteller are respected as holy defenders of nature and the natural world.

334.name: Toxin Doctor
334.description: When you specialize in venoms and poison-making, you invest in special protective garb to keep from being poisoned by your own experimentsâor else! And if your clients are just a little intimidated by your creepy attire, all the better.

335.name: Blackfeather Court Whistle
335.description: Use near a corpse to call the Blackfeather Court to feast.
335.hint: Obtained by exploring the Crow's Wood.

336.name: Finvir's Trinket
336.description: This bauble casts an otherworldly light upon its owner.
336.hint: Obtained by exploring Bad Man's Hallows.

337.name: Lodorr's Crown
337.description: The metal is warm to the touch.
337.hint: Obtained by exploring the Hall of the Dead.

338.name: Sanguine's Goblet
338.description: The goblet is never quite empty.

339.name: Justal's Falcon
339.hint: Obtained by exploring the Lion's Den.

340.name: Lena's Wand of Finding
340.description: A gift from a fellow student of Shad Astula.

341.name: Almalexia's Enchanted Lantern
341.description: A light dances within the glass of the lantern, waiting to be released.

342.name: Questionable Meat Sack
342.description: There's a lot of meat in here.
342.hint: Obtained by exploring the Forgotten Crypts.

343.name: Battered Bear Trap
343.hint: Obtained by exploring the Toothmaul Gully.

344.name: Nirnroot Wine
344.description: A unique wine that is never tasted and never runs out but always gets you drunk.
344.hint: Obtained by helping to make Nirnroot Wine in Cyrodiil.

345.name: Discourse Amaranthine
345.hint: Obtained by exploring the Vile Manse.

346.name: Glanir's Smoke Bomb
346.hint: Obtained by exploring the Crimson Cove.

347.name: Fetish of Anger
347.description: A small, dark stone, hot to the touch.
347.hint: Obtained by exploring the Obsidian Scar.

348.name: Bonesnap Binding Stone
348.description: A strange Ayleid stone from the Bonesnap Ruins.
348.hint: Obtained by exploring the Bonesnap Ruins.

349.name: Token of Root Sunder
349.description: A small seed given by Root Sunder.

350.name: Yokudan Totem
350.hint: Obtained by exploring the Lost City of the Na-Totambu.

351.name: Mezha-dro's Sealing Amulet
351.description: A strange amulet used by Mezha-dro to seal tears in Oblivion.
351.hint: Obtained by exploring the Village of the Lost.

352.name: Nanwen's Sword
352.description: A polished but cheap prop, property of the counterfeit Ayleid king.

353.name: Malacath's Wrathful Flame
353.description: A relic of the Cult of Malacath, useless in combat but very impressive.

354.name: Hidden Pressure Vent
354.description: Rkindaleft's pressure release system was, and is, unusual.
354.hint: Obtained by exploring the ruins of Rkindaleft.

355.name: Dominion Lizard-Locks
355.description: Going to war may mean donning a helm, but beneath it an Argonian Dominion warrior is entitled to wear these official Alliance Lizard-Locks, which keep beaded bristles under control while still looking superb.

356.name: Jubilee Cake 2016
356.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. It's a festival for your taste buds!
356.hint: Obtained by completing the 2016 Anniversary event.

357.name: Snowy Sabre Cat Cub
357.description: This little cub loves to play in the snow, but don't let it get lost in the deep driftsâand when you pull it out, be careful of those little sabre teeth!

358.hint: Acquired by joining the Thieves Guild.
358.name: Thieves Guild Leathers
358.description: The Thieves Guild of Abah's Landing distributes a set of protective garb to its members. The many buckles are carefully secured to prevent jangling, and scuffed to avoid reflection in the desert sun.

359.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Forever Hold Your Peace" in the Thieves Guild questline.
359.name: Merchant Lord's Formal Regalia
359.description: The merchant lords of Abah's Landing wear their most expensive finery to weddings, funerals, executions, and other public events attended by their peers.

360.hint: Acquired by traveling to Abah's Landing for the first time.
360.name: Jackal
360.description: The Jackal of Tamriel is called by some the "thieves' dog" because it's quick to sniff out sources of food, and clever enough to figure out how to get at them. Once tamed, they serve as loyal companions.

361.name: Coin of Illusory Riches
361.description: Remind yourself at any time what you went into thieving for!
361.hint: Acquired by becoming a Master Thief.

363.name: Dragon Priest
363.description: Once, it is said, a cult of Dragon-worshipers ruled all of northern Tamriel. Their leaders were Dragon Priests, cruel clerics of great power who hid their faces under magical masks. Now you can wear the semblance of these legendary magi.

364.name: Clockwork Shalk
364.description: The Clockwork Shalk is a fabricant from the hidden laboratories of Sotha Sil. It seems programmed to obey the master it imprints upon, but who knows what secret orders it will follow if events occur to trigger them?

365.name: Alliance War Horse
365.description:
It's no surprise the Three Alliances compete to breed the strongest and most majestic chargers for their armored cavalries.
|cFFFFFF
Appearance is linked to your character's alliance.

Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

368.name: Drunk
368.description: Thish ish gonna make you wobble an' weave like you're intoxit â¦ inebriash â¦ drunk ash a skunk. It even worksh on High Elves.

373.hint: Acquired by entering either the Ruins of Mazzatun or Cradle of Shadows dungeons for the first time.
373.name: Heroic
373.description: You're valiant, you're bold, you're larger than life and twice as awesomeâand you want everyone to know it.

374.hint: Acquired by traveling to the Gold Coast for the first time.
374.name: Assassin
374.description: Feeling brash and brassy? Adopt the swaggering attitude of a cocksure killer and show the world that death and danger are your bread and butter.

375.name: Ruins of Mazzatun
375.description: Venture into Mazzatun, the "Puzzle City" of the Xit-Xaht tribe of Argonians, who have been forcing other Lizardfolk to work as slave labor on a project that has driven their masters â¦ mad! Can you free them in time?

377.name: Furious
377.description: Seething with fury at the injustice of it all? This is the personality for you.

378.name: Melancholy
378.description: When the tragic burden of life in Tamriel is simply too much to bear, express your sorrow and grief with this personality.

379.name: Cheerful
379.description: "Personnes of pleasante disposition make ye most merrie companions, whether for roistering at taverne or massacre of ye Elfs" â Pelinal Whitestrake

380.name: Plumed Wide-Brim Acorn-Warder
380.description: "Ever been to Valenwood and seen them huge graht-oaks? The biggest ones have acorns as big as your head. Yes! That big! Heavy, too, with points on 'em. I won't go into those woods without my Wide-Brim Acorn-Warder hat. Save your life."

381.name: Z'en Vengeance Kiss-Me-Not Cap
381.description: When a Wood Elf vows a Vengeance Oath to the god Z'en, they may wear this tusk-encrusted cap as a symbol of having sworn off physical affection until the vendetta is complete. Admittedly, the Kiss-Me-Not is also sometimes worn just as a joke.

382.name: Upright Antler Skullcap
382.description: Nothing says "Happy to see you" like the aggressively elevated antlers of this Bosmeri skullcap! First impressions count, and you're sure to impress with this splendid rack on your cranium. For best results, wax the antlers to keep them smooth and shiny.

383.name: Feathered Bycoket Cap
383.description: Do you see yourself as a jaunty forest outlaw, plundering the rich and then making fools of the Town Guard as you escape into the nearby woods? Swashbuckle away with a quip, a song, and this devil-may-care Feathered Bycoket Cap!

384.name: Bull Antelope Tricorne
384.description: The brash and extravagant Bull Antelope Tricorne is a favorite among Minotaur fanciers, Nord berserkers, and the Undaunted, who have little use for subtlety. It's a hat that says, "Back off, buddy." (Or perhaps, "Let's play ring-toss!")

385.name: Silvenari Felt Bycoket
385.description: This bycoket is the dashing felt cap worn by the Silvenar's Own Jaqspurs, the famous archers who form the personal guard of the Bosmer "Voice of the People." Under the Aldmeri Dominion, this elite unit has recently been revived by the latest Silvenar.

387.hint: Unlocked by completing the Litany of Blood achievement.
387.name: Cadaverous Assassin
387.description: "Yea, those brothers and sisters who have spoken the Litany of Blood may thereafter walk as Cadaverous Assassins, striking fear of loathsome death into the hearts of all who behold them."

389.name: Box of Forbidden Relics
389.description: Perform the Black Sacrament after completing all of the Black Sacrament contract achievements to receive a Box of Forbidden Relics.
389.hint: Acquired by successfully attaining the Flawless Sacrament achievement and performing the Black Sacrament.

390.name: Blade of the Blood Oath
390.description: Perform a blood oath as the Bane of the Gold Coast to receive the Blade of the Blood Oath.
390.hint: Acquired by attaining the title of Bane of the Gold Coast and performing a blood oath.

391.name: Sep Adder
391.description: These flying vipers have short tempers and nasty dispositions, but just look at those cute crimson eyes! Some of them can even be trained not to inject poison when they bite. The perfect pet!

392.name: Heartland Brindle Badger
392.description: Native to the Cyrodilic Heartland, the Brindle Badger is said to be as fierce as a wolverine, yet as cunning as a fox. A Brindle Badger adorned the banners of King Hrol when he led his knights on the Quest of Sancre Tor.

393.name: M'aiq the Badger
393.description: How did this one become a so-handsome copperback Badger? M'aiq will tell you. One day near Balmora he met two Telvanni wizards, one of whom said, "Everything I tell you is true," while the other said, "Everything I tell you is a lieâ¦."

394.name: Black Cat
394.description: This black cat knows things you cannot know, and sees things you cannot see. But that is the nature of all black cats, is it not?

395.name: Kagouti
395.description: Domesticating the savage Kagouti to serve as a mount is a recent endeavor, and to be frank, more than a little experimental. Do you have what it takes to stay in the saddle on one of these fierce, bipedal reptiles?

396.name: Allaria Erwen the Exporter
396.description:
This free-spirited merchant is happy to join your adventures and take excess loot off your hands; however, Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds are too bloody for her liking.

When summoned, she will purchase any non-stolen goods you or your groupmates offer her.

397.name: Cassus Andronicus the Mercenary
397.description:
This severe mercenary is duty bound to guard your possessions with his life. Unless you're in Cyrodiil or the Battlegroundsâhis contract explicitly excludes travel there.

When summoned, his banking services are available to you and your groupmates.

398.name: Abah's Watch Turban
398.description: Feel dapper yet cool under the desert sun by donning the Abah's Watch Turban, the head-wrapping of the stylish Hew's Bane guards!

399.name: Abah's Watch Turban with Mask
399.description: At your next desert soiree, be stylish yet mysterious, intriguing and tantalizing, by combining the Abah's Watch Turban with a feature-concealing mask.

400.name: Storm Atronach Horse
400.description: Summoned from the plane of Levinace, the Storm Atronach Horse is a Daedric mount of majesty and terror, ready to appear in Tamriel whenever called to your service.

401.hint: Acquired by being an ESO Plus Subscriber.
401.name: Costume Dyeing
401.description: Unlocks the ability to dye your Costume and Hat Collectibles with any Dye you've unlocked. This can be done at any Dye Station, found in many large cities.

402.name: Storm Atronach Guar
402.description: By modifying Koron's Peremptory Summons, the standard spell used to call atronachs from Oblivion, the conjurer can compel a Daedra to assume the form of a common Tamrielic mountâeven a Guar, if so desired!

403.name: Storm Atronach Senche
403.description: It is said the great conjurer Corvus Direnni was the first to compel a Storm Atronach to assume the form of a great cat, and shocked all Balfiera Island by riding around its shores on a crackling Storm Atronach Senche!

404.name: Storm Atronach Camel
404.description: The Altmer wizard Corvus Direnni astounded High King Ar-Azal of Hammerfell by conjuring a Storm Atronach that assumed the form of a horseâbut when Ar-Azal tried to stump him by commanding he summon a Storm Atronach Camel, Corvus Direnni instantly did so!

405.name: Storm Atronach Bear
405.description: According to Nord legend, in his wars against the Snow Elves the mighty Ysgramor the Harbinger rode a Storm Atronach Bear Mount conjured for him by his personal Clever Man.

406.name: Clouded Senche-Leopard Cub
406.description: Of all the varieties of wild senche-cats, the Clouded Leopard may be the most beautiful. Their cubs love to play-fight, and stalk tiny bugs with the most hilariously serious expressions.

407.name: Hedge Wizard's Claw Cap
407.description: Hedge Wizards, those itinerant folk-mages who cast minor spells for farmers and peasants, garner respect by wearing gear that's just a bit outrageous and intimidatingâlike the Claw Cap favored by the Hoodoo Tinkers of the Dragontail Mountains.

408.name: Traditional Wizard's Cowl
408.description: When you're a mage, sometimes it's important to be able to peer out with menace and mystery from beneath the drooping rim of your stitched leather Wizard's Cowl. Otherwise, how will the common herd know you're a master of magicka?

409.name: "Clever Man" Wizard Hat
409.description: In the traveling comedy troupes of Tamriel, the recurring mage character is known as Fantasticus the Clever Man, and he wears the signature broad-brimmed pointy hat that just says "wizard" to the average citizen.

410.name: Dwarf-Style Mage's Hat
410.description: This Dwarven-themed conical wizard hat and goggles is offered this season by Jork, the famous Tailor-Thane of Windhelm. "If the Dwarves were still around, and if Dwarves had wizards, I bet this is just what they'd wear!" says the irrepressible Jork.

411.name: Fibonaccus Spiral Hat
411.description: The Cheydinhal wizard Fibonaccus was renowned for both his exploit in animating the mermaid statue of Anvil, and for his conical hat that twisted into a spiral. It's said that when Fibonaccus was surprised, the hat would unfurl and stand straight up!

412.name: Imperial Mananaut Cap & Goggles
412.description: This fanciful take on the cap and goggles of the legendary Imperial Mananauts, adapted by Diocletia of Skingrad from an old engraving, is this season's must-have item for fashionable wizards of the Mages Guild.

413.name: Alliance Rider Hood
413.description:
Wear the Alliance Rider Hood and proudly display your army's bold heraldic symbol, whether it's the Eagle, the Lion, or the Dragon!

|cFFFFFFAppearance is specific to your character's alliance.|r

|cff0000This collectible is not dyeable.|r

414.name: Dominion Topaz Circlet
414.description: Proven heroes of the Aldmeri Dominion may wear upon their brow this silvery circlet, adorned with a single, central yellow topaz.

415.name: Dominion Topaz Coronet
415.description: Argonian heroes of the Aldmeri Dominion may wear upon their brow this silvery coronet, adorned with a single, central yellow topaz.

428.name: Four-Spike Wattle
428.description: The Four-Spike Wattle is an arrangement of throat spines particularly popular on the coastal shores of Thornmarsh.

429.name: Sailor's Squid Goatee
429.description: The double-waxed "Squid Goatee" is a favorite of the dapper sailors of Tamriel's southern coasts.

430.name: Talon Veil
430.description: The so-called "Talon Veil" is worn by Cat-Folk who have passed the dangerous initiation rites of a Khajiiti hunting club.

431.name: Lizard Rhinoceros
431.description: Even more legendary than the unicorn is that imaginary two-horned beast called the rhinoceros. Live the legend with Lizard Rhinoceros horns!

432.name: Roostertail Frills
432.description: What could seem more adventurous than looking like you're always marching into a stiff headwind? Big frills for big thrills!

433.name: Short-Spiked Crest
433.description: If you've always wanted to look like the teeth of a circular saw were erupting from your cranium, this is the style for you. Get serious.

434.name: Wavy Triple Braided Updo
434.description: Inspired by the mesas and buttes of southern Hammerfell, this updo is a striking look for your next semi-formal affair.

435.name: Long Wild Locks
435.description: Who's got the hair that drives 'em wild when playing tavern bard at the inn? You do.

436.name: The Heroic Poet
436.description: Oh, you romantic devil, tossing off quatrains and epigrams as you charge into battle to defend the underdog! You know who you are, and this is your hair.

437.name: Covenant Lion Circlet
437.description: Proven heroes of the Daggerfall Covenant may wear upon their brow this silvery circlet with a central, roaring lion.

438.name: Long Foregathered Mane
438.description: This feline warriors' favorite consists of a handsome long mane, gathered in three places by turquoise-studded pewter clasps. Fierce but not entirely informal.

439.name: Pumpkin Spectre Mask
439.description: It's a Witches Festival tradition to masquerade as Hollowjack the Pumpkin Spectre, menacing the adults and mock-frightening the timid. If that sounds like fun to you, this mask is just what you're looking for.

440.name: Scarecrow Spectre Mask
440.description: Folk all across Tamriel know that during the Witches Festival you don't linger near the harvested fields, lest the Scarecrow Spectre come and take your head. Now you can masquerade as this legendary bogeyman!

441.name: Jhunal's Owl Mask
441.description: Wise-Wing the Owl is associated in northern Tamriel with the god Jhunal or Julianos. During the Witches Festival she is said to warn the unwary away from graveyards and witches' covens where they may come to harm.

442.name: Rajhin's Cat Mask
442.description: During the Witches Festival, no one perpetrates more cunning and devious tricks than Rajhin the Footpad, the Purring Liar. This mask enables you to adopt one of the many faces of that consummate trickster.

443.name: Hist Guar
443.description: In Black Marsh this mount is called Scales-Seem-Daubed-with-Hist-Sap, but the rest of Tamriel just calls it the Hist Guar. It is the only subspecies of guar known to enjoy music.

444.name: Aurbical Symbols
444.description: Mystical body markings express your connection to the magicka essence of Nirn.

445.name: The Aurbic Eye
445.description: Mystical markings for your facial features to emphasize your anima essence.

446.name: Wings of the Wind Goddess
446.description: Wings on back and breast express your reverence for the divine spirits of the wind.

447.name: Winged Brows
447.description: Wings on your brows express your reverence for the divine spirits of the wind.

448.name: Mystic Geometries
448.description: As on the skin of the sky, so on the skin of the votary: display the Mystic Geometries on your own mortal worldskin.

449.name: Zyggazag
449.description: Let the zyggazag on your features display your arcane connection to the Mystic Geometries of the Aurbis!

450.name: Enveloping Scales
450.description: A full body marking that emulates a near-complete second set of scaley-skinned armor.

451.name: Chevron Head Paint
451.description: What is a chevron but a standing wave in the River of Life? Stay moist with this head tattoo.

452.name: Chevron Slashmarks
452.description: Like standing waves in the flow of the River, the Chevron Slashmarks show where you stand in the current of life.

453.name: Chevron Headwrap
453.description: Adorn your cranium with the standing waves in the River of Life.

454.name: Square Spiral Fractal
454.description: Applying the Laws of the Hist to the chaotic life of the marsh is called Squaring the Spiral.

455.name: Squarejaw Headwrap
455.description: Square the spiral with a cranial display of mystical tattoos!

456.name: Dark Crescent Moons
456.description: Khajiiti who wear the Dark Moons tattoos may be displaying a preference for unrestrained behavior.

457.name: Dark Moons Headwrap
457.description: To show the Dark Moons on one's features often indicates defiance of social conventions.

458.name: Lunar Orbit Lattice
458.description: Acknowledge the rule of the Moons Jone and Jode over all things Khajiiti with the Lunar Lattice markings.

459.name: Lunar Lattice Headwrap
459.description: Acknowledge the rule of the Moons Jone and Jode over all things Khajiiti with the Lunar Lattice markings.

460.name: Shadow Striping
460.description: Body markings that resemble the mottled shadows of light filtering through the Elsweyr jungles.

461.name: Shadow Stripe Headwrap
