461.description: Head markings that resemble the mottled shadows of light filtering through the Elsweyr jungles.

462.name: Fine Upstanding Spines
462.description: Erect the spines of high fashion! And add in a couple of upturned petite nose horns to seal the deal. Xuth!

463.name: The Tousled Bard
463.description: What could be more romantic than a Khajiiti singing poetâwith hair to match?

464.name: Wrestler's Buzz Cut
464.description: Some warriors just want to keep it short, simple, and serious. Deadly serious.

465.name: Warrior Topknots
465.description: If one topknot isn't enough to express how tough you are, how about two dozen? That'll show 'em.

466.name: Portside Shave
466.description: Shaved to port, with a radical comb-over to starboard. You look like you mean business, soldier.

467.name: Crest with Pony Braid
467.description: This topknot crest descending into a triple-wrapped braided ponytail is both warlike and practical, and is often worn by those soldiers who worship Alkosh, the Dragon-Cat.

468.name: Wrapped Horsetail
468.description: Gather your flowing mane into a single towering topknot with the Wrapped Horsetail, a favorite among officers and bandit leaders.

470.name: Short Mussed Wave
470.description: With a head of hair this awesome, who needs braids, beads, or wraps? Those curls are strictly au naturel.

471.name: Azure Brow-to-Temple Circlet
471.description: This exquisite metal circlet features a bright blue azure proudly mounted on the wearer's brow.

472.name: Spiny Lashes
472.description: Radical extended eyelid spines are au courant for the fashionable Saxhleel in Helstrom this season! Just don't blink when you're kissing someone.

473.name: Subtle Dark Lashes
473.description: When you want to emphasize your lovely eyes without going overboard on something like exotic or stage makeup, Subtle Dark Lashes are just the right touch.

474.name: Long Patriarch Beard
474.description: A long beard curled with the wisdom of years confers authority on any face, regardless of age.

475.name: Tousled Temple Tufts
475.description: Hey, kitten, what's sexier than that just-got-out-of-bed look â¦ on tufts of hair in front of your ears? Nothing, that's what. (If you're a Khajiit.)

476.name: Haj Mota Hatchling
476.description: Though it may some day grow into a horrific face-eating behemoth, when it's young the Haj Mota Hatchling is undeniably cute. For a while, they are trainable, come when called, and happily waddle after their masters wherever they may go.

477.name: Desert Lynx
477.description: The Desert Lynx, or caracal lynx, is native to south central Tamriel, roaming the savannahs from Corinthe in Elsweyr as far north as West Weald in Cyrodiil. It's the totem animal of the pastoral Khajiiti tribes, and assists with managing the herds.

478.name: Infernal Sep Adder
478.description: Though it may look like it just crawled from the depths of the Deadlands, the Infernal Sep Adder is actually native to the higher altitudes of Hammerfell. As pets, they are â¦ not affectionate. Great conversation starters, though.

479.name: Witchmother's Whistle
479.description: Use this whistle to summon the Witchmother's Cauldron. During the harvest, drinking the cauldron's brew may have additional effects.
479.hint: Obtained by completing the Witches Festival event.

480.name: Covenant Lion Coronet
480.description: Argonian heroes of the Daggerfall Covenant may wear upon their brow this silvery coronet with a central, roaring lion.

481.hint: Acquired by completing the "Ruins of Mazzatun Challenger" achievement.
481.name: Amber Plasm
481.description: Proudly display your victory in Mazzatun with this daub of glowing and magically-infused amber plasm!

482.hint: Acquired by completing the "Cradle of Shadows Challenger" achievement.
482.name: Spiderkith
482.description: Kissed by spider, Spiderkith, Daedric legend, tale, and myth!

483.name: Dark Moons Lynx
483.description: The Khajiit of Corinthe believe the all-black Dark Moons Lynx is the worldly incarnation of Southpaw, the feline companion to Rajhin the Footpad, god of thieves. It's said Southpaw keeps watch while Rajhin is breaking and entering.

484.name: Dwarven War Dog
484.description: This loyal beast has been trained for warfare, and will stick with you through every kind of conflict. As a bonus, it comes outfitted in ancient Dwarven dog armor, canine barding as durable today as it was when it was first made many centuries in the past.

489.name: Pact Dragonclaw Circlet
489.description: Proven heroes of the Ebonheart Pact may wear upon their brow this majestic circlet surmounted by silvery Dragon claws.

490.name: Pact Dragonclaw Coronet
490.description: Argonian heroes of the Ebonheart Pact may wear upon their brow this majestic coronet surmounted by silvery Dragon claws.

491.name: Cradle of Shadows
491.description: The Argonians of the Dark Brotherhood need your help against a cadre of rogue assassins who threaten to hurl all Black Marsh into bloody chaos. Fight your way into the Cradle of Shadows to uncloak the secrets of the twisted Silken Ring!

492.name: No Hair Style
492.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

493.name: Small Averted Spines
493.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

494.name: The Spines of Welcome
494.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

495.name: Dual Forehead Horns
495.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

496.name: Widespread Cranial Spikes
496.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

497.name: Spiky Cranial Cluster
497.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

498.name: Anterior Antlers
498.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

499.name: Six-Spike Parietal Array
499.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

500.name: Spiky Sweptback Updo
500.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

501.name: Daedra Horns with Spike Cluster
501.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

502.name: Fore-and-Aft Webbed Spike Crest
502.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

503.name: Tall Dual Web Crests
503.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

504.name: Maximum Frisee
504.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

505.name: Frisee Pouffee
505.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

506.name: Spiked Frisee
506.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

507.name: Triple Web Crest
507.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

508.name: Quadratic Web Crest
508.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

509.name: Four Sheathed Spikes
509.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

510.name: Modest Dual Crests
510.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

511.name: Cranial Spine Cluster
511.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

512.name: Dual Hind Horns
512.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

513.name: Central Spine Crest
513.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

514.name: Outrigger Side Spikes
514.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

515.name: Broad Web Ears
515.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

516.name: Coil with Ring Braids
516.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

517.name: Coil with Long Fall
517.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

518.name: Braided Ponytail
518.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

519.name: Left-Parted Bob
519.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

520.name: Long and Combed Back
520.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

521.name: Pulled Back Curl Cluster
521.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

522.name: Leftside Bun Twist
522.description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

523.name: Tight Braided Crown

584.name: Dragonfly Wing Lashes
584.description: A touch of bright and exotic iridescence draws all eyes to your eyes, for a lash adornment that is pure magicka.

585.name: Long Glitter Lashes
585.description: Long, luscious golden lashes gilded with glistening glitter glamorously glorify your glowing gaze.

586.name: Dark Shaman
586.description: Far from town, temple, and market, those of ill intent meet in secret conclave to importune the forces of darkness for power and mastery. Behold here the dire raiment they don for this fell purpose.

587.name: Belly Dancer Veil
587.description: This pearl-encrusted, beaded veil masks the features of those ritual belly dancers who perform in Hammerfell and Tamriel's south.

588.name: Jawbone Blades
588.description: You'll get the respect you deserve down at the Staymoist Tavern when you walk in sporting these aggressive Jawbone Blades. Look out, dryskins!

589.name: Feathered Headdress
589.description: Why bother with spines or spikes when your skull can sprout a fountain of feathers? You'll be the fanciest lizard in the mud-wallow.

590.name: Long Elven Braid
590.description: There's always been a lot of cultural interchange between the Wood Elves and the Catfolk, and it even shows up in their hairstyles, as in the popular Long Elven Braid style.

591.name: Great Elk
591.description:
Though the Reachmen of Markarth say they were the first to successfully domesticate the Great Elk of Skyrim and break them as mounts, the Nords of Haafingar say it was really all their idea.
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

592.name: Dozen-Banded Vvardvark
592.description: This creature, unusually cute for a denizen of Vvardenfell, is a newcomer to the island whose home and origin are unknownâunless the rumors are true that it's a hybrid born from the magical laboratories of the Telvanni.

593.name: Morrowind
593.description: A dread shadow hangs over Morrowind, portending doom even as Red Mountain shudders and quakes. Travel to Vvardenfell and aid the priests of Vivec in this new region full of prophecy, Dark Elf rivalries, and ancient traditions.

594.name: Storm Atronach Aura
594.description: Clothe yourself in the Aura of the Storm with this memento of Daedric summoning!

595.name: Storm Orb Juggle
595.description: Do you want to juggle a Storm Atronach's internal organs? Dumb questionâof COURSE you want to juggle a Storm Atronach's internal organs.

596.name: Storm Atronach Transform
596.description: Assume the semblance of a mighty Storm Atronach with this transformation memento! Just be sure to hold onto your rocks.

597.name: Sword-Swallower's Blade
597.description: This trusty blade is unworthy of combat, but harmless when swallowed.

598.name: Juggler's Knives
598.description: These trusty knives are weighted to be poor for throwing in combat, but excellent for catching and juggling.

600.name: Fire-Breather's Torches
600.description: Quite a harmless, but earnest, display of largesse and lung capacity - feel free to spew fire everywhere!

601.name: Mud Ball Pouch
601.description: A seemingly endless supply of mud balls, ready for tossing at unsuspecting targets.

602.name: Fire Rock
602.description: When used near a friendly strangler, can cause the plant to pull you to its location.
602.hint: Obtained by assisting the Dead-Water tribe in Murkmire.

603.name: Duchess
603.description: "One may have to associate with individuals of low degree, but that's no reason for vulgar behavior, indelicate gestures, or poor posture. Class always tells, don't you think?" âDuchess Olivie Delrusc

604.name: Commander
604.description: "A commander must project confidence and mastery, or no one will want to obey her orders. Behave as if you're the one making the rules, not following them. Walk like you own the place, and stand like an Emperor." âMagus-General Septima Tharn

605.name: Thief
605.description: "If you're going to sneak, for the love of Tava don't do it half-heartedly. Hide! Be furtive! Lurk like you mean it! Because I'm done bailing you out of the Abah's Watch lock-up." âZeira of the Thieves Guild

606.name: Dominion Warrior Head Tattoos
606.description: Proven warriors of the Aldmeri Dominion are entitled to display these striking head tattoos on skull and jawbone.

607.name: Cobalt Sep Adder
607.description: The blue-scaled Cobalt Sep Adder is the rarest of the wild varieties, and almost never seen in captivity. They are particularly prized by the royalty of Hammerfell's contentious city-states, as they're said to be able to detect poison in drinks and food.

608.name: Storm Atronach Wolf
608.description: The Storm Atronach Wolf was the favored mount of the notorious Hjeimar the Heinous, a wizard who lived in a remote tower north of Bruma, who rode his when leading his Goblin Fiends in raids on the nearby valleys.

609.name: Black Senche-Lion
609.description: The legendary preferred mount of Elsweyr's greatest thieves, the most famous Black Senche-Lion of all was Rajhin's mount Umbrage, which could both talk and, for brief periods, fly!

610.name: Dominion Warrior Body Tattoos
610.description: Proven warriors of the Aldmeri Dominion are entitled to display these striking body tattoos from neck to ankle.

611.name: Pact Warrior Face Tattoos
611.description: Proven warriors of the Ebonheart Pact are entitled to display these striking face tattoos denoting their heroism.

612.name: Pact Warrior Body Tattoos
612.description: Proven warriors of the Ebonheart Pact are entitled to display these striking body tattoos from neck to ankle.

613.name: Covenant Warrior Face Tattoos
613.description: Proven warriors of the Daggerfall Covenant are entitled to display these striking face tattoos denoting their heroism.

614.name: Covenant Warrior Body Tattoos
614.description: Proven warriors of the Daggerfall Covenant are entitled to display these striking body tattoos from neck to ankle.

615.name: Covenant War-Locks
615.description: Going to war may mean donning a helm, but beneath it an honored Covenant warrior is entitled to wear these official Alliance War-Locks, which keep long hair under control while still looking superb.

616.name: Covenant Lizard-Plumes
616.description: Going to war may mean donning a helm, but beneath it an Argonian Covenant warrior is entitled to wear these official Alliance Lizard-Plumes, which keep out of a helmet's way while still looking superb.

617.name: Pact Veteran's Battle Crest
617.description: Going to war may mean donning a helm, but beneath it an honored Pact warrior is entitled to wear this official Alliance Battle Crest, which keeps hair under control while still looking superb.

618.name: Pact Lizard Battle Crest
618.description: Going to war may mean donning a helm, but beneath it an Argonian Pact warrior is entitled to wear this official Alliance Battle Crest, which keeps spines under control while still looking superb.

619.name: New Life Festival Cap
619.description: Celebrate the turning of the year and the return of Magnus the Sun in this festive New Life cap. With a bobbing ball of fur on the end of its tapering blue velvet wimple, everyone will know you're the life of the festival!

620.name: Sun's Dusk Winter Hood
620.description: You'll be toasty warm even in Sun's Dusk with this festive furry hood, crowned with a spray of lucky mistletoe that will make you welcome everywhere!

739.description:
When the Empire of Cyrodiil was at its height, the Imperial Legion Cavalry rode these chalk-white chargers into battle beneath the red diamond banner. 
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

740.name: Arctic Fennec Fox
740.description: The Arctic Fennec is native to the snowy shores of Skyrim's Sea of Ghosts, and the local Nords, when they spot one romping in the drifts, respond with the traditional oath of "Shor's Ears!"

741.name: Dusky Fennec Fox
741.description: The Dusky or Midnight Fennec Fox is native to the high savannah of Northern Elsweyr, and is often domesticated by nomadic tribes of Khajiit.

742.name: Tuxedo Bear
742.description: Though the famed bard Svaknir wrote a hilarious song in which the Tuxedo was mocked as "the Chub Loon of Bears," this magnificent ursine mount has been esteemed by Nord nobles since the early First Era.

743.name: Senche-Tiger Cub
743.description: It's a striped Senche-Tiger Cub. What more could you need to know? "Ah," you ask, "but is it magical?" Just look in those eyes for your answer.

745.name: Black Senche-Panther Kitten
745.description: "Rajhin the Purring Liar had so many shadows that some of them took on lives of their own, becoming black senche-panthers who stalk freely through Elsweyrâjust like this kitten that plays with my tail." âClan Mother Ahnissi

746.name: Dro-m'Athra Senche Cub
746.description: Combine Adorable with Abominable, and what do you get? The dro-m'Athra Senche Cub, the cutest thing ever to come out of the Dark Behind the World. Dance, kitten, dance!

749.name: Senche-Leopard Cub
749.description: The senche-leopard is one of the most feared predators of the Tenmar Forest in central Elsweyr, but if one of its adorable cubs can be adopted when young, it makes a fiercely loyal companion.

750.name: Striped Senche-Panther Cub
750.description: Striped senche-panthers are popular mascots of the Baandari Pedlars of Elsweyr. Incredibly adorable as cubs, even when small they can be trained like magpies to fetch shiny things back to their masters.

751.name: New Life Monk's Cap
751.description: For those who wish to celebrate New Life without tawdry and garish display, we offer this more modest festival hat, well suited to monks, simple merchants, and holy knights vowed to poverty. Because New Life is for everyone!

752.name: Ascadian Cliff Strider
752.description: This bluish breed of Vvardenfell aerial reptile, known as the Azure or Ascadian Cliff Strider, is prized by flying-lizard fanciers as the prettiest and most ornamental of its species. Bonus: its screech terrifies crying babies into silence.

753.name: Nordic Bather's Towel
753.description: This bathing costume keeps you modest in all climates, whether the Abecean Sea or a hot spring in Skyrim.

754.name: Colovian Filigreed Hood
754.description: The fine filigree on this Colovian fur hood helps you stand out in the crowd. Certain to keep your head warm!

755.name: Colovian Fur Hood
755.description: A Colovian fur hood, double-stitched and plain.

756.name: No Major Adornment
756.description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

757.name: No Minor Adornment
757.description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

758.name: Floral Swirl Aura
758.description: Invoke a temporary aura of the Wild Hunt: use this memento to cause spectral leaves to swirl around you while flowers bloom at your feet.

759.name: Wild Hunt Transform
759.description: Invoke the power of the Wild Hunt with this transformation memento. By bough and by leaf, a spriggan you'll be!

760.name: Wild Hunt Leaf-Dance Aura
760.description: Invoke a temporary aura of the Wild Hunt: use this memento to cause mystical leaves to dance and twirl around you.

761.name: Craglorn Welwa
761.description: Credit for the irresponsible and foolhardy project of domesticating the Craglorn Welwa is usually claimed by the Iron Orcs, who are always looking for ways to prove that they're "more bad-tusk" than the Orcs of Wrothgar or Skyrim.

762.name: Great Dark Stag
762.description:
The Great Dark Stag is one of the five Aspects of Hircine, invoked as Uricanbeg, "whose hooves drum the Blood Summons."
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

763.name: Nightfall Sabre Cat
763.description:
The Reachmen of the upper Karth valley, who train them as mounts, swear that the Nightfall variant is sacred to the Daedric Prince Nocturnal.
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

764.name: Sabre Cat Cub
764.description: Sabre Cats are mighty and majestic hunters that rule the northern plains and tundra by sheer strength and savageryâbut, Daedra take it, they sure are cute when they're cubs!

765.name: Nightfall Sabre Cat Cub
765.description: "In my first months as a captive of the Reachmen, the only thing that made life bearable was my beloved pet, the Nightfall Sabre Cat Cub I was allowed as a companion." âArthenice Belloq

766.name: Black Morthal Mastiff
766.description: Bull Mastiffs from Morthal in Skyrim are fearless and tireless hunters inured to the hardships of the frozen marshes. The black ones are particularly popular with mages and alchemists.

767.name: Tan Morthal Mastiff
767.description: Bull Mastiffs from Morthal in Skyrim are fearless and tireless hunters inured to the hardships of the frozen marshes. The tan variety is a favorite with scouts, hunters, and trackers.

768.name: Gray Morthal Mastiff
768.description: Bull Mastiffs from Morthal in Skyrim are fearless and tireless hunters inured to the hardships of the frozen marshes. The gray breed are quite popular with rogues, thieves, and (incongruously) priests.

769.name: Hearthfire Hatchling
769.description: Hearthfire Hatchlings, which are found only in an orphaned state, appear to be the offspring of a normal kagouti and one of the Hearthfire variety. Driven away by ordinary kagouti, these hatchlings are in grave need of adoption.

770.name: Bi-Color Coxcomb Cap
770.description: Even fools and jesters have a hierarchyâonly the best-looking or most aristocratic are entitled to call themselves Coxcombs and wear the coveted Bi-Color Cap! Do you think you qualify?

771.name: Fool's Cap and Masque
771.description: By tradition, after it's over no one mentions the high jinks that took place during the Jester's Festival, but some shy or reserved folks still prefer not to be recognized during the shenanigans. For them we have the Fool's Cap and Masque!

772.name: Ass-Ears Jester Cap
772.description: Back in the First Era, fools and harlequins used to wear actual donkey ears on their hats as symbols of their profession. Over time the floppy ears have become merely symbolic, but the Ass-Ears Jester Cap is still charmingly goofy.

773.name: Jester
773.description: Whether you're feeling flamboyant and theatrical, or just ready to jape and jeer at the world, adopt the mocking mannerisms of the Jester and poke some fun at those who take life too seriously. Time to yuk it up!

774.name: Deadlands Firewalker
774.description: You wandered the turbulent landscape of the Deadlands and proved your strength. Flame is now your feisty partner instead of a deadly foe, ready to face whatever grueling challenges Oblivion has to offer.

775.name: Scholar
775.description: Ever notice how everyone in Tamriel keeps a journal? Now you can show the world that you're making your own scholarly record of your adventures and the deeds of those around you. Perhaps the pen IS mightier than the sword.

776.name: Dread Anka-Ra
776.description: When Emperor Tarish-Zi returned out of the mists of the past, his ancient warriors rose from the dead to serve him as the stony Anka-Ra, undead that seemed hewn from rock itself. â¦It could be a good look for you.

777.name: Flannel Forester's Hood
777.description: Just because your headwear serves as woodland camouflage, that doesn't mean it can't be comfy-warm!

778.name: Forester's Hood with Berries
778.description: It's festival time! Spruce up your woodland hood with some bright leaves and berries.

779.name: Forester's Hood with Flower
779.description: A red flower pinned to the left side of your hood means you're on a wild huntâfor shenanigans!

780.name: 12-Point Antler Skullcap
780.description: The rank of a Hunter of Hircine is said to be marked by the number of points on his cap's antlers. Plus they're always prepared for a game of ring-toss!

781.name: 14-Point Antler Skullcap
781.description: For when twelve points just aren't enough! But watch those low doorways, scout.

782.name: Wild Hunt Antler Skullcap
782.description: The writhing antlers of this fearsome cap resemble curling claws caught in the midst of a horrific Wild Hunt tranformation!

783.name: Wild Hunt Rootbrim Hat
783.description: The curling roots and vines that wrap the rim of this hat represent the swirling power of the Wild Hunt unleashed.

784.name: Moth Priest
784.description: "The priests of the Ancestor Moth are devoted to veneration of those who came before us, for the wisdom of the ancestors can sing the future into the present. As such, we alone have the privilege of interpreting the Elder Scrolls." âSister Terran Arminus

785.name: Ancestor Moth Swarm
785.description: "The Ancestor Moths that accompany some mystically-attuned mortals are more than mere insectsâthey are animated by the loving spirits of the dearly departed, and may grant wisdom and awareness to those they visit." âSister Terran Arminus

786.name: Devoted Torchbug
786.description: The Wood Elves say that to be followed by a friendly Torchbug is an infallible sign of good fortune. Of course, they also catch them, dry them out, and smoke them in pipes.

787.name: Horned Brow Plate
787.description: Feeling Daedric? Get Oblivious with the Horned Brow Plateânow with faux rivets!

788.name: Head Horns Aplenty
788.description: You could put horns on top of your head, but everybody does thatâonly the truly original would think to put them on their chin!

789.name: Feather Brows of Mystery
789.description: Are you an adept of arcane lore? An initiate into esoteric secrets? A master of martial mayhem? Show your mastery with the Feather Brows of Mystery!

790.name: Coral Snake Nose Ring
790.description: When you want your left nostril to say, "I am elegant but dangerous," this is the accessory you're looking for!

791.name: Goldenwing Circlet
791.description: A circlet of beaten gold influenced by the winged chevrons worn by the Nord priesthood of Kyne.

792.name: Golden Brow Wing
792.description: A golden wing on the forehead bespeaks an Argonian who looks up from the mud to behold the sky.

793.name: Sabre Cat Ear-Fang
793.description: The sabre-teeth of northern Tamriel's great hunting cats make truly imposing earrings!

794.name: Sabre Cat Brow Spike
794.description: Though Sabre Cats aren't native to Black Marsh, Argonians have long admired their fangs. They import them to use as adornments.

795.name: Barred Feather Horns
795.description: Julianos' avian companion, Wise-Wing, is usually represented as a barred owl, so wearing barred owl tail-feathers often bespeaks devotion to the God of Wisdom.

796.name: Shaman's Bird-Bone Circlet
796.description: Sometimes you just feel barbaric, and then only wearing a naked bird-skull on your forehead will do.

797.name: Bird Skull Brow Bauble
797.description: "Yes, I like to wear a skull on my skull. More skulls are always better than fewer, are they not?" âAdzi-Loh

1040.name: Plum Color Eyeshadow
1040.description: Give your eyes a touch of the exotic with Plum Color Eyeshadow, a favorite of the Wood Elves of Silvenar.

1041.name: Bronze Color Eyeshadow
1041.description: Bronze Eyeshadow is popular around the shores of the Abecean Sea, where they are felt to give one a certain gravitas.

1042.name: Azure Feather Eyelashes
1042.description: This exotic eyewear is most often associated with priestesses of sky deities like Tava, Kyne, and Kynareth.

1043.name: Amethyst Eyelashes
1043.description: These extravagant lashes are said to have been inspired by the hypnagogic gaze of the Lamia Mesmera.

1044.name: Eight-Fang Nose Chain
1044.description: You're a member of the Undauntedâyou don't need a reason.

1046.name: Rotmeth Hangover Bed-Head
1046.description: You probably shouldn't have had that last flagon, but Daedra take it! Life's too short to worry.

1047.name: Mane-of-Many-Rivers
1047.description: This hairstyle honors the goddess Khenarthi in her agricultural aspect as The Gatherer of Waters.

1048.name: Feathered Kelp-Scalp
1048.description: Seaweed head-feathers were first popularized by the aquatic hunter Lurks-in-Murk of Helstrom.

1049.name: Mid-Parted Shoulder-Length
1049.description: A classic traditional look, popular with every race on Tamriel (if they have hair instead of spines).

1050.name: Fluttering Forehead Feathers
1050.description: "As an archer, I like to have a windvane right on my noggin," says Tlaxal-Hei of Thorn.

1051.name: The Casual Rascal
1051.description: Everyone knows somebody who wears this head of hair: they may lead you into mischief, but you know you'll have a good time.

1052.name: Multi-Spined Skull Crest
1052.description: This menacing look is a favorite of surly teen-aged Argonians in the more unsavory parts of Gideon.

1053.name: Uricanbeg Antler Tattoos
1053.description: These body markings are sacred to the Aspect of Hircine known as Uricanbeg the Great Stag, and are often worn by hunters who cull the forest's herd animals.

1054.name: Wyrd Root Tattoos
1054.description: This set of body markings is common among the wyresses of the woodland covens and the forest scouts who hunt for them.

1055.name: Wild Vines' Embrace Tattoos
1055.description: Those dedicated to the worship of Y'ffre will often adopt the Wild Vines' Embrace markings as a sign of their devotion to the Green.

1056.name: Uricanbeg Antlers Face Tattoo
1056.description: Adherents of the Great Stag aspect of Hircine often show these Antler Bracket Face Tattoos.

1057.name: Wyrd Root Face Tattoo
1057.description: The Bramblevine face tattoos betray a dedication to the darker side of nature magic.

1058.name: Wild Vines Face Tattoo
1058.description: The sprig-and-leaves face tattoo known as the Wild Vines denotes a follower of the nature deity called Y'ffre or Jephre.

1060.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion
1060.name: Mara's Kiss Public House
1060.description:
As the least restricted seaport in the Summerset Isles, Vulkhel Guard has visitors from across Tamrielâand you're likely to meet most of them hoisting a mug at the Mara's Kiss Pub.
Room is too small for Dueling.

1061.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion
1061.name: The Rosy Lion
1061.description:
This inn has always had the reputation of being the safest place in Daggerfall for common citizens in search of illicit services to meet their shadier counterparts.
Room is too small for Dueling.

1062.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion
1062.name: The Ebony Flask Inn Room
1062.description:
The Dark Elves may not worship Dibella, but down at the cornerclubs they show that they still know how to have a good timeâin their own special way.
Room is too small for Dueling.

1063.name: Barbed Hook Private Room
1063.description:
Like every busy port, Skywatch has a seamy underside. A private room at the Barbed Hook offers easy access to the criminal classesâand a quick escape from the nearby docks.
Room is too small for Dueling.

1064.name: Sisters of the Sands Apartment
1064.description:
In Sentinel, the best way to hide out in plain sight is with a private room in the Sisters of the Sands, the town's largest inn. It also has the best food in the city, and is the place King Fahara'jad sends to for take-out.
Room is too small for Dueling.

1065.name: Flaming Nix Deluxe Garret
1065.description:
Even if you don't personally have a taste for the famous fire-pit dancing at the Flaming Nix, you have to admit it adds a certain cachet to having a room there. Not to mention an unusual fragrance.
Room is too small for Dueling.

1066.name: Black Vine Villa
1066.description: Would you want to live in an old stone house just across a dark jungle stream from a haunted Ayleid ruin? Silly questionâwho wouldn't?

1067.name: Cliffshade
1067.description: Just outside the Altmeri settlement of Marbruk, the forest is wide and open, the climate is mild, the setting idyllic: the elegant home of Cliffshade seems an abode blessed by the gods.

1068.name: Mathiisen Manor
1068.description: This elegant walled estate is truly the apogee of Altmeri architecture, including a grand entrance hall, curving double staircases, and a blossom-tree garden with circular reflecting pool.

1069.name: Humblemud
1069.description: A mud house is a constant reminder of the impermanence of life, and that we are but standing waves in the river of existence. But one still wishes it to look nice and comfortable, and decorates accordingly. Of course.

1070.name: The Ample Domicile
1070.description: "This house is a good house, plenty of room for guar! Palisade is strong to keep guar from straying, and many guar can feed in the garden! Very good, yes! Esqoo will come to visit often!" âEsqoo of Dhalmora

1071.name: Stay-Moist Mansion
1071.description: How does this spacious and comely hilltop manor, so far above the fen, nonetheless stay so delightfully damp? It is a paradox, like life itself. (Don't miss the upper-story lodging with separate entrance!)

1072.name: Snugpod
1072.description: A perfect graht-oak pod home, grown by a Home Singer from the very roots of Elden Rootâcompact, comfortable, and convenient to everything. Praise Z'en!

1073.name: Bouldertree Refuge
1073.description: When civilization grows too confining, it's a relief to be able to withdraw into a handsome home in the wildsâespecially one with an imposing wall around it, to keep out beasts and bandits.

1074.name: The Gorinir Estate
1074.description: The Gorinir family, a cadet branch of the royal Camoran line, has fallen on hard times and had to sell their palatial Cormount home. The seasons turn, luck changes, and their loss is your gain.

1075.name: Captain Margaux's Place
1075.description: The famous Breton merchant-explorer Captain Margaux hasn't been seen since her ship the Golden Spriggan sailed off over the horizon into the Sea of Pearlsâwhich makes her house near the docks in Daggerfall available for you!

1076.name: Ravenhurst
1076.description: Two floors, no waiting, in this handsome walled town house makes for prime real estate in the quaint Rivenspire town of Fell's Run. The local story that the ravens that loiter around the front steps are the revenant spirits of former owners is absurd.

1077.name: Gardner House
1077.description: The Gardners were the royal family of Wayrest before every single one of them was carried off by the Knahaten Flu. Which is why the spacious and well-situated Gardner House feels like it's fit for a king!

1078.name: Kragenhome
1078.description: This residence might not be in Kragenmoor's best neighborhood, but if you're looking for classic Dunmeri architecture at an affordable price, this town house certainly fits the bill.

1079.name: Velothi Reverie
1079.description: This charming abode was named after both the Prophet Veloth who founded the surrounding town of Narsis, and the Velothi Mountains that rise above the walled garden at its rear.

1080.name: Quondam Indorilia
1080.description: This capacious Dunmeri mansion, with its walled garden and view across a waterfall to majestic Mournhold, was originally built to house a noble family of House Indoril.

1081.name: Moonmirth House
1081.description: A small elevated house on an idyllic plantation in the mild and hospitable clime of Khenarthi's Roost? This one would find that sweet paradise!

1082.name: Sleek Creek House
1082.description: All your friends are already nearby in Rawl'kha, yes? Invite them over to have a party at your so-sleek riverside house, with its private garden and over-creek deck. Much sweetness!

1083.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Reaper's March Adventurer" Achievement
1083.name: Dawnshadow
1083.description: Ah, such a sweet estate, with every appurtenanceâout in the country, yet convenient to the nearby Khajiiti metropolis of Dune! What can one do but love and admire it?

1084.name: Cyrodilic Jungle House
1084.description: An Imperial, of course, is at home anywhere in Tamriel. This compact house at the Baandari Trading Post in Malabal Tor is a bit of Cyrodiil in Valenwood, and just steps away from the fine food and drink at the Silver Moons Inn.

1085.name: Domus Phrasticus
1085.description: No one has seen Phrastus the Scholar since his ill-advised return to the Imperial City. He's probably fineâhe must be!âbut in the meantime, his walled town house in Elinhir is available on an indefinite basis.

1086.name: Strident Springs Demesne
1086.description: This fortified manor between Arenthia and Skingrad at the headwaters of the Strid River should satisfy all those who aspire to the life of the landed gentry. Inside the gatehouse you'll find gardens, a waterfall, and a mansion in Second Empire style.

1087.name: Autumn's-Gate
1087.description: In the heart of The Rift, just outside the lively, small town of Nimalten, you will find this sturdy wooden home, with a large hearth to keep you warm in the Skyrim winter, and a stone wall to keep out the trolls.

1088.name: Grymharth's Woe
1088.description: Fine urban living in Windhelm is now available at this commodious town home, which features a lofty main floor, two fireplaces, and a second-floor balcony. Alas, that balcony lacks a railing, which is how Grymharth, after too much mead, came to woe.

1089.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"The Rift Adventurer" Achievement
1089.name: Old Mistveil Manor
1089.description: By tradition, the biggest mansion on the south side of Riften is always called Mistveil Manor. Since the death of old Thane Snelgar, the current Mistveil Estate has come available, including its impressive stone mansion with attached stable.

1090.name: Hammerdeath Bungalow
1090.description: "It may be small, but at least it's gloomy. And if you enjoy beating up on your friends, like I do, it's right next door to the arena!" âGoorguk gro-Murtag, Orcish Realtor

1091.name: Mournoth Keep
1091.description: This fortified household is strong, intimidating, and remoteâin short, everything an Orc holds dear. And if you get tired of the "remote" part, there's a convenient wayshrine just outside your gate!

1092.name: Forsaken Stronghold
1092.description: When Hakkvild drove the Orcs of Yashnag's Kingdom out of Falkreath in 2E 467, the exiled Orsimer came east to establish Forsaken Stronghold. But the last Orcs died in 563 after they were visited by a merchant infected with Knahaten Flu.

1093.name: Twin Arches
1093.description: It may be small but it's solid, and it keeps the sandstorms out. The scenery is magnificent, but if you're in the mood for civilization, it's right outside the south gate of Hallin's Stand.

1094.name: House of the Silent Magnifico
1094.description: After the death of his beloved daughter Haruzeh at the Running of the Dunerippers, the Magnifico Z'za retired to his house in Sentinel and never spoke again, spending his last days playing endless games of hammergammon with his trained monkey, Lizard.

1095.name: Hunding's Palatial Hall
1095.description: This elegant pleasure palace, with its walled grounds enclosing stables, well, gardens, pool, watchtower, and docks, were paid for by the blood and treasure spilled from the countless treasure ships taken by the legendary Captain Izad.

1096.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Hero of the Aldmeri Dominion" Achievement
1096.name: Serenity Falls Estate
1096.description: Set in a quiet corner of Reaper's March, the rural manor of Serenity Falls deserves its name, with plenty of room for servants and livestock, all behind a handsome wall to keep out the bandits and burglars.

1097.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Hero of the Daggerfall Covenant" Achievement
1097.name: Daggerfall Overlook
1097.description: Before Daggerfall Castle was built, the kingdom's rulers lived in this imposing manor, now known as Daggerfall Overlook. The keep comes complete with a lower dungeon level.

1098.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Hero of the Ebonheart Pact" Achievement
1098.name: Ebonheart Chateau
1098.description: A magnificent castle keep, complete with walls, watchtowers, well, fountain, and stable, all dramatically sited on the slopes of an active volcano! It just needs a murder, and then it will be haunted as well.

1099.name: Grand Topal Hideaway
1099.description: You probably think only the mad masterminds of vast criminal organizations have their own private tropical islands. Well, think again: you, too, could have a hidden hideaway ever-trembling on the verge of volcanic destruction!

1100.name: Earthtear Cavern
1100.description: You want privacy? What could be more private than lost and forgotten Nedic ruins in a remote corner of Craglorn's backcountry? Especially recommended for overthrown despots, retired master assassins, and Ministers of Finance exiled for embezzling.

1101.name: Ever Damp Reed-Fiber Kilt
1101.description: Now you can avoid the vexation of dry-scale thigh-chafing with the new "Ever Damp" kilt-of-reeds, available from Jaxa the Hermit in every Argonian's favorite color: mud-brown! (Though you may dye them else-wise, should such be your whim, egg-sibling.)

1102.name: Upriver Striped Sash-Kilt
1102.description: Be the best-dressed lizard in the xanmeer in this striped reed-fiber kilt with over-and-under shoulder sashes! Alternating panels of mud-brown and sandbar will say "Do you wallow? So do I!" to every Argonian you meet.

1103.name: Marshlord Formal Bugshell Robes
1103.description: For the Saxhleel who dares to scintillate, the reclusive Jaxa the Hermit presents this season's must-have formal-wear, the multi-layered Marshlord robe set, sewn with the shiny shells of thousands of tiny swamp insects!

1104.name: Rootbrim Hat with Berries
1104.description: As the swirling roots and vines symbolize the Wild Hunt, the addition of a sprig of berries represents the taming of chaos by Y'ffre.

1105.name: Rootbrim Hat with Flower
1105.description: The flower added to this hat's wild roots and vines represents the stability that followed the Great Naming.

1107.hint: Complete the challenges set forth by Jester Queen Ayrenn, Jester King Emeric, and Jester King Jorunn during the Jester's Festival.
1107.name: Crown of Misrule
1107.description: Awarded only to the most mischievous and mirthful pranksters, this jingling gold-like crown is a symbol of great status during the Jester's Festival.

1108.name: Cherry Blossom Branch
1108.description: This enchanted branch is forever blooming with vibrant cherry blossoms to pluck as one pleases.
1108.hint: This rare party favor can occasionally be found in Jester's Festival gift boxes handed out to those who complete the daily challenges issued by Jester Queen Ayrenn, Jester King Emeric, and Jester King Jorunn.

1109.name: Jubilee Cake 2017
1109.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. It's a festival for your taste buds!
1109.hint: Obtained by completing the 2017 Anniversary event.

1141.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Crypt of Hearts I.
1141.name: Bust: The Ilambris Twins
1141.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Crypt of Hearts I.

1142.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Vaults of Madness.
1142.name: Bust: Grothdarr
1142.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Vaults of Madness.

1143.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Selene's Web.
1143.name: Bust: Selene
1143.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Selene's Web.

1144.name: Molag Amur Cliff Strider
1144.description: The Molag Amur Cliff Strider is prized by reptilian connoisseurs because its coloration, though somber, is lightened by its subtle golden tones. And if startled, its squawk will cause passersby to jump and horses to bolt.

1145.name: Dwarven War Horse
1145.description:
This loyal horse has been trained for warfare, and will stick with you through every kind of conflict. As a bonus, it comes outfitted in ancient Dwarven horse armor.
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

1147.name: Milady's Cloud Cat
1147.description: White cats are sacred to Dibella, the Lady of Love, and all white cats are said to be her representatives in the animal kingdom. A House of Dibella will typically have three or four milk-white cats within its walls.

1148.name: Shadowghost Senche-Panther
1148.description: In Elsweyr, being seen in the company of an uncanny Shadowghost Senche-Panther will put one under suspicion of being a Namiira cultistâor even a disguised dro-m'Athra.

1152.name: Snowy Sabre Cat
1152.description:
Of all Tamriel's great felines, the Snowy Sabre Cat is the hardiest when it comes to winter weather, barely noticing the Atmoran gales as they come howling in across the Sea of Ghosts. 
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

1153.name: Adorable Assassin
1153.description: Knock 'em dead with this casual hairstyle popularized by the Dark Elf assassins of Morrowind.

1154.name: Assassin-Style Sunset Crest
1154.description: This season the hairstyles of the Morag Tong are all the rageâeven among the usually Dark Elf-averse Argonians!

1155.name: Dwarven Spider
1155.description: A loyal Dwarven Spider liberated from a Dwemer ruin, converted, using the "Neramo Method," to an unlocked and autonomous state that enables it to leave its original locale.

1156.name: NOT IN USE
1156.description: Turns your world black-and-white, and summons a ghost that everyone can see. NOT IN USE

1157.name: Snow Leopard Sabre Cat
1157.description:
The shamans of the Skaal tribe domesticated the Snow Leopard Sabres as mounts, but to keep them exclusive their breeding was restricted, and they are down to a dwindling few.
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

1158.name: Twilight Shard
1158.description: This rough-hewn crystal star pulses with brilliant Daedric energyâusing it produces a dazzling tribute to Azura.
1158.hint: Obtained by helping Rhea Opacarius defeat the Daedric forces working against Azura.

1159.name: Dwarven Horse
1159.description: The ancient Deep Elves made animunculi of many kinds, imitating nature with mechanical constructs. The Dwarven word for mount was "vamidium," but their equine automata are more commonly known as Dwarven Horses.

1160.name: Dwarven Senche
1160.description: Since nearly all Dwemer sites are in northeast Tamriel, where the only large feline is the sabre cat, scholars of Dwarven civilization have long wondered why they chose to make animunculi mounts that resemble the senche-tigers of the south. It's a mystery!

1161.name: Dwarven Bear
1161.description: Scholar of the Dwemer Guylaine Marilie theorized that bear vamidiums were animunculi mounts reserved only for those Deep Elves of high rank or status. "Imagine a noble in full armor on a Dwarven Bear Mount," he wrote. "What could be more impressive?"

1162.name: Dwarven Guar
1162.description: Guar vamidiums, or Dwarven Guar Mounts, are most often associated with Dwemer sites in Morrowindâas might be expected, since that's where guar are most in use as pack and riding animals.

1163.name: Dwarven Camel
1163.description: Dwarven Camels are most often found among the ruins of the desert-dwelling Rourken clan of the Dwemer, who left northeast Tamriel and traveled west to found cities in the remote back-country of Hammerfell.

1164.name: Dwarven Wolf
1164.description: Dwarven Wolves, or Lupine Vamidiums, are most often seen in proximity to Dwemer ruins of northern and western Skyrim, where wolves are most common in the wild. Its loping gait is said to give the most comfortable ride of any mechanical mount.

1165.name: Bloodroot Forge
1165.description: Deep in the Jerall Mountains lies the long forgotten ruins of the Bloodroot Forge, an ancient place of power rekindled after centuries of dormancy by Dreadhorn Reach clan to fuel their campaign of conquest.

1166.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Scarlet Judge" in Suran.
1166.name: Regalia of the Scarlet Judge
1166.description: This regalia has been passed down through generations of vigilante heroes, each cloaked in mystery and intrigue. With it comes the heavy burden of upholding justice in Vvardenfell, no matter the cost.

1167.name: The Pie of Misrule
1167.description: Does this taste funny to you? Formerly used to obtain an experience boost during Jester's Festival, but no longer needed! For that purpose, that is. You should still eat it, because pie is delicious.
1167.hint: Obtained by completing the Jester's Festival event.

1168.name: Breda's Bottomless Mead Mug
1168.description: This wooden mug always seems to have just enough mead in it for one more toast. While no longer necessary for earning extra experience during New Life Festival, you can still keep it around for quaffing.

1170.name: Seht's Dovah-Fly
1170.description: These are clearly fabricants, clockwork simulations of living creatures, with the distinctive appearance of the handiwork of Sotha Sil. But if so, how did they escape Clockwork City? What powers them? And why do they make such loyal pets? No one knows.

1171.hint: Acquired by finding all of the ancestral tombs of Vvardenfell and the lost Library of Andule.
1171.name: Vvardenfell Scale Model
1171.description: Librarian Bradyn presented you with this scale model of the island of Vvardenfellâa miniature version of the replica in the library in Vivec City.

1173.name: Brassilisk
1173.description: "The Brassilisk is created from interconnected brass squares, its exposed copper wiring allowing for its snakelike movement. Popular as a pet, you'll often see them following the quick footsteps of young scholars." âEndilaril, Clockwork City Naturalist

1174.hint: Acquired by digging up its various parts via the Antiquities system.
1174.name: Ebon Dwarven Wolf
1174.description: "There is no evidence that the Dwemer kept dogs, or pets of any other kind, for that matter, but like their neighbors the Nords they did seem to have some affection for the Wolves of northern Tamriel. One sees this in their mounts." âThelwe Ghelein

1175.name: Grazelands Gentlemer Farmer
1175.description: "Just because you're reclaiming the wastelands from the barbaric Ashlanders doesn't mean you have to dress like a savage," says designer Voldsea Arvel. "You're a proud House Dunmer, so why not look like one?"

1176.name: Seyda Neen Jodhpur Ensemble
1176.description: "Don't think, just because they're involved in trade, that the folk of House Hlaalu don't know how to dress," says Davon's Watch couturier Voldsea Arvel. "This grand new outfit I designed for them combines practicality with genuine House Dunmer class."

1177.name: Arvel's Ashland Attire
1177.description: "Designing for conditions in Vvardenfell is a stimulating challenge," says Voldsea Arvel. "That's why the outer layers of my Ashland Attire are of tightly-woven kresh fiber that just sheds ash and soot, so you can look like a lord even in an ash storm!"

1178.name: Holiday in Balmora Outfit
1178.description: "With the growth of Balmora, sport hunting in Morrowind has a new capital," says designer Arvel. "Whether you're pursuing nix-oxen or hunting hive golems, dress for the chase in these luscious leathers!"

1179.name: Buoyant Gentility Ensemble
1179.description: "I've woven some of Lord Vivec's austere elegance into this outfit, my tribute to the Tribune," says Voldsea Arvel. "Soiree tonight in St. Delyn Plaza? In your new Buoyant Gentility garb, you'll be a Vvardenfell vision!"

1180.name: Ancestral Homage Formal Gown
1180.description: "There's nothing wrong with showing some healthy gray skin while paying homage to the Ancestors," says Voldsea Arvel. "The Ancestors won't mind, and your current incarnation deserves to be seen!"

1181.name: Dwarven Puzzle Orb
1181.description: Warning: for thousands of years, everyone who has ever fiddled with these ancient Dwarven Puzzle Orbs has died. It's true that sometimes they seem to have died peacefully at an advanced age, but still.

1182.name: Dwarven Tonal Forks
1182.description: There's something strangely soothing about the subtle vibration and crackling sparks emitted by these Dwarven Tonal Forks. So very soothing. In fact, you'd like to see them, feel them again. Right away. And for a long time.

1183.name: Dwemervamidium Mirage
1183.description: This enables its possessor to temporarily assume the appearance of wearing a suit of Dwemervamidium, or steam-assisted semi-mechanized heavy Dwarven armor. It's genuinely awe-inspiring, albeit only briefly.

1184.name: Gorne Striped Wolf
1184.description: The Isle of Gorne off the east coast of Morrowind is home to many strange creatures found nowhere else in Tamriel. One of these is the giant Striped Wolf, packs of which terrorized the island's settlers till they were suppressed in the Troubled House Hunt.

1185.name: Dwarven Spider
1185.description: Of all the Dwemer animunculi, the Dwarven Spider is perhaps the most familiar and iconic. This versatile construct comes in several variations, and it should come as no surprise that one of them is a vamidium, or mechanical mount. Clankin'!

1186.name: Chroma-Blue Dwarven Spider
1186.description: Rarest of all Dwarven Spider vamidiums are those powered by gems that emit a cold blue light, said to reflect the frigid stolen soul of the Dwemer engineer trapped within it.

1187.name: Kagouti Fabricant
1187.description: Wheeled constructs and fabricants do just fine in most regions of the Clockwork City, but for traversing rough synthetic terrain, Seht's Apostles prefer the tough and capable Kagouti Fabricant mount.

1188.name: Pellitine Mustang
1188.description: The small equines of the subtropical Pellitine forests have subtle vertical stripes for camouflage under the canopy. They've been crossed with the larger Anequine Mustang to create a striking striped mount, the favorite of the First Corinthe Hussars.

1189.name: Adamant Dwarven Horse
1189.description: Though Dwemer constructs are made mostly of so-called Dwarven Metal, some rare animunculi have parts forged from a super-hard whitish alloy known to blacksmiths as Dwarven Adamant. It's one of the rarest materials on Nirn.

1190.name: Adamant Dwarven Senche
1190.description: There have long been unconfirmed reports of Dwarven Senche vamidiums with key parts made of the extremely rare and super-hard Dwarven Adamant metal. At long last, these reports have been substantiated.

1191.name: Adamant Dwarven Wolf
1191.description: The shining metal known as Dwarven Adamant is an alloy melding ores of unknown origin into the most durable material ever made. Though found in parts of the ultra-rare Adamant Dwarven Wolf, the secret of its forging seems as lost as the Dwemer themselves.

1192.name: Brassy Assassin
1192.description: Emulate the distinctive attitude of a certain bold and brassy Morag Tong assassin with this brash and irreverent personalityâand just hope she finds it flattering rather than irritating!

1193.name: White Morthal Mastiff Pup
1193.description: "The whiter the fur, the muddier the pup. Or so I say. Sondi claims it's easier to see dirt on Snowflake, so he gets more baths. But he has twice as many baths as tan Mudrunner. And Mudrunner earned his name. Adore them both, of course."âEyga

1194.name: Tuxedo Vvardvark
1194.description: The most popular conjecture about the origin of the Vvardvark is that it's a magical hybrid created by a rogue Telvanni wizard. The coloration of the Tuxedo Vvardvark, according to this theory, was intended to enable it to hide in a flock of chub loons.

1195.name: Temple Spike Torc
1195.description: This broad metal forehead torc features aggressive spikes rising from the wearer's temples.

1196.name: Sporty Tail Tuft
1196.description: You'll swing your tail to the Two Moons Dance with pride when it's tipped with the so-sleek Sporty Tail Tuft. Clan Mother approved!

1197.name: Six-Spike Tail Trim
1197.description: They'll give you plenty of room to yourself in the mud wallow when you show up wearing your dangerous-looking Six-Spike Tail Trim. Erect the spine of passive aggression!

1198.name: Magenta Rainbow Hair
1198.description: Show your pride in your hair, mane, or bristles with this shimmering rainbow that veers into the ultraviolet.

1199.name: White River Braids
1199.description: Extravagant White River braidsâthey're not just for Nords anymore! Long pale tails, first popularized by the Priestesses of Kyne, now available in every salon.

1200.name: Anvil Sunset Eyeshadow
1200.description: Gaze at them with eyes like a fiery sunset over the Abecean Sea with this striking eyeshadow adornment.

1201.name: White-Gold Eyeshadow
1201.description: This mystic eye-shading is a favorite of members of the Mages Guild, as it makes their eyes resemble the guild's famous magic-eye symbol. Enchanting!

1202.name: Tangerine Spike Eyeshadow
1202.description: When you're weird as Falinesti and want people to know it, here's the eye adornment to put that idea across. Go grotesque!

1203.name: Dwarf-Style Sun Goggles
1203.description: When your entire civilization lives in subterranean cities, you devise high-quality goggles to protect your eyes from the blinding sun of the surface world! Dress to impress with these stylish bronze shades inspired by the long-lost Dwarves of the deeps.

1204.name: Dwemeri Monocular Contrivance
1204.description: It's said that the original ancient device this was based upon enabled the Dwarves to see the tonal composition of reality. Fake out your friends by telling them that this replica enables you to see through their clothes!

1205.name: Dwarf-Style Brow Shields
1205.description: These high-concept Dwarven adornments are like pauldronsâfor your face! If anyone asks you what they're for, just waggle your brows, smile, and say, "Bthun nchuan."

1206.name: Deep Elf Goggle-Horn
1206.description: Scholars of the vanished Dwarven race theorize that this device augmented Dwemeri vision by adding an elevated "third eye" that added time-perspective to depth perception. We just like the way it looks!

1207.name: Nchuleft Tonal Visor
1207.description: This omnigatherum based on designs discovered in the Dwarven ruin of Nchuleft combines the Brow Shields and the Goggle Horn into one mighty upper-face visor that'll have you saying, "Thuabtharng btham!"

1208.name: Dwarven Crested Hood
1208.description: This is a re-creation of the Crested Hood worn by the light infantry of Dumac's Own Royal Skirmishers at the Battle of Red Mountain.

1209.name: Dwemeri Tonal Attenuator
1209.description: Dwarven tonal architects were careful to wear deflective headgear to protect their ears and thought-organs against harmonic feedback fluctuations. "The Tonal Attenuator is clear evidence that the Dwemer lacked all concept of glamor" âGuylaine Marilie

1210.name: Dwarven Visor Miter
1210.description: Use of the term "Miter" for this Dwemer headgear is a misnomer, as the Dwarves were a secular race without a priesthood. The originals of these Visors are believed to have magically amplified thought projection, or "Calling."

1211.name: Telvanni Wizard-Lord Robe
1211.description: The Wizard-Lords of Great House Telvanni measure themselves by magical power rather than by ostentation or display, so the design of their robes is relatively simple and restrained. Don't be fooled: these are the garments of powerful sorcerers.

1212.name: Ragged Royal Page Cut
1212.description: Bangs with ear-length sides is the hallmark hairstyle of Royal Pages across Tamriel. This variant is a little wilder, for a page with rage.

1213.name: Unruly Bangs
1213.description: You're a true wild child whose hair simply cannot be controlledâlike your spirit. Go ahead, shake that unruly mop!

1214.name: Karthwolf Shepherd
1214.description: The Reachmen of Western Skyrim use their domesticated ice wolves to protect their clans' livestock. They also keep the herds healthy, as the Karthwolves themselves will cull out the weaklings.

1215.name: Sadrith Mora Quilted Snood
1215.description: Once a person reaches a certain station in life, they wish to dress so as to reflect that honor and dignity, if only out of self-respect. The Sadrith Mora Quilted Snood sends the message that you are a person of consequence in the community.

1216.name: Crimson Garden Flower Hat
1216.description: Everyone will know you have something to celebrate when you're bedecked with a wreath of crimson Narsis Peoniesâso vibrant, so vivid!

1217.name: Blooming Bouquet Hat
1217.description: Be the personification of spring itself in the vibrant Blooming Bouquet Hat, bringing colorful cheer wherever you go!

1218.name: Blossom Burst Bonnet
1218.description: Who says a flower garden can't look aggressive? Your enemies will be abashed and taken aback when you bound into battle in your Blossom Burst Bonnet!

1219.name: Dwarven Spiked Miter
1219.description: Though the spikes on this so-called "miter" look aggressive, scholars of the long-lost Dwemer believe they actually functioned as "etheric antenna," helping to pull in long-distance "Thought Calls."

1220.name: Dwarven Master Miter
1220.description: This is a replica of the headgear scholars of the Dwarves believe was worn by the "Tuathumz" or "central pylon" of their Thought Calling system. The three finials are either broadcast-foci, or convenient tabs for wall hanging.

1221.name: Star-Made Circlet
1221.description: "And upon the Star-Made Circlet there shall be Three Diamonds in remembrance of our Glorious Empire's Foundation: One Diamond for Alessia, One Diamond for Morihaus, and One Diamond for Pelinal, also called Whitestrake."

1222.name: Star-Made Sword Coronet
1222.description: "And the Paravant gave each to Pelinal and Morihaus a coronet surmounted by a sword, for they were the living weapons of Empire, AE ALTADOON, and no mortal could stand before them."

1223.name: Warrior-Poet Face Tattoos
1223.description: Decorate your epidermis with writhing, sinuous, barbed fingers of mystic energy evoking the imagery associated with Lord Vivec, Tribune and Warrior-Poet of Morrowind!

1224.name: Warrior-Poet Body Tattoos
1224.description: Decorate your epidermis with writhing, sinuous, barbed fingers of mystic energy evoking the imagery associated with Lord Vivec, Tribune and Warrior-Poet of Morrowind!

1225.name: Automaton Face Tattoos
1225.description: Some say the Mundus is naught but a great Mechanism, and we are but animunculi, like Dwarven automatons, turning like gears in some universal clockwork. But some mortals are just motorheads, you know? These machine-inspired face markings are for them.

1226.name: Automaton Body Tattoos
1226.description: Some say the Mundus is naught but a great Mechanism, and we are but animunculi, like Dwarven automatons, turning like gears in some universal clockwork. But some mortals are just motorheads, you know? These machine-inspired body markings are for them.

1227.name: Ebony Epidermis
1227.description: Never trust an alchemist with a Daedric scrollâyou might end up with skin that's the color and hardness of Ebony! Unless you think that's a good idea, of course.

1228.name: Neramo's Lightning Stick
1228.description: The artificer Neramo rewarded you with this Dwarven electrified cane as a memento of your adventure in the ruins of Nchuleftingth.
1228.hint: Awarded for completing the quest "The Heart's Desire" in Vvardenfell.

1229.name: Dreamer's Chime
1229.description: Even choked with ash, this bell recovered from the Forgotten Wastes emits a haunting tone and glows when struck.
1229.hint: Awarded for completing the quest "Echoes of a Fallen House" in Vvardenfell.

1230.hint: Acquired by finding its seven parts in the Forgotten Wastes, and combining them.
1230.name: Sixth House Robe
1230.description: We do not acknowledge these garments, and we shall not speak of them, nor of the House we do not name.

1231.name: Austere Warden Outfit
1231.description: This leather outfit is the chosen attire of Wardens, warriors whose powers come from Y'ffre's blessing. These master story tellers weave tales which come to life, creating plants, animals, and the elements of nature to aid them in battle.

1232.hint: Acquired by finding its seven parts in Nchuleftingth, and combining them.
1232.name: Dwarven Theodolite
1232.description: This construct was a sort of automated measuring device designed to explore and survey subterranean areas, according to scholars of the lost Deep Elvesâexcept for Narsis Dren, who insists it was an object of pursuit in Dwemeri team sports.

1233.hint: Acquired for completing the Balmora quest line in Vvardenfell.
1233.name: Morag Tong Face Tattoo
1233.description: Proven allies of the Morag Tong are entitled to display these striking face tattoos denoting their service to the group.

1234.hint: Rewarded for completing the Telvanni quest line in Vvardenfell.
1234.name: Telvanni Magister
1234.description: "We have one rule that governs the actions of every member of House Telvanniâthere are no rules. We are ambitious, curious, devious, and, yes, power-hungry. For the mage with the most power wins, and the winner is always right."âMagister Gothren

1235.hint: Obtained by helping Lord Vivec distribute his divine blessings.
1235.name: Buoyant Armiger Body Tattoos
1235.description: Proven warriors of Lord Vivec and the Tribunal are entitled to display these striking body tattoos from neck to ankle.

1236.name: Replica Tonal Inverter
1236.description: Recall your bravery as Vivec's Champion with this replica of the Tonal Inverter, an invention which creates sound waves that temporarily disrupt the flow of energy within magical devices.
1236.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Divine Intervention" in Vvardenfell.

1237.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Halls of Fabrication.
1237.name: Bust: Assembly General
1237.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in the Halls of Fabrication.

1238.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Halls of Fabrication.
1238.name: Fabrication Sheath
1238.description: Proudly display your victory in the Halls of Fabrication with this sheath of burnished bronze!

1240.name: Clockwork City
1240.description: Reports of mysterious shadow assassins draw you into Sotha Sil's Clockwork City to investigate a new Daedric threat. Uncover the secrets of this strange new zone, take on a new 12-player trial, earn powerful new armor sets and items, and more.

1241.name: Vvardvark
1241.description: The Common, or Demotic Vvardvark has become, in just a few years, an everyday sight on the island of Vvardenfell. But where did they come FROM? Popular opinion points the finger at the wizards of House Telvanniâbut they get blamed for everything.

1242.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion
1242.name: Saint Delyn Penthouse
1242.description:
For the city-loving Dark Elf, there's no better choice of residence than the Saint Delyn Penthouse in the heart of Vivec City, on the Waistworks level of the Saint Delyn canton.
Room is too small for Dueling.

1243.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Savior of Morrowind" Achievement
1243.name: Amaya Lake Lodge
1243.description: Enjoy the opulent luxury of a country lodge built by the Dark Elves of an earlier, more expansive eraâa walled estate with a grand multistory house, roof balcony, stable, storage building, a well, and room for a formal garden.

1244.name: Ald Velothi Harbor House
1244.description: On the coast north of Gnisis, this three-level home in the Redoran "bug-house" style comes with a walled courtyard, a nearby dock, and convenient access to the nearby ruins of Ashalmawia and Arkngthunch-Sturdumz.

1245.name: Tel Galen
1245.description: Fulfill your fantasies of a fungal flat with this fabulous Telvanni wizard's tower, on a private island on Azura's Coast! Comes complete with grand foyer, workshop, suite, and tower chamber ideal for magical research.

1248.hint: Acquired by completing the Star-Made Knight achievement during the Whitestrake's Mayhem Holiday Event.
1248.name: Mayhem Victor's Laurel Wreath
1248.description: As a Star-Made Knight, this victor's laurel wreath will sit lightly on your brow, informing everyone you meet of your legendary triumph. Hail and kudos!

1249.name: Naryu's Morag Tong Costume
1249.description: Naryu Virian the Morag Tong assassin is nothing if not practical, and her functional, low-profile leather armor provides vital protection without compromising her agile acrobatics.

1250.hint: May be purchased from the Stablemaster at the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
1250.name: Ebon Dwarven Horse
1250.description: Though most ancient Dwemer automata are constructed primarily of the so-called Dwarven Metal some rare and special animunculus mounts wear a shell of other materials, such as Ebony. The resulting Ebon Dwarven Horse is an especially durable vamidium.

1251.name: Vitrine Dwarven Horse
1251.description: "A horse-shaped Dwarven mount constructed of Ebony, Adamant, Dwarven Metal, and Glass? Sure, why not? The Dwemer could build almost anything, and seemed determined to prove it." âHerebane, Nord "Scholar of the Vanished"

1252.name: Ebon Dwarven Senche
1252.description: Certain rare Dwarven senche vamidiums are constructed with key mechanical components forged, not of the usual Dwarven metal, but of ebony and ebony-steel alloys.

1253.name: Vitrine Dwarven Senche
1253.description: "When considering the Dwarven automaton mounts, the so-called vamidiums, one gets the sense that the Deep Elves were not attempting to replicate nature, but to improve upon it. Case in point: the Vitrine Senche." âThelwe Ghelein, Scholar of the Dwemer

1254.name: Vitrine Dwarven Wolf
1254.description: Of all known Dwarven mounts, or vamidiums, one of the rarest is the Wolf animunculus with critical components made, not of Dwarven Metal, but of some sort of Dwemeri Glass.

1255.name: Teatime
1255.description: Invite your friends (or enemies) to join you in a lovely spot of tea!

1256.name: Morag Tong Outfit Style
1256.description: Unlocks all Morag Tong outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

1257.name: Star-Made Diamond Diadem
1257.description: "But Al-Esh thought it meet to retain the Laureled Diadem for her own Imperial Brow, and it was set with Twin Red Diamonds, one for Herself and one for Belharza to Come, who was even then Quickening."

1258.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Falkreath Hold.
1258.name: Bust: Domihaus
1258.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Falkreath Hold.

1259.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Bloodroot Forge.
1259.name: Bust: Earthgore Amalgam
1259.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Bloodroot Forge.

1260.name: Feral Guardian, Slate Gray
1260.description:
The greatest wardens summon the mightiest animals. Give your summoned bear the look of solid stone with this Slate Gray bear appearance.

Applies to Feral Guardian, Eternal Guardian, and Wild Guardian. Select in Skills menu.

1262.name: Kiss This
1262.description: When words aren't strong enough to express your disdain, encourage them all to "Kiss this!"

1263.name: Belly Laugh
1263.description: Express your hilarious mockery of another with this over-the-top laugh emotion.

1264.name: Go Quietly
1264.description: To a defeated opponent, express your concernâor lack thereofâby urging them to pass on softly and silently. Aww!

1265.name: Trophy: Argonian Behemoth
1265.description: Trophy taken from the Argonian Behemoth in honor of an Undaunted victory in Maelstrom Arena.

1266.description: Trophy taken from Captain Blackheart in honor of an Undaunted victory in Blackheart Haven.

1292.description: Trophy taken from Ra Kotu in honor of an Undaunted victory in Hel Ra Citadel.

1293.description: Trophy taken from Rakkhat, Fang of Lorkhaj in honor of an Undaunted victory in Maw of Lorkhaj.
