1299.description: Trophy taken from the Assembly General in honor of an Undaunted victory in the Halls of Fabrication.

1300.name: Trophy: Domihaus
1300.description: Trophy taken from Domihaus Bloody Horned in honor of an Undaunted victory in Falkreath Hold.

1301.name: Trophy: Earthgore Amalgam
1301.description: Trophy taken from the Earthgore Amalgam in honor of an Undaunted victory in Bloodroot Forge.

1302.hint: Acquired for completing the Balmora quest line in Vvardenfell.
1302.name: Morag Tong Body Tattoo
1302.description: Proven allies of the Morag Tong are entitled to display these striking body tattoos denoting their service to the group.

1303.name: Nightmare Senche
1303.description: A night-black senche-tiger with burning paws and flames hissing from its face: this is surely the stuff of evil dreams. The origin of this horrific mount is obscure, but some see the hand of Mehrunes Dagon in it.

1305.name: Morag Tong Spatter Lenses
1305.description: Naryu Virian says, "When you take out a target, these Morag Tong-style goggles will keep spattering blood out of your eyes, so you can see your way clear to make your escape when the local guards come after you!"

1308.hint: Obtained by helping Lord Vivec distribute his divine blessings.
1308.name: Buoyant Armiger Face Tattoo
1308.description: Proven warriors of Lord Vivec and the Tribunal are entitled to display these striking facial tattoos.

1309.name: Linchal Grand Manor
1309.description: This imposing estate in the Nibenese style was originally built as the summer manor of an Imperial City nobleman, now sadly deceased. Gardens with statues and a reflecting pool surround the stately walled mansion. Sumptuous!

1310.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"An Unsparing Harvest" Achievement
Available During Witches Festival Only
1310.name: Exorcised Coven Cottage
1310.description: Pay no attention to the rumors: this witches hut on the edge of Hag Fen in Glenumbra is guaranteed NOT to be haunted by the dead, the undead, or restless spirits of any kind. It does come with tumbledown walls to keep the crocodiles and wolves out. Spooky!

1311.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Horns of the Reach Delver" Achievement
1311.name: Hakkvild's High Hall
1311.description: Hakkvild, former Jarl of Falkreath who freed the hold from the hands of Yashnag's Orcs, built himself this spacious hall on the heights above town, with convenient access to the crypts of his ancestors. And now it can be yours!

1312.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"The God of Schemes" Achievement
1312.name: Coldharbour Surreal Estate
1312.description: This overlooked acreage atop a floating plateau in Molag Bal's Oblivion realm of Coldharbour is available to be developed however you like. It's a secluded location, very quiet and private, even scenic in its own austere way.

1313.name: Sidelong Sweep
1313.description: Nord sea raiders from the coasts of Skyrim first popularized this style, a visible demonstration of its wearer's commitment to going all-in. Not for the cautious.

1314.name: Death Grin Body Tattoo
1314.description: This grim design is often worn by members of groups usually in opposition to each other: necromancers such as the Worm Cult, and the priests of Divines who guide souls to the afterlife such as Arkay, Xarxes, and Tu'whacca.

1315.name: Death Grin Face Tattoo
1315.description: This grim design is often worn by members of groups usually in opposition to each other: necromancers such as the Worm Cult, and the priests of Divines who guide souls to the afterlife such as Arkay, Xarxes, and Tu'whacca.

1316.hint: Awarded for completing the "Falkreath Hold Challenger" Achievement.
1316.name: Dreadhorn Shaman
1316.description: Those who assist in the dark rituals of the Dreadhorn Reachclan must first coat their skin in a chalky whitewash, and then draw scarlet sigils of power upon it in a thick paint mixed of nirncrux and blood.

1317.name: Blood-Forged
1317.description: Blood. Nirncrux. Iron. Combined with the unholy rites of the Reachmen at the Bloodroot Forge, the result is a clinker-cracked, glowing-hot skin like no other: the Blood-Forged!

1318.name: Inkwing Death Crow Body Tattoo
1318.description: The fearsome Death Crow tattoo is a favorite of Reach clans, smugglers, pirates, and worshipers of Nocturnal.

1319.name: Inkwing Death Crow Face Tattoo
1319.description: The fearsome Death Crow tattoo is a favorite of Reach clans, smugglers, pirates, and worshipers of Nocturnal.

1320.name: Color Streaked River Braid
1320.description: It's as if a master painter touched your tressesâor you fell down among the dye pots in a dyeing station! Either way, the result is fabulous.

1321.name: Sanguine's Rose Red Lip Tint
1321.description: This is a lip tint that proclaims its wearer's dedicated commitment to passion, whether as a follower of Sanguine, of Dibella, or of the earthy side of Morwha. Pucker up, adventurer!

1322.name: Dremora's Kiss Purple Lip Tint
1322.description: For the truly exotic, tint your lips with a color not found naturally on Nirn, only in the swirling depths of Oblivion. Dare you declare yourself a denizen from beyond the realm of mortals?

1328.name: Azure Sky Blue Lip Tint
1328.description: Sky Blue Lip Tint always makes a bold statement! That statement being either "I'm a cheerful free spirit" or "I'm a psychotic killer," depending on the face that's wearing it.

1329.name: Nocturnal Indigo Lip Tint
1329.description: Indigo Lip Tint is a popular way for worshipers of Nocturnal to do honor to the Mistress of Shadows. And it's not just for Nocturnal cultists: on the right face, dark blue lips can be strangely compellingâ¦.

1330.name: Cinder Wolf
1330.description: This appears to be a reanimated undead corpse of a wolf mount that was burned to death in some horrific event, and has returned hell-bent on vengeance. An intimidating ride, for sure!

1331.name: Fang Lair
1331.description: Venture into the Fang Lair dungeon, put an end to a necromancer threat, and face off against a fearsome reanimated Dragon!

1332.name: Karthwolf Charger
1332.description: In the valley of the Karth, the Reach clans have domesticated the fierce ice wolves, which they have bred for size and endurance to serve as mounts. A raiding party of Reach warriors riding Karthwolf Chargers is a fearsome sight indeed.

1333.name: Darloc Brae Beast Mask
1333.description: The face of the ancient Khajiiti warlord known as Darloc Brae, the Golden Beast of Anequina, snarls in bas relief from pictorial walls across Elsweyr. His feral, feline jaw is replicated in this Beast Mask created for the Khajiiti Havoc Dance.

1334.name: Bull Horns
1334.hint: Acquired when entering either the Falkreath Hold or Bloodroot Forge dungeons for the first time.

1335.name: Skeletal Pack Wolf
1335.description: When the Two Moons are full, the undead wolf pack rises from the grave, point their canine craniums at the sky, and try to howlâbut the only sound is a dismal rattling in their bony throats.

1336.name: Jackdaw Daedrat
1336.description: The planes of Oblivion are infinite in their variationâand so are their vermin. The Jackdaw Daedrat is a bony Daedric rodent that likes to collect shiny things like your jewelry, and nip and nibble at things it shouldn't, but at least it's cute, right?

1337.name: Skeletal Senche-Leopard
1337.description: Is Necromancy always wrong? Not even death can stop this loyal senche-leopard from stalking to adventure at your side!

1338.name: Hollowjack Spectre Mask
1338.description: It's a Witches Festival tradition to masquerade as Hollowjack the Hollowjack Spectre, menacing the adults and mock-frightening the timid. If that sounds like fun to you, this mask is just what you're looking for.

1339.name: Thicketman Spectre Mask
1339.description: Folk all across Tamriel know that during the Witches Festival you don't linger near the harvested fields, lest the Thicketman Spectre come and take your head. Now you can masquerade as this legendary bogeyman!

1340.name: Deep Elf Executioner's Hood
1340.description: Ancient engravings tell us that a Dwarven executioner, or "Chun Abakch," always concealed his or her features under a hood of black spidersilk, a material that was also used by the Dwemer for funeral shrouds.

1341.name: Serpentine Interlace Body Tattoo
1341.description: This design symbolizing the intertwining of all life forms is popular with wyresses, Wardens, Y'ffre-worshipers, and all those who feel a special connection with Nature in Tamriel.

1342.name: Serpentine Interlace Face Tattoo
1342.description: This design symbolizing the intertwining of all life forms is popular with wyresses, Wardens, Y'ffre-worshipers, and all those who feel a special connection with Nature in Tamriel.

1343.name: Karthwolf Body Tattoo
1343.description: Many of the Reach clans along the Karth River worship Hircine, the Father of Manbeasts, and take the savage Skyrim wolves as their totems. These tattoos evoke that heritage.

1344.name: Karthwolf Face Tattoo
1344.description: Many of the Reach clans along the Karth River worship Hircine, the Father of Manbeasts, and take the savage Skyrim wolves as their totems. These tattoos evoke that heritage.

1345.name: Haunted House Cat
1345.description: If one lives in a house haunted by spirits of the departed, acquiring a Haunted House Cat to keep the ghosts company will distract them from haunting you. The fact that it can see the spirits of the dead doesn't keep this cat from being sweet and sociable.

1346.name: Falkreath Thane
1346.description: This classic Nord kilted jerkin outfit projects the confidence and authority of a Falkreath fighting clan chiefâcomplete with the traditional horned helmet!

1347.name: Climbing Briar Face Tattoo
1347.description: The Climbing Briar's twisting shoots symbolize your indomitable life force, while its thorns proclaim you are willing and able to defend yourself against all adversaries.

1348.name: Death Grin Skull Mask
1348.description: You'll appear to be Death Itself coming for your enemies when you confront them wearing a Death Grin Skull Mask. Show your adversaries what's in store if they dare to oppose you.

1349.name: Nightmare Daemon Mask, Human/Elf
1349.description: Incarnate the anger of Oblivion itself with this visage of nightmare terror evoking the dreaded Dremora at their most frightening. Daemonic!

1350.name: Nightmare Daemon Mask, Khajiiti
1350.description: Incarnate the anger of Oblivion itself with this visage of nightmare terror evoking the dreaded Dremora at their most frightening. Daemonic!

1351.name: Nightmare Daemon Mask, Argonian
1351.description: Incarnate the anger of Oblivion itself with this visage of nightmare terror evoking the dreaded Dremora at their most frightening. Daemonic!

1352.name: Dibella's Doll Mask, Human / Elf
1352.description: When worshipers of Dibella wish to honor the Lady of Love by engaging in anonymous bestowal of affection, they don an exquisite porcelain Dibella's Doll Mask.

1353.name: Dibella's Doll Mask, Khajiiti
1353.description: When worshipers of Dibella wish to honor the Lady of Love by engaging in anonymous bestowal of affection, they don an exquisite porcelain Dibella's Doll Mask.

1354.name: Dibella's Doll Mask, Argonian
1354.description: When worshipers of Dibella wish to honor the Lady of Love by engaging in anonymous bestowal of affection, they don an exquisite porcelain Dibella's Doll Mask.

1355.name: Falkreath Hold
1355.description: Long a symbol of Nord strength, the embattled city of Falkreath has endured countless conflicts with the wild men from the Reach. Until now. Besieged by the mighty Dreadhorn minotaur and Reachman alliance, the final fate of Falkreath is all but sealed.

1356.name: Shadowghost Horse
1356.description: Shadowghost Horses are never bred, only found, and then only on misty nights when both moons are dark. Then they are summoned from beyond by hooded Shadowghost Wranglers, roped and saddled and broken for riding by ordinary mortals.

1359.name: Witch Knight Charger
1359.description: During their invasion of High Rock, the Reachmen were profoundly impressed by the power and splendor of the Breton mounted knights, and decided to breed their own hardy northern steeds to the same size. They succeeded!

1360.name: Frost Draugr Charger
1360.description: Now seen well outside Skyrim, these skeletal horses once served among Ysgramor's soldiers and were honored after their deathsâor so says one of the epic ballads found in Solitude's Bards College. Dare you ride a steed of such provenance? Of course!

1361.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event.
1361.name: Nix-Ox War-Steed
1361.description: It was the warlike Erabenimsun tribe of Ashlanders who first broke the wild Nix-Oxen of Vvardenfell to domestic use, and an ashkhan, the legendary Ashu-Ammu, who first rode one into battle.

1362.name: Plague Husk Senche
1362.description: "Some argue that nothing good came from the Llodos Plague, but I disagree. Ride this noxious necromantic senche, and you'll quickly find all the Peryite followers in a crowd. Perfect if you're hunting one down."âSondryn Fyr, Assassin

1363.name: Daedric Death Mask
1363.description: Daedra Worshiper, do you dare wear a mask that strikes fear into the souls of ordinary mortals? Then the Daedric Death Mask is for you! For as is graven upon its metal horn bands: FEAR ABIDES.

1364.name: Moonshadow Wings Mask
1364.description: The Lepidopterans are a sect of Azura cultists who conceal their features with elaborate butterfly masks. These have recently become a fad among the jaded youth of mainland Morrowindâand now you can wear one, too!

1365.name: Bull-Heart Skull Sallet
1365.description: This barbaric helm partly made from the skull of a bull is much like those worn by the Bull-Heart Warriors of the Reach in their savage Horned Triumph ritual.

1366.name: Stag-Heart Skull Sallet
1366.description: This antlered helm is like those worn by the Stag-Heart Reachmen, a sect that worships the Daedric Prince Hircine in his aspect of Uricanbeg, the Great Stag whose hooves drum the Blood Summons.

1367.name: Crow-Heart Skull Sallet
1367.description: Some Reachclans are ruled by Hagravens, and those feathered terrors are protected by a personal guard known as Crow-Heart Warriors. Their fearsome helmets appear to incorporate the skull of a great predatory bird.

1368.hint: Awarded for completing the "Bloodroot Forge Challenger" Achievement.
1368.name: Keptu-Horn Skull Sallet
1368.description: The similarity of this traditional Nedic skull helm to the Skull Sallets of the Reachmen is strong evidence of the ancient cultural interchange between the tribes of the Nedes and the clans of the Reach.

1369.name: Solitude Stevedore's Jerkin
1369.description: "The Nord stevedores who work the docks below the great stone arch of Solitude have a style all their own," says Jork the Tailor-Thane of Windhelm. "They take what they like from travelers of Tamriel and make it their own. Now you can, too!"

1370.name: Nordic Knot Doublet and Breeches
1370.description: "Nordic Knot designs symbolize the heritage of the people of Skyrim," says designer Jork of Windhelm. "This upscale ensemble pays tribute to that tradition, and looks good even on those not lucky enough to be Nords."

1371.name: Dire Pony
1371.description: When you always wanted a pony as a child and your parents wouldn't let you have one so you grew up bitter and tormented and became a dark cultist but now you can finally afford a pony.

1372.name: Plague Husk Horse
1372.description: A zombie horse is fearsome enoughâbut a Plague Husk Horse, wreathed in a glowing miasma of toxic infection, is a truly terrifying mount!

1373.name: Shadowghost Senche
1373.description: An oversized breed of black senche-panthers, the Shadowghost Senche is said by the Khajiit to be sacredâor rather unholyâto Namiira the Great Darkness, who sends them as mounts to bear away those who are doomed to die.

1374.name: Shadowghost Pony
1374.description: It's said that to catch a Shadowghost Pony, one should seek out a cemetery on a dark night during Witches Festival and wait quietly near the grave of a child. Bring a carrot or sweet apple.

1376.name: Frost Draugr Senche
1376.description: What were senche-tiger mounts doing in ancient Skyrim, and why were their half-frozen bodies mummified beside the Draugr in certain dark Nord catacombs? And why are they rising now, imbued with animating frost magic? The answers are as yet unknown.

1377.name: Cinder Skeletal Senche
1377.description: "Long-held grudges and rage simmer within this skeletal sencheâfitting given its supposed origin as a battle steed for Orcs fighting within the Ashen Forge! This mount's riders gain the utmost respect from Malacath's adherents."âErisa Moorcroft

1378.name: Skeletal Cat
1378.description: Even dark necromancers have feelingsâsome of them, anywayâand love their companion pets. Some love them so much they reanimate them after they pass away.

1380.name: Clockwork Skeevaton
1380.description: Originally designed for probing tiny, inaccessible areas of the Clockwork City, the mechanical Skeevaton can be set to recognize and follow an individual mortal, replicating pet behavior on the surface of Nirn.

1381.name: Shadowghost Wolf
1381.description: Unlike nearly all other wolves, the Shadowghost Wolf has no pack and lives a solitary life, haunting lonely moors and wastelands, appearing only at night and rarely then. Some doubt it is a real creature of the mortal plane at all.

1382.name: Clockwork Obscuros
1382.description: As a souvenir of Sotha Sil, pop up your personal projected image of the sphere of Clockwork City.
1382.hint: Obtained by investigating the deaths of mages, murdered by their own shadows.

1383.name: Crow's Calling
1383.description: Summon a member of the Blackfeather Court for a friendly visit. Watch out for droppings!

1384.name: Swarm of Crows
1384.description: Call down a swarm of crows to surround you in a menacing aura.

1385.name: Murderous Strike
1385.description:
Command a magically-murderous crow to crash down upon your enemies in a suicide strike.

|cFFFFFFThis Memento is used on other players.|r

1386.name: Zombie
1386.description: Graargh URR agg rhhh HAAAGH gug gug gug. RrrrrRRrrrrawww! GHORF blafffft urgl! Sneg?

1387.name: Shadowghost Pack Wolf
1387.description: Unlike their lone cousins, the great Shadowghost Wolf Mounts, the smaller Shadowghost Pack Wolves hunt on the darkest nights in howling groups. Separated from their packs, they make loyal companions.

1388.name: Wraith-of-Crows
1388.description: Pay homage to Nocturnal the Night Mistress by assuming the appearance of her horrific half-bird servant!

1389.name: Cinder Mask
1389.description: How do the Ashkhans of Vvardenfell keep volcanic dust out of their eyes and ashes out of their lungs? With a deluxe Cinder Mask, crafted from the finest netch leather and guar bone!

1390.name: Winterhold Blizzard Hood
1390.description: Be prepared for white-out conditions in the blizzards of northern Skyrimâor just radiate squinty-eyed danger in this face-concealing protective hood.

1391.name: Casual Plague Doctor
1391.description: Blights, flus, and plagues may bedevil Tamriel, but even the most dedicated Plague Doctor needs a little casual down-time now and then in order to keep those epidemics in check. Put down that mortar and pestle and head down to the tavern for some ale!

1392.name: Flame Atronach Camel
1392.description: When Peregrine Direnni passed her Master Conjurer test by summoning the first-ever Flame Atronach Camel, her mentor Corvus gave her high marks but was heard to comment, "Now you're just showing off."

1393.name: Flame Atronach Guar
1393.description: Flame Atronachs are summoned from the Oblivion plane of Infernace, a realm so hot that molten rock flows across its surface, and its Daedra are creatures of living flame. Summoned to Tamriel, such atronachs can be given almost any shape, even a Guar!

1394.name: Flame Atronach Bear
1394.description: When the Empress Hestra led her legions in harrying the Vampire King Styriche and his Gray Host into western Hammerfell, it's said she did so while riding a great Flame Atronach Bear Mount named Fiery Ursula.

1395.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
1395.name: Shadowghost Guar
1395.description: Blending in with the shifting gray ash clouds on the slopes of Red Mountain, the Shadowghost Guar are the only known nocturnal breed of the species, and thus are rarely seen, even by the native Dark Elves.

1396.name: Shadowghost Guar
1396.description: Rarely seen outside the ash clouds of Vvardenfell's great volcano, the little Shadowghost pony guar is scary cute.

1397.name: Dreadhorn Face Tattoo
1397.description: The Reachmen of the Dreadhorn clan revere Minotaurs for the brute strength and savagery, a regard evinced in their barbaric but strangely beautiful sets of tattoos.

1398.name: Dreadhorn Body Tattoo
1398.description: The Reachmen of the Dreadhorn clan revere Minotaurs for the brute strength and savagery, a regard evinced in their barbaric but strangely beautiful sets of tattoos.

1399.name: Dragon Cult Face Tattoo
1399.description: Skyrim's Dragon Cult was exterminated two eras ago, but its powerful symbology lives on in the banners of the Ebonheart Pact, and in these bold draconic tattoo sets.

1400.name: Dragon Cult Body Tattoo
1400.description: Skyrim's Dragon Cult was exterminated two eras ago, but its powerful symbology lives on in the banners of the Ebonheart Pact, and in these bold draconic tattoo sets.

1401.name: Forbidden Dinner
1401.description: Consumption of certain kinds of flesh is forbidden to decent mortals in all civilized societies.

1402.name: Muscle Flex
1402.description: Show off your mighty thews for all to admire!

1403.name: Admire Me
1403.description: Throw your arms wide to call attention to the fact that YOU are the most awesome being within three provinces!

1409.name: Flame Atronach Horse
1409.description: It was the master summoners of the Direnni who first discovered that a conjurer could impose any desired shape on a Flame Atronachâeven that of a horse. Direnni mages mounted on flaming horses first appeared at the Battle of Glenumbria Moors.

1410.name: Flame Atronach Senche
1410.description: For centuries the conjurers' standard spell for summoning Flame Atronachs has been Koron's Peremptory Summons, which is easily modified to change both the duration of the summoned atronach's binding and its formâfor example, into that of a senche-tiger.

1411.name: Flame Atronach Wolf
1411.description: "An oversized Flame Atronach Wolf makes for an impressive mount," wrote arch-conjurer Corvus Direnni, "but it's inconvenient to house such a steed in flammable stables. When I'm not riding mine, I temporarily lodge it in a pocket realm Adjacent Place."

1412.name: Flame Atronach Bear Cub
1412.description: Summoned from the Infernace plane of Oblivion, this Flame Atronach variant is given the form of a charming little bear cub. Good for warming hearts and hands alike!

1413.name: Frostbane Sabre Cat
1413.description: Sabre Cats, of course, are inured to the harsh, wintry conditions of Skyrim, and scarcely need warding from the cold; kitting them out as Frostbane mounts is therefore more a question of tradition than of protection.

1414.name: Shadow Atronach Senche
1414.description: Summoned from Oblivion, this shadow atronach was made all the more grand by being compelled to take the form of a senche mount. It's popular amongst those who wish to move quickly and quietly through the more dangerous realms of Tamriel.

1415.name: Flame Atronach Senche-Jaguar
1415.description: The first summoner of this fiery kitten was attempting to compel the Daedra into the form of a full-grown senche-jaguar. Though initially embarrassed by her mistake, she nonetheless grew an attachment to this far more adorable form.

1416.name: Flame Atronach Pack Wolf
1416.description: "Though smaller than its mount counterpart," wrote arch-conjurer Corvus Direnni, "it's necessary to take all precautions when handling the Flame Atronach Pack Wolf. I've found their curiosity insatiable, especially when near flammable objects."

1417.name: Flame Atronach Pocket Horse
1417.description: Due to the unusually tame nature of the Flame Atronach Pocket Horse, it has a long tradition of being the companion of younger members of the Direnni clan. It's a good introduction to Daedric summoning for any budding conjurer.

1418.name: Cold-Flame Atronach Wolf
1418.description: After years of conjuring, Peregine Direnni sought a new Daedra to compel to be her mount. She took an immediate liking to the Cold-Flame Atronach, found in the Daedric realm of Takubar. Summoning it in the form of a wolf just added extra flair.

1419.name: Egg-Sister Bias-Cut Casual Wear
1419.description: "Simple yet stylish, most advantageous for displaying one's tattoos and markings," says Jaxa-Kel, who found these designs by her relative, the elusive Hermit, at a clothiers' bench near some Barsaebic ruins in Shadowfen.

1421.name: Lizardly Four-Fabric Skirt Set
1421.description: "The Hermit presents the latest in silky swamp chic," says Jaxa-Kel, "combining flax, feathers, alit-scales, and spun dank-cotton in contrasting layers of chevrons and lightning. So lizardly!"

1422.name: Xanmeer Doyen's Worship Robe
1422.description: "Corset of kagouti-leather, full skirt of dank-cotton, beaded-shell vambraces and bird-skull pauldrons: everything a Xanmeer Doyen needs when welcoming worshipers into the Arboreal Reverie. The Hermit's outdone itself this time," says Jaxa-Kel.

1423.name: Dremora Kyn Body Tattoo
1423.description: When the Dremora go to war, the Kyn adopt special geometric body markings that display their commitment to victory over dishonor. With these tattoos, mortals can look just as fearsome as Dremora.

1424.name: Dremora Kyn Face Tattoo
1424.description: When the Dremora go to war, the Kyn adopt special geometric face markings that display their commitment to victory over dishonor. With these tattoos, mortals can look just as fearsome as Dremora.

1425.name: Clockwork Apostle Body Imprints
1425.description: The striking Imprint Tattoos some Clockwork Apostles display on their bodies are inspired by the mechanomagical circuitry of Sotha Sil's Fabricants and Factotums.

1426.name: Clockwork Apostle Face Imprints
1426.description: The striking Imprint Tattoos some Clockwork Apostles display on their faces are inspired by the mechanomagical circuitry of Sotha Sil's Fabricants and Factotums.

1427.name: Skyfire Guar
1427.description: This colorful guar was once thought to be poisonous by many, but found to be relatively harmless by an adventuresome rider. Caution! Patience is needed to bring this obstinate mount to heed.

1428.name: Winter Corsage Broadbrim
1428.description: This is the subtlest of this year's New Life Festival Broadbrim hats, accented with a small corsage of winter holly and berries.

1429.name: Winter Garland Broadbrim
1429.description: Feeling like you want a New Life hat that's a bit more festive than one with a mere corsage? The Winter Garland Broadbrim offers a vibrant display of berries and fir crowning your brow!

1430.name: Winter Wreath Broadbrim
1430.description: Not satisfied with a mere garland of fir on your chapeau? Go all-out with the Winter Wreath Broadbrim, which wraps the entire top of your hat in festive New Life greens, holly, berries, and cones. It's a party on your head!

1431.name: Prodigious Brass Mudcrab
1431.description: These perky metal creations are known to pack quite the pinch. Though their rust-resistant coatings do enable them to enter into water, they're far better at sinking than swimming.

1432.name: Helkarn Wolf
1432.description: Hailing from the heart of Elsweyr, these striped mounts are known for their gentle and trusting natures. Once they found them incompetent as watchdogs, the villagers of Helkarn bred them to mountable size.

1433.name: Brigand's Beard
1433.description: Proudly masculine facial hair, the Brigand's Beard projects authority, power, and a devil-may-care attitude.

1437.name: Winter Garland Dapple Gray
1437.description: This festive horse is sure to spread holiday cheer! The proud owner of such a steed can be almost assured that they have the handsomest horse in town.

1438.name: Crimson Flame Lipstick
1438.description: Crimson Flame is a lipstick for the passionate, whether your passion is romance, adventure, or singing heartfelt bard songs in the local tavern on Loredas Night.

1439.name: Royal Purple Lipstick
1439.description: By ancient High Rock tradition, the deep Royal Purple color has been reserved for the use of Breton kings and queens, a custom that may date back to the Direnni Hegemony. Now any mortal can wear a monarch's lip color!

1440.name: Ebony Brassilisk
1440.description: This experimental variation on the standard Brassilisk has certain key components fabricated from an Ebony alloy for enhanced durability out in the storms of the Radius.

1441.name: Flame Atronach Pony Guar
1441.description: Compelled to take the form of a small guar, this flame atronach makes for a great traveling companion, especially in colder climates. It's best to summon your newfound friend only when outdoors, since its mischievous nature might lead to accidents.

1442.name: Fire Cyclone Body Markings
1442.description: Impress your friends and strike fear into your enemies with these dazzlingly vibrant body markings. Be warned! This look can only be pulled off by the most bold and daring adventurers in Tamriel.

1443.name: Fire Cyclone Face Markings
1443.description: Impress your friends and strike fear into your enemies with these dazzlingly vibrant face markings. Be warned! This look can only be pulled off by the most bold and daring adventurers in Tamriel.

1444.name: Night Frost Atronach Steed
1444.description: This chilling steed was created from a Frost Atronach that was conjured into the shape of a horse. Perfect for an adventurer visiting a warmer climate, this steed can help you stay cool even in extreme temperatures.

1445.name: Pariah's Pinnacle
1445.description: The grand and majestic mountaintop retreat of Baloth Bloodtusk was sealed off in the First Era by King Joile, but its ancient Orcish halls were recently reopened by order of King Kurog.

1446.name: The Orbservatory Prior
1446.description: Sotha Sil's designation of this mountaintop laboratory as the "Orbservatory Prior" clearly indicates that the site was an experimental or test version of what he had in mindâthough whether he ever built an "Orbservatory Final" is unknown.

1447.name: Spotted Snow Senche-Leopard
1447.description: Even for the elusive senche-leopard, the Spotted Snow is a rare variety. Despite its frosty-looking fur, this adorable companion makes for a great cuddle buddy during long winter nights.

1448.name: White-Gold Imperial Pony
1448.description: The White-Gold Imperial Pony was said to have made its debut as the birthday present for a noble's daughter, though which family claims this prestige is still hotly debated throughout Cyrodiil.

1449.name: Shrike's Nocturnal Frock
1449.description: Do you like to keep to the shadows, yet long for a striking look of your own? Any admirer of the Prince of Night and Darkness will appreciate this eye-catching costume.

1450.name: Xanmeer Doyen's Feather Tiara
1450.description: This gorgeous tiara is replicated from the intricate regalia of the Xanmeer Priesthoods. Wow the crowd and stand out with this beautiful plumage waving above your brow.

1451.name: Brazenheart Circlet
1451.description: This stylized circlet is popular as a courtship gift for young Clockwork Apostles, though some of their older peers regard it as too gaudy. Now you can make up your own mind!

1452.name: Alloy Circlet
1452.description: This simple, metal alloy circlet, based on Clockwork Apostle designs, is sure to impress with its air of elegance and refinement.

1453.name: Mechanist Tiara
1453.description: This is a replica of the impressive tiara awarded to Clockwork Apostles when they reach the rank of Mechanist. Congratulations, Gear-Champion!

1454.name: Inferno Ink Body Markings
1454.description: Though once reserved for summoners of Flame Atronachs, these tattoos can now be worn by any adventurer bold enough to try their daring look.

1455.name: Inferno Ink Face Markings
1455.description: Though once reserved for summoners of Flame Atronachs, these face tattoos can now be worn by any adventurer bold enough to try their daring look.

1456.name: Frostbane Guar
1456.description: Since the Guar is native to warmer climates, the existence of the Frostbane Guar in Skyrim, theoretically protected from the cold by its dangling talismans, may be the strongest argument of those who say the Frostbane wards actually work.

1457.name: Frostbane Wolf
1457.description: The Sacred Wolf was one of the most revered Atmoran animal totems, associated by later Nords with the goddess Mara. The great Frostbane Wolf is therefore one of the most iconic mounts of the ancient Nords.

1458.name: Telvanni Master Wizard
1458.description: Lesser mages are often surprised to find that the usual apparel of a Telvanni Master Wizard is more stately than ostentatious. The truth is, Wizard Lords such as Divayth Fyr have no need of gaudy display. Their power lies elsewhere.

1459.name: The Standing Wave
1459.description: Do you stand tall and proud, adventurer? Then so should your hair! Add to your already impressive height with The Standing Wave, the hairdo that's sweeping the Fighters Guild.

1460.name: The Standing Flame
1460.description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to conjure a small Flame Atronach and have it perch atop your head like a standing hairdo of fire? Wonder no more! The Standing Flame is here for YOU.

1461.name: Factotum
1461.description: Dissatisfied with the imperfections of your mortal form? Wear the gleaming Factotum Polymorph, and move with the precision of Sotha Sil's humanoid constructs. Anuvanna'si!

1462.name: Soul Gem
1462.description: Soul Gem beats Clippers, Clippers beat Parchment, Parchment beats Soul Gem. Ready? Go!

1463.name: Clippers
1463.description: Soul Gem beats Clippers, Clippers beat Parchment, Parchment beats Soul Gem. Ready? Go!

1464.name: Parchment
1464.description: Soul Gem beats Clippers, Clippers beat Parchment, Parchment beats Soul Gem. Ready? Go!

1465.name: Radius Mask
1465.description: Clockwork Apostles who must venture into the frequently-inclement weather outside the Brass Fortress protect their eyes and faces by wearing a Radius Mask of synthetic wool and vitrine. Mysterious!

1466.name: Radius Rebreather
1466.description: Apostles who still have their original, organic lungs may want to protect them out in the Radius by investing in a full-hood Rebreather, which keeps out the storm-blown metallic motes that can lead to "brass lung."

1467.name: Brass Fortress Rebreather
1467.description: This full-coverage articulated metal mask is like a Brass Fortress for your head, providing maximum protection against both environmental contaminants and walking into low-hanging pipes.

1468.name: Flamebrow Fire Veil
1468.description: By local standards, the Firedancers of central Hammerfell wear scandalously little clothing, which may be why they protect their modestyâand identitiesâby hiding their faces behind Flamebrow Fire Veils. Hot!

1469.name: Flame Atronach Face Visor
1469.description: When seeing a Flame Atronach from the realm of Infernace, one has to wonderâwhat's going through the mind behind that impassive visage of fire? Now others can wonder the same about you when you wear the Face Visor that emulates that flaming look.

1470.name: Inferno Facade
1470.description: This full-face visor looks as if an Atronach's flaring features had been captured in metal, giving its wearer the otherworldly look of an elemental Daedra from Oblivion.

1471.name: Infernal Epidermis
1471.description: Look like an ever-burning Flame Atronach from Oblivion with the Infernal Epidermis, a smoking-hot skin of fire, ash, and charcoal.

1472.name: Mages Guild Sentry Cat
1472.description: These short-haired, large-eared cats are a common sight in Mages Guildhalls, where it's said their keen senses enable them to detect all manner of intruders, even those that are magically concealed or from realms of Oblivion.

1473.name: Scorpion Fabricant
1473.description: "Since our Incarnatoriums can be modified to produce Fabricants modeled on almost any creature of Tamriel Above, why are Scorpion Fabricants of differing sizes so popular? They're our most-requested fabs!" says Clockwork Apostle Dringest.

1474.name: Lustrous Nix-Ox Fabricant Steed
1474.description: Before Saints Llothis and Olms had to be confined in the Asylum Sanctorium, they used to ride through the Brass Fortress on holy days on these bizarre Fabricant mounts. But the parades are long gone, and the synthetic steeds have been repurposed.

1480.name: Factotum
1480.description:
Adopt the perfected form of a Factotum and move with clockwork precision.

|cff0000This Polymorph will also override any currently equipped Personality|r

|c22ADDCAlters the /idle, /sleep, /bow. /twiddle, /wave, /hammerwall, /hammerlow, and /dance emotes|r

1481.name: Fiery Orb
1481.description: This memento briefly summons a flaming orb of the very stuff of the Plane of Infernace.

1482.name: Flame Pixie
1482.description: Conjuring a tiny Flame Atronach from Oblivion for a few moments really warms up the room!

1483.name: Flame Eruption
1483.description: There's angry, and then there's conjuring-an-erupting-volcano-in-the-floor angry.

1484.name: White-Gold Imperial Courser
1484.description: Created after years of extensive breeding, the White-Gold Imperial Courser is said to be the most beautiful horse in all of Tamriel. With its almost ethereal beauty, these horses are owned by only the wealthiest riders.

1485.name: Psijic Brassilisk
1485.description: These rare Brassilisks are powered by blue soul gems brought back from the Psijic hideaway of Artaeum at the end of the First Era by Sotha Sil himself.

1486.name: Foxbat Brassilisk
1486.description: These mysterious green-glowing Brassilisks have been showing up in the environment outside the Brass Fortress. Some Clockwork Apostles suspect there's a rogue Incarnatorium assembling them somewhere out in the Radius.

1487.name: Steam-Driven Brassilisk
1487.description: With soul gems in short supply, the Clockwork Apostles invented this experimental Brassilisk powered by steam stored under high pressure.

1488.description: Learned from the Breton crafting style, acquired by looting backpacks, wardrobes, and other world objects throughout Tamriel.

4657.description: Learned from the Dremora crafting style.

4658.name: Dremora Girdle
4658.description: Learned from the Dremora crafting style.

4659.hint: Acquired by traveling to the Brass Fortress in Clockwork City for the first time.
4659.name: Scintillant Dovah-Fly
4659.description: The Dovah-Fly is a common sight in the oil-slick ravines of the Clockwork City. While its ornate clockworks are a wonder to behold, it's hard to shake the feeling that it's always watching you.

4660.hint: Found rarely in Asylum Sanctorium, in the hardest configuration of Veteran Mode.
4660.name: Clockwork Curator
4660.description:
It seems that permanent residence within a titanic factotum wears heavily upon one. A vacation, then, may be better for the soul in the end.

|cff0000This Polymorph will also override any currently equipped Personality|r

4661.hint: Acquired by defeating Saint Olms, Saint Llothis, and Saint Felms in the same fight in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.
4661.name: Sanctified Silver
4661.description: Shine with the radiance of the purified Saints of the Asylum Sanctorium with this sheen of silvery skin.

4662.name: Begone!
4662.description: This intimidating display is sure to scare off even the bravest birds.
4662.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Lost in the Gloam" in Clockwork City.

4663.name: Umbral Projector
4663.description: Want to relive the horror of watching a harmless shadow become a bloodthirsty killer? This mechanical marvel will let you do just thatâwithout the harmful effects, of course.
4663.hint: Acquired by completing the "Hero of Clockwork City" Achievement.

4664.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Light of Knowledge," in Clockwork City.
4664.name: Revolving Celestiodrome
4664.description: A gift from the mysterious Sotha Sil himself, this device displays the superb craftsmanship and meticulous detail that are hallmarks of the work of the Clockwork God.

4665.name: Trophy: Saint Olms the Just
4665.description: Trophy taken from Saint Olms the Just in honor of an Undaunted victory in Asylum Sanctorium.

4666.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.
4666.name: Bust: Saint Olms the Just
4666.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Asylum Sanctorium.

4667.name: Nix-Ox Fabricant Steed
4667.description: Programmed for obedience and fabricated for endurance, these synthetic Nix-Ox Steeds are the perfect mounts for ranging out from the Brass Fortress across the dangerous Radius.

4671.name: Frostbane Bear
4671.description: The Bear was also one of the ancient Atmoran animal tokens, associated later with the Nord god Tsun, so the Frostbane Bear has historically been one of the most prestigious mounts a tradition-loving Nord could ride.

4672.name: Frostbane Camel
4672.description: Perhaps the Atmoran totems and dread-knots sported by the Frostbane Camel actually do help protect it from the bitter cold of Skyrim. Or maybe camels are just too ornery to care.

4673.hint: Available from the Level Up Reward System.
4673.name: Storage Coffer, Fortified
4673.description:
|cFFFFFF30 Slots|r

This coffer can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this coffer do not appear at crafting stations.

4683.name: Camlorn Top Hat with Buckle
4683.description: Top of Sundas morning to you, in your Camlorn Top Hat with a buckle!

4684.name: Camlorn Top Hat with Shamrock
4684.description: You'll be having the Luck of the Iliac when you wear your Camlorn Sundas Top Hat sporting a bright green shamrock!

4685.name: Camlorn "Lucky Bouquet" Top Hat
4685.description: You're ready for spring in Glenumbra when you wear your Camlorn Sundas Top Hat sporting a "Lucky Bouquet" of flowers and a bright shamrock!

4690.name: Ruffian's Turban Balaclava
4690.description: When you're doing stealthy work, it pays to be practical. The Turban Balaclava is quiet, shows a low profile, and most importantly hides your features in case there's an inconvenient witness.

4691.name: Malefic Standing Collar Hood
4691.description: You know what's great? If you add a standing collar to a hood and half-mask, it suddenly makes you look more dangerous, sinister, and threatening. That's what.

4692.hint: Acquired by entering either Fang Lair or Scalecaller Peak for the first time.
4692.name: Renegade Dragon Priest Mask
4692.description: This hood and visor is a replica of the imposing mask worn by Zaan, the renegade Dragon Priest of the Scalecaller cult.

4693.name: Beaded Skull Chaplet
4693.description: Barbaric the early Nords may have been, but they knew how to adorn themselves in fierce finery. The Beaded Skull Chaplet is a prime example.

4694.name: Sacred Rhombus Circlet
4694.description: Clergy in the Dragon Cult below the Priest level adorned themselves with the tall pointed diamond symbol known as the Sacred Rhombus, a design said to be symbolic of a Dragon's scales.

4695.name: Serpent Scale Face Marking
4695.description: These ophidian tattoo markings are favored by those who revere Serpents, Dragons, and other mystical reptilians.

4696.name: Serpent Scale Body Marking
4696.description: These ophidian tattoo markings are favored by those who revere Serpents, Dragons, and other mystical reptilians.

4697.name: Necromantic Sigil Face Tattoos
4697.description: Do you dare to wear the serpentine Necromantic Sigil that displays your dedication to the arts of undeath?

4698.name: Necromantic Sigil Body Tattoos
4698.description: Do you dare to wear the serpentine Necromantic Sigils that display your dedication to the arts of undeath?

4699.name: Dragonbone Chain Face Marking
4699.description: The bones of the Dovah have a powerful symbolic significance to worshipers of the ancient Dragon Cult, who created this Dragonbone Chain tattoo set.

4700.name: Dragonbone Chain Body Marking
4700.description: The bones of the Dovah have a powerful symbolic significance to worshipers of the ancient Dragon Cult, who created this Dragonbone Chain tattoo set.

4701.name: Dragon Vassal Face Markings
4701.description: In ancient times, mortals wishing to express their utter devotion and fealty to the Dovah were known to wear these Dragon Vassal Face Markings.

4702.name: Dragon Vassal Body Markings
4702.description: In ancient times, mortals wishing to express their utter devotion and fealty to the Dovah were known to wear these Dragon Vassal Body Markings.

4703.name: Scalecaller Peak
4703.description: Fight your way through cultists in the Scalecaller Peak dungeon and stop them from unleashing a terrible disease upon Tamriel!

4704.name: Star-Brow Diadem
4704.description: This elegant tiara simultaneously evokes the heavenly stars that are the source of all Magicka, and the horns of the Dragons whom the ancient Nords worshiped. Perhaps the ancient Atmorans weren't as barbaric as they're depicted!

4705.name: Eternal Hunger Coronal
4705.description: This metallic tiara, with its central, stylized Dragon head, its mouth ever-gaping in Eternal Hunger, was popular in the lower-level clergy of the Dragon Cult, according to scholars of those ancient times.

4706.name: Scalecaller Rune of Levitation
4706.description: Use this memento to briefly hover ominously, eyes glowing, like a menacing ancient Dragon Priest.

4707.name: Scalecaller Frost Shard
4707.description: Use this memento to put a chill in the heart of your adversary by conjuring a brief magical ice cyclone before you. (It's also handy for chilling your drink.)

4708.name: Bone Dragon Summons Focus
4708.description: With this memento, for just a moment, you conjure the awe-inspiring illusion of the rise of a dreadful Bone Dragon.

4709.hint: Acquired in the Dragon Bones DLC Collector's Bundle.
4709.name: Fang Lair Courser
4709.description: In Fang Lair, not even ancient warriors' steeds are safe from reanimation by necromancers! Though to be fair, if you're looking for "grimly impressive," this is the mount for you.

4710.name: Masqued "Unicorn" Steed
4710.description: Is that the famed and incredibly-rare creature of legend, the true Unicorn from Hircine's Oblivion realm of the Hunting Grounds? â¦Well, no, it's a horse with a horn attached to its forehead. But the effectâit's just so magical!

4712.name: True Ghost Horse
4712.description: Not a spectre, not a zombie, not a horse of a spooky colorâthe True Ghost Horse is the actual shade of a deceased mount, returned from beyond the equine grave.

4713.name: Manelord Nightmare Senche
4713.description: King of the Nightmare Pride, this night-black senche-tiger has burning paws and flames hissing from its face; rumor says Mehrunes Dagon is responsible.

4714.name: Frostbane Horse
4714.description: The ancient Nords who came to Skyrim with Ysgramor worshiped animal totems, and adorned their mounts with symbolic hair-knots and hide strips meant to protect their livestock from the frigid climate. These  "Frostbane" talismans are still in use today!

4720.name: Dragonfire Wolf
4720.description: Ancient legends from the time of the Dragon Wars tell of Dragon Knights riding into battle mounted on colossal flaming wolves. Were they wolf mounts mystically imbued with Dragonfire? Flame Atronachs conjured in the form of wolves? No one knows.

4721.name: Galvanic Storm Steed
4721.description: The Galvanic Storm Steed fuses the power of a Storm Atronach from Oblivion with the bloodline of the Yokudan Chargers, the famous war horses of the Redguards, to create an incomparable mount.

4722.name: Snow-Blanket Sorrel Horse
4722.description: This handsome breed of horse is native to the Colovian Highlands of Cyrodiil, and is a common sight from Chorrol to Bruma. The Snow-Blanket Sorrel is known for its intelligence and high spirits.

4723.name: Tattooed Shorn Camel
4723.description: The dervishes of Rihad shave their Hammerfell camels and tattoo them with mystic symbols sacred to the spirits of the deep desert, to placate those wayward spirits in hopes they'll refrain from leading the camels astray among the dunes.

4724.name: Bal Foyen Circus Guar
4724.description: Like other reptilian creatures, Guar can be bred for bright, even gaudy colors. The Argonians of Dhalmora offer this entertaining variant, a popular performer in Tamriel's traveling shows.

4725.hint: Awarded for completing the "Fang Lair Challenger" Achievement.
4725.name: Worm Wizard
4725.description: There's just something about Worm Anchorites, those creepy necromancers of the Worm Cult, and the sinister way they act. It's almost as if dealing with the undead has an unhealthy effect on one's personality.

4726.name: Small Bone Dragon Construct
4726.description: This construct resembles a great and fearsome Bone Dragon, but it's actually a product of the Necromancer's art, assembled from modern bird and reptile bones and then reanimated.

4727.name: Unholy Glow Bone Dragon
4727.description: This necromantic construct of reanimated bones resembles a gruesome Bone Dragon, one so charged with unholy power that it emits an uncanny blue glow.

4728.name: Madcap Jester Monkey
4728.description: Say, why does this little chum look at you funny? It must be your face! Ook ook! Ah, ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!

4729.name: Karth Winter Hound
4729.description: The Karth Winter Hound is the snow-white breed of the Markarth Bear Dog, snowy year-round for hunting in Skyrim's snow-capped peaks. Some Reach clans reserve the Winter Hounds solely for chieftains.

4731.name: Flameback Boar
4731.description: Like the Purple Daggerback, the breed of Flameback Boars clearly had some kind of brush with the uncanny that imbued them with magical aspects. Regular boars just don't have crimson glowing eyes and flame-colored bristle crests down their backs.

4732.hint: |cffffffPurchasing this pet increases your inventory capacity by 5 slots on all characters account wide.|r
4732.name: Mournhold Packrat
4732.description: Are you the kind of adventurer who simply Must Loot Everything? Being followed around by the Mournhold Packrat, an actual cargo rodent, tells the world that you're an Acquisitionist who's not going to leave behind a single spoon!

4733.name: Wrothgar Buck Goat
4733.description: The Orcs of Wrothgar have a hardy breed of goats well-suited to the area's rugged terrain and changeable climate. Each goatherd particularly prizes his herd's master Buck Goat; these tend to be both intelligent and pugnacious, good animal companions.

4734.name: Big-Eared Ginger Mouser
4734.description: The Ginger Mouser is a favorite barn cat of grain farmers all across central Tamriel, not just because it keeps the storage bins rodent-free, but also for its affectionate personality and goofy good looks.

4735.name: Karth Winter Pup
4735.description: When the Karth Winter Hound has puppies, it even softens the Briarhearts of the Reachmen. Who's a good barbarian pup-pup, then? Is it you? It IS you!

4736.name: Nightmare Senche Cub
4736.description: Despite the fact that this night-black senche-tiger cub has burning paws and flaming eyes, it's so adorable it might be a nightmare you never want to awaken from!

4737.name: Mage's Sentry Kitten
4737.description: When it's a kitten, the Mage's Sentry Cat is so adorable, it's said that some sorcerers enchant them to stay that age always.

4739.name: Helkarn Wolf Pup
4739.description: The pups of the Helkarn Wolves from Elsweyr are almost as sociable with people as dog puppies, so they get a lot of attention when young. This probably contributes to their docility as mounts when full grown.

4740.hint: |cffffffPurchasing this pet increases your inventory capacity by 5 slots on all characters account wide.|r
4740.name: Bristleneck War Boar
4740.description: Originally from Solstheim, this tempestuous boar exists in two modes: hungry and hungrier! Given that it can carry gear, though, providing it with its favorite fungi is a small matter.

4741.name: Magma Scamp
4741.description: Scamps are lesser Daedra used as servants and menials by a number of different Daedric Princes. The Magma Scamps are servants of Mehrunes Dagon, and can be summoned from his Oblivion plane of the Deadlands.

4743.name: Decayed Zombie
4743.description: Decayed Zombie: the skin condition no amount of Lillandril Moisturizing Lotion can cure! Pairs well with Worm Cult style armor.

4744.name: Frostbane Pony Guar
4744.description: Though the reptilian Guar are native to the warmer climates south of Skyrim, the compact Pony Guar have long been popular pets among the aristocracy of Riften. Traditional Nords like to dress them in the Frostbane garb used on more local animals.

4745.name: Frostbane Sabre Cat
4745.description: In "The Tail of Ysgramor's Cat," the Harbinger's Sabre Cat hunting companion is described as being festooned with Atmoran Frostbane talismans, and some tradition-loving modern Nords still decorate their Sabre Cats in the same manner.

4746.name: Frostbane Bear
4746.description: Nords who follow the tradition of hanging Frostbane totems and talismans on their beasts to protect them from Skyrim's bitter cold often do it even when the animals are still young, to get them used to the idea.

4747.name: Frostbane Wolf
4747.description: To accustom their Frostbane Wolves to the click-clacking of dangling talismans and totems, the ancient Nords began dressing their companion wolves in Frostbane garb from an early age.

4748.name: Frostbane Pony
4748.description: The hardy ponies of the frozen north look even shaggier when they're decorated with Frostbane hair-knots and ancient Nord totems. Whether the talismans keep the cold away is impossible to tell, but it's certain these ponies never lose their good cheer.

4749.name: Ashen Fang Lair Courser
4749.description: Sometimes, when necromancers reanimate a creature, they overdo it and imbue the undead entity with an excess of dark conjuration. In the case of the Ashen Courser, this residue of mystical power manifests as a cloud of grave dust and ash.

4751.name: Trophy: Scalecaller
4751.description: Trophy taken from the Scalecaller in honor of an Undaunted victory in Scalecaller Peak.

4752.name: Trophy: Thurvokun
4752.description: Trophy taken from Thurvokun in honor of an Undaunted victory in Fang Lair.

4753.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Scalecaller Peak.
4753.name: Bust: Scalecaller
4753.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Scalecaller Peak.

4754.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Fang Lair.
4754.name: Bust: Thurvokun
4754.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Fang Lair.

4755.name: Scalecaller Dragonflame Maul
4755.description: With this outfit style, you can change the appearance of your two-handed mace into that of the fiery Scalecaller Dragonflame Maul, and fell your awestruck opponents with a flaming Dragon-headed bludgeon!

4756.name: Tusked Dragon Priest Mask
4756.description: This is a replica of what Dragon Cult scholars call the "Tusked" Dragon Priest Mask. Though it's been seen in certain ancient engravings, to date no historian has been able to identify it with a specific ancient Dragon Priest.

4757.name: Archaic Dragon Priest Mask
4757.description: Dragon Priest Masks came in many variations, but one classic design was more notorious than all the others, the look that Nord historians have come to term the "Archaic" form.

4759.name: Flip the Bird
4759.description: Show the ultimate in disdain for your adversary by flipping the bird at them.

4760.name: Line in Sand
4760.description: Exuding contempt, you draw a line in the sand, and dare your opponent to cross over it.

4761.name: I See You
4761.description: Put your opponent on notice that you see EXACTLY what they're up to.

4762.name: Renegade Dragon Priest
4762.description: Sure, Dragon Priests were evil overlords who ruled mortals in the name of tyrannical Dovah, but what a fashion sense they had! Now you can adopt the appearance of the Renegade Dragon Priest from Scalecaller.

4763.name: Bleakrock Housecarl Dress
4763.description: "We Nords are a people unafraid of getting our hands dirty," says Jork the Tailor-Thane. "We like our clothes to be practical, yet stylish at the same time. My Bleakrock Housecarl Dress is a prime example!"

4764.name: Bardic Tavern-Singer's Dress
4764.description: "Whether you're belting out 'Ragnar the Red' in the tavern, or just down there for the Loredas evening dance, all eyes will be on you in this free-swinging layered dress!" âJork the Tailor-Thane

4765.name: Jarl's Justice Formal Frock
4765.description: "We Nords tend to be an informal people at most times, but when a Jarl sits to decide a legal case, it's important that our system of law be honored with the proper attire!" âJork, the Tailor-Thane of Windhelm

4766.name: Rawhide-Laced Riften Jerkin
4766.description: Jork the Tailor-Thane says, "Summer may be short in Riften, but when it finally comes the Nords greet it with open arms. And how better than in this patterned sleeveless jerkin, accented with rawhide laces?"

4767.name: Skald's Damask Jerkin
4767.description: This damask twill jerkin is a favorite this season for skalds across Skyrim, and you'll see them strumming in it from Riften to Solitude. "Pair it with a warm tunic underneath for maximum versatility," says designer Jork of Windhelm.

4768.name: Ringed and Gathered War Beard
4768.description: If you're a manly barbarian warrior, you need a beard, but you also don't want it getting in the way during archery or close combat. So: ring it up, and gather it up, and there you are! Fierce, yet fancy.

4769.name: Studded Leather Brow Band
4769.description: This metal-studded Leather Brow Band is as practical as it is decorative. After all, a barbarian warrior might have a little too much mead, miss the doorway a bit, and BANG. Best to have a bit of protection for the old noggin, am I right?

4770.name: Fierce Pierce Facial Rings
4770.description: Every barbarian warrior needs rings for the nose, brow, and earsâFierce Piercings indeed! But keep the rings small so it doesn't give an adversary something to yank upon.

4771.name: Double Diagonal Face Warpaint
4771.description: Warpaint? Yes! Fierce! Two slashesâright across the face! Back off, civilized sweetrolls. Barbarian warrior here! Savage! Warpaint! Coming through!

4772.name: Dark Emphasis Eyelashes
4772.description: Dark eyes: brooding, romantic, even intimidating. Dark Emphasis Eyelashes draw other eyes to yours.

4773.name: Wire Cage Half-Mask
4773.description: For the strong and untamed spirit, the spiraling wires of this jewelry half-mask express the inner power that no cage could ever contain.

4774.name: Dangling Triple-Chain Earrings
4774.description: Wrought from fine precious metal by master jewelers, these exquisite earrings add a flash of shining beauty to anyone's ears.

4775.name: Eye-Briar Gemmed Tattoo
4775.description: This begemmed Eye-Briar face tattoo gives one a barbaric beauty that's both wild and sophisticated, at home in the big city or around a wilderness campfire.

4781.name: Spellbreaker Shield
4781.description: Alter your shield's Outfit style with a replica of the Spellbreaker Elder Scrolls Artifact, a Dwarven shield associated with the Daedric Prince Peryite. In the early First Era, it was granted for a time to the Dragon Priest Zaan the Scalecaller.

4782.name: Kick the Dirt
4782.description: Taunt your contemptible opponent by kicking some dirt at them.

4783.name: Come Get Some
4783.description: Beckon your loser of an opponent to come get a piece of youâif they dare.

4784.name: Factotum Dance
4784.description: Express yourself in this clockwork dance with the perfect mechanical precision of one of Sotha Sil's Factotums.

4786.name: Jubilee Cake 2018
4786.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. It's a festival for your taste buds!
4786.hint: Obtained by completing the 2018 Anniversary event.

4787.name: Barbaric Windblown Hair
4787.description: At last, a hairstyle that expresses the wild, windblown freedom of the untamed barbarian warrior. When you've spent all day galloping across the wilderness in pursuit of loot and adventure, THIS is what your hair looks like!

4789.name: Wyrd Elemental Plume
4789.description: Use this wyrd memento to invoke elements of wind and air into a swirling vortex
4789.hint: Obtained by helping the Great Mage find the missing Wyress Oracle.

4790.name: Blackmarrow Necro-Turban
4790.description: Raise the dead in style in your Blackmarrow Necro-Turban, featuring a sinister upper-face half-visor and twin metallo-antlers. Pairs well with zombie mounts and the Fang Lair crafting style.

4792.name: New Moons Cross-Sash Robe
4792.description: "Two dark moons mean bad luck," says designer Samsu the Sleek, "but a whole series of new moons says the opposite: that one has survived adversity, and even prospered! That's the message of this handsome new robe, in breathable cotton and linen."

4793.hint: Awarded for completing the "Scalecaller Peak Challenger" Achievement.
4793.name: Blackmarrow Necromancer
4793.description: Feel the uncanny power of Necromancy radiate from your very flesh with the eerie Blackmarrow Skin! It's as creepy as undeath itself, and a great conversation starter down at the tavern.

4794.name: The Erstwhile Sanctuary
4794.description: Built into the foundations of Kvatch itself, this ancient complex was abandoned by the Dark Brotherhood after a subterranean collapse tumbled one wall of the Speaker's bedchamber into a massive natural cavern.

4795.name: Princely Dawnlight Palace
4795.description: Prince Hubalajad, in one of his wilder flights of extravagance, had a second palace built solely to better catch the light of the morning sun. It's a magnificent estate that truly makes one feel like a monarch.

4796.name: Shadow-Rider Senche
4796.description: Creatures of "Shadow"âare such things possible? Or is the Shadow-Rider Senche merely a black senche-panther mount wrapped in Illusion spells? Somehow, it just seems too uncanny for that mundane explanation.

4797.name: Jester's Scintillator
4797.description: Celebrate Jester's Festival in scintillating color.
4797.hint: This rare party favor can occasionally be found in Jester's Festival gift boxes rewarded to those who complete the daily challenges issued by Jester Queen Ayrenn, Jester King Emeric, and Jester King Jorunn.

4798.name: Hide Helmet
4798.description: Hides your currently-equipped Helmet for the current Outfit.

4799.name: Hide Chest
4799.description: Hides your currently-equipped Chest for the current Outfit.

4800.name: Hide Shoulders
4800.description: Hides your currently-equipped Shoulders for the current Outfit.

4801.name: Hide Waist
4801.description: Hides your currently-equipped Waist for the current Outfit.

4802.name: Hide Legs
4802.description: Hides your currently-equipped Legs for the current Outfit.

4803.name: Hide Feet
4803.description: Hides your currently-equipped Feet for the current Outfit.

4804.name: Hide Hands
4804.description: Hides your currently-equipped Hands for the current Outfit.

4807.name: Breton Dagger 3
