9774.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Spellscar Lithoarms style.

9775.name: Aurielic Quasigriff
9775.description: Taken from the nest almost as soon as it breaks through its shell, this quasigriff is pampered and preened as befits a creature sacred to Auriel. Its golden feathers are used as fletching by archers in Balfiera.

9776.name: Splendid Seabird Earring
9776.description: Abecean pirates string together beads, shells, and colorful feathers to create earrings. The bead's color is specific to each crew. The crew members of the Storm Snapper use blue beads and string the tail feathers of the Chain Skua into their jewelry.

9777.hint: Awarded by earning the "Master Marine" achievement.
9777.name: Stormsurge Face Markings
9777.description: Artists in Shimerene paint the bodies of explorers with paints made from crushed shells. The designs are said to focus the explorer and help them sense the sea's temperament to avoid disaster.

9778.hint: Awarded by earning the "Dreadsail Reef Conqueror" achievement.
9778.name: Stormsurge Body Markings
9778.description: "I inscribed my face with graceful waves to ward off the ocean's beckoning song. But I can't resist the ocean forever. One day, I'll sail into the horizon and be happily lost among the waves."âAlwoisse, Captain of the Sea's Mystery

9779.name: Old Salt Face Tattoos
9779.description: Your tears taste like the salty waves you brave. Your muscles endure like the anchor that holds your ship fast at sea. And the moons dictate both the tides and your schedule more often than not. Honor these aspects with an artistic facial tattoo.

9780.name: Old Salt Body Tattoos
9780.description: After seeing you stand firm in many an Abecean squall, some claim you have brine for blood. While you wish this were true, you chose the next best thing to express your love of sailing: intricate tattoos of ships and other aspects of life on the high seas!

9781.name: Azure Imp Epidermis
9781.description: "Some, shall we say, ambitious sorts came up with a way to look a bit like those azure imps you sometimes see flitting about. No, you don't gain wings, but you'll very likely frighten most people out of their wits regardless."âDivayth Fyr

9782.name: Mossblood Imp Epidermis
9782.description: "The mossblood imp's coloration lends itself well to walking undetected among the foliage of Valenwood. But perhaps that's not what the mages intended given the provenance of the imp. Unintended consequences abound with imp-related projects."âDivayth Fyr

9783.name: Bargain-Marked Skaafin
9783.description: Whether you hope to travel safely through the Fields of Regret by looking more like a Skaafin or wish to appeal to Clavicus Vile, this skin has you coveredâliterally.

9784.name: Piebald Senche-Serval
9784.description: "Ride one of these piebalds for any travel outside Sentinel. They love the heat more than any senche-serval I've stabled. Makes me believe the tales of Summerset outcasts raising them out in one of the bandit caves nearby decades ago."âBurhan, Stablehand

9785.name: Nightcrest Fellrunner
9785.description: Argonian farmers sell Fellrunner feathers to hunters by the sack. Even one armband of pale Fellrunner down allows hunters to slink through the swamps of Murkwood unnoticed.

9786.name: Screaming Midyear Nixad
9786.description: "Why. Can't. They. Keep. Quiet? Arkay blesses them with their own cycle, but every few years they claw their way back into Greenshade. And what do they do once they get here? Scream. Constantly."âHasinel, Lament of the Midyear Screech

9789.name: Magmaheart
9789.description: "Little stops the patient flow of magma, or so druids have always known. Seeing this quality in you, they whispered words that set your very being aflame. Now, I free you. Go, heart of magma. Burn."âDruid Llanith

9790.name: Daggerfall Paladin
9790.description: "As I keep saying, this armor isn't just for show. I paid for it with blood, honor, and loyalty during Ranser's War. And I wasn't aloneâwe lost many to traitorous fools. Now, what's your story, paladin?"âPaladin Celice Foucher

9791.name: Appleback Salamander
9791.description: Brigands in Wayrest tried to use these creatures to help them harass nobles of that town, but after that plan backfired on them, they sold their stock. Lucky for you, these fiery salamanders receive loyalty training before being sold now.

9792.name: Enchanting Cherry Blossom Visage
9792.description: Painting a sprig of blossoms from Auridon's fair shores on your cheek ensures the petals of your own elegance will bloom in the eyes of all who see it.

9793.name: Enchanting Cherry Blossom Marks
9793.description: "Cherry blossoms in Auridon art symbolize perfection that defies time's erosion. But to paint their likeness? The temporary nature of paint and the artistry of the painting? I've never seen such a stunning display of elegance!"âIdawen, Art Historian

9794.name: Flint-Pelt Fox
9794.description: Legend tells of a Breton hunter who freed a Flint-Pelt Fox from a hagraven's snare. Now these creatures seek out any warrior who calls hagravens "foe," often lingering around areas terrorized by their hated enemies.

9795.name: Hay-Crown Chub Loon
9795.description: Hay-Crown Chub Loons were revered as omens of good harvests until one winter in Rivenspire, when desperate farmers discovered that these creatures were delectable. Druids took the dim-witted, delicious birds with them when they fled to High Isle.

9796.name: Royal Courier
9796.description: A courier's life is fraught with danger. Bandits and political agents lie in wait to intercept royal missives. A courier's clothes often have hidden pockets where they can slip important documents and keep them from the wrong hands.

9797.hint: Obtained by using 25 Coral Haj Mota Lures from Ghost Haven Bay in High Isle, and 25 Coral Haj Mota Decoys from the Spire of the Crimson Coin.
9797.name: Coral Haj Mota
9797.description: Native to the Systres Islands, these haj mota prefer coastal areas, where they spend so much time submerged that coral forms on them. So, if you love to spend quality time at the beach, this fierce predator might just make for a great beach buddy!

9798.name: Nord Carved Cuirass
9798.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Nord Carved style.

9805.name: Falkreath Riding-Lynx
9805.description: The people of Falkreath call these lynxes "blizzard bringers." The cats are as powerful as the buffeting winds that scour the slopes of the Shriekwind Bastion. There are even rumors that the lynx's growl causes avalanches high up in the mountains.

9807.name: Opal Chokethorn Greatsword
9807.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Opal Chokethorn style.

9812.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Opal Chokethorn style.

9813.name: Opal Chokethorn Shoulder
9813.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Opal Chokethorn style.

9814.name: Impish Epidermis
9814.description: Morality is a useless cause with no end other than smug self-satisfaction. Cast that aside and showcase your mischievous nature. You'll know you've succeeded in shirking your former self when your scarred skin pulls tightly across your chest.

9815.name: Anequine Oasis Eyes
9815.description: "Though many dispute whether Khenarthi, S'rendarr, or another spirit grants these jade-green eyes to blessed individuals, all agree on one thing: Those who discover and share the location of an oasis to those in need earn them."âSulema, Initiate Scholar

9816.name: Darloc's Golden Eyes
9816.description: "Darloc Brae, warlord that he was, conquered much in his life. Those with a fiery spirit and peerless martial skills sometimes possess the same molten eyes that blazed from the Golden Beast of Anequina's visage."âSulema, Initiate Scholar

9817.name: Azure Eyes
9817.description: "Some claim those who ventured to Moonshadow, Azura's realm of blinding beauty, leave with these glowing blue eyes, but I think they're just the result of meddling with too much magic."âBivale Saryoni, Scholar

9818.name: Incognito Adventurer's Hood
9818.description: Blend into the crowds of Tamriel's cities and beyond while protecting your head from the environment with this soft-to-the-touch hood. It feels so good you might never want to take it off!

9819.name: Arox the Mutilator
9819.description: Kneel before the mighty Arox and he might just offer to crush your enemies for you! But, as a daedrat. Not his former much bigger self. After adding Arox to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

9820.name: Hezehk
9820.description: Fresh from Madam Whim's in Fargrave, this irrepressible Skaafin immediately imparts a surprisingly upbeat atmosphere to your abode. After adding Hezehk to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

9821.name: Relic-Apprentice Marafar
9821.description: With her initial Daedric studies finished, Marafar hopes to uncover more secrets as she assists Artaeum's Relicmaster. Will you host her efforts? After adding Marafar to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

9822.name: Opal Scourge Harvester Maul
9822.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Opal Scourge Harvester style.

9823.name: Opal Scourge Harvester Bow
9823.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Opal Scourge Harvester style.

9824.name: Opal Scourge Harvester Shield
9824.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Opal Scourge Harvester style.

9825.name: Opal Scourge Harvester Staff
9825.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Opal Scourge Harvester style.

9826.name: Opal Scourge Harvester Sword
9826.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Opal Scourge Harvester style.

9827.name: Opal Scourge Harvester Mask
9827.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Wayrest Sewers II. Available only during the Undaunted Celebration.

9828.name: Opal Scourge Harvester Shoulder
9828.description: Purchased from Chief Urgarlag at an Undaunted Enclave or acquired from an Undaunted Opal Shoulder Coffer. Available only during the Undaunted Celebration.

9829.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r
9829.name: Stitchedwell Stick Guar
9829.description: Soul Shriven knights ride only the most finely stitched steeds. As one old knight proclaimed, "Don't mind the bit of fray at the bottom there. Or the pesky splinters sticking out of the handle. This guar is a jolly smooth ride!"

9836.name: Ocean Lamellar
9836.description: When threatened, the scales on some Sea Elves lengthen from flimsy scales to broad plates. With wider scales of your own, you'll look ready for the danger of crossing the seas in search of enemies and adventure.

9837.name: Salamandrine Guar
9837.description: "Boredom. Boredom and that accursed holiday in Stonefalls. That's why I used my considerable skills to merge a salamander and a guar. Hmm. The colors are striking. It was just a whim, but I'm pleased with the results."âIrastimil Direnni, Creature Creator

9838.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in High Isle.
9838.name: Nighthunter's Cowl
9838.description: "Lord of the Hunt, guide my vision. Let me see through the owl's eyes. Let me find my prey. Let me pierce them with my talons!"âPrayer to Hircine woven into the cowl

9860.name: Stargazer
9860.description: Ready for some restful time staring at the stars? Stretch out and start looking for your favorite constellation with this emote.

9861.name: Feline's Fancy Juggling
9861.description: Up for your next juggling challenge? Try yarn ballsâboth fancy and colorful. Just watch out for pouncing feline friends!

9862.name: Astral Aurora Projector
9862.description: Create a breathtaking aurora effect with a device once known to add wonder to the Direnni halls on Balfiera. So sparkly!

9863.name: Ritual Casting
9863.description: Exhibit your mastery of magical manifestations! Looks magnificent, yes? But what does the ritual do? Oh, that's up to you, of course.

9864.name: Flower Fling
9864.description: Want to show appreciation for a divine performance? Maybe express your deep adoration to someone? Toss them a flower!

9865.name: Hoard of the Schemers
9865.description: This war chest? It's all yours now, and you're not afraid to defend it! Schemers seeking to retrieve it best beware if they try anything.

9866.name: Wargame Ballista
9866.description: Set yourself against your yard war foes with this portable ballista. As you take aim, just remember that it's a game, not an actual war.

9867.name: Elite Seat
9867.description: Take your place on this elegant throne and survey all who seek your leadership.

9868.name: Air the Heir
9868.description: Grant refreshing relief to those around you by waving this graceful fan.

9869.name: Wait the Great
9869.description: Dignity. Aplomb. Poise. Unceasing imperturbability. These traits suffuse your very being as you attend to the needs of others.

9870.name: Bumbling Artificer
9870.description: Oh, hey, what's this â¦ uh. Oops. You didn't see that. That didn't just happen.

9871.name: Boomerang Blunder
9871.description: Until you master the art of the Valenwood boomerang, expect to break a few things. Potentially including someone else's nose.

9872.name: Aurelian Osprey Coronel
9872.description: Ospreys are known for their precision, ruthlessness, and endurance. Wealthy mariners in Summerset believe wearing one of these bejeweled raptors gives them the insight of a seafaring predator.

9873.name: Society Domino Mask
9873.description: Whether you're attending masquerades in High Isle or Daggerfall, this mask and hood provides you with stylish anonymity. Keep one in your pack for those last-minute invitations to another royal gala.

9874.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
9874.name: Rubyflare Torchnix
9874.description: "Legends claim the Erabenimsun tamed these luminous creatures after Ashu-Ammu rode the first nix-ox into battle. While it's strange to choose a steed whose glow gives away your position, some warriors delight in added danger before battle."âMurdyn Athren

9875.name: Hel Ra Camel of Kingship
9875.description: "At first, Baezati was angry. They give him a camel? Baezati rides nothing less than a charger. But this one must confess he enjoyed the ride. It was smooth. Fast. Surefooted. Even the rocks around Hel Ra gave the beast no issues."âBaezati's Travelogues

9876.name: Graniteclaw Durzog
9876.description: "Graniteclaw Durzogs gorge themselves on the array of sea life swimming around the Systres Archipelago. Their markings help them blend in with the reefs and their feathers keep water from dripping into their eyes."âExcerpt from Physiology of Amphibians

9877.name: Battle-Scarred Visage
9877.description: The life of a fighter is fraught with danger, whether it be battling to the death in the Arena district or dealing with ambushes on the road. Scars, and proof that you have the skills to survive, are the mark of a hirable adventurer.

9878.name: Battle-Scarred Body
9878.description: "Mortals think they can fight Zazriz in Dredaza's area and return unscathed and alive? Zazriz laughs. The only mortals Zazriz respects are ones who bear proof of surviving battle. Come, fools, let Zazriz give you the scars of respect."âZazriz, Gladiator

9911.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Tower Full of Trouble."
9911.name: Ember
9911.description: A talented Mage and former street kid, Ember is a chaotic, earnest, notorious troublemaker. In short, she's a certified disaster. Call this companion to your side for a bit of chaos and help her fuel her endless curiosity for mystic knowledge.

9912.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Tournament of the Heart."
9912.name: Isobel Veloise
9912.description: Brave, forthright, and just a little dorky, Isobel Veloise is a knight errant sworn in your service. Call this companion to your side and lead her forth in search of glorious tales, wrongs to right, and delicious candy sweets.

9977.name: Aurora Firepot Spider
9977.description: Feeling festive? Let this little firepot spider follow you around! With its adorable alchemical light show, you're bound to brighten up anyone's dayâincluding your own!

9978.name: Salamandrine Pony Guar
9978.description: "To my chagrin, thieves stole my current batch of pony guars! I'd hoped to gift some to my cousin, who adored my salamandrine guar and whose love of pony guars knows no bounds. Those thieves had better watch out."âIrastimil Direnni, Creature Creator

9979.name: Midnight Cantor Senche-Raht
9979.description: After spending years expelling dro-m'Athra from Nirn, M'aar decided to follow a new path. Now they hope to explore as much of the Mundus as possible before venturing to the Gates of the Crossing.

9980.name: Tortoiseshell Echatere
9980.description: While they often disagree on theology, the Orsinium Orcs are unified by their love of this echatere's coat. Some call it a blessing from Trinimac. Others call it an outcast's brand from Malacath. Either way, this beast is a bundle of skittering joy.

9981.name: Spellscar Kagouti
9981.description: Driven to madness by the erratic magic around the Spellscar, these kagouti make surprisingly excellent pets. In comparison to their lucid and more aggressive kin, an insane kagouti is docile and picks up commands with ease.

9982.name: Wraithtide Senche
9982.description: "Some believe these skeletal senche respond to the call of a lost soul seeking safe passage. I firmly believe Y'ffre's hand is involved, and I pray I can prove it one day."âDruid Phillic

9983.name: Wraithtide Horse
9983.description: "The day a Stonelore druid thundered in on this frightful sea-birthed horse, well â¦ let's just say I'm glad I recognized Druid Dolvasie on top. Her ferocious expression will haunt my nightmaresâas will this steed."âSquire Hareld, Oaken Order

9984.name: Wraithtide Guar
9984.description: "The ghost of Ol' Brineburr herds glowing guar down trade roads, seeking buyers. Don't be put off by their appearance. Or, hmmm, maybe seeing your steed's skeleton is a bonus to you? Regardless, get one."âInitiate Rogeric

9985.name: Wraithtide Bear
9985.description: "Where mages born from water gather, they enact ancient rites. Together they bind the essence of bear and sea and death, forming it into a mount one of their number may ride. Or so the tales go."âDruid Sandire

9986.name: Wraithtide Wolf
9986.description: "Communing with the Evergrowth is sometimes confusing. I saw the waters birth an unusual wolf pack, flowing like the angry waves that gave them life. Experience proves they possess the same loyalty other wolves have toward their riders."âDruid Anotille

9997.description: "Respect the dovah-fly. They are the spirits of the ancestors given new life. They brighten the quiet tranquility of ponds and streams. What better afterlife is there?"âDruid Henneque Blakeley

9998.name: Yoltoor Dovah-Fly
9998.description: Shimmering like fire, these dovah-flies dart around port cities, eating many of the nuisance insects that pester transported livestock. Recently, merchants started training and selling them to help others with insect issues.

9999.name: Armory Station
9999.description: You can place this station in multiple homes, where it allows you and your guests to save and equip Armory builds.

10039.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Nazaray style.

10040.name: Nazaray Staff
10040.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Nazaray style.

10041.name: Nazaray Mace
10041.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Nazaray style.

10042.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Nazaray Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.
10042.name: Nazaray Mask
10042.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Shipwright's Regret.

10043.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Nazaray Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.
10043.name: Nazaray Shoulder
10043.description: Purchased from Urgarlag Chief-bane at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Urgarlag Chief-bane's Mystery Coffer.

10051.name: Ossa Accentium
10051.description: Once the home of an eccentric merchant-collector, this sumptuous manor possesses a view framed by one of Fargrave's otherworldly skeletons plus offers easy access to all the amenities and exotic goods this city provides.

10052.name: Agony's Ascent
10052.description: Cautioning whispers about these dominating spires convince the wary to avoid the place for fear of torture â¦ or worse. Those with courage, though, might find the stalwart tower and commanding views make for an imposing Oblivion keep.

10053.name: High Isle
10053.description: The Society of the Steadfast calls all able-bodied adventurers to the island of High Isle in the Systres Archipelago to assist in a matter of great import to all alliances. Seek out Lady Arabelle Davaux in the city of Gonfalon Bay for details.

10055.name: Ossified Rime Wolf
10055.description: "Tears of rage and hatred don't go wasted in Skyrim. These rare droplets fall upon the snow, calling a spirit of bone and rime from Aetherius. Within seconds, a frost-spiked wolf forms, snarling and bridled with grim purpose."âHef, Tale Collector

10056.name: Reefstrider Ornaug
10056.description: Scales the color of High Isle's sky speckle this beast, making it highly sought after by nobles. When domesticated, the Reefstrider joyfully takes its rider across tidepools and shallows, but avoids the deepsâespecially in northern climes.

10057.name: Forge Master's Charger
10057.description: Though some claim these fiery steeds first sprang from the Earth Forge, others make a case for the fires of Morkuldin's Descent taking that honor. None can quench the blaze of this incandescent horse!

10058.name: Ruby Fledgling Terror Bird
10058.description: With plumage as vibrant as the setting sun, these terror birds are often trained to parade around the halls of Rimmen. Nobles delight in the strangeness of their movements and the brilliance of their feathers.

10059.name: Volkihar Death Hound
10059.description: Rarely do these inky black death hounds venture beyond Castle Volkiharâmost serve their master's purpose at home better than abroad. The ones wandering after folk are probably some form of spy for the Volkihar vampires.âNalana, Advisor to House Tamrith

10060.name: Heartland Butcher's Dog
10060.description: Families along the Niben River bred Butcher's dogs to protect their homesteads. The dogs earned their name generations later when the farmers realized they were more likely to watch the ribs and roasts than the front door.

10061.name: Azuredoom Wrathsteed
10061.description: "The sight of this welwa's claws sparks something in my imagination, showing me different scenarios where those icy talons end my life. It's beautiful. In a horrible, gruesome way. I wonder if it can be tamed?"âPyn Bossard, Welwa Researcher (Deceased)

10062.name: Baysong Quasigriff
10062.description: Unlike their mainland cousins, the quasigriffs of the Systres Archipelago have vibrant, sea-tinted feathers. Admittedly, Irastimil Direnni never intended to create such colorful creatures. Noble Bretons adore them and travel about High Isle on their backs.

10063.name: Brineglow
10063.description: Extensive proximity to a certain breed of ornaug may cause these unusual luminescent markings to appear. Or such is the claim of the druids. True or not, they make for great tavern discussions.

10065.name: Aurulun Fledgling Gryphon
10065.description: Spring blossoms nod their heads as if recognizing kin in this Elf-pampered companion. Some caretakers claim these gryphons provide a sense of ease to those who care for themâand pain for those who seek their demise.

10066.name: Scaled Sabatons
10066.description: A unique Outfit look for footwear in the Scaled Sabatons style, acquired through digging for Antiquities.

10067.name: Mantle Pelagicon Epaulets
10067.description: A unique Outfit look for shoulders in the Mantle Pelagicon style, acquired through digging for Antiquities.

10068.name: Hallowed Hourglass Basin
10068.description:
A small golden offering bowl engraved with Dragon imagery and filled with consecrated sand.

The first of three components required to create a Soulfire Dragon Illusion.

10069.name: Illuminated Dragon Scroll
10069.description:
A vellum scroll upon which prayers to the Dragon God are inscribed.

The second of three components required to create a Soulfire Dragon Illusion.

10070.name: Kvatchian Incense
10070.description:
Sacred incense burned in the offering bowl that propitiate Akatosh for his blessing.

The last of three components required to create a Soulfire Dragon Illusion.

10071.name: Aureate Anointing Oils
10071.description:
Sacred golden oils rubbed on the skin before holy rituals to the Dragon God.

A component required for the Scales of Akatosh skin.

10072.name: Lustrous Ritual Sand
10072.description:
A scattering of pearlescent hourglass sand.

A component required for the Scales of Akatosh skin.

10179.name: Sacred Scale
10179.description:
A single golden dragonscale.

A component required for the Scales of Akatosh skin.

10181.name: Statuette: Kaladas of Leyawiin
10181.description: A miniature statue of Saint Kaladas, builder of the Great Chapel of Zenithar in Leyawiin.

10182.name: Statuette: Mehrunes Dagon
10182.description: A miniature statue of Mehrunes Dagon, Daedric Prince of Destruction and Ambition.

10183.name: Painting: Dagon's Mercy
10183.description: A painting of Mehrunes Dagon, towering over his cultists in the Deadlands.

10184.name: Giladil the Ragpicker
10184.description:
Giladil happily trades items you don't need for useful crafting materials! She doesn't ply her trade in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds because those areas aren't lucrative enough.

After she's summoned, you and your groupmates can use her services.

10186.name: Stoneglow Imp
10186.description: "Don't let those icy blue eyes fool you. It's their claws you need to keep an eye onâthey can shatter stone, leaving behind nothing but glowing rubble. Thankfully, they're actually quite good-natured creatures once they imprint on you."âDivayth Fyr

10187.name: Druidic Knotwork Body Tattoos
10187.description: To the druids, the repetition of one braid forming three-sided shapes is a symbol that all three druidic circles share the same goals. A reminder that unity eclipses the differences in how they revere Y'ffre.

10188.name: Druidic Knotwork Face Tattoos
10188.description: "Use ash, root earth, or sea ink. Loop the sign of the united circles upon your face and look over the splendor of the forests and sea foam with clarity. Let Y'ffre guide your eyes to all he creates."âRitual blessing of the Draoife high priests

10189.name: Defensive Rune Face Tattoos
10189.description: "Julianos, god of all that is known to be true, guide my eyes toward the answers I seek. Let me cast my spells successfully. Through your power, may my lessons be everlasting."âRitual prayer to Julianos

10190.name: Defensive Rune Body Tattoos
10190.description: The Scholar-priests of Skingrad fashioned these triangular markings to call on the knowledge of the God of Wisdom and Logic. Bearers of the markings say that their memory improved after completing the tattoos.

10191.name: High Isle Mariner's Face Tattoos
10191.description: "Want to earn respect from High Isle sailors? Laugh in the face of a mast-shearing storm between here and Amenos, plus feed a few pirates to the fishes, and I'll ink your face so that all know your spirit."âFlorent Renaudin, Tattoo Artist

10192.name: High Isle Mariner's Body Tattoos
10192.description: "Life on the waters calls for courage, calm, and canniness. Show all three while we're facing down Dreadsails or ornaug throngs, and we'll take you out for Gonfalon grog and tattoos like mine."âGermonde Baduoin, Sailor

10193.name: Cutting Edge
10193.description: Your tongue isn't the only sharp thing about youâyour keen coif can slice right through the pompous bluster of even the stodgiest get-together.

10194.name: Stillrise Ritecaller
10194.description: "The few Kothringi that survived the tumultuous events at Stillrise Village now serve the Ideal Masters. So if you see this garb, flee."âOrranvir

10195.name: Reefdweller
10195.description: The colorful inhabitants of High Isle reefs often act differently when land-dwellers approach. To better swim among the local aquatic life, druids imitate them by imbuing their skin with gorgeous blues and greens. Care to try it?

10196.name: Ethertide
10196.description: "I walked through the waters of the Ancient Darkness. The waves of the Void washed through me. Tread in the nothingness too long and it seeps into you. Mangles you. Twists you into something other than what you were."âOpius Balvel, Oblivion Walker

10197.name: Red Diamond Face Stainwork
10197.description: Resembling the glass forged in the fires of an artisan's workshop, this marking is painted on the brow of anyone who's been tempered by the flames of the empire's collapse. The marking may wash away with rain, but the vow remains.

10198.name: Red Diamond Body Stainwork
10198.description: "The glass stained on my skin as it is in the temples of the Imperial city is a pledge. Not to a dreamâfleeting and unattainableâbut to the future that lays before us. An oath to see the empire restored!"âGarrus Congonius, Champion of the Heartlands

10199.name: Druid-Bound Ursauk
10199.description: "I prefer the company of animals over people. Communing with the Evergrowth provides a calming respite from the need to speak. This ursauk, for example, has proven most personable. And now, it needs a rider."âDruid Dolvasie

10200.name: Scavenger Legion Helm
10200.description: "If you see a soldier with a swooping carrion bird on their helm, walk away. They're Imperials, sure, but this band of warriors survives the Cyrodiil warzone using tactics that would make a Dremora blush."âHingor Netch-Eater

10201.name: Stonelore Bear
10201.description: Each of the druid circles keeps a different ursine companion. The Stonelore bear was originally bred to help with ambitious construction projects. While druids shaped heavy stone slabs, their bears supported the more fragile components of the structures.

10202.name: Stonelore Elk
10202.description: "We value elk for their nimble hooves and gentle nature. They accompany us where larger beasts cannot go. They do not shirk in the face of danger or abandon their work. I wish I could say the same about some of the initiates! Hmph!"âDruid Barjot

10203.name: Stonelore Fox
10203.description: Druid stories say that the first foxes swam from Y'ffelon shortly before Mount Firesong spewed ash and flame. Those who befriend a Stonelore fox live long lives, though the Stonelore insist it has nothing to do with the fox's survival instincts.

10204.name: Stonelore Guar
10204.description: "This one adores the guar with its useless small arms and big round head. J'zurdru and the guar bonded over a love of belly rubs. Also napping on warm rocks and watching the clouds in the sky. Lazy but very relaxing, yes?"âDruid J'zurdru

10205.name: Stonelore Lynx
10205.description: "It may be a little biased of us, but predators take longer to earn their horns. I suppose we just want proof that they're well-trained before we give them another weapon. Still, little Ivy was so proud when she got hers."âDruid Celina, Beast Master

10206.name: Oldefire Elk
10206.description: "On the first night of Hearthfire, folks all over the Systres burn blessed oldefire logs. The smoke mingles with the soughing of leaves, giving form to spirits unseen the rest of the year. They take the form of loyal elk steeds."âBook of the Leaves

10207.name: Harvestleaf Lynx
10207.description: "When trees shrug off their colorful mantles, druids gather around a lynx summoned by Y'ffre. While they sing chants, the God of Song and Forest transforms the feline into a steed. Only a Hearthfire champion may claim such a mount."âBook of the Leaves

10208.name: Glimmertarn Ursauk
10208.description: "We choose some of our guardians based on their overwhelming presence, like this ursauk. While riding it, I swear that the marrow in my bones resonates with her growls."âRolmanoril of Glimmertarn

10209.name: Mottled Sheep
10209.description: "Her calm presence keeps our patients at ease. Sometimes I ask them about the patterns and shapes they see in her coat, and their answers give me insight into their state of mind."âMender Teliel

10210.name: Nibenay Bay Ram
10210.description: "Sturdy rams graze the lush meadowlands all around Nibenay Bay. An amusing tale claims they first became steeds because the local herbalist wearied of them eating all the nirnroot. They were trained to saddle and now, here we are."âSadia Vonius, Student

10211.name: Su-Zahleel Horse-Lizard
10211.description: "Lizard-steeds are a gift from the Hist. They have dependable backs and dry scales. You know, we only realized how entwined our roots were when we trekked back from Mazzatun. These beasts kept us off our aching feet."âSkeexalttul, Su-Zahleel Ambassador

10212.name: Amberdust Wamasu Hatchling
10212.description: "I found the wamasu that â¦ resisted my care. It bit my hand. It's blue! Well, more of a tealish color. Did the druid's magic affect the creature? Or was it some other factor? I think I'll release more of them!"âValerine Cadiou, Master Beast Tamer

10213.name: Knights of St. Pelin Face Marks
10213.description: "Envying my friend's wing tattoos, are you? If you want your own, join the Order of Saint Pelin. Once you've made your vows and served honorably alongside us, you may just earn your own wings. It's bloody work, though. You up for it?"âSir Falbalg

10214.name: Knights of St. Pelin Body Marks
10214.description: Saint Pelin's story is one of sacrifice. The Order of Saint Pelin honors his gift to this day. It's traditional for blood from a new knight to be mixed with tattoo ink and used to create this sword and wing iconography.

10215.name: Jakarn
10215.description: Thief though he is, Jakarn promises not to steal from your house if you allow him to stay. But as to your heart? Well, that's a different matter. After adding Jakarn to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

10217.name: Jester Anglidor
10217.description: This Jester's Fest performer brings all the joy and frivolity of that holiday to your homeâperfect for when you wish to host a friendly gathering! After adding Jester Anglidor to your home, you can set him on a path and interact with him.

10218.name: Ascendant Outfit Style
10218.description: Unlocks all 7 Ascendant Knight outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

10219.name: Statuette: Steadfast Stendarr
10219.description: A miniature statue of the Divine Stendarr, God of Mercy, Justice, and Charity.

10220.name: Statuette: Prince Hew
10220.description: A miniature statue of the Yokudan Prince Hew, who is also known as Prince Hubalajad.

10221.name: Painting: The Gates of Brass
10221.description: A painting of the Brass Fortress, seat of power for the Clockwork God, Sotha Sil.

10222.name: Frostmoss Imp
10222.description: "Why do people insist on having imps about? And why especially these kind? They twist whatever you tell them to do into something that serves them best, not you. Only those with an extraordinarily firm hand should even bother with them."âDivayth Fyr

10223.name: Seaveil Spire
10223.description: Early in the First Era, a pious tribe of Nedes followed the Tower's guidance to an undersea anomaly, where they built a submerged sanctuary. Millennia later, the edifice and anomaly remain, providing a secure and wondrous escape from the surface world.

10224.name: Sterling Cavy
10224.description: "The cavy's placid essence makes them nature's mediators, dear. I adopted this one years ago. There's an undeniable sophistication in silver hair, you see. It gives one the impression of wisdom, whether earned or not."âLady Arabelle Davaux

10225.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
10225.name: Bleakrock Snowdog
10225.description: Originally hailing from Bleakrock Isle, these blue-eyed canines love playing in the frosty air and snow of that distant spit of land. In fact, the locals often bring them inside at night just so that they aren't awoken by their antics in the morning.

10226.name: Feed Bird
10226.description: Take a moment to breathe and feed the birds. There's always a hungry bird somewhere, after all!

10227.name: Sword Dance
10227.description: According to the Way of the Sword, the blade must become an extension of the body. Display a Redguard's weapon-mastery with this stylish display!

10228.name: Where's My Drink?
10228.description: Lost your drink, eh? Well, where did you last have it? Check there.

10229.name: Crab Pinch
10229.description: That crab seems interested in you. Is it friendly? It seems that maybeâno, no, ouch! It's pinching your finger!

10230.name: Sit and Drink
10230.description: Rest your weary feet and slake your mighty thirst! You deserve it.

10231.name: Ashgray Senche-Serval
10231.description: "House Mornard won't say where it tamed these gorgeous beasts. My guess is Summerset. For a time, only the elder nobles of that house rode their own. Now, after a downturn in Mornard fortunes, you'll find them all over Tamriel."âSadia Vonius, Student

10232.name: Aurelite Gryphon Feather
10232.description:
A gleaming golden gryphon feather.

A component required for the Aurielic Quasigriff mount.

10233.name: Gilded Gryphon Barding
10233.description:
Gilded mount barding fitted for a quasigriff.

A component required for the Aurielic Quasigriff mount.

10234.name: Sacred Seeds of Akatosh
10234.description:
Enchanted seeds fit for consumption as animal feed.

A component required for the Aurielic Quasigriff mount.

10235.name: Cadwell's Surprise Box
10235.description: Surprise boxes are fun! Why, you never know what will pop out. But wait. Is that â¦ Cadwell?

10236.name: Mariner's Nimbus Stone
10236.description: Whether by magic or blessing, you've discovered a wondrous stone that shows the world just how attuned you are to the sea.

10237.name: Warmaiden's Wolf
10237.description: While Nords claim this lightning-limned wolf seeks out Kyne's champions to serve, the Stonelore Druids believe differently. Only an imbalance in nature would cause such a creature to coalesce. Its purpose? To find a rider who can restore the balance.

10238.name: Morthal Bear-Dog
10238.description: It's the prestige of the mastiffs of Morthal that give the city's resident breed of bear-dog license to be a bit more â¦ silly. Whether watching over children or facing intruders, someone's bound to get a licking.

10239.hint: Awarded by earning the "Lost Depths Explorer" achievement.
10239.name: Mulberry Hermit Crab
10239.description: Before the druids, before the coin-barons, before even the noble houses, the hermit crab held dominion over the Systres. Hauling its belongings wherever it travels, its beady eyes give you a look that seems to say, "We're not so different, you and I."

10240.name: Rustpelt Sabre Cat
10240.description: "Where'd I get the cat? Cards. Poor thing was used in place of coin by some pet-smuggling lowlife. I'm teaching her how to count cards and fetch me a pint."âPrivateer Mahk

10241.name: Pop the Cork
10241.description: It's time to celebrate! Pop open that sparkling cider and enjoy the moment.

10242.hint: Awarded by earning the "Swashbuckler Supreme" achievement.
10242.name: Stormsurge Howler
10242.description: Covered in coral and barnacles, this unusual sea creature moves like rushing water, creating a smooth traveling experience for its riders. Some speculate that Kyne crafted them from a sea storm and sent them to land to find those who revere her.

10243.name: Anchorborn Pony
10243.description: "Now, I says to my friend, look at all this dark anchor debris. No one's using it. No one owns it. And I look at his pony, this sickly little thing, and I say, why not make ourselves something nice?"â"Innovator" Delan

10244.name: Speckled Welwa
10244.description: This savage welwa so interested members of the College of Sapiarchs that they brought several to Sil-Var-Woad for study. To help endear them to the public, an enterprising conservator trained them to saddle and "lent" them out into the wild.

10245.name: Spyglass
10245.description: Scan the horizon for distant shores with your trusty spyglass. Better to know the lay of the land than go in unprepared, yes?

10246.name: Glimmer Dust
10246.description: Add a bit of alchemy to your day by using this fine powder.
10246.hint: Awarded by earning the "Steadfast Collaborator" achievement.

10247.name: Guardian's Frozen Shard
10247.description: A glacial fragment from the body of one of the timeless guardians found in the Coral Aerie. It freezes anything it touches.
10247.hint: Awarded by earning the "Coral Aerie Conqueror" achievement.

10248.name: Maormer Ocean Pearl
10248.description: This perfectly smooth, aquamarine pearl is supposedly the essence of the ocean itself. Holding it makes you feel at one with the sea.
10248.hint: Awarded by earning the "Seafaring Sleuth" achievement.

10249.name: Lover's Quandary Flower
10249.description: They love me â¦ they love me not.

10250.name: Ringtail Jerboa
10250.description: The eye-catching tail pouf of the ringtail jerboa makes for a daring fashion statement especially appreciated by the aristocracy of High Isle. It's also, of course, used for balance.

10251.name: Hermit Crab
10251.description: "See the crab's big tidepool eyes? Delicious. Their big claws that can fell saplings with one snip? The meat inside is as juicy as the fruit about to drop off a tree. Trust me. Keep one of these around in case you need a snack."âXoko, Hee-Tepsleel Chef

10252.name: Pangrit Nymphling
10252.description: "My study of pangrits have provided few clues as to their origin. Their young don't possess the spikes of the adults, and their hide is supple like velvet. I could almost hug one of these smaller versions! Almost."âSadia Vonius, Student

10253.name: Turquoise War Pangrit
10253.description: "Some claim the Hadolids created the pangrits somehow. I suspect they simply tamed these spiky beasts. If they'd made them, they'd be smarter. If a pangrit wants something, they poke you. Learn quickly how to tell what they want!"âSaissula, Stablemaster

10254.name: Wayrest Vanner Pillion Steed
10254.description: Bred by savvy Wayrest stablehands to handle heavy loads, these horses can carry more than one rider. The saddle, crafted by leatherworker Amal, provides both riders with stability while making for an easy ride on the animal.

10255.name: Liespinner's Vestments
10255.description: Acolytes of Mephala spread falsehoods and disinformation to keep their secrets hidden. When they meet, they don these vestments to conceal their identities. Beware her whispers beneath the veil.

10256.name: Sinistral Cincture Belt
10256.description: A unique Outfit look for belts in the Sinistral Cincture style, acquired through digging for Antiquities.

10257.name: Encratis's Behemoth Maul
10257.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Encratis's Behemoth style.

10258.name: Encratis's Behemoth Bow
10258.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Encratis's Behemoth style.

10259.name: Encratis's Behemoth Shield
10259.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Encratis's Behemoth style.

10260.name: Encratis's Behemoth Staff
10260.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Encratis's Behemoth style.

10261.name: Encratis's Behemoth Sword
10261.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Encratis's Behemoth style.

10262.hint:
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r
10262.name: Grand Joust Destrier
10262.description: "A knight's mount is the extension of her body. Four more legs to push her forward. Two longer ears, to warn her of danger. And a large heart to pump courage through her veins."âGwenifyr Dufort, The Meaning of Chivalry

10277.name: Lemondot Netch
10277.description: "Do colors seem louder? Does music taste different? Does Tirdas have a personality? You're probably experiencing the synesthesic venom of the rare lemondot netch. Relax. It's harmless. A little new perspective never killed anybody."âAlinon the Alchemist

10278.name: Soulrazer Knight
10278.description: While the origin of the Soulrazer Knights is shrouded in mystery, their power and dogged determination are legendary. Assume their guise and watch your enemies run in terror at the sight of your unnatural glow.

10279.name: House Dufort Banneret Cuirass
10279.description: An Outfit look for chests in the House Dufort Banneret style.

10280.name: House Dufort Banneret Helm
10280.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the House Dufort Banneret style.

10281.name: House Dufort Banneret Greaves
10281.description: An Outfit look for legs in the House Dufort Banneret style.

10282.name: House Dufort Banneret Pauldrons
10282.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the House Dufort Banneret style.

10283.name: House Dufort Banneret Sabatons
10283.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the House Dufort Banneret style.

10284.name: House Dufort Banneret Gauntlets
10284.description: An Outfit look for hands in the House Dufort Banneret style.

10285.name: House Dufort Banneret Girdle
10285.description: An Outfit look for waists in the House Dufort Banneret style.

10286.name: Boneman
10286.description: "We die. We pray. To live. We serve."âThe Boneman's Oath, The Book of Life and Service

10287.name: Jubilee Cake 2022
10287.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. So zesty with a touch of heatâwake up your taste buds!
10287.hint: Obtained by completing the 2022 Anniversary event.

10288.name: Sentinel Fox Mask
10288.description: Popularized at one of King Fahara'jad's festivities by young Maraya before she came of age, these ornate masks became de rigueur at Sentinel gatherings for many weeks. Some still proudly display them on shelves, while others wear them out of nostalgia.

10290.name: New Moon Fox
10290.description: "Do not underestimate the foxes trained by the Cult of the New Moon. Their glowing crimson eyes should be enough to warn you away. If you are foolish enough to attempt to steal an adult, say farewell to Nirn."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers

10292.hint: |cffffffEquipping this outfit style hides your stowed shield, bow, staff, or two-handed weapon.|r
10292.name: High Rock Spellsword Jerkin
10292.description: An Outfit look for chests in the High Rock Spellsword style.

10293.name: High Rock Spellsword Hat
10293.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the High Rock Spellsword style.

10294.name: High Rock Spellsword Breeches
10294.description: An Outfit look for legs in the High Rock Spellsword style.

10295.name: High Rock Spellsword Epaulets
10295.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the High Rock Spellsword style.

10296.name: High Rock Spellsword Shoes
10296.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the High Rock Spellsword style.

10297.name: High Rock Spellsword Gloves
10297.description: An Outfit look for hands in the High Rock Spellsword style.

10298.name: High Rock Spellsword Sash
10298.description: An Outfit look for waists in the High Rock Spellsword style.

10299.hint: |cffffffEquipping this outfit style hides your stowed shield, bow, staff, or two-handed weapon.|r
10299.name: High Rock Spellsword Robe
10299.description: An Outfit look for chests in the High Rock Spellsword style.

10300.name: Trophy: Kargaeda
10300.description: Trophy taken from Varallion in honor of an Undaunted victory in Coral Aerie.

10301.name: Trophy: Nazaray
10301.description: Trophy taken from the Maormer Pirate in honor of an Undaunted victory in Shipwright's Regret

10302.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Coral Aerie.
10302.name: Bust: Kargaeda
10302.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Coral Aerie.

10303.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Shipwright's Regret.
10303.name: Bust: Nazaray
10303.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Shipwright's Regret.

10304.name: Fashion Witch Ensemble
10304.description: "Hold onto your crystals, fellow witches! Why eschew fashion for practicality, when we can have both? Wear my original design, and you can conjure a potent potion and the affections of everyone around the cauldron. Happy witching!" âWeavewitch Faetia

10305.name: Wyrd Sight
10305.description: The most dedicated champions of the forest receive visions from their Wyrd Sight, a gift from the Sisters. As to what those visions are, well. It depends on the champion.

10306.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Challenges of the Past" in High Isle.
10306.name: Jerall Rescue Dog
10306.description: When merchants don't arrive through the passes of the Jerall Mountains as expected, groups of searchers head out with these well-trained dogs to find them. More than a few winter caravans have these friendly dogs to thank for their lives.

10307.hint: Awarded by earning the "Life of the Party" achievement.
10307.name: Stonelore's Legend Face Paint
10307.description: Instead of looking to recreate the mountains or symmetry of stones, Stonelore Druids developed a pattern of looping swirls and harsh line breaks. They paint it in charcoal and ash around one eye to represent the ever-watchful gaze of Y'ffre.

10308.hint: Awarded by earning the "Ascendant Unmasked" achievement.
10308.name: Stonelore's Legend Body Paint
10308.description: "Don't ask a Stonelore druid about their markings. They'll tell you a long tale about how one of their ancient practitioners went six days without sleep and saw the magic of Y'ffre swirling about him. What nonsense!"âThe Final Correspondence of Lernynyas

10309.name: Vinedusk Vigilant
10309.description: Among the Vinedusk Rangers lurks an even more dangerous force: assassin-scouts who move quietly through forests, dealing with any who pose a threat. Sometimes called "tree ghosts," they wear custom-made gear that works with their preferred combat styles.

10311.name: Highland Spotted Lynx Cub
10311.description: Years ago, vermin overran Kvatch during a poor harvest year. To combat this threat to their low winter food supplies, the citizens brought in spotted lynx cubs from breeders. These creatures love freshly hunted vermin, warm hearths, and crusty bread.

10312.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
10312.name: Highland Spotted Lynx
10312.description: This spotted lynx was an uncommon sight in the Colovian hills until an enterprising hunter brought back some young to raise. Decades later, these lithe creatures serve well as mounts to those who prefer felines.

10313.name: Dockside Paper Wasp
10313.description: "Clearing wasps from the Betnikh docks falls to our youngest warrior. One such asked a mage to help her befriend the wasps, and she led them away. All but one settled elsewhere, instead choosing to follow her loyally. I see you have one now."âStulga

10315.name: Eyes of Umaril
10315.description: "Some say that Umaril the Unfeathered can work through mortals, making their eyes glow. You see someone with yellow radiance in their eyes? Think twice before pummeling such folk."âGlobura of Gonfalon Bay

10316.name: Autumnal Indrik
10316.description: As the weather chills and leaves take on fiery hues, the spirit of this young indrik begins to stir. When a paladin of Jephre performs an act the God of Song and Forest finds worthy, it takes its shaky steps into the world.

10317.name: Moss Spine Daedrat
10317.description: "We found daedrats eating our ceremonial supplies in the cellar last Midyear. Now the damned things have gone green, and the Archdruid says they're a bridge from Galen to Oblivion? Draigh!"âCallice Marence, formerly of Daggerfall

10318.name: Saturalia Ice Steed
10318.description: Tales tell of a mercenary abandoned by her lord during a storm. Her frozen lips begged for help. Sanguine heard her pleas, forming the ice into a steed. Come Saturalia morn, the crimson blood of that lord drenched the snow and evergreen boughs.

10319.name: Piebald Cat
10319.description: Bretons have a strange practice of letting piebald cats loose in the secret passages of their manor homes. It stems from an ancient, noisy infestation of Sheogorath's never-there beetles. It took years, but the clever felines eventually killed them all.

10320.name: Orchid Whisper Moth
10320.description: The Dragonstar Caravan Company first found these brilliant moths while traveling from Evermore. Though attracted to the campfires, they didn't burn themselves. Instead, they settled on the caravan's goods, then followed them as if guarding them.

10321.name: Sweetgrape Dragon Frog
10321.description: Once bred for their ability to smell when a grape is perfectly ripe, the Sweetgrape Dragon Frog is now considered an invasive pest. Winemakers go to great lengths to keep the grape-loving frog away from their vineyards.

10323.name: Shallowbay Nereid
10323.description: "Splash among the fish and flora? Looking like a nereid scaled in hues of coral, pearl, and night? Speak to me no more of this pure joy. This unadulterated bliss. You merely tease, yes. Yet â¦ magic, you say?"âTariran, Seeker of New Experiences

10324.name: Fellbraun Chub Loon
10324.description: The naivety of the chub loons endears them to druids, whose mission is to protect nature. When the Eldertide landed on Galen and found a new species, they took it as a blessing from Y'ffre and built their villages where the loons make their nests.

10325.name: Silver-Bellied Guarling
10325.description: "In retrospect, attempting to add nirnroot to molten silver by using magic was a terrible idea. Now my guarlings and I are covered in silver, blue, and black streaks. Nothing I do will change us back. At least it's attractive!"âMy Experiments, Vol. 5

10326.name: Galen Wisp
10326.description: Wisps are sent from Y'ffre to herald the storms of Rain's Hand. To see one is to see the promise of new growth, new life, and a new chapter in nature's cycle.

10328.name: Ragebound Steed
10328.description: "Studies into ragebound breeds trace their lineage to Hircine and the Reach. Legend says the Lord of the Hunt gifted the first Ragebound Horse to a tribe after witnessing them chase down a vampire. On foot. In the dark."âBeastmaster's Practical Bestiary

10329.name: Ragebound Sabre Cat
10329.description: "When you're at your worstâwhen the only thing keeping you going is pure rage? That is the moment you know its strength. These cats will happily teach you this lesson, if you need a tutor."âArparnagh of Markarth

10330.name: Ragebound Bear
10330.description: "Each pelt and bone on this monster of a bear reminds its rider of past battles. Rage turned to an end. Victory ripped from the rider's enemies. You know the feeling, I think. It's in your eyes. Rage. Barely controlled."âArparnagh of Markarth

10331.name: Ragebound Kagouti
10331.description: "You're not hearing me. These were nothing like normal kagouti. Fury, froth, and carnage. And their riders, eyes wide with harnessed rage. That's what drew me in. That's why I joined them."âMedresi Guvron of Markarth

10332.name: Ragebound Durzog
10332.description: "This beast lives a life of controlled fury that only its rider keeps in check. Unfortunately for us, these durzogs usually pick riders who let loose their own wrath with great frequency."âMedresi Guvron of Markarth

10333.name: Blessed Rubedite Metal Enamel
10333.description:
A bottle of reddish-gold metal enamel for use on enchanted armor.

A component required for the Daggerfall Paladin costume.

10334.name: Captured Dragonflame
10334.description:
A bottle containing a mysterious, ever-burning flame.

A component required for the Daggerfall Paladin costume.

10335.name: Sanctified Metalworking Tools
10335.description:
Tools blessed by Akatosh and Zenithar both for the etching of armor.

A component required for the Daggerfall Paladin costume.

10336.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Saarthal Scholar style.

10347.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Anvil of Zenithar style.

10348.name: Bergama Fennec Fox
10348.description: The Ash'abah revere Fennec Foxes for leading lost children back to the tribe. Scholars say that it is more likely the foxes are seeking out the nearest watering hole, which is usually where the tribes are anyway.

10349.name: Gideon Trail Dog
10349.description: Trails through the thick marshlands outside Gideon change with every passing storm. Hunters in the city bred these dogs to be light enough not to get stuck in the muck and trained their noses to detect new paths of sure footing.

10350.name: Runepriest's Greatsword
10350.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Runepriest's style.

10356.name: Passion Dancer's Bow
10356.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Passion Dancer's style.

10357.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Passion Dancer's style.

10358.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Passion Dancer's style.

10359.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Passion Dancer's style.

10360.name: Witchmother's Servant Jerkin
10360.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10361.name: Witchmother's Servant Hat
10361.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10362.name: Witchmother's Servant Breeches
10362.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10363.name: Witchmother's Servant Epaulets
10363.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10364.name: Witchmother's Servant Shoes
10364.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10365.name: Witchmother's Servant Gloves
10365.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10366.name: Witchmother's Servant Sash
10366.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10367.name: Alik'r Shrieking Cheese
10367.description: The name says it all! It's cheese, it's from Alik'r, and it shrieks. See for yourself!

10368.name: Sapphire Heraldry Horn 1
10368.description: Announce the beginning of festivities by playing a jaunty tune on this gleaming horn, originally used at the Sapphire Tourney.
10368.hint: Acquired by completing the "Founder's Foe" Achievement.

10369.name: Contemplation of Aetheric Arms
10369.description: "None are so blessed as those who, while meditating about Aetherius, gain multiple spirit limbs for a few moments. Alas, while they are impressive to look upon, they do not allow you to accomplish more things."âScholar Zoellene Ruqueville

10370.name: Souvenir Conch Shell
10370.description: The soothing sounds of waves crashing on the shore emanate from this High Isle conch shell when you hold it up to your ear. Ah, memories of sunny days amid the surf.

10371.name: Fargrave Occult Curio
10371.description: With this strange bit of bone from exotic Fargrave among your belongings, you need simply gesture and focus your will to cause your hands to glow. Neat trick, eh?

10372.name: Witchmother's Servant Battle Axe
10372.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10373.name: Witchmother's Servant Bow
10373.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10374.name: Witchmother's Servant Shield
10374.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10375.name: Witchmother's Servant Staff
10375.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10376.name: Witchmother's Servant Axe
10376.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10377.name: Witchmother's Servant Maul
10377.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10378.name: Witchmother's Servant Greatsword
10378.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10379.name: Witchmother's Servant Mace
10379.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10380.name: Witchmother's Servant Sword
10380.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10381.name: Witchmother's Servant Dagger
10381.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Witchmother's Servant style.

10382.name: Vale Sabre Cat Growler
10382.description: Bards in Skyrim claim these luminous sabre cats gain their glow from Kyne. Scholars in the College of Sapiarchs refute this, each with their own pet hypotheses. Everyone agrees that this growler's fur is silky soft and its rumbling purr soothing.

10383.name: Spellcrafted Sand Stronghold
10383.description: Though it may start as simple sand, this material magically forms into a miniature stronghold worthy of the loftiestâif minusculeâsand rulers.

10384.name: Skingrad Pillion Courser
10384.description: "The first pillion mount in Skingrad came about when two of Rislav's siblings wished to ride with fewer guards about. 'Two guards per horse,' they were told. Thus they created the first battle-hardened pillion mount."âRichon Charchere, Stablemaster

10385.name: Sadrith Mora Formal Attire
10385.description: "The use of red star shells marks this clothing as valuableâand extremely rare. So, if you're ever gifted with this outfit by a Telvanni, prize it highly and wear it well. And come back to Sadrith Mora if you need repairs."âRalys Givyn, Tailor

10386.name: Jouster's Charger
10386.description: "Though these fellows work the tilt-yard like a dream, they're trained to the field, too. You never know when you'll need a finely barded steed to get you across those fancy sunflower fields you see around High Isle."âPerien Jerrick, Castle Navire

10387.name: Sadrith Mora Spore Pony
10387.description: Telvanni magisters use only the hardiest of the fire-hued fungi when magically coercing it into a new form. Whether one such magister crafted these pleasantly companionable spore ponies causes snippy disagreements among mages and scholars alike.

10388.name: Sadrith Mora Spore Steed
10388.description: Softly spoken words cut apart those who claim a mere Telvanni mage crafted this spore steed. The correctionâan archmagister brought this russet and amber glory into beingâgently flays the soul of the ignorant s'wit. As it should.

10389.name: Black Heights Camel
10389.description: "You'd not think to see camels around this one's home of Black Heights, but you'd be wrong! We love to brighten these fragrant beasts with pigments and a touch of sleekening oil so that they provide both beauty and transport!"âHurzarr, Artist

10390.name: Netchspot Abstraction Face Marks
10390.description: "Strokes of golden joy embracing rings of azure and bronze. These call attention to the spark of enduring happiness within you. You already love the idea of it, I can tell. Make it a reality."âArtist-Adept Aimira

10391.name: Netchspot Abstraction Body Marks
10391.description: "The calm of the netch infuses some folk. Yet their spirit burns bright with playful inner joy. For one such person, I created colorful tattoos inspired by golden, spotted netches I encountered long ago."âArtist-Adept Aimira

10392.name: Shagrath's Favor Face Marks
10392.description: Rarely do those gently gathered within Shagrath's web ever leave. Dreams of whispersilk strands tug upon the heart of her prey. And those few that escape gain a webbed brand on their visage.

10393.name: Shagrath's Favor Body Marks
10393.description: "I can see Shagrath's interest in you. The silver strands spun across your body speak volumes. My question is, will you traverse her weavings, or spin your own? Shagrath prefers the latter."âSelene

10394.name: Skald's Face Branding
10394.description: Traversing northern waters exposes ships to dangers not found in warmer seas â¦ such as restless spirits. Skalds brave these challenges fearlessly, marking their brows in defiance of the unquiet dead.

10395.name: Skald's Body Branding
10395.description: "I've learned that Nord vessels sailing the Sea of Ghosts prefer having a skald on board to lull the spirits haunting those waters into happier memories. These fish-knot markings indicate a master seafaring skald."âSarion

10396.name: Crusader's Coin Chicken
10396.description: Easily identifiable by their flaming red feathers, this aggressive barnyard fowl has been used as an alternative to a guard dog by knights on crusade. Their loud crowing is nearly impossible to sleep through.

10397.name: Cipher's Eye Pocket Watcher
10397.description: "What have you learned, Watcher? Mortals on Nirn keep small companions. Oh, is that so? Names you say? As my small companion, you wish one? Very well, I shall call you Ocula. You have indeed earned it."âMorian Zenas

10398.name: Scarlet War Pangrit
10398.description: "These hard-headed creatures might seem empty-minded. Yet, somehow, they keep you alive when you've angered the ornaugs. Such is the nature of a loyal mount."âSaissula, Stablemaster

10399.name: Companion's Wolf Pup
10399.description: The ancestry of this rambunctious dark-furred pup goes all the way back to the Five Hundred Companions of Ysgramor. That doesn't stop it from acting like a mischievous little furball, though!

10400.name: Earthen Root Enclave
10400.description: The Firesong Circle, unseen in the wider world for years, now threatens a tender peace between the Druids. Laurel seeks help to protect the resting place of a legendary sacred seed. Can you soothe Air, Root, and Stone, and survive the fury of the Firesong?

10401.name: Graven Deep
10401.description: An abandoned Dwemer facility sits atop an uncharted island in the Abecean Sea. The prefect place for an adventure! Join Dhulef of the Mages Guild as he investigates mysterious storms, shattered ships, and the dark stirrings of Necromancy at Graven Deep.

10403.name: Saint Pelin
10403.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Pelin.
10403.hint: Acquired by playing the Tales of Tribute tutorial quest in Gonfalon Bay on High Isle.

10404.name: Spellsword Coronet
10404.description: The light glinting off the metal of this ornate coronet might be the only warning an enemy has before you strike them down with your arcane might. Never underestimate Breton magic!

10405.name: Grandmaster Delmene Hlaalu
10405.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Hlaalu Grandmaster Delmene.
10405.hint: Acquired by playing the Tales of Tribute tutorial quest in Gonfalon Bay on High Isle.

10406.name: Duke of Crows
10406.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of the Duke of Crows.
10406.hint: Acquired by playing the Tales of Tribute tutorial quest in Gonfalon Bay on High Isle.

10407.name: Psijic Loremaster Celarus
10407.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Psijic Loremaster Celarus.
10407.hint: Acquired by playing the Tales of Tribute tutorial quest in Gonfalon Bay on High Isle.

10408.name: Rigurt the Brash
10408.description: The Nord diplomat Rigurt travels around Tamriel to learn about other cultures while demonstrating his own brand of Nord culture. Welcome him home! After adding Rigurt to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

10409.name: Druid Ryvana
10409.description: Mysterious and kind, Druid Ryvana welcomes the chance to teach others about the wisdom of the Stonelore Druids. What teachings has she for you? After adding Ryvana to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

10410.hint: Acquired by completing the "Tales of Tribute Master" achievement.
10410.name: Brahgas
10410.description: Brahgas loves playing Tales of Tribute but needs a break to shake off some bad luck. Perhaps a fellow player like you can put him up for a bit? After adding Brahgas to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

10411.name: Royal Courier Hood
10411.description: While traveling swiftly toward their goal, a royal courier deals with harsh climates and rough weather conditions, such as Skyrim's snow. With this sturdy hood, a courier gains protection against these hazards so that they can focus on the task at hand.

10412.name: Oak's Promise Face Marks
10412.description: With its rich green hues and distinctive shape, this marking is a natural for those who appreciate and protect the living world around them.

10413.name: Oak's Promise Body Marks
10413.description: "The druids of old knew the oak's promise: stand strong, stay true, and shelter all. Some Stonelore Druids mark this promise into their skin even today. And they'll cudgel you into the dirt if you cut down a tree."âGlobura of Gonfalon Bay

10414.name: Mnemoflare Fabricant
10414.description: "A reminder to all researchers that a close eye must be kept on the Mnemoflare Fabricant. It has a frustrating knack for picking locks and its sharp claws have made short work of Attendant Mhunvack's herb garden."âBthuchard, Dwemer Researcher

10416.name: Plant Yourself
10416.description: Need to take a break? Why not conjure up a chair for yourself and sit. You deserve a nice respite.

10417.name: Crimson Bone Hammer
10417.description: Crafted from an executioner's block and a bone, this unsettling hammer picked up at the Spire of the Crimson Coin requires quenching before use against a certain bloodmage's phylactery. Why not quench it again for old time's sake?
10417.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Blood, Books, and Steel" in High Isle.

10418.name: Harrowforged Durzog
10418.description: "Harrowforged Durzog: Ready your quickest poisons and most potent spells. Your target defeated horrors possibly beyond your ken to earn this glorious crimson steed."âRecent notation in a chapbook for Dark Brotherhood Initiates

10419.name: Voidmother's Welwa
10419.description: "Come closer, Namira's chosen. Take a good look at this spectacular welwa. The Spirit Queen wishes to reward you with it. Of course, journeys with this steed will lead you into further efforts for your queen. Small price to pay, yes?"âVoidmother Della

10420.name: Opal Earthgore Maul
10420.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Opal Earthgore style.

10421.name: Opal Earthgore Bow
10421.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Opal Earthgore style.

10422.name: Opal Earthgore Shield
10422.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Opal Earthgore style.

10423.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Opal Earthgore style.

10424.name: Opal Earthgore Mace
10424.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Opal Earthgore style.

10425.name: Opal Earthgore Mask
10425.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Opal Earthgore style.

10426.name: Opal Earthgore Shoulder
10426.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Opal Earthgore style.

10427.hint: Awarded for completing the quest, "Race for Honor" in High Isle.
10427.name: Lady Garick's Sacred Shield
10427.description: Lady Joslin Garick brought her crew home safely until the last timeâor so the legends state. Now that you have proven worthy of her heritage, you can hang this famous All Flags Navy captain's shield on your wall.

10428.name: Ghost Haven Caravel
10428.description: The stories of the Ghost Haven caravel still make the rounds at taverns and campfires on High Isle. With this astounding illusion device, you can recreate the caravel's appearance to add evocative detail to every story you tell.
10428.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Buried at the Bay" in High Isle.

10429.name: Crow Court Pony Guar
10429.description: "You wouldn't think a guar would get along with a murder of crows, but this fine fellow does! Maybe it's the exquisite purple hue? In any case, it's started leaving gemstones for the little menaces. Most peculiar."âIrastimil Direnni, Creature Creator

10430.name: Sailor-at-Arms
10430.description: High Isle seafarers often take posts on escort ships, hoping to hone their martial skills and slake their thirst for combat on the open seas. If that describes you, this Breton-designed garb should serve you well!

10431.name: Sailor-at-Arms Helm
10431.description: When confronting foes on a ship's deck, you need head protection that fits snugly and provides cushion against potential blows. Luckily, armorer Arienne Mathierry of Gonfalon Bay crafted just the thing for warrior-sailors like you!

10434.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Green with Envy."
10434.name: Ember
10434.description: Curled up in the corner, perfecting a new spell â¦ just how much trouble could Ember get into? Why not find out? After adding Ember to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

10435.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Princess Detective".
10435.name: Isobel Veloise
10435.description: Isobel Veloise is equally happy hunting Daedra in a dank cave and kicking back in front of a roaring fire. An upbeat addition to any home! After adding Isobel to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

10436.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Ember's Gang."
10436.name: Luxury Thieves Tools
10436.description:
A set of well-made thieves tools set within a leather pouch. One tool is missing, likely snatched by your thieving companion for her own amusement. 

Permanently grants the passive "Ember's Intuition" to the bearer.

10437.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "A Knight's Best Friend."
10437.name: Stendarr's Sweets Vault
10437.description:
This pottery effigy has a small cap on top, allowing access to the hollow interior. Within, Isobel has secreted away a delicious assortment of some of her favorite sweets. 

Permanently grants the passive "Isobel's Grace" to the bearer.

10438.name: Oaken Order Mountain Goat
10438.description: Cavalry masters of the Oaken Order diligently trained mountain goats to the bridle. Now, these surefooted creatures are both mounts and companions. None can match their spirit or persistence, or so the wizardly knights boast.

10439.name: Frostbane Dragon Priest
10439.description: "Dragon priests donned formidable masks and adorned their gear with hide knots to protect them from weather and enemies alike. These Atmorans may have found the bitter cold of Skyrim invigorating, but they still wore proper layers."âZoellene Ruqueville

10440.name: Painting: All Flags on High
10440.description: A painting featuring Gonfalon Bay nestled among its protective waters and cliffs, with a mysterious knight overlooking it all.

10441.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion
10441.name: Ancient Anchor Berth
10441.description:
Whether the bay's waters are tranquil or rough, you'll always find a spot of calm and warmth within the walls of this cozy inn room in Gonfalon Bay. Services abound just outside the door, making this a convenient berth.
Room is too small for dueling.

10474.name: Ragebound Harness
10474.description: "Some say rage dances within like fire, consuming all before it. For some in the Karth River valley, this fire is a source of strength. A remorseless flame that I see burns within you. Now, let's get you geared up."âMage Baxold, Ragebound Scholar

10475.name: Necrom
10475.description: What truths are best left hidden? Discover Necrom and delve into the forbidden secrets of Apocrypha. Fight to preserve reality from Morrowind's Telvanni Peninsula to Hermaeus Mora's realm!

10476.name: Ragebound Mask
10476.description: "You might think the bone of this mask would shatter in a single blow? No, it's tempered. By fire, by blood, by magic. It protects your head while making you look fearsome. And I'm terribly proud of it. "âMage Baxold, Ragebound Scholar

10509.description:
Set up your home's gaming room properly with this exquisite Tales of Tribute table.

|cFFFFFFThis table does not allow you to play Tales of Tribute matches.|r

10510.name: Tales of Tribute Decks, Display
10510.description: A perfect display case for your perfect decks! What more can you ask for other than victory?

10511.name: Highhallow Hold
10511.description: Variously held by both House Dufort and Mornard, this stately manor near the edge of Gonfalon Bay is now available to the adventurer-about-town. It commands a majestic view of the water and provides easy access to the jewel of High Isle.

10512.name: Mercymother's Attire
10512.description: This exquisite garb was created in honor of Almalexia's gentle grace and leadership over the centuries since Red Mountain. A devotional surrogate often wears this attire during the days-long observation called the Fast of Forebearance.

10513.name: Mercymother's Crown
10513.description: Some priests of the Tribunal don this crown during the Festival of Forebearance. Those seeking Mother Morrowind's mercy find its visage comforting. Those who would do the Dark Elf people harm feel something behind the eyesâa terror that they can't name.
