10571.name: Sapphire Heraldry Horn 2
10571.description: Announce the beginning of festivities by playing a jaunty tune on this gleaming horn, originally used at the Sapphire Tourney.
10571.hint: Acquired by completing the "Tribute Tactician" Achievement.

10572.name: Sapphire Heraldry Horn 3
10572.description: Announce the beginning of festivities by playing a jaunty tune on this gleaming horn, originally used at the Sapphire Tourney.
10572.hint: Acquired by completing the "High Roller" Achievement.

10574.name: Red Eagle
10574.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Red Eagle.
10574.hint: Acquired by playing through the Tales of Tribute questline based out of Gonfalon Bay on High Isle.

10575.name: Rajhin
10575.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Rajhin, the Purring Liar.
10575.hint: Acquired by completing all requirements for the "Flower of Chivalry" achievement on High Isle.

10576.name: Icerage Bear
10576.description: Scrolls from Direfrost Keep indicate that the ice witches first invoked these creatures as vessels to contain their rage and hunt those who had wronged them. Presumably they wanted loyal familiars, but found the bears also make formidable mounts.

10577.name: Trophy: Tideborn Taleria
10577.description: Trophy taken from Tideborn Taleria in honor of an Undaunted victory in Dreadsail Reef.

10578.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Dreadsail Reef.
10578.name: Bust: Tideborn Taleria
10578.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Dreadsail Reef.

10579.name: Shallowstalker Ornaug
10579.description: The shimmering blues and purples of this ornaug mimic the coral shallows around Galen. If you stumble upon these playful creatures cavorting in the water, move slowly and you may just tickle their curiosity. If they like you, one might even adopt you.

10580.name: Round of Applause
10580.description: Be ready to support (or admonish?) your friends with a very literal round of applause.

10581.name: Trumpet Solo
10581.description: You're not afraid to show your skill with a trumpet. Just the opposite, in fact.

10582.name: Biscuit Bear-Dog
10582.description: Hunters often rely on the services of a loyal dog to protect them as they retrieve their kills. This breed not only ensures that their hunter remains well-guarded, but also provides quiet companionship.

10583.name: Eldertide Epaulets
10583.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Eldertide style.

10584.name: Eldertide Pauldrons
10584.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Eldertide style.

10585.name: Darkswarm Talisman
10585.description: "All you have to do is hold this close to your chest and listen to your heartbeat. It summons so many friends. So â¦ wondrous. So â¦ dark. I love it!"âNaifaha the Dread Dreamer

10586.name: Mara's Pledge Mare
10586.description: In some towns, pledging oaths before Mother Mara is accompanied by a lavish gift. Legends describe a steed exchanged at Bravil, white as fresh snow and adorned with spring's first flowers. And thus a tradition was born that has survived until today.

10587.name: Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh
10587.description: You may place the hourglass within your home. Focusing on its falling sands causes them to blur, and local perception of time to shift. Until the hourglass is disturbed, time seems to stand still. Enjoy everything from eternal sunrises to endless nights.

10588.name: Engraved Glassblowing Tools
10588.description:
Blessed and engraved tools for glassblowing.

A component required for the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh furnishing.

10589.name: Hallowed White-Gold Ingot
10589.description:
A sanctified ingot of specially-prepared white gold.

A component required for the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh furnishing.

10590.name: Mysterious Time-Lost Sands
10590.description:
Two pouches of sand, one golden and one black. Touching the sands calls forth memories of experiences long ago and those yet to be experienced.

A component required for the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh furnishing.

10591.name: Ansei Frandar Hunding
10591.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Frandar Hunding.
10591.hint: Acquired by collecting deck fragments from content (such as delves, public dungeons, world bosses, volcanic vents, and quests) across High Isle.

10592.name: Apple Intimidation
10592.description: Stab that fruit! It deserves it. Then enjoy its sweet, sweet deliciousness.

10593.name: Knightly Bow
10593.description: Time spent among nobles requires knowledge of etiquetteâor at least knowledge of how to bow properly. If you prefer more martial forms of respect, this knightly bow may become your favorite.

10594.name: Pale Lord's Throne
10594.description: Oh, life. Or death. Whichever. It matters not, really, as long as you have power over both. As a Pale Lord, you can grant either to those who kneel before you.

10595.name: Sapphire Knighting
10595.description: Re-enact the knighting ceremony held at Castle Navire, just as the Knight Commander does it. Your opinion of who is and is not a knight is somewhat less binding than hers.

10596.name: Apprentice's Flower Trick
10596.description: You've practiced this for ages, or so it seems. Now let's see your mastery over â¦ oh dear. No. That's not it. That's not it at all.

10597.name: Riften Leafpile
10597.description: You haven't lived until you've thrown yourself into a Riften-style leafpile. Start by making the pile. Then throw yourself into it. Praise Kyne!

10599.name: Umbral Striped Senche-Raht
10599.description: When this beautiful beast lost their rider while traversing a labyrinth, this banded Senche-raht left to seek mystical help to get back inside. Since their efforts often lead them into peril, Nushaben hopes to find a partner for the long journeys ahead.

10600.name: Duskfall Welwa
10600.description: Using knowledge gained from the forbidden book Occaecium Beluaria, followers of Hermaeus Mora transformed a welwa into a multi-hued, darkly shimmering steed. He allows his most experienced agents in Tamriel to use them for overland tasks.

10601.name: Handy Pocket Scrib
10601.description: "Keep a kwama scrib in your pocket. Always. No, don't ask why. Trust me on this. Just make sure to let it out once in a while."âArsyn Herandus, Necrom Kwama Farmer

10602.name: Tidal Wave Incarnate
10602.description: Gather the power of Daedric energies within you, then explode with lightning in the form of a cobalt-blue Incarnate. Channeling the power of a tidal wave, you'll make quite an impact on your friends.

10603.name: Balmora Constrictor
10603.description: "Don't mind my new friend. She's very gentle as long as nobody gets handsy. I love her emerald scales, too, don't you? A little bit of joy on days when I bring her to help me with customers."âMilesa Relavel

10604.name: Duskfall Ancestor Lizard
10604.description: "To fear change wastes time one could spend engaging with the moment. These dark creatures are gifts from our past to both voh-vastei and those who need to be led into the present."âNisswo Uaxal

10605.name: Brindle Bear Cub
10605.description: These adventurous cubs love playing in waterfalls, often using crevices behind them as lairs during the winter. The smell of butter draws them like nothing else. As a result, some claim a dairy farmer first tamed one of these cubs.

10606.name: Heartland Coon Cat
10606.description: "Angry squirrels ruined this one's wares last season, but also called forth this little savior. A hunter of rodents, moths, and other pests. Azartah takes saving when offered."âAzartah of Cropsford

10607.name: Sorcerer-King Orgnum
10607.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Orgnum, the Sorcerer-King.
10607.hint: Acquired by defeating Tales of Tribute founders and completing all requirements for the "Founder's Foe" achievement.

10608.name: Armor of the Unfeathered
10608.description: "Scholars of the topic once gathered to re-enact the battle between Pelinal Whitestrake and Umaril the Ayleid sorcerer-king. Thankfully, their well-crafted illusion magics live on to this day. Care to daunt the dauntless by donning it?"âStephen Surilie

10609.name: Ayrenn's Fledgling Gryphon
10609.description: "This wondrous gift from the keepers of the Royal Menagerie tickles me so much. I hope this adorable breed finds warm hearths and caring hearts wherever they land."âQueen Ayrenn

10611.name: Petal Presentation
10611.description: Give your favorite person a delightful flower.
10611.hint: Awarded by completing the "Sojourn of the Druid King" quest.

10613.name: Galenwood Mask
10613.description: "Guided by a druid's artistry, this mask is birthed from earth and stone. This gives it form. Then air and water tease out weakness, leaving behind a formidable symbol of the True Way."âDruid Julisa

10614.name: Mercymother's Coronet
10614.description: "House Indoril reverentially marks the Fast of Forebearance in honor of the Healing Mother. Several coronets are fashioned in her honor and rewarded to those who have lived up to her name during this ecclesial holiday."âMage Tolendir Gals

10615.name: Indigo Twilight Camel
10615.description: Before climbing atop these richly hued camels, those who revere Ruptga kneel within the mount's shadow and pray for safe passage. Some focus on the immediate journey while others renew their wish for guidance to the Far Shores after death.

10616.name: Ahz-m'Athra
10616.description: Yahareni sought to survive by any means necessary when the Knahaten Flu struck Orcrest. Death won, and Namiira gained their corrupted soul. Now, freed from the Dark Behind the World by a foolish mortal, they seek an equal to walk beside them in darkness.

10617.name: Aderene, Fargrave Dregs Dealer
10617.description:
Aderene is willing to trade items you don't need for useful materials. Some obscure Daedric contracts prohibit her from trading in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

After she's summoned, you and your groupmates can use her services.

10618.name: Zuqoth, Armory Advisor
10618.description: You and your groupmates can prepare for combat by summoning Zuqoth to change and save builds outside of your home. Some obscure Daedric contracts prohibit her from offering her services in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

10619.name: Hermitage Servitor
10619.description: "Someone made this. I reached out to Apocrypha, to a place of pure thought and potential. And when I withdrew, this hideous unblinking monstrosity stepped from the shadows. It will not leave. It will not stray. Why? WHY?"âFinal notes of Iratian Cipius

10620.name: Tel Aruhn Guarling
10620.description: Records indicate Tel Aruhn merchants bred the tawny lambent guar with the freckled guar. Scholars dispute this, saying instead that the Imperial Legion accidentally created them when they administered the area. Either way, they're crafty little snugglers.

10621.name: Umaril's Radiance Elk
10621.description: "The Unfeathered sought victory over the Sunnatren. 'Their banners portray crude elks. Let them tremble as we defeat them on such beasts.' A season ended before I finished my work. May they forever remain loyal to him."âGandravanya's Journal, Translated

10622.name: Umaril's Radiance Guar
10622.description: "The marshfolk vexed the Unfeathered. 'They scatter to fight. But they fear so-named guar. Let us use that.' It took longer to acquire the needed guar than to ready them. May they forever hunt Umaril's foes."âGandranya's Journal, Translated

10623.name: Umaril's Radiance Senche
10623.description: "Nomads of the sands traded with the Unfeathered's foes. 'Let us disrupt them with mounts both fleet and quiet.' The desert cats I worked with adapted quickly. May they forever slip through the silence for him."âGandravanya's Journal, Translated

10624.name: Umaril's Radiance Wolf
10624.description: "Umaril sought to direct the paths of the conquered. 'The creature must take initiative and stay the course.' Balancing these traits with loyalty took many seasons. May they forever direct the Unfeathered's flocks."âGandravanya's Journal, Translated

10625.name: Lich
10625.description: "Want to look like a lich without all the bother of manipulating your own soul? Illusion's your friend! Just work magic from this school and before you can say "Mannimarco's a s'wit," you're a figure of necromantic majesty."âOthreloth Hlaalo, Illusionist

10626.name: South Weald Prairie Dog
10626.description: Wood Elf tribes introduced these prairie dogs across the northern Valenwood to help maintain the overall health of the forest. Some even kept a few around their homes. Now you'll see them scurrying after man and mer alike, cute little noses twitching away.

10627.name: Hivethief Vvardvark
10627.description: "Look at that tongue! You can thank Spellwright Domavas for these bug-eating beauties, expanding on Magister Varkenel's work. I hear he first tried to give them feathers, failed, then came up with this gorgeous steed."âCidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster

10628.name: Gnisis Durzog
10628.description: "We don't get many durzogs from Gnisis, but when we do, we stable them away from kwama. You see, House Redoran bred them to help herd kwama in the mines. They found out the hard way that the beasts love eating scribs."âCidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster

10629.name: Cliff Racer Catastrophe
10629.description: Locals say that a visit to Vvardenfell isn't a true visit until you've had cliff racers diving at you after flying, flying in the sky, flying so high. Those who have experienced this "welcome" beg to differ.

10630.name: Orb Juggling
10630.description: Some street performers mastered the art of making a crystal orb look as if it floatsâbut it's merely a trick that they can pass on to you.

10631.name: Key Harp
10631.description: Play High Isle's favorite instrument, the key harp, and entertain your audience with your skills.

10632.name: Grahtwood Fisher
10632.description: "Each morning during my travels around Grahtwood, one of the local fishers clung to the trunk of a nearby tree. I think it wanted some of my breakfast, so on the third day, I shared. Now it follows me everywhere."âNurome

10633.name: Inkfur Ursauk
10633.description: "Tales say Grahtwood's ancient oaks called these black-furred ursauks from the deep woods. But why? Every reason this one hears is different! Guards for a sapling grove. Help with a werewolf problem. Or maybe for bear hugs."âZhiraz, Traveling Farmhand

10634.name: Fillia's Maormer Deck Fragment
10634.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

10635.name: Murzaga's Maormer Deck Fragment
10635.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

10636.name: Nhorhim's Maormer Deck Fragment
10636.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

10637.name: Author's Maormer Deck Fragment
10637.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

10638.name: Linyia's Maormer Deck Fragment
10638.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

10639.hint: Found occasionally in delves on High Isle and Amenos.
10639.name: Delver's Ansei Deck Fragment
10639.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

10640.hint: Found occasionally after defeating World Bosses on High Isle and Amenos.
10640.name: Slayer's Ansei Deck Fragment
10640.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

10641.hint: Found occasionally after sealing volcanic vents on High Isle and Amenos.
10641.name: Geomancer's Ansei Deck Fragment
10641.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

10642.hint: Found occasionally after defeating bosses inside the Ghost Haven Bay and Spire of the Crimson Coin public dungeons.
10642.name: Hero's Ansei Deck Fragment
10642.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

10643.hint: Complete the quest "A Chance for Peace" on High Isle.
10643.name: Diplomat's Ansei Deck Fragment
10643.description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

10644.name: Xylo Pollen Bat
10644.description: These brown-furred bats pollinate flowers along the Xylo River. Without them, nature's web in the Valenwood would be deeply disrupted. Plus they look adorable when they sneeze.

10645.name: Duskember Fox
10645.description: A rare sight, these colorful foxes keep to the shadows in the wild. When trained to the saddle, they proudly display their glossy coats and fine saddlery. Their favorite food is snow berries, and they will do almost anything for their daily treat.

10646.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Keeper of the Bastion."
10646.name: Obsidian Dwarven Sphere
10646.description: Zuugarz of Orsinium says she first discovered these obsidian-worked animunculi, a claim backed up by the loyal construct that follows her around. She's since learned her scholarly companion "gifted" it to her, but that's not something she's eager to share.

10647.hint: Awarded by earning the "Light of the Lost Depths" achievement.
10647.name: Touch of the Draoife Face Marks
10647.description: With a few strokes of mystic ink, the druid council imparts their blessing. The Draoife's auguries foretold of this moment, though they remain silent on what glorious purpose you may yet fulfill.

10648.hint: Awarded by earning the "Earthen Root Enclave Conqueror" achievement.
10648.name: Touch of the Draoife Body Marks
10648.description: "Auguries. Through stone and starlight, fire and ash, the Draoife glimpse the futureâand act. And they gave you such wondrous markings. Oh, my friend, what secrets will you find in the wilds?"âScholar Thaegara

10649.name: Amberleaf Earring
10649.description: "Upon the felling of the maples, Y'ffre wept. Her amber tears glistened before dropping onto the leaves, encasing them in lamentation-given-form. Picking one up, she said, 'Wear these in memory of this day.' And they did."âGrove-Death of the Maples

10650.name: Dreadsail Face Tattoo
10650.description: The Dreadsail adopted a tradition from Red Bramman's crew whereby anyone who has survived swells eight sailors high tattoos a gust of wind on their cheeks. This tattoo has even been used as a letter of recommendation when signing on to a new crew.

10651.name: Dreadsail Body Tattoo
10651.description: "I fear not the billowing gales that threaten to tear the planks from my decks. Nor the raging storms that call forth sea serpents from the roiling sea. What's to fear? I carry them all within me."âAllonda, Boson of the Painted Ray

10652.name: Soul Crystals of the Returned
10652.description: Scholars dispute the origin of these hovering soul crystals. Some believe the lich Vastarie first brought them back from Coldharbour. Others claim Mannimarco returned these souls to Tamriel. Regardless, you know the means to summon them. Dare you do so?

10653.name: Karth River Sabre Cat
10653.description: Deep in the Karth River canyon, this golden sabre cat jumps from rock to rock on sparkling spring mornings. Knowing this, young Reach witches often camp nearby to set up their taming rituals, hoping to gain one as a loyal mount.

10654.name: Clan Mother Tadali
10654.description: Get ready for a visit from Clan Mother Tadali! She'll share her wisdom with you if you share your sunbeams with her. After adding Tadali to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

10655.name: Dhulef
10655.description: Grab your favorite beverage and settle in for pithy tales from former pirate, current Mages Guild member, and Stonelore druid friend Dhulef. After adding Dhulef to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

10656.name: Captain Isara Davaux
10656.description: Ghostly Isara may think she's still part of the All Flags Navy, fighting their ancient foes, but that just makes her a hauntingly novel guest. After adding Isara to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

10658.name: Fighter's Guild Blade Barrel
10658.description: "When you have a barrel full of blades nearby, you'll never be caught flat-footed!"âOld Fighters Guild Motto

10659.hint: Acquired by digging for Antiquities on Galen.
10659.name: Barkroot Blessing
10659.description: "Some druids seek an understanding of nature by opening themselves to the cycle of the seasons. Rooted, they gain leaves and bark, taking in water and nutrients as would a tree. Or so the druids at the Jaded Ornaug claimed last night."âAurelienne Broles

10660.name: Firesong
10660.description: The isle of Galen is threatened by Sea Elf raiders and druid unrest. The Society of the Steadfast seeks adventurers to help House Mornard defend Galen. Report to Lord Bacaro Volorus in the city of Vastyr if you possess courage equal to the task.

10661.name: Meadowbreeze Memories
10661.description: Spring flows through your veins even as greenery traces itself across your skin, creating white blooming flowers. Thanks to Y'ffre, the scents and sensations of past springs on breezy meadows sweep over you.

10663.name: Icerage Helm
10663.description: "You hear tales about folk wearing these icy helms. Tales where they master deep rage. Ballads about how many foes they've ripped through with their bare hands. I see you've earned one. I would've loved to have seen that fight."âDushugg of Orsinium

10664.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
10664.name: Faunfrolic Great Elk
10664.description: Inspired by the knights of Castle Navire, a band of Fauns decided to breed elks as their mounts. They stopped when they realized their hooves made it difficult to ride and, in truth, they could run just as fast as the elks could.

10665.hint: Acquired by combining ten Scraps of Minstrel's Cloth found in Stupendous Jester's Festival Boxes during the Jester's Festival.
10665.name: Jester's Daedroth Suit
10665.description: "Feeling puny? Small? Afraid? Do what I do! Wear your Daedroth apparel and snarl at everyone you meet. No, you can't have my garb! But I can make you some â¦ for a price."âJester-Apprentice Xat-Xot

10666.name: Get Out
10666.description: Express your wish for someone to leave your vicinity with this compelling gesture.

10668.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Savior of Necrom."
10668.name: Berylglow Nix-Ox Steed
10668.description: "Yes, Gemmy here glows. The Hlaalu of Balmora fed the first of its kind a rare mushroom, causing a reaction in its belly. The glow passed to its young. They're fast but feisty. Don't say I didn't warn you."âCidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster

10697.name: Passion Dancer Blossom
10697.description: Allow the passion of Dibella to lead you in a dance of her choosing and, in return, she may gift you with boon of one of her lively blooms. These frolicsome flowers flourish in the presence of energetic adherents like you.

10698.name: Dhulef's Bubble Ward
10698.description: "Ever visited the bottom of the sea? I overheard a Redguard talking about doing just that with some spell he's working on. A warding trinket, maybe. It's like walking in a bubble, I guess."âEnri Coulon of the Ancient Anchor
10698.hint: Awarded by earning the "Graven Deep Conqueror" achievement.

10699.name: Alinor Eye Crest
10699.description: Once granted only to those who performed a service to the nobility of Summerset, this crest later saw wider use during the Alinor-Lillandril skirmishes of 2E 320. Those fighting for Alinor wore them to help them identify fellow skirmishers.

10701.name: Kvatch Outrider's Warhorse
10701.description: Originally bred by Kvatch for speed, these pale horses became the favored mounts of outriders during the rivalry with Skingrad in the First Era. Since then, though their numbers vary from few to many, they've continued to serve with honor and distinction.

10702.name: Passion Dancer's Attire
10702.description: Sing, dance, and engage in other artistic pursuits while wearing this Dibella-inspired ensemble. Let the influence of the Goddess of Beauty, Love, and Affection enchant your senses while you spark creativity in others by your very presence.

10703.name: Hoardhunter Ursauk
10703.description: Gallivant across any terrain, seeking your next treasure, with this massive, gilded ursauk. Not only does it bear the blessing of Sai, or so its breeders claim, but its gear contains one element from another successful treasure-seeker's hoard.

10704.name: Chromatic Scorpion
10704.description: "Nightmares of scorpions. So many colors, but the dream-sea blue one tipped with angry-eyes red stepped forth. I woke to see this wondrous creature. A gift from Vaermina? My partner says they live in Satakalaam, but how did one get to Wayrest?"âGaelle

10705.name: Eldertide Arm Cops
10705.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Eldertide style.

10706.name: Blossom Bloom
10706.description: This eternally blooming flower once graced the boudoir of a Dibellan high priest. Gifted to you for services rendered, you may now command it yourself.

10708.name: Hew's Bane Pillion Palfrey
10708.description: Smuggler crews in Hew's Bane first trained these palfreys to bear two riders. Originally, the training was just a cover story to hide their illicit work. But they quickly found having a mount that could hold two extremely useful for heists.

10709.name: Legion Zero Sabre Cat
10709.description: After forcing sabre cats to drink the Blood of Coldharbour, Legion Zero soldiers mounted up and secured the Imperial City Nobles District for Mannimarco. Many of these soldiers died, leaving their steeds without riders. Perfectâfor you, anyway.

10710.name: Gloamsedge Jack
10710.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Gloamsedge style.

10717.name: Auroran Polychrome Wolf
10717.description: "The mix of hues in this Auroran wolf reminds me of the Colored Rooms. The beauty pains me, piercing my heart like a dagger. And if you stare too hard, you get lost in the eternity of its radiance. So, don't stare too hard."âYaduur, Scholar

10718.name: Firesong Face Art
10718.description: "Burn your eyes and see through the smoke to the True Way. Submit your mind to the flames and be remade in the essence of nature's bliss. Y'ffre will keep your path bright and your heart's fire will never dim."âPrayer said during the festival of Y'ffelon

10719.name: Firesong Body Art
10719.description: The Firesong of Y'ffelon smear their arms and legs with ash from the volcano, then draw intricate bolts of amber over the ash. Outsiders find it impossible to tell whether the bolts are lightning or roots. Which is just how the Firesong like it.

10753.name: Hunter's Carved Bone
10753.description: "The nacreous waters of the Bowl of the Hunt await the bone's holder. Look deeply. Beyond your skin. Feel it? The hunt howls through blood and bone and sinew. Now, sing your wolf-song to begin your journey as one of Hircine's chosen."âWitchmother Gretis

10754.name: Plant Parley
10754.description: You've answered the eternal question of "Who's a good plant?" by claiming that title for your own plant.

10755.name: Cinderstone Kagouti
10755.description: "None can quench the life-fire blazing in this kagouti's heart. Night and day, we sing and dance amid magma rivers, fanning the spark of creation. If we're blessed, the magic takes and one of our number gains a devoted steed for life."âMy Life Amid Flame

10756.name: Galenwood Leafshade
10756.description: With this gorgeous leaf, you have access to shade at any time. It's even better at keeping the rain off!

10757.name: Khenarthi's Windwalker
10757.description: "Don't be fooled by lesser steeds. These horses seem to ride Khenarthi's winds when treated with respect. Act as if the God of Winds gifted you with this noble creature herself, as this one does, yes?"âHuzdargo, Senchal Stablemaster

10758.name: Evermore Painter's Moth
10758.description: "Of course I used pigment from local moths when painting Duke Blaise Guimard's portrait. Several of my artist friends keep sanctuaries for these colorful creatures. Perhaps my own little Springrain will help start mine."âLady Alyna Talemelier's Journal

10759.name: Faun Fawn
10759.description: Rumors that Systres Fauns call these gray-hued young deer to their frolics stem from the markings both share. Undoubtedly, the grog that accompanies such tales has something to do with these claims. Whatever the case, they're adorable in the extreme.

10760.name: Bitter Coast Wasp
10760.description: "My family thinks wasps are the worst, but one of these solitary fellows helped me stave off a cliff strider attack. It started following me after it nibbled on a strider I'd killed. I guess it likes to eat them."âGellius Nuncius, Wanderer

10761.name: Heartwood Dauber
10761.description: The wasps found in the heart of the woods around Lake Honrich use mud to build their nests. While they normally keep out of sight, they swarm any who threaten their nests. Those who help defend against intruders may just find a friend following them home.

10836.description: Learned from the House Mornard Crafting Style, acquired from Galen Daily Delves and completing Galen World Boss Quests.

10837.name: Wayrest Party Incident
10837.description: Everything's set for a perfect Wayrest gathering. The tea? Steeped exquisitely. The cups? Cleaned and set on a shining tray. The attendees? Ready to share the latest news andâoh dear. Someone just spilled the tea.

10838.name: Bal Sunnar
10838.description: Time itself swirls in chaos behind the walls of Bal Sunnar, a hidden Telvanni outpost on the outskirts of Stonefalls. Ally with Saresea of the Psijic Order to end this temporal tumult, restore the timeline, and safeguard the causality of Tamriel.

10839.name: Scrivener's Hall
10839.description: The walls between realms sunder in Scrivener's Hall, a library in the mountains south of The Rift. Join Keshargo, Scribe of Mora, as he struggles to retake the enigmatic archive and return his order to their rightful place as watchers of the unknown.

10840.name: Eyes of the Scamp
10840.description: "Mix the sweat from your last kill with that of a Scamp. Then pray to Mehrunes Dagon. Might be that he grants your eyes a guise of sorts. Scamp's eyes, they call it. Good favor is what I call it."âGolor the Banekin Handler

10841.name: Eyes of S'rendarr
10841.description: Mercy, compassion, and charity radiate from your eyes as clearly as the moons shine in the evening sky. Were you blessed by S'rendarr the Runt, or did your actions and words grant you this glow?

10843.name: Braided Tresses
10843.description: About to leap into battle? Or pirouette into a gala? Do so knowing that you are both well-coiffed and richly accessorized.

10844.name: Statuette: Kynareth of the Winds
10844.description: A miniature statue of Kynareth, goddess of the elements, as sculpted in High Isle.

10845.name: Statuette: Duchess Martinne
10845.description: A miniature statue of the Duchess Martinne Guimard, leader of the consortium that purchased the Systres Archipelago.

10846.name: Painting: Systres Archipelago
10846.description: A painting by Vaudrie Barthel, well-known for her landscapes and scenes depicting life and nature in the Systres Isles.

10847.name: King's Guard Ram
10847.description: Stablers who see this impressive steed enter yards say they're blessed with good luck. Not only does caring for these Glenumbran rams bring profit, but their presence is said to herald a calm and peaceful night ahead.

10848.name: Sungard Sabre Cat
10848.description: Not long after the Battle of Sungard, these sabre cats started prowling the area. Scholars at the time believed some element of the battle disturbed their normal habitat. Seeing an opportunity, animal handlers found cubs and started raising them as pets.

10849.name: Menevian Coachdog
10849.description: Commonly seen trotting alongside carts and coaches in Stormhaven, these perceptive dogs serve as deterrents to bandits and other road hazards. Within recent years, they've become popular in other parts of Tamriel, including Blackwood and the Rift.

10850.name: Ghastly Visitation
10850.description: "A classic mage prank: hide an enchanted pebble on someone, then trigger the magic. An illusion springs up, ranging from silly to frightening. A common gag is the appearance of a dark entity of the most frightening sort!"âScholar Thaegara

10851.name: Blightlord's Skeever
10851.description: "I'd heard that Peryite followers wake up to find their skeevers transformed by his blessing. Never really thought about it until I woke up next to one. We're fine now, but by my Prince's pustules, those first moments got my battle rage up."âYamighu

10852.name: Apocryphal Bookwyrm
10852.description: Some claim these curious Daedric wyrms from Apocrypha devour books to vouchsafe the knowledge for their master. Others believe cultists of Hermaeus Mora use these creatures to hunt tomes long thought lost. Perhaps you know the truth?

10853.name: Statue, Ascendant Lord
10853.description: Though the artist who sculpted this statue remains unknown, those who have faced the Ascendant Lord declare it captures this leader's might and presence perfectly. Claimed from the treasure trove of the Ascendant Order.

10854.hint: Awarded for completing Earthen Root Enclave.
10854.name: Trophy: Archdruid Devyric
10854.description: Trophy taken from Archdruid Devyric in honor of an Undaunted victory in Earthen Root Enclave.

10855.hint: Awarded for completing the Graven Deep.
10855.name: Trophy: Euphotic Gatekeeper
10855.description: Trophy taken from the Euphotic Gatekeeper in honor of an Undaunted victory in Graven Deep.

10856.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Earthen Root Enclave.
10856.name: Bust: Archdruid Devyric
10856.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Earthen Root Enclave.

10857.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Graven Deep.
10857.name: Bust: Euphotic Gatekeeper
10857.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Graven Deep.

10858.name: Antecedent Scholar's Guar
10858.description: House Telvanni is renowned for the brutality of their scholarly infighting. In shadowy caves across the Inner Sea, a cult to Hermaeus Mora has grown up among those expelled from the House but still thirsting for knowledge, power, and one day â¦ revenge.

10859.name: Dwemerdelve Scavenger
10859.description: Early merchant-scavengers of the Zainab Tribe collected Dwarven pieces they found in nearby ruins. Instead of adding them to their wares, though, they worked the pieces into exploration garb, hoping for better protection against Dwarven constructs.

10862.name: Understone Obsidian Hare
10862.description: "When she came of age, young Stena took a rabbit under her protection. I swear, I've seen Hircine himself manifest within her to defend that creature."âBrewer Bodgrannagh of Markarth

10864.name: Eldertide Body Ink
10864.description: "The gauntlet at your back pushes you down the path toward Y'ffre. Sure strokes push paint into skin as they push outsiders from our shores. The Systres belong to druids and the tide of our wrath is ever flowing."âArchdruid Alix, Founder of Y'ffre's Path

10865.name: Eldertide Face Ink
10865.description: The symbolic representation of tide, waves, and ripples form a disjointed but notable path across the temple, brow, and cheekbones in this traditional Eldertide marking. Friendlier druids say the symbols represent the ocean as the purest path to Y'ffre.

10866.hint: Acquired by completing the "Welcome to Galen" achievement on Galen.
10866.name: Firesong Obsidian Mask
10866.description: The flame of knowledge burns brightly within you, eclipsed only by this obsidian-tempered mask wrought by the Firesong Circle. Though they protect the rites used to shape their magma-born armor, they gift these masks to those who share their love of lore.

10867.hint: Complete the quest "Seeds of Destruction" on Galen.
10867.name: Y'ffelon's Body Brand
10867.description: "Ooh! Some of the Firesong Circle's early markings. This design is so colorful. I wish I knew how it transformed over the seasons. But, I'll never know because some kelp-brained fool recorded our volcanic history on flammable material!"âDruid Laurel

10868.hint: Complete the quest "A Sea of Trouble" on Galen.
10868.name: Y'ffelon's Face Brand
10868.description: Dating back to the era shortly after Druid King Kasorayn's passing, this vibrant forehead marking depicts the eruption of Mount Firesong. Used in placating rituals, those bearing this paint were supposedly safe from the wrath of the volcano.

10869.name: Heartland River Crab
10869.description: "Give one of these green-shelled beauties food, and they'll follow you around a bit. Keep it up, and you've a friend for life. If they were smaller, I'd let them dangle from my ears, but they settle into my pack well enough."âAetis Salvitto

10870.name: Rimmen Jerboa
10870.description: "This one isn't sure just when these adorable jerboa first showed up in Rimmen, but they are recent. Also, nuisances. They distract so much, plus this one's keeps getting underfoot. Maybe it seeks to kill Sharrasti."âSharrasti, Scholar

10871.name: Ashlander's Fungal Beat
10871.description: Add a sweet beat to any area by pulling out your favorite shroom drum and playing a traditional Ashlander solo.

10872.name: Eyes of the Xivilai
10872.description: The cunning madness of the Xivilai gleams in your eyes as you pursue your latest endeavor. Will you succeed because of, or in spite of, this new luminescence you've earned?

10873.name: Spellscar Salamander
10873.description: "You'd think a salamander warped by the Spellscar would be a frightening beast, but I find the play of energies in their form enthralling. Also, no matter the weather, having one at your feet helps you stay comfortably warm or cool."âNaifa, Scholar

10874.name: Gonfalon Sea Cur
10874.description: Also called the "Dog of the Watch," these dark-furred mutts work alongside sailors on their docked ships. Recently, the craze among Gonfalon Bay nobles involves sponsoring the care, feeding, and, oddly, hats for these beloved canines.

10875.name: Eyes of Sanguine
10875.description: "Revel in the moment as you've never done. Fix the passionate excess in your mind, then let it go to fully enjoy the next moment. And the next. Some say that with practice, you can see the debauchery of Sanguine gleaming from your eyes."âSeducer Trilvath

10876.name: Hircine's Chosen Face Marks
10876.description: "Hircine called youâI see it upon your face. Your scars tell the story of the kill, as does the Huntmaster's scarlet marks. Tell me. Was it fun?"âGarlor of Orsinium

10877.name: Hircine's Chosen Body Marks
10877.description: The hunt calls. Your prey fights, wounding you and leaving scars. In the still that follows, a Huntmaster marks you with ink crafted from your foe's viscera. A glorious end to a proud legend tells its tale upon your own hide.

10878.name: Ode to Clockwork Body Art
10878.description: "A stunning veneration of the Tinkerer in traditional Dark Elf style. The artist's neo-classical interpretation of Tribunal decorative aesthetics is a tribute to ancient-meets-modern sensibilities."âAssistant Maren, Library of Vivec

10879.name: Ode to Clockwork Face Art
10879.description: Upon seeing these marks, some focus on how they enhance the cheekbones. By contrast, Assistant Maren of the Library of Vivec notes the connection to the Father of Mysteries. As if he caressed the recipient's face, leaving behind symbols of inspiration.

10880.name: Topknot Cascade
10880.description: Whether it's a flow of hair or spikes, this stunning style shows the world that you're ready to take it on. No holds barred.

10881.name: Sanguine Revelry Steed
10881.description: The scent of flowers precedes this cream-colored steed's arrival. White-and-merlot barding features the grinning silver-and-gold visage of Sanguine, Lord of Revelry. Will you let the promise made by its illusory roses and wine entice you into merriment?

10882.name: Leaning Scholar
10882.description: Expert scholars learn whenever and wherever they can. Leaning against a wall while reading? Easy!

10883.name: Sitting Scholar
10883.description: Long considered the best way to do research, sitting grants the advantage of allowing your body to rest a bit while you exercise your mind.

10884.name: Standing Scholar
10884.description: When scholars are faced with a queue, they pull out a book and get to work. Every moment is meaningfulâespecially when you're trying to solve a historical puzzle or figure out your next alchemical experiment.

10885.name: Fingers Crossed
10885.description: Cross your fingers and hope for the best!

10887.name: Dark Lady's Headrest
10887.description: Blessedâor cursedâby Vaermina, this pillow looks comfortable, but acts as a summons to dreadful nightmares. Dare you rest on it?

10893.name: Euphotic Gatekeeper Maul
10893.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Euphotic Gatekeeper style.

10894.name: Euphotic Gatekeeper Bow
10894.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Euphotic Gatekeeper style.

10895.name: Euphotic Gatekeeper Shield
10895.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Euphotic Gatekeeper style.

10896.name: Euphotic Gatekeeper Staff
10896.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Euphotic Gatekeeper style.

10897.name: Euphotic Gatekeeper Mace
10897.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Euphotic Gatekeeper style.

10898.name: Bonemold Cuirass
10898.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Bonemold style.

10899.name: Bonemold Helm
10899.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Bonemold style.

10900.name: Bonemold Greaves
10900.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Bonemold style.

10901.name: Bonemold Pauldrons
10901.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Bonemold style.

10902.name: Bonemold Sabatons
10902.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the Bonemold style.

10903.name: Bonemold Gauntlets
10903.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Bonemold style.

10904.name: Bonemold Girdle
10904.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Bonemold style.

10905.name: Speckled Wolf
10905.description: After an Investigator Vale story featured one of these variegated wolves native to Alik'r, their popularity as steeds rose among the ranks of the adventurous literati. Their loyalty may have, if anything, been understated in the story.

10906.name: Quintessential Camel
10906.description: "Anu. Padomay. That's what this camel reminds me of. Where one ends, the other begins. What one begins, the other ends. Striations of stasis and change. One. Eternal. Quintessential. Just like this camel. Duck. It's about to spit."âAtazal of Sentinel

10907.name: Flesh of the Harrowed
10907.description: The power of the harrowstorm ripples just beneath your skin. Let that energy surge forth and impressâor terrifyâall those around you.

10908.hint: Acquired by completing the "Bal Sunnar Conqueror" achievement.
10908.name: The Taskmaster's Banner
10908.description: "My task list saved me. Yes, I know. Every Peryite priest says that. It's true in my case. So true that I prayed at the bank the moment I found out I'd barely missed a Dragon disaster at home. Now I look like this when I want to."âSlera Cinna, Banker

10909.name: Draoife Old Growth Sigils Basin
10909.description: "This basin served many druids, yet now you possess it. How came you to such a gift? No, don't tell me quickly. Let's linger over this tale. I'm sure it's a good one."âDruid Antoine
10909.hint: Complete the quest "A Heart Turned Black" on Galen.

10910.name: Glimmertarn Glow
10910.description: "Druid chants drift through the air as one of their number drinks deeply of the glowwine. Slowly, the alchemy spreads throughout the body and skin, suffusing it with the amaranthine-hued blessing of the God of Song and Forest."âBook of the Leaves

10911.name: The Druid King
10911.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.
10911.hint: Acquired by collecting deck fragments from content (such as delves, world bosses, volcanic vents, and quests) across Galen.

10912.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Great Oaks from Little Acorns."
10912.name: Graht-Oak Squirrel
10912.description: "These large, floof-tailed beasts love to scamper around their home Graht-oak, tucking nuts and seeds into hidey-holes around its roots. Keep an acorn in your pocket, and you've a friend for lifeâor until it sneaks that acorn away from you!"âAmridil

10913.name: Passion's Muse
10913.description: You allow the music of Dibella to flow through you, and in turn to those you meet. The spirit of the Passion Dancer guides your movement in all the things you do.

10914.name: Hoardwalker Face Marks
10914.description: Seen from Outlaws Refuge to the soirees of affluent merchants, these shimmering gold facial marks carry with them the promise of more riches to comeâif you dare seek out treasure hoards.

10915.name: Hoardwalker Body Marks
10915.description: "Sometimes the most priceless treasure you can carry out of a forgotten hoard is that which gleams on your hide. After all, riches are easily spent, but skin or scale tends to stay with you your whole life."âHeknorr, Heistmaster

10916.name: Bright Lady's Baubles
10916.description: Inspired by a famous statue of Meridia, these earrings feature fine details that can please any devotee of the Lady of Infinite Energies. May her light shine on all your endeavors.

10919.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Sane and Clearheaded."
10919.name: Ram of Dark Dreams
10919.description: "Swirls of velvety purple. Curved horns. Eyes glowing as they stared down at me. Did I still dream? Had I eaten the wrong mushroom? But no, I was awake. Ah, Vaermina. I delight in serving you, but this gift interrupts my studies."âMalven Relas's Journal

10920.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Chronicle of Fate."
10920.name: Fate Scryer
10920.description: "Hermaeus Mora's Remnants act as his sword and shield, protecting important secrets. Those dressed as we are may be few these days, but that may change soon. Or it may change never."âTyss of the Remnants

10921.name: Spore Savant Face Marks
10921.description: "The twists and turns of a magister's mind become more pronounced the longer they bend their will to spore crafting. Perhaps it's the organic ebb and flow of the fungus? Flora flows into fascinating function. But you know that, yes?"âArtist-Adept Aimira

10922.name: Spore Savant Body Marks
10922.description: There's always a celebration when a Telvanni spore savant's first structure reaches maturation. Some retain spore-ink artisans to decorate the architect's skin with mushrooms and claim the recipient receives visions of future projects during the process.

10924.name: Enchanted Saturalia Tree
10924.description: Deck a Saturalia tree with ornaments and lights. Join your |cffffffgroup members|r, and let the fun of the New Life Festival begin!

10925.name: Dibella's Sweetroll Stack
10925.description: Share a delightful stack of gooey-sweet baked goods with your best friends. Or taunt your worst enemies with themâyou have sweetrolls and they have none!

10926.name: Urshilaku Nix-Ox
10926.description: Before these colorful creatures served as mounts for the Urshilaku, their shells were ground up for pigment. Seeing their potential as fast-moving steeds, handlers trained them for scouting missions, often hiding their bright colors with dried mud.

10927.name: Chaurus Egg Ear Studs
10927.description: When a chaurus is sighted, Blackreach hunters rally to deal with the potential threat. The first to confirm a kill wins the right to wear these ear studs. But are they actual miniature eggs or simply skillful replicas?

10928.name: Balfieran Nose Studs
10928.description: During the year after Ryain Direnni's purchase of Balfiera, those attending celebratory gatherings wore these nose studs. Decades later, to claim they attended these parties, various mer commissioned tweaks to unadorned portraits to add the decoration.

10929.name: Half-Hatched Guarling
10929.description: "One morning I found a little guarling in my garden. Rushing around, bouncing off things. I'm not entirely sure why it wanted to keep bits of its shell, but I don't care. Look at how cute it is! I think we're friends now, and I would die for it."âFaylva

10930.name: Card Conjuring
10930.description: Show off your expertise with Tales of Tribute in a different wayâby conjuring a card out of thin air!
10930.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Card Conjurer."

10934.description: Learned from the Scribes of Mora Crafting Style, acquired by defeating the final boss in Scrivener's Hall.
