11051.name: Chartreuse Lily Petals
11051.description:
Softly glowing petals of a mystical lily.

The first of three components required to create Passion Dancer Blossom.

11052.name: Enchanted Silver Flute
11052.description:
An enchanted wind instrument used to summon benevolent spirits.

The second of three components required to create Passion Dancer Blossom.

11053.name: Mystical Sheet Music
11053.description:
The music of the Divines, written in a format understandable to mortal minds.

The third of three components required to create Passion Dancer Blossom.

11055.name: Bottle of Silver Mist
11055.description:
A sealed bottle of magical mist.

A component required for the Passion's Muse personality.

11056.name: Delicate Dancer's Baton
11056.description:
A thin, flexible stick used for testing balance and coordination.

A component required for the Passion's Muse personality.

11057.name: Pressed Lily Petal Insoles
11057.description:
Delicate insoles made of pressed mystical lily petals.

A component required for the Passion's Muse personality.

11059.name: Hoarfrost, Takubar Trader
11059.description:
Summoned from the fourth Sinus of Takubar, Hoarfrost will convey your goods (or the goods of your groupmates) to the cold-flame pits of Oblivion in exchange for mortal coins.

Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.

11062.name: Statuette: Baron-Admiral Olo
11062.description: A miniature statue of Bendu Olo, Baron-Admiral of the All Flags Navy, as sculpted in High Isle.

11063.name: Statuette: Ascendant Lord
11063.description: A miniature statue of the mysterious Ascendant Lord, who seeks to claim an ancient legacy.

11064.name: Painting: Systres Seaside Manor
11064.description: A painting by Vaudrie Barthel that captures the play of light and water at an elegant manor in the Systres Archipelago.

11065.hint: Complete the quest "Guardian of Y'ffelon" on Galen.
11065.name: Phoenix Moth
11065.description: "Druids say the moths are ash made manifest. They leap from the flames of Mount Firesong and flutter away on the breeze. Nonsense! I've seen a moth ignite and then emerge from the coals like a cocoon."âFeather-Brained Teeska

11066.name: Harrowing Reaper
11066.description: Terrify your enemies. Don the guise of the dreaded harrowing reaper! It's time to reap what they sowed!

11067.name: Harrowstorm Destrier
11067.description: The first destrier born from a harrowstorm spurned its original rider and galloped away before any present could capture it. This pattern continued for a time, leading many to wonder where they went. Some say they must find new ridersâfor good or ill.

11068.name: Buoyant Armiger Bear
11068.description: "Vicious, the bear was, all a-rumble with menace, despite its chains. 'Let us please Lord Vivec with this two-toned creature. Its growls show promise in a world filled with craven whispers.' And so it began."âArmiger Tharys's Journal

11069.name: Buoyant Armiger Kagouti
11069.description: "Vile mischief inflicted wounds upon the striped kagouti. 'Lord Vivec must know we have healed this creature who protected his servants. Remembered pain will lead to prevented pain.' And so it befriended the bear and spider."âArmiger Tharys's Journal

11070.name: Buoyant Armiger Ornaug
11070.description: "Exuberance flowed from the emerald ornaug, then it despaired. 'It enjoyed its freedom from the cage, yet lack of purpose brought it low. Perhaps Lord Vivec can grant it one among us.' And so it joined our other three steeds."âArmiger Tharys's Journal

11071.name: Buoyant Armiger Ram
11071.description: "Curious, the horned beast sniffed at food before turning away. 'Ah, curiosity drives it, but caution tempers it. A wise beast for Lord Vivec's study. Perhaps it can teach fools wisdom and open sages to hope.' And so it ended."âArmiger Tharys's Journal

11072.name: Buoyant Armiger Dwarven Spider
11072.description: "Intense shudders wracked the spider of Dwarven make. 'It smells most foul. Let us repair its workings for Lord Vivec. Its perpetual existence shall provoke needed change among us.' And so it joined the bear."âArmiger Tharys's Journal

11073.name: Stefan Mornard
11073.description: With both knightly skills and druidic lore in his repertoire, Sir Stefan Mornard makes for a deadly foeâand a courteous houseguest. After adding Sir Stefan to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

11074.name: Caska
11074.description: Caska the Senche-raht serves as the first mate on The Perfect Pounce, and she loves time off to pursue other interestsâperhaps in your house! After adding Caska to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

11075.name: Mel Adrys
11075.description: Vampire hunters such as Mel Adrys travel widely in pursuit of their quarry, and they need places to rest between hunts. Care to host this Dark Elf? After adding Mel to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

11076.name: Spellscar Quasigriff
11076.description: The unchained potential that emanates from the Spellscar twists and changes everything it touches. Who or what drew a quasigriff to Craglorn is still a mystery, but these esoterically beautiful beasts add something new and transcendent to Tamriel.

11077.name: Necrom Evening Attire
11077.description: Honor your Redoran ancestors and your sense of style by donning this opulent evening wear! Perfect for midnight funeral ceremonies as well as starlit observances tailored to suit your beloved recently deceased.

11079.name: Firebelly Shalk
11079.description: Unlike their more common domesticated cousins, the Firebelly Shalk constantly blazes. Militant Dark Elves sometimes train these Glasscrag Edifice natives to infiltrate the holds of their enemies. Others find them fiery friends on cold Ashlands nights.

11080.name: Glowgill Guarhide
11080.description: Skin tone changes, taking on the texture of rough hide. Glowing blue markings. Some attribute these skin changes to the Hist. Riders of these glowing steeds believe that this transition occurs as you increase your bond with your beast.

11081.name: Pact Mother Elite Ensemble
11081.description: "Today I don new robes, a symbol of my vow, my office. Blessed by Almalexia, may the Mother of Morrowind guide my hand. May she lend strength to me in times of conflict. For the Pact!"âExcerpt from Urona Hlaalu's Journal

11082.name: Abyssal Tomeshell
11082.description: "Love books, do you? What if they had tentacles and an eye? The gift of flight? Like them as much then? Yes? Oh, delightful! Here, befriend my beloved Philosophicus AeternumâPhilo for short. Expand its knowledge of Nirn."âThe Archivist of the Lost

11083.name: Cartoklept Map
11083.description:
An old relic with the power to pinpoint the location of Cartoklepts and reveal their coordinates on your map.

To reveal Cartoklept locations, the relic must be used in Scrivener's Hall and the Cartoklept must be in the same realm at the time of use.
11083.hint: Obtained by locating the buried treasure in The Rift after securing a treasure map from the vault inside Scrivener's Hall.

11084.name: Recall of the Galen Wilds
11084.description: Walking through the old growth of the Galen wilds leaves a tangible mark on the soul.

11085.name: Gyrfalcon Gather
11085.description: When trained, the High Isle gyrfalcon can spot and retrieve plants for the handler. Druids claim this is Y'ffre's will.

11086.name: Druidstone Mine
11086.description: The ores of High Isle sometimes need a little extra nudge. Luckily the Green provides, or so secondhand tales at Gonfalon Bay's Ancient Anchor claim.

11087.name: Stonelore Split
11087.description: Trees grant gifts that linger after their passing. Druids recognize this gift as what it is, a blessing from Y'ffre.

11089.name: Jubilee Cake 2023
11089.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. Its secret ingredient is an unfathomable enigma, giving it a complex flavor profile!
11089.hint: Obtained by completing the 2023 Anniversary event.

11090.name: Kwama Miner's Kit Jack
11090.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Kwama Miner's Kit style.

11091.name: Kwama Miner's Kit Helmet
11091.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Kwama Miner's Kit style.

11092.name: Kwama Miner's Kit Guards
11092.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Kwama Miner's Kit style.

11093.name: Kwama Miner's Kit Arm Cops
11093.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Kwama Miner's Kit style.

11094.name: Kwama Miner's Kit Boots
11094.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the Kwama Miner's Kit style.

11095.name: Kwama Miner's Kit Bracers
11095.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Kwama Miner's Kit style.

11097.name: Pyroclast, Infernace Conservator
11097.description:
Hailing from the pocket realm of Infernace, Pyroclast will holdfast your items (or the items of your groupmates) in the fiery pits of Oblivion. Minor scorching may occur.

Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.

11098.name: Rain's Hand Renewal
11098.description: "After a dry winter, priests of Y'ffre perform a ritual intended to ensure gentle storms arrive. During a successful ritual, leaves appear to grow on the body of a chosen one, who can forevermore call upon this leafy appearance at will."âRichien Thalin

11099.name: Unstable Emerald Glyphic
11099.description: An ancient relic of Hermaeus Mora, the Emerald Glyphic is resonant with nameless and antiquarian forces. It's worth careful study. Just be careful not to learn something you were not meant to know.
11099.hint: Acquired by completing the "Fate's Proxy" achievement.

11100.name: Steadfast Society Ball Domino
11100.description: "To offset the suffering caused by the Three Banners War, some of us host gatherings to raise funds for our healing centers. Each event sees the biggest donor receiving a mask embellished with an Imperial red diamond. I adore mine."âEstayne Justal

11101.name: Jester's Jig
11101.description: Show your inner jester by dancing this joyful jig! Ah, the mirthful merriment.

11102.name: Necrom Armiger Senche
11102.description: "We were all surprised when this senche arrived via envoy. 'A gift from Necrom to an armiger of great repute. Return and aid in the training of more!' And so I ventured to Necrom with a cunning, furry companion."âArmiger Tharys's Journal

11104.name: Briarheart Face Scarification
11104.description: "Feather and claw. Marked for a Briarheart, eh? What called you? Reachfolk dreams? Daedric nightmares? A persuasive witch? All of these and more? It matters not to me. I simply want a chance to examine your facial ink."âArtist-Adept Aimira

11105.name: Briarheart Body Scarification
11105.description: Long before a warrior undergoes the ritual to become a Briarheart, some candidates undergo a marking ceremony. Scars shape ornate feathers and claws into their skin as a sign the Reach Hagravens chose them. These folk often lead others into battle.

11106.name: Lost in the Woods
11106.description: You're totally lost. In the woods. We can tell.
11106.hint: Acquired by completing the "Scribes of Fate Scout" achievement.

11107.hint: Found occasionally in delves on Galen.
11107.name: Delver's Druid Deck Fragment
11107.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

11108.hint: Found occasionally after defeating World Bosses on Galen.
11108.name: Slayer's Druid Deck Fragment
11108.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

11109.hint: Found occasionally after sealing volcanic vents on Galen.
11109.name: Geomancer's Druid Deck Fragment
11109.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

11110.hint: Complete "The Best of Friends" achievement on Galen.
11110.name: Soothing Druid Deck Fragment
11110.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

11111.hint: Complete the quest "The Dream of Kasorayn" on Galen.
11111.name: Dreamer's Druid Deck Fragment
11111.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

11113.hint: Obtained by completing the quest "The Double Edge."
11113.name: Sharp-as-Night
11113.description: Sharp-as-Night is more than a mysterious mercenary with a forgotten past. With your help, he's learning what it means to look out for others. Call this companion to your side when you need to get the job done with a hardened survivalist watching your back.

11114.hint: Obtained by completing the quest "The Fateweaver Key."
11114.name: Azandar al-Cybiades
11114.description: Azandar al-Cybiades has always known he was meant for greatness. Every twist and turn on his path to arcanist power was done with clear eyes and a convivial attitude. Call this companion to your side and undertake an eldritch adventure into the unknown!

11115.name: Foe Crusher
11115.description: Ah, the sweet victory of seeing your foes die at your hands. Even sweeter? Crushing their skulls into splinters.

11116.name: Knife Savant
11116.description: Battle isn't the only place for sharp edges! Amuse yourself and your friends by showing off skillful knife tricks.

11117.name: Play Pan Flute
11117.description: Fauns aren't the only creatures who can play pan flutes. Perform your own musical pieces with this bucolic instrument.

11118.name: Sailor's Sextant
11118.description: Never leave shore without your trusty sextant. This navigation instrument plays an important role in journeys by sea.
11118.hint: Acquired by completing the "Fate's Secrets" achievement.

11119.name: Cursed Reach Doll
11119.description: A dark curse from the Dragon cult still lingers around this adorable little doll. Is it safe to handle? Perhaps brandish at your friends? There's only one way to find out.

11120.name: Discord Dremnaken Runt
11120.description: Dremnaken runts do not take kindly to acts of aggression. They include chin scratches and head pats in this category, more's the pity. In fact, it's best you avoid even the gentlest of eye contact.

11121.name: Peninsula Hermit Crab
11121.description: Hermit crabs are nothing if not adaptable. Those from the Telvanni Peninsula use hollowed mushroom caps as their homes and serve as ornaments in Dark Elf gardens.

11143.name: Fungal Ash Hopper
11143.description: Originally found in volcanic regions in the Dark Elf territories, these insects can be tamed with kind words and cheese. They chirp excitedly when happy or when skittering on slick floors.

11144.hint: Acquired by completing the "Glory of the Aldmeri Dominion" achievement.
11144.name: Aldmeri Dominion War Marks
11144.description: May these Aldmeri Dominion facial marks be the last thing your enemies see before you defeat them in Cyrodiil. For the Queen!

11145.name: Iterative Onyx Glyphic
11145.description: An ancient relic of Hermaeus Mora, the Onyx Glyphic is resonant with eldritch power and temporal forces. Best to hand it off to someone you trust. You know, like yourself.
11145.hint: Acquired by completing the "Scrivener's Hall Conqueror" achievement.

11146.name: Dragonscale Draugr Bear
11146.description: Riders of these draugr bears find the dragonscale barding does an exemplary job. There's exactly as much jouncing as you'd expect riding hard on a skeletal ursine's back. Plus, the frost magic imbued within adds a frisson of chill to keep riders alert.

11147.name: Shor's Fox
11147.description: "You may laugh, but like Shor, this fox has added years to my life. Years. Saved me from some giants by outwitting them. Hoisted me by my breeches out of the angry spring waters of the Yorgrim. I breed them now, so I named them."âThorkell

11149.name: Iliac Bay Hermit Crab
11149.description: Hermit crabs are famous for making homes out of any discarded shell, but the hermit crabs of Iliac Bay are pickier than most. They choose shells that match their own delicate blue coloration.

11150.name: Ashen Cliff Strider
11150.description: Natives of the Ashlands of Vvardenfell, these flightless, winged reptiles use their pale coloration to hide amidst that barren terrain. They can be trained, however, and follow their owners almost anywhere.

11151.name: Ancestral Haj Mota
11151.description: In Telvanni lands, haj mota sometimes lay their eggs in broken catacombs or abandoned cemeteries. The hatchlings acquire a coating of green grave-mold on their shells and become sensitive to the presence of ghosts.

11152.name: Autumn Messenger Fox
11152.description: "As kits, these rambunctious little trouble-making furballs keep this one on her toes. But their predilection for trouble when young works in your favorâtheir ability to sense harm is nearly magical. Perfect for messenger work!"âTesusah, Stablemaster

11153.name: Elden Root Elk
11153.description: Legend says a trading caravan was once ambushed on its way to Elden Root. Only one survived. Days later they arrived safely, slung across the back of a majestic white-and-black elk. Perhaps you might make such a friend if you find yourself in need.

11154.name: Do'Krin Ascetic's Henna
11154.description: "To teach within the Order of the Claw, one must first pass the Trials of the Ascetic. In one trial, you must meditate without pause while another designs patterns on your skin with henna. Perhaps next time this one shall pass that trial."âKansur-jo

11155.name: Swaying Skeleton Face Art
11155.description: The Vaermina cult leader Larul first wore this facial design while presiding over a lich-making ritual. Her gleeful laughter still echoes in the damp caverns of Kingscrest Cavern. Yet, in the waking world, she is nowhere to be found.

11156.name: Swaying Skeleton Body Art
11156.description: "On wicked nights when the wind flees grasping limbs, we weep lich-ink onto ourselves. Any who see us in their dreams take on our lich-bone symbols and step into lands of nightmare while sleeping and awake."âNearly illegible snippet from Larul's Journal

11159.name: All-Maker's Bear
11159.description: The bears of Solstheim have a deep and ancient connection to the All-Maker. When the time comes to serve as a mount to the Skaal, or so the stories go, they enter the corral as mild-mannered as a cub.

11160.name: All-Maker's Horse
11160.description: The harmony of the All-Maker dwells within the chest of this steed. It breathes in the breath and breathes out the wind. In its wake does the earth move, the waters flow, and the sun shine.

11161.name: All-Maker's Senche-Raht
11161.description: Unlike other Senche-rahts, Thryn has accepted many riders in its time, though only a few have lasted beyond one battle. This is due to Thryn's habit of testing its rider's mettle with daring maneuvers and wild risksâall in the name of a good story.

11162.name: All-Maker's Dwarven Spider
11162.description: "I don't normally consult on the personal projects of other folk, but it was an honor to study beside you. Whatever gave you the excellent idea to overhaul it in the style of the Skaal?"âNeramo, in a letter to the artisan known as the Spidersmith

11163.name: All-Maker's Wolf
11163.description: "On a dark and moonless night, raiders stole into the village with plunder in their eyes and violence in their hearts. Their victory was assured, until a lone howl ripped through the icy night air." âThe All-Maker's Land, translated

11164.name: Scrawl of the Arcanist Visage
11164.description: Scholars endlessly dispute the concepts hidden among text fragments of The Arcanist's Path. Ancient secrets? Troves of forbidden knowledge? Or, as claimed by one notable arcanist, the particular ingredients for an herbal tea blend?

11165.name: Scrawl of the Arcanist Tattoos
11165.description: "How can I find the right words when the One Who Knows wants them hidden? When I can't capture and keep them in my mind even in Apocrypha? Wait â¦ let my body be my parchment and my blood form the ink!"âScrap from The Arcanist's Path

11166.name: Ebontusk Pocket Mammoth
11166.description: First domesticated around Bonerock Cavern, these miniature mammoths are affectionate pets and follow their masters at a cautious, reasonable gait. Carefulâpocket mammoths are known cuddlers.

11167.name: Chaotic Creatia Cub
11167.description: A playful bit of incarnated plasma first summoned by talented arcanists from the strange realms beyond Tamriel, these cubs are mischievous, devoted, and harmless. Well, mostly harmless.

11168.name: Ashsorrow Vvardvark
11168.description: These ashen vvardvarks are much adored by Ashlander children. Their long tongues hungrily searching Morrowind's volcanic vents for food make for an entertaining sight.

11169.name: Goldscale Guar
11169.description: "The glint of gold I glimpsed when I first spotted these guar made me think I'd found a vein of gold, but no. Instead I found something betterâgolden guar that match my exquisite taste. One nudged me to ride it, too! We're best friends."âGanalyn Relvan

11170.name: Oleander Senche-Serval
11170.description: The artists of Black Heights found a new canvas upon which to share their imagination: senche-servals. The high-quality pigments used on this feline's fur weather much without causing harm, and artists claim the cats preen as they're painted.

11172.name: Fogbreak Lighthouse
11172.description: The cozy life of a lighthouse keeper awaits any who claim Fogbreak as a home. This welcoming lighthouse includes a large undercroft, stunning views of the sea, a beacon to help ships navigate dangerous waters, and plenty of outdoor space to savor.

11173.name: Shroomtender Robe
11173.description: An Outfit look for robes in the Shroomtender style.

11176.name: Bottled Skin Dyes
11176.description:
Two bottles of ink used for semi-permanent dyeing of the skin in Dibellan festival rites.

A component required for the Meadowbreeze Memories skin.

11177.name: Ground Jade Lily Powder
11177.description:
The ground powder of dried jade lily petals, mixed with skin dyes to cause the ink to glow slightly.

A component required for the Meadowbreeze Memories skin.

11178.name: Pressed Silver Leaves
11178.description:
Sanctified silver pressed into extremely thin leaf-shaped wafers for application to the skin during Dibellan festival rites.

A component required for the Meadowbreeze Memories skin.

11179.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Scrivener's Hall.
11179.name: Bust: Ozezan the Inferno
11179.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Scrivener's Hall.

11180.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Bal Sunnar.
11180.name: Bust: Roksa the Warped
11180.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Bal Sunnar.

11181.hint: Awarded for completing the Scrivener's Hall.
11181.name: Trophy: Ozezan the Inferno
11181.description: Trophy taken from Ozezan the Inferno in honor of an Undaunted victory in Scrivener's Hall.

11182.name: Trophy: Roksa the Warped
11182.description: Trophy taken from Roksa the Warped in honor of an Undaunted victory in Bal Sunnar.

11183.name: Chronometer of the Tribunal
11183.description: You may place the Chronometer in your home. Watching the dial spin causes local perception of time to shift. Until the Chronometer is disturbed, time stands still. Enjoy Sotha Sil's morning sun, Almalexia's mid-day mercy, or the star-spun night of Vivec.

11185.name: Bitter Coast Recall
11185.description: The mages of southwestern Vvardenfell were inspired by the smoking vision of Red Mountain on the horizon. If crimson is your color, this variant is perfect for you!

11186.name: Reach Witch Removal
11186.description: Claim this tool, inlaid with numerous Reach enchantments and perfect for rune extraction. A hallmark of the Karth River Reach clans.

11187.name: Grovetender's Sweep
11187.description: The druids of the Systres often use a blessed sickle to harvest plants and herbs. Why not give it a try yourself?

11188.name: Karth River Cleave
11188.description: Cleave through wood like a Reach warrior on the Karth River! These worthies use a special handcrafted axe that gives them a burst of pride in their work, and now you can too.

11189.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "A Hidden Fate."
11189.name: Abyssal Cephaliarch's Face Art
11189.description: Librarians possess mixed feelings about any who exhibit the eye-framing swirls of Hermaeus Mora. These curators of knowledge honor erudition among those who seek their tomes, yet they fear the covetousness that can drive agents of the Golden Eye.

11190.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "A Calamity of Fate."
11190.name: Abyssal Cephaliarch's Body Art
11190.description: "In his name, I seek lost tomes and bring them home to Apocrypha. In his name, I remove words of power from the sight of knowledge seekers. And in his name, I bear markings of eyes and tentacles. Do you honor Hermaeus Mora as I do?"âScrollseeker Thelmarn

11191.name: Meln's Soul Gem
11191.description: With the soul of Meln the Mouthless tucked away in your rucksack, you'll never be at a loss for advice, commentary about the world, and other tidbits he decides to (over) share with you.
11191.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Spirit of Fate."

11192.name: Coiled Bob
11192.description: "Derik Hallin of the mid-First Era popularized tightly coiled short hair, specifically among sword-singers. Since then, some among us who study the Book of Circles created variants for Khajiit and Argonians who wish to learn our ways."âKhazha of Sentinel

11193.name: Auroran Commander Helm
11193.description: After Umaril the Unfeathered bound himself to Meridia's realm, he started his "ruin-from-afar" campaigns, sending servants out to deal with his foes. The commanders among them wore these helms to denote their rank within each group.

11194.name: Abyssal Bunny
11194.description: "I wished for ears that could listen to dreams. He gave them to me. How lonely was I that I needed to be part of your most private wonders? Now I wander a forest of waking horrors. Please, take care of him. It was my fault."âNote found in Jasper's basket

11195.name: Windcaller Garb
11195.description: "Fleet of foot though wolves may be, the wind moves faster. It flows into places even insects cannot reach. Thus the Skaal witch who masterfully calls upon it gains the title of Windcaller, Blessed of the All-Maker."âSkaal Shaman Rik

11196.name: Iron Orc Welwa
11196.description: Iron Orcs labor hard and long, fight until their dying breath, and train mounts to do the same. So, if you're lucky enough to ride one of their welwas, expect to be pushed to your own limits as your mount keeps going despite all obstacles in its path.

11197.name: Solstheim Shiver Wolf
11197.description: "Don't muck with another rider's wolf, unless you're ready to meet the All-Maker. These are spirit beasts. They come when summoned, but they're loyal only to their rider. I nearly lost a finger learning that lesson the hard way." âHlokela, Solitude

11198.name: Crafty Lerisa
11198.description: As her name implies, Crafty Lerisa possesses a cunning that keeps her alive. Right now it's telling her to sit tightâperhaps in your home? After adding Crafty Lerisa to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

11199.name: J'baanluk
11199.description: No job is too small for this Pahmar-raht resistance fighter. That said, he needs a place to rest before his next efforts against his oppressors. After adding J'baanluk to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

11200.name: Filbert Cienne
11200.description: Ready to learn more about Peryite, the Prince of Pestilence? Then Filbert's ready to visit and share his knowledge. After adding Filbert to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

11201.name: Blessed Highmane Lion
11201.description: "And thus did Alkosh bestow a companion of pure light upon his champion. From atop the beast, the champion rode a noble path. And wherever the lion's paws fell, light and justice soon followed thereafter." âPath of the Highmane, translated

11202.name: Star-Orphan Elk
11202.description: "After weeks of searching, I finally caught a glimpse of that illustrious beast on the horizon. I thought it was a vision from Meridia, but then it approached on the icy tundra and I felt the warmth of its breath on my hand." âJournal of Mage Abzrolg

11203.name: Ashmourning Vvardvark
11203.description: Originally seen as a mistake by its creator, vvardvarks grew in popularity, compelling Telvanni magisters to expand its development. This dark-hued mount is perfectly suited to carry riders in funerary processions honoring revered ancient ancestors.

11204.name: Hollowjack Indrik
11204.description: "Twisted twigs, a scent of death, a dance amid the briars. A dash of howls and drip of gore starts sinister fires. Stir round with haunted bone, then call me with your screams. If I approve, a mount you gain to torment your foes' dreams."âLord Hollowjack

11205.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Tenacious Dreamer."
11205.name: Whorls of the Dark Dream Visage
11205.description: "I saw the woman with the glowing lavender tattoos again. She wasn't smiling, so I asked her to. At first, she stared. A dreadful stare. Then she smiled. I only just now woke from the ghastliest nightmares I've ever experienced."âRelur Uveran's Journal

11206.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Sanity's Edge Conqueror."
11206.name: Whorls of the Dark Dream Marks
11206.description: Though the lavender glow of these swirls seems to promise comfort, those who study the Weaver of Dreams know better. It takes less than a moment for a dream of contentment to twist ominously into a nightmare of Vaermina's choosing.

11207.name: Spellscar Sheathe
11207.description: The power of the Spellscar transforms your appearance with its mesmerizing display of colorful light peeking out from under a cracked shell of darkness. Those who recognize this effect may wonder if you're entirely stableâwhich is exactly what you want!

11208.name: Azure Ombre
11208.description:
"Why did I choose this stunning blue hair style? First, it's my choice! Second, if you can do this, you're a master alchemist and hair artist like me. Why not flaunt it?"âDabienne Geontene of Skingrad

This hair style overrides your base hair color.

11209.name: Ebony Dwarven Scarab
11209.description: "Some of father's creations can be so frightening what with the way they hiss and stutter, but not this small scarab, no. After all, its bright glow does wonders to keep the monsters beneath my bed at bay."âFabricator Anzalf's Daughter

11210.name: Clockwork Nix-Hound
11210.description: A fabricant from the hidden laboratories of Sotha Sil, the clockwork nix-hound is a small but lifelike imitation. It even "hunts" and consumes tiny scraps of metal in its vicinity. Watch out for your coin purse!

11216.name: The Fair Winds
11216.description: Enjoy sea-based living on the Fair Winds, a spacious galleon hailing from the Systres Isles. You have a bevy of travel options a mere spin of the ship's wheel away, with ports of call in Vulkhel Guard, Davon's Watch, and Daggerfall. Just watch for ornaugs!

11217.name: Statuette: Kaalgrontiid
11217.description: A miniature statue of Kaalgrontiid, the emerald sovereign of wrath and terror.

11218.name: Statuette: Orc Warrior
11218.description: A miniature statue of an Orc warrior emanating strength.

11219.name: Painting: Galen in Harmony
11219.description: A painting presenting a peaceful blending of Breton and druidic architecture, set against the wild lushness of Galen's flora.

11220.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion
11220.name: Journey's End Lodgings
11220.description: Whether taking part in funerary rites or visiting the Dark Elf city of the dead, visitors to Necrom can rest easy within the confines of this spacious room inside the Mourner's Solace Inn. Full privacyâeven from ancestral spiritsâis guaranteed.

11221.hint: Acquired by completing the "Glory of the Daggerfall Covenant" achievement.
11221.name: Daggerfall Covenant War Marks
11221.description: You've donned your battle regalia. Now add these Daggerfall Covenant facial paints and confront your enemies in Cyrodiil. For King and Covenant!

11222.hint: Acquired by completing the "Glory of the Ebonheart Pact" achievement.
11222.name: Ebonheart Pact War Marks
11222.description: Prepare yourself for battle across Cyrodiil with facial paints that exhibit your alliance with the Ebonheart Pact. Blood for the Pact!

11223.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Necrom Grand Adventurer" Achievement
11223.name: Emissary's Enclave
11223.description: Years ago, Tribunal priests requested a Necrom-based residence for an emissary and their staff. Today, this expansive home with scenic terraces is privately owned and seeks a caretakerâperhaps youâuntil an emissary of the Three needs it again.

11224.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Castoff Destinies."
11224.name: Sacred Watcher Hood
11224.description: Scholar Leane Ascien spends pages outlining the process to attract a Watcher to wrap around the heads of a Mora follower. The knowledge exchanged and protection granted is a sacred experience, if uncomfortable. When done, the Watcher removes the memory.

11225.name: Ayleid Face Ruinmarks
11225.description: This triangular light blue facial marking shows off your love of all things Ayleidâplus lends authority to your tales of Ayleid ruin exploits! Who would dare refute even the most audacious of your stories with this symbol on your brow?

11226.name: Ayleid Body Ruinmarks
11226.description: "Barra agea ry sou karanâwear lore as your armor. Say these words at a certain Ayleid gate under the Magician's light, and you may be blessed with light-blue markings reminiscent of that gate's design. Which gate? Soon I'll know."âAlfarmuth of Eyevea

11227.name: Cathay Baandari Face Brand
11227.description: During the Baandari Ritual of Pathkeeping, the highest ranked Baandari present bestows deep vermilion and brilliant white dots and crescents on a respected littermate. These marks acknowledge that the peddler lives by the Way of the Baandari.

11228.name: Cathay Baandari Body Brand
11228.description: "Cathay peddlers state that Baan Dar smiles upon those who undergo the Ritual of Pathkeeping to receive red and white brands. Know the Way of the Baandari, and you grasp the wandering litter's strengths â¦ and their challenges."âOstarion the Storyteller

11229.name: Prism of Moribund Sapience
11229.description: A replica of the cursed Daedric relic once gifted to the powerful portal mage Dreynis by an envoy of Sheogorath. Though only a facsimile, some say it has some of the same insanity inducing properties as the original.
11229.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "In a Troubled House."

11230.name: Necrom Armiger Face Markings
11230.description: "Lord Vivec, heed my prayer. With your blessing, I traveled to Necrom. To tell my father's spirit of an oath kept, duties done. My honor as a Buoyant Armiger upheld. As my father smiles down upon me, the Dead Keepers scribe upon my flesh."âArmiger Relura

11231.name: Necrom Armiger Body Markings
11231.description: Buoyant Armigers assigned to Necrom often meditate before their pilgrimage, reflecting on what they hope to achieve. Once there, if they accomplish their goals, a Dead Keeper body artist adorns their skin with Necrom symbology.

11232.name: Lavender Guar
11232.description: Guar have long been at home in the Black Marsh, making them steady companions to the Argonians. It is not uncommon for Lavender Guar to bond deeply with their riders, standing watch while they sleep and affectionately nuzzling them.

11233.name: Ginger Pocket Mammoth
11233.description: Much like the pocket mammoths first domesticated near Bonerock Cavern, these creatures are docile and affectionate, plus make excellent livestock. This sub-species is particularly prized among breeders for its distinctive fur color.

11237.name: Star-Orphan Fawn
11237.description: Aethereal light pours off this unearthly fawn. Some say it's a blessing from the Divines, while others think it's a Daedric trick. Still, it's a rare thing to be trusted by such an elusive creature, placing its companions in auspicious company.

11238.name: Shezarr's Chicken
11238.description: Some claim this breed of bird from Cyrodiil's heartland has a deeper connection to Shezarr than the name. This is likely due to their escape artist reputation, which finds them "being misplaced" quite regularly.

11239.name: Silent Moons Sheep
11239.description: Docile and hardy, these sheep were first tamed near Whiterun. Their thick wool is woven into cloaks and blankets, protecting the wearer during harsh winters. Nord children sometimes bed down among the flock, enjoying the sheep's warmth.

11240.name: Sagacious Psijic Senche-Raht
11240.description: Aloof and strangely mournful, there's no question Pirzbi wields powerful magic. Some say their innate ability and keen intellect have become an obstacle for those who wish to partner with them. Perhaps you will find success where they did not.

11241.name: Cumberland Anniversary Attire
11241.description: High King Emeric ordered this dashing attire for the anniversary of his coronation. The first of the Cumberland Dynasty to ascend to the throne, Emeric seeks to rule the Daggerfall Covenant wisely. With this garb, he also leads with panache.

11242.name: Almalexia
11242.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia, Mother Morrowind.
11242.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Mercymother, I Bend My Knee."

11260.name: Shadow Queen's Labyrinth
11260.description: A winding maze dominates the grounds of this twilight-enshrouded estate, creating endless opportunities to perplex visitors. The visceral awe evoked by Nocturnal's Evergloam skies provides an exquisite contrast to the spacious, Summerset-inspired home.

11293.description: Fangtomes know not the importance or content of the books they inhabit. In the event that your rare first editions or vital academic texts have gained a tenant, simply befriend the tome via ample spine massages and a gentle ruffling of its pages.

11326.name: Black Fredas Senche-Lizard
11326.description: Some find the color unnerving, but many riders enjoy the onyx shade and welcome the superstitious tales that follow this mount. Just know that countless legends and tales of woe begin when a Black Fredas beast crosses one's path.

11328.name: Kindred's Concord Cuirass
11328.description: Learned from the Kindred's Concord Crafting Style, acquired from Bastion Nymic.

11329.name: Kindred's Concord Helm
11329.description: Learned from the Kindred's Concord Crafting Style, acquired from Bastion Nymic.

11355.name: Kindred's Concord Mace
11355.description: Learned from the Kindred's Concord Crafting Style, acquired from Bastion Nymic.

11356.name: Kindred's Concord Shield
11356.description: Learned from the Kindred's Concord Crafting Style, acquired from Bastion Nymic.
