11357.description: Learned from the Kindred's Concord Crafting Style, acquired from Bastion Nymic.

11358.name: Kindred's Concord Sword
11358.description: Learned from the Kindred's Concord Crafting Style, acquired from Bastion Nymic.

11359.name: Kindred's Concord Dagger
11359.description: Learned from the Kindred's Concord Crafting Style, acquired from Bastion Nymic.

11360.name: Chimer Half-Mask
11360.description: "Did the High Velothi craft this mask to emulate Vivec, or did the Master of Morrowind take a liking to a Chimer artisan's work and mirror that in his appearance? Best not propose the latter within the hearing of any Dark Elves."âAncemen of Auridon

11361.name: Harvestleaf Lacquer
11361.description: "In my dream, the lava poured down the valley. I called to the winds and the trees to save me, and they answered. A shield from the flames. Their mark has never left me."âInitiate Selyna

11362.name: Mycoturge Fascinator
11362.description: Mycoturges who achieve a certain level of mastery in their craft may don this fascinator, which they must first craft from bloodtooth toadstools. If it thrives for a full season of wear, they gain recognition as a master mycoturge.

11363.name: Effigy Earrings of Saint Vorys
11363.description: Forcefully express your willâby wearing golden earrings that honor both Saint Vorys the Immolant and, by extension, your ancestors. The design features the emblem of House Telvanni's patron saint.

11364.name: Dreamstrider Face Art
11364.description: "Do not talk to me of dreams. I've seen your dreams. Your nightmares. I've walkedâand flownâalongside you through tragedy and awe. Vaermina's gifts let me see much. Look here. She also marked my face. Today, I choose to show her art."âTredyn Ildram

11365.name: Dreamstrider Body Art
11365.description: Vaermina dances in your dreams, beckoning you to join her on journeys of wonder â¦ and of woe. When you awake, you return changed in both body and mind. Will you show off your wondrous new body art or keep it to yourself?

11366.name: Mycoturge Face Markings
11366.description: "The crossed mushroom stalks on my face indicate my expertise with crafting mage towers. Precision and accuracy meet at that spot. You need both to build a lasting tower for a mage and their extraordinary number of books."âMycoturge Anisi Farano

11367.name: Mycoturge Body Markings
11367.description: Those who create structures using fungus often adorn their bodies with ornate markings featuring mushrooms. These mycoturges provide their own mycelial-based inks to the artist for their works of body art.

11368.name: Nightmare Nest Face Art
11368.description: "What you call reality is drudgery. We truly live only during the hours of sleep, when the Weaver of Dreams welcomes us into her many-layered nest of truth. See my face? This art marks that I'm hers. Live your true life. Join us."âDreamdelver Marbruk

11369.name: Nightmare Nest Body Art
11369.description: Some Vaermina cultists believe they can morph dreams into reality via an intricate series of rituals. The rites culminate in an incense-shrouded chamber wherein a recipient gains tattoos similar to the group's favorite Weaver of Dreams statue.

11370.name: Class: Arcanist
11370.description:
Unlocks the Arcanist class for use in character creation.

Channel the eldritch powers of Apocrypha as an Arcanist. These spellcasters channel secret runes and abyssal spells to destroy their enemies, heal their allies, and defend against any foe.

11371.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Honor, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.
11371.name: Gravegrasp Cuirass
11371.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Gravegrasp style.

11372.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Honor, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.
11372.name: Gravegrasp Helm
11372.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Gravegrasp style.

11373.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Honor, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.
11373.name: Gravegrasp Greaves
11373.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Gravegrasp style.

11374.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Honor, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.
11374.name: Gravegrasp Pauldrons
11374.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Gravegrasp style.

11375.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Honor, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.
11375.name: Gravegrasp Sabatons
11375.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the Gravegrasp style.

11376.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Honor, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.
11376.name: Gravegrasp Gauntlets
11376.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Gravegrasp style.

11377.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Honor, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.
11377.name: Gravegrasp Girdle
11377.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Gravegrasp style.

11379.name: Prodigious Crimson Mudcrab
11379.description: "How many times have I told you to keep your fingers away from the claws? Now look at you, knuckles bruised and nothing learned. The crab did nothing wrong. Maybe it's time this one found a more appropriate home."âOverheard on the Necrom docks

11380.name: Hearthhome Moth
11380.description: These ponderous moths flap slowly between pools of moonlight, attracted by the glow. During the day, they either rest on shady tree trunks or follow behind those who make them feel safe. Their delicate wings are famously soft to the touch.

11381.name: Dreugh Queen Cuirass
11381.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Dreugh Queen style.

11382.name: Dreugh Queen Helm
11382.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Dreugh Queen style.

11383.name: Dreugh Queen Greaves
11383.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Dreugh Queen style.

11384.name: Dreugh Queen Pauldrons
11384.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Dreugh Queen style.

11385.name: Dreugh Queen Sabatons
11385.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the Dreugh Queen style.

11386.name: Dreugh Queen Gauntlets
11386.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Dreugh Queen style.

11387.name: Dreugh Queen Girdle
11387.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Dreugh Queen style.

11388.name: Legionnaire's Recall
11388.description: "One of the Legion Zero traitors we'd been tracking called forth some sort of circle and vanished before we could ambush him. What foul magics have they learned in their time here?"âScrap from the journal of Tatius Nerva

11389.name: Ashen Runegathering
11389.description: With a flourish of your sharp Ashlander blade, you collect a runestone in the manner taught to you by the people of the wastes.

11390.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Light the Way to Freedom".
11390.name: Sharp-as-Night
11390.description: Solitary mercenary Sharp-as-Night isn't used to company, but if you invite him into your home, this warden will leave his icy demeanor at the door. Mostly. Talk to him to hear his unfiltered thoughts, or set him on a path to let him wander your estate.

11391.name: Azandar
11391.description: Azandar al-Cybiades is a consummate researcher and peerless arcanist. Just ask him! After adding Azandar to your home, you can set him on a path. You and your guests can also talk to him. Trust us, he's got plenty to say.

11392.name: Ashen Militia Battle Axe
11392.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Ashen Militia style.

11393.name: Ashen Militia Bow
11393.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Ashen Militia style.

11394.name: Ashen Militia Shield
11394.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Ashen Militia style.

11395.name: Ashen Militia Staff
11395.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Ashen Militia style.

11396.name: Ashen Militia Axe
11396.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Ashen Militia style.

11397.name: Ashen Militia Maul
11397.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Ashen Militia style.

11398.name: Ashen Militia Greatsword
11398.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Ashen Militia style.

11399.name: Ashen Militia Mace
11399.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Ashen Militia style.

11400.name: Ashen Militia Sword
11400.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Ashen Militia style.

11401.name: Ashen Militia Dagger
11401.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Ashen Militia style.

11402.name: Deepsnow Prairie Dog
11402.description: "Cute little critters, aren't they? The white pelt helps them blend into the mountains of Skyrim. That's good, because they're just about the tastiest thing the winter has to offer. Except for that one. He's off limits."âNarrald Snow-Bourne

11403.name: Welkyndstone Ruins Pup
11403.description: "The Wild Elves did something right when they tamed these adorable beasties! Look at those eyes, and that tail! Plus with that handsome armor, they'll be well protected on the road." âApprentice Odrethin

11404.name: Play Netch Bagpipes
11404.description: "Netch bladders are perfect, just perfect. Most folk don't see their potential. But I do! Just add a few pipes, some reinforcement, and a little tuning â¦ here, give one a whirl. It's an experience!"âSerana Hlaalu, Inventor

11405.name: Ash Hopper Chomp
11405.description: When prepared with care, an ash hopper's leg provides a savory eating experience that leaves you wanting more. So, what are you waiting for? Chomp down!

11406.name: Preening Peacock
11406.description: "I felt beige. All over. Very beige. People ignored me, and I was sad. Then I got an idea. People pay attention to peacocks. So, why not look more like them? Colorful. Delightful. And very much not beige. My magic worked!"âEntry from an Anonymous Journal

11407.hint: Acquired by completing the "Ichor Most Malevolent" achievement.
11407.name: Maligraphic Mount
11407.description: "I'm not going to say that you need to ride this beast. But when the Prince of Secret Knowledge hands you the reins, are you really going to turn them down? I know I wouldn't!"âFiler Xess

11408.name: Solstice Indrik
11408.description: Legend says this indrik was born of a child's toy, touched by magic on the year's longest night. Others believe a worthy rider wished it into being by pleading with the moons on a cold Frostfall night. Regardless, riders see the world for the wonder it is.

11409.name: Harpy's Bane Durzog
11409.description: "All durzog are relentless in the pursuit of prey, but this sub-species is particularly vicious, especially when following a harpy's scent. Even experienced handlers sometimes struggle to contain their ferocity on the hunt." âElsweyr: A Rider's Guide

11411.hint: Acquired by completing the "Peer Into the Mirror Maze" achievement.
11411.name: Shattered Mirror Maze Face Marks
11411.description: "After a time, I found myself in the wending, ever-coiling hallways of a labyrinth. Despite the crepuscular atmosphere, I saw carved meter and verse 'pon the walls. The words crept behind my eyes. Beneath my skin. As you can see." âScribe Maylen

11412.hint: Acquired by completing the "Walk Through the Mirror Maze" achievement.
11412.name: Shattered Mirror Maze Body Marks
11412.description: Some labyrinths lack a solution. Those within can only mark time by the beating of their heart and the weakness in their body. Those who walk these endless caliginous mazes without purpose may be marked by the journey. If they ever make it out.

11413.name: Esoteric Environment Greaves
11413.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Esoteric Environment Greaves style, acquired through digging for Antiquities.

11414.name: Cryptcanon Vestments
11414.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Cryptcanon Vestments style, acquired through digging for Antiquities.

11422.name: Order of the Lamp Destrier
11422.description: Selectively bred for generations by the Mages Guild and the Order of the Lamp, these steeds possess remarkable stamina and agility. No expense is spared in their training, and they are equipped with armor rivaling that of the finest knights in Tamriel.

11423.name: Order of the Lamp Jackal
11423.description: Cunning and fast, this jackal has a laughing bark that echoes for miles. While they can be somewhat wild even to their riders, the jackal's preternatural ability to find shortcuts and quick exits has made it a preferred mount for many Lamp Knights.

11424.name: Order of the Lamp Lion
11424.description: "Magicka depleted. Enemies on all sides. The cornered mages despaired. Until they heard a growl erupt into a roar as a Lamp Knight and his leonine steed smashed through the enemy ranks."âTale of the Palatinus, translated

11425.name: Order of the Lamp Vvardvark
11425.description: Though not the most fearsome mounts, these recent additions to the Lamp Knight stable are treasured for their loyalty, surefootedness, and tracking skills. Some mages claim they can smell magicka, making them invaluable to the Order of the Lamp.

11428.name: Bolt of Indigo Cotton
11428.description:
A specially-prepared bolt of purplish cloth.

A component required for the Passion Dancer Garment costume.

11429.name: Bolt of Silver Silk
11429.description:
A specially-prepared bolt of silvery cloth.

A component required for the Passion Dancer Garment costume.

11430.name: Enchanted Sewing Kit
11430.description:
An enchanted sewing kit used for assembling garments without needing to waste precious time threading needles.

A component required for the Passion Dancer Garment costume.

11431.name: Statuette: Vaermina, Dreamweaver
11431.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Vaermina, the Lady of Nightmares.

11432.name: Statuette: Dwemer Guardian
11432.description: A miniature statue of a sentinel found outside many Dwarven ruins in Morrowind.

11433.name: Painting: Arrival at Bal Foyen
11433.description: The light of dawn caresses the spires of Bal Foyen as a trader and their travel-burdened guar arrive at this Dark Elf sanctum by the sea.

11434.name: Eyebright Raven
11434.description: "The ravens of Rivenspire are some of the smartest in all of Tamriel. Something about surviving in such an inhospitable land, I think. This fine fellow has been my companion on many a long night in the study."âLady Felyse Talemelier

11435.name: Alchemy
11435.description: Need some mirth and mystery in your home? Invite Alchemy, a renowned performer from the House of Reveries, to stay with you. After adding Alchemy to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

11436.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Memories of the Spearhead."
11436.name: Captain Kaleen
11436.description: The inimitable Captain Kaleen seeks some shore leave before setting sail for her next job. If you've a bunk for her, she'll gladly take it. After adding Captain Kaleen to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

11437.name: Scruut
11437.description: Divergences in fate's threads draw Scruut's attention. Yet, this mighty Watchling seeks your company until the Great Eye summons her. Coincidence? After adding Scruut to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

11438.name: Buraniim Isle Ornaug
11438.description: The shallows of Buraniim Isle are rife with a unique subspecies of ornaug. Vibrant and playful, these ornaugs have been known to splash in the surf to attract the curiosity of would-be prey. When the unsuspecting meal draws too close, they strike.

11439.name: Skingrad Guard Mastiff
11439.description: "The training of one's canine is tantamount to the importance of military maneuvers. Neglecting a Legion canine weakens the entire unit. Like watering grapes in the field, proper care yields the fruit of loyalty."âLegion Recruit Training Manual

11440.name: Molag Bal Illusion Imp
11440.description: Why would a mage train an imp to cast a seeming of the God of Schemes? Who knows? But this tiny Dark Father, this diminutive Prince of Pain, this undersized Lord of Lies is almost cute. Almost.

11441.name: Solstheim Shiver Wolf
11441.description: Many have met their ends at the jaws of a fully grown Solstheim wolf. This trained version, however, still has snowflakes in its fur and frolics whenever it comes across a fresh snow drift. It even gives freezing cold kisses when called.

11442.name: Strid River Fisherfolk
11442.description: "Don't mess with the fisherfolk of Strid River. They cut down pirates without remorse if bothered by them. That rugged garb they wear hides more than hooks, too. And you'll never see them coming if they don't want to be spotted."âClotylda Emard

11443.name: West Weald Tharriker
11443.description: "We subdued this one and trained it a bit. Poor beast, fresh from the Recollection grow pits. Doesn't know what it is or where it came from. Maybe it will take to you. Just mind the tail, now."âFausta Arius, Legion member

11444.name: Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf
11444.description: "The Dawnwood's new, but the forest's roots reach deep. The Ayleids were here before us, and they left their own mark on the land. We tamed this beast through the Green, but Y'ffre knows how long it's been out here." âNothelas, Bosmer priest

11445.hint: Found occasionally in delves on Telvanni Peninsula.
11445.name: Delver's Almalexia Deck Fragment
11445.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia.

11446.hint: Found occasionally after defeating World Bosses on Telvanni Peninsula.
11446.name: Slayer's Almalexia Deck Fragment
11446.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia.

11447.hint: Found occasionally after defeating Herald's Seekers in the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha zones.
11447.name: Academ's Almalexia Deck Fragment
11447.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia.

11448.hint: Found occasionally after defeating bosses inside Gorne and The Underweave public dungeons.
11448.name: Hero's Almalexia Deck Fragment
11448.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia.

11449.hint: Complete the quest "Llaro's Headache" in Apocrypha.
11449.name: Seeker's Almalexia Deck Fragment
11449.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck that tells the story of Almalexia.

11450.name: Bright Moons Dragon Imp
11450.description: "A very talented Imp, no? It cannot be denied Jone and Jode have blessed this creature with their light. Some even speak of having to hide their moon sugar from it!" âAdept Lakjo

11451.name: Mystical Quasigriff
11451.description: This beast has been touched by the deep magic, connecting to the power between the worlds. It carried a draught of creatia back with it to Nirn, glimmering with potential in every feather and bone.

11452.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Darkest Before the Dawn."
11452.name: Sharp's Handmade Fishing Lure
11452.description:
A nightwood fishing lure in the shape of a minnow, decorated with a black feather. The illusion enchantment activates with bait and water, enticing fish with writhing flashes of color.

Permanently grants the passive "Sharp's Patience" to the bearer.

11453.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "The Consummate Cohort."
11453.name: Abyssal Tea Set
11453.description:
Well-used clay vessels comprising a tea set. The kettle and a set of cups is etched with tentacles and eldritch runes. The whistle of the pot sounds like darkly whispered secrets.

Permanently grants the passive "Azandar's Inquisitiveness" to the bearer.

11454.name: Galerion's Indrik
11454.description: Gilded from head to hoof, this indrik practically glows with the light of inspiration. It may have been a fabled companion of Vanus Galerion. Whether or not the legends are true, its rider will see a world full of shimmering ideas and possibilities.

11455.name: Sunset Welwa
11455.description: "Reptilian welwa are particularly prized among the Argonians. This could be due to their perceived connection to the Hist, or simply the fact that their scales allow them to wallow in the marsh alongside their masters."âBlack Marsh Rider's Guide

11456.name: Sword-Singer's Redoubt
11456.description: Some claim the truest treasure in this former Sword-Singer stronghold glitters below ground in the form of cool, clear water. After the retreat of the Sword-Singers, enterprising merchants set up markets here for wealthy clients. Perhaps you will too?

11457.name: Brindle Bear
11457.description: "I've only seen a wild brindle bear once, and I don't wish to repeat the experience. The creature found me in the woods, bagging up a deer. It growled. I froze. But then it walked right by me. It must have already eaten."âScarius Barbatus of Kvatch

11458.name: Master-Wizard's Ram
11458.description: "Most mages prefer not to ride onto the front line of a battle. But if they must, they go prepared. The Mages Guild chooses their steeds with care, only training the most surefooted rams to carry their magisters into battle."âMagus Vacia Sidonia

11459.hint: Acquired by completing the "Scheming Skeevers" achievement.
11459.name: Maligraphic Skeever
11459.description: Leave it to a skeever to somehow wriggle free of the Infinite Archive. This Maligraphy probably poses minimal threat to the world at large. Let's just hope none of its bigger brethren learn the same trick.

11460.name: Stainedwing Butterfly
11460.description: Despite their magnificent and fragile appearance, these butterflies are quite resilient. They've been known to cling to their chosen master through thick and thin, even in the midst of battle.

11461.name: Blueblood Frog Hound Pup
11461.description: "Don't let the eyes fool you. This pup is a master manipulator. It'll have you believing it's never eaten a day in its life while there's still a frog leg hanging from its mouth. By Julianos, it's hard to resist though."âScholar Vilia Ceno

11462.name: All-Maker's Face Art
11462.description: Skaal artists scribe waved bands, signs of the All-Maker's grace, upon the brows of the worthy. The ink they use combines the All-Maker's six gifts: earth, fauna, flora, sun, water, and wind.

11463.name: All-Maker's Body Art
11463.description: "The art on my body reminds me that life flows from the All-Maker. Earth, sun, and water nurture our forests, where wolves fill the air we breathe with their nightly howls. Then life flows back to the All-Maker in an eternal cycle."âSkaal Shaman Rik

11464.name: Saarthal Shepherd
11464.description: "Any Nord can be proud with a canine like this at their side. Our ancestors tamed them ages ago. Ever since, they've been helping us watch our flocks, scare predators away, and keep unruly children from getting underfoot."âFarmer Eoeilif

11465.name: Meridia-Touched Asp
11465.description: The way it shimmers in the sunlight makes it obvious this is not an average snake. The serpent glows with an iridescent magic, which it uses to hypnotize its prey when it rears up. Even men and mer struggle to resist its mesmerizing scales.

11466.name: Solstheimstone Incarnate
11466.description: Invoke the icy fury of the frozen north with this Daedric seeming. Even the fiercest foes will freeze in their tracks when confronted with an incarnation of a Solstheim blizzard.

11468.name: Highmane's Hero Face Marks
11468.description: The Dragon King of Cats gilds his champions so their endurance and dedication may be seen by all. Those who bear this mark have borne great responsibility upon their shoulders and risen to heed the call.

11469.name: Highmane's Hero Body Marks
11469.description: "Ah, you have the strength and endurance of Alkosh at your side! This one can see it in your eyeâthe gleam of victory. Now, the Dragon King of Cats has claimed you as his own. It is an honor few can dream of." âPriest Adahni

11470.name: Orphan of the Stars
11470.description: "The night sky isn't absent of Meridia's light, lonely one. In fact, it's the place where it can be felt the most keenly, when the smallest mote of luminance stands in stark contrast to the abounding shadows."âDorathil, Hollow City mage

11471.name: Evoker on Errantry
11471.description: "Don't get me wrong, robes are wonderful. But in the field I need something more form-fitting and practical. Plus these boots are magnificent. And the detail on the buckle! Delightful!"âMage Adelle Montagne

11472.name: Statuette: Mora, Lord of Secrets
11472.description: All statues of the Inevitable Knower are, after a fashion, access points from Apocrypha to Nirn. Given that, go carefully as you invite Hermaeus Mora into your home.

11473.name: Statuette: Vivec's Triumph
11473.description: A miniature version of the "Thirty-Fourth Sermon" statue, carved by the people of Necrom.

11474.name: Painting: Sanity's Edge
11474.description: "As you can see by my attached references, I am one of the foremost experts in vicinage wards, forfending spells, and the art of research. If anyone can deal with the Dreamstone's ire, it is me. I hope you come to the same conclusion."âWarlock Vanton

11476.name: Boneshaped Handpan
11476.description: Set the tempo for a proper celebration in the Green with this handpan crafted from bone. While the source of the bone may vary, all such instruments resonate similarly, allowing drummers to transition in and out of day-long performances smoothly.

11477.name: Skaal Maul Dance
11477.description: While training, Skaal warriors learn dances with their weapons of choice. Those who focus on the maul perform the dance together on the fifth day of Last Seed to celebrate a maul warrior's victory over the Corrupt Man, a pawn of the Adversary.

11480.name: Summoned Booknado
11480.description: The pages of the Book of the Aggrieved resist being readâto the point where they often flutter into the air and threaten handlers with innumerable paper cuts as they swirl in a booknado!
11480.hint: Acquired by completing the "Infinitely Versed" achievement.

11481.name: Tentacular Tome
11481.description: "If a book sprouts tentacles and flies off, take that as a sign to find another book to read. And if it's required reading for your education, well, it's fine to say a tomeshell ate your studies. Won't be the first time."âTinos Guls, Student

11482.name: Skingrad Noble Snack
11482.description: Discerning tasteâyou possess it. Especially when it comes to grapes. Table grapes. Wine grapes. All grapesâbut most of all Skingrad's grapes. Come, enjoy a snack!

11483.name: Necrom Attire Hood
11483.description: "Evening funerary ceremonies require a certain amount of sophistication along with the expected decorum. You can't go wrong with this hood, which pairs exquisitely with the Necrom evening gown I commissioned for House Redoran."âSelar Ralvas of Necrom

11484.name: Warlock's Veil
11484.description: While the missing moon makes its presence known, mages gather materials to craft these veils. A solemn ceremony under the light of the Ritual constellation affixes the enchantment that allows the wearer to see while the veil covers their eyes.

11485.name: Eyevea Evoker's Flair
11485.description: "Each piece of this ornate head jewelry represents a trial that I passed to gain the title of Evoker. You may not see Eyevea-trained evokers like me wearing these every day. But for formal occasions? Just the thing."âEvoker Triann

11486.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with a Arena Gladiator's Retribution, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.
11486.name: Unfeathered Battle Visage
11486.description: "The confrontation between the Star-Made Knight and Umaril the Unfeathered will fade into memory unless we keep it alive. Pelinal freed many from oppression. I hope, by inking my face, to invite conversations about this topic."âLucius the Earnest

11487.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with a Arena Gladiator's Retribution, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.
11487.name: Unfeathered Battle Tattoo
11487.description: Some scholars aren't satisfied by simply retelling the story of the epic battle between Pelinal Whitestrake and Umaril the Unfeathered. These invested few prefer to share their knowledge via illustrations inked upon their own bodies!

11488.name: Solstheim Earrings
11488.description: Skaal tales suggest the symbols on these earrings were already on trees and rocks discovered when the first Nords came to Solstheim. The All-Maker moves in mysterious, and sometimes fashionable, ways.

11489.name: Knower's Eye Hairpin
11489.description: Keep your hair, fur, or feathers untangled and well-coiffed! All with a distinctive hairpin bearing the visage of Hermaeus Mora. While it may not utter dark secrets into your ear, its glint may attract someone who can share intriguing mysteries with you.

11490.name: Skaal's Brow Band
11490.description: "You never walk alone under the All-Maker's gaze. The fur and leather in this band are a reminder that all are One. Meanwhile its gentle pressure on your head can keep you grounded to unbroken earth."âSkaal Shaman Rik

11491.name: Ayleid Ruins Wildgrowth
11491.description: Potent magic lies buried in the roots of the Dawnwood. Ancient Ayleid ruins have been touched by the Green. Verdant, wild, and uncontainable, some resist the pernicious growth. Others embrace this fertile power.

11492.name: Soul Harvester Earrings
11492.description: Much like successful merchants who save the first coin they earned, those who master the use of soul gems creatively showcase their practice morpholiths. Eldil Helothren first made wearing them as earrings fashionable among Necrom mages.

11493.name: Windcaller Face Markings
11493.description: "May the skies smile upon you, caller of the winds. We recognize the delicate mark of your office upon your face and know the path you chose to walk with your creature companion holds darkness and great deeds. Let us help?"âNona the Wise of Solstheim

11494.name: Windcaller Body Markings
11494.description: The flowing body art of a Solstheim windcaller brings to mind the breezes and gusts of air that accompany them as they travel. Some claim the marks depict their story of self-discovery while walking the path the All-Maker set before them.

11495.name: Thief Starskin
11495.description: When the Thief constellation shines brightest, bandits, assassins, and all who favor stealth and shadow breathe a little easier. Some hope for this protection every day, invoking the Thief's blessing on their skin.

11496.name: Windcaller's Circlet
11496.description: Blessed stalhrim nestles protectively between wolf embellishments in this arresting circlet. Those who call upon the winds and train wolf guardians to serve the Skaal proudly wear this piece.

11497.name: Planemeld's Master Body Art
11497.description: The chains of Coldharbour are symbols of fear and oppression. What does it say about those who would ink the dark anchors of Molag Bal upon their skin?

11498.name: Planemeld's Master Face Art
11498.description: Reverence for the Lord of Lies prompts some to adorn their temples with the horns of Bal. Terrifying in their simplicity, they should deter assailants. But some swear they can see the Lord of Schemes himself staring back from within.

11499.name: Tome of Forbidden Appetites
11499.description: Ask not what's for dinner, for it may be your face! Especially if the piquantly profane Tome of Forbidden Appetites has anything to say about it.

11500.name: Necrom Prelate Robes
11500.description: After learning all the ceremonies and practices of the Keepers of the Dead in Necrom, some of their number take on the role and robes of the prelate. These worthies spend most of their hours in the Necropolis, maintaining its sanctity and traditions.

11501.name: Shivering Isles Anointment
11501.description: Butterflies. Glowing pink eyes. The Shivering Isles calls to you. Will you fight the call or bend the knee to the Mad God?

11502.name: Silver-Limned Guar Charger
11502.description: "My marshmates don't understand why I chose this beast. They say it is territorial and snappy. You just have to read the signs. Like right now. Its tail is twitching. You should move your hand if you like your fingers."âSkeeheieeus of Stormhold

11503.name: Aether-Tempered Mystic
11503.description: "There are many wonders in this world, and many mysteries, too. One can never hope to unravel them all. Those who peer too deeply are likely to find themselves changed by the journey."âMage Gwenieth

11504.name: Bruma Spotted Pig
11504.description: "Absolutely not. We can't keep it! Pigs are livestock, nothing more. Don't give me that look. All right, I'll admit it's very cute. And soft. Still, though, we can't keep it. We'll find it a good home."âOverheard in Bruma

11505.name: Ruby Haj Mota
11505.description: The eye-catching hue of this haj mota may be beautiful, but it belies a fiery demeanor. Haj motas are known for their harsh temperaments, but this one is not to be trifled with. Thankfully, it's too small to do more than snap at ankles.

11506.name: Sugarsnow Monkey
11506.description: "Watch your moon sugar around these ones. They have keen eyes and clever hands. This one has lost her lunch to Zuzdu more times than she can count. Still, they can be quite sweet when they want to be. Probably from all the stolen sugar."âTahara

11507.name: Emerald Oak Nixad
11507.description: "Emerald Oak Nixads are known for their mischief. Their coloration allows them to hide in forests, waiting for unsuspecting travelers to pass by. Upon leaving, travelers will find their rations much lighter, especially sweets."âGold Coast Field Guide

11508.name: Sword-Singer's Tufted Camel
11508.description: "HoonDing knows they don't look fast. But that's actually a good thing. No one will expect you to cover as much ground as you do. And there is truly nothing more terrifying than a camel charging you at full speed."âBilami the Caravaneer

11509.name: Blessed Honeycomb
11509.description:
Gently harvested from apiaries on the grounds of Dibellan monasteries by the hands of serene priests.

A component required for the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount.

11510.name: Gilded and Dyed Saddle
11510.description:
A specially-crafted saddle made of oiled leather and plated metal fixtures, sized for an enormous mount.

A component required for the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount.

11511.name: Sorcerous Golden Ink
11511.description:
A bottle of magical golden ink used to dyeing fur or skin into magical patterns.

A component required for the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount.

11513.name: Destruction Dale Fawn
11513.description: Though alarming at first glance, this fawn is perfectly content with its strangely blazing body. Those who can tame this extreme example of mystical adaptation will find its back an excellent medium for cooking over an open flame.

11514.name: Conjured Dragon Imp
11514.description: This impressive vision is the work of a very dedicated illusion imp. The shimmering form sparks the adoration of all who see it, making for easy handouts and safe havens for this tiny so-called Dragon.

11515.name: Prismatic Senche Cub
11515.description: "This cub is special, yes. Beautiful and quite friendly. Not the softest companion, but others have said the same about me."âScholar Zansora

11516.name: Anchorwright Raiment
11516.description: The makers of Molag Bal's Dark Anchors possess specialized skills in that art. To protect their forms while working, they developed their own protective gear embellished by chains. The intimidating mask also disguises their identity.

11517.name: Sisei Flowering Dress
11517.description: Early in the year, Argonians don colorful garments and invite Blackwood visitors to do the same. Will you join them in their celebration of this season of growth, romance, and renewal?

11518.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Sanity's Edge.
11518.name: Bust: Ansuul the Tormentor
11518.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Sanity's Edge.

11519.name: Trophy: Ansuul the Tormentor
11519.description: Trophy taken from Ansuul the Tormentor in honor of an Undaunted victory in Sanity's Edge.

11520.name: Altered Ornaug
11520.description: This beast is the result of a collaboration between Shad Astula students and Mages Guild apprentices. Rumor is it may be slightly psychic, responding to its rider's commands almost before they're uttered aloud. The color is a nice bonus, too.

11522.name: Atmoran Snow Ursauk
11522.description: Though fearsome in appearance, these ursauks make staunch companions when properly socialized. Their thick fur and hardy constitutions allow them to thrive even in the harshest environments, especially those in the northern reaches of Tamriel.

11523.name: Celestial Lynx
11523.description: Swift as a stream and silent as a shadow, this creature appears in many folktales across Tamriel. In some, the lynx stalks its quarry across the night sky. In others it's an agile companion, perfect for worthy hunters prowling the darkest nights.

11525.name: Kelesan'ruhn
11525.description: Designed by a mycoturge for a now-missing arcanist, this Telvanni-style residence showcases gorgeous views. Both magical and mundane access to a sizable workshop and a cozy living space allow for uninterrupted research and rejuvenating rest, respectively.

11526.name: Coldfire Recall
11526.description: "The cold-flames speak to me. Will the flames speak to you, too, calling you to a master? Or perhaps you are a masterâof bones? No matter. Go where your path leads, as I do. Perhaps we'll meet next in Coldharbour?"âYmirra, Master of Bone and Scythe

11527.name: Recall of the Crusader
11527.description: Let the fire of righteousness kindle within your heart. Let that flame carry you to your next worthy endeavor.

11528.name: Armiger Axing
11528.description: Use an edge sharpened to exacting Buoyant Armiger standards when chopping your next log. After all, you would not wish to disappoint Lord Vivec, would you?

11529.name: Bound Pickaxe Strike
11529.description: "Why demean myself just because I need samples for an experiment? Minerals are so â¦ filthy. Better to let a bit of mystic ephemera do the heavy lifting."âAnendir the Enchanter

11530.name: Chorrol Retriever
11530.description: These playful golden canines happily accompany their people on journeys near and far, making friends with anyone they meet along the way. The downside to this endearing show of trust is, of course, that they're not the best guard dogs.

11531.name: Sai-Sahan's Revelry Ursine
11531.description: "Ah, this is a beast worthy of a hero! Don't worry, faithful Minana here has seen her share of battles and more than earned the armor she now wears. She will be a staunch companion to you, no matter where HoonDing bids you."âDragonguard Zarina

11532.name: Varen's Revelry Courser
11532.description: A steed worthy of an emperor, this courser represents the finest traits of Imperial equestrian skill. Steady and strong with an incredibly smooth gait, this mount could help its rider fell countless kingdoms.

11533.name: Titanborn's Revelry Wolf
11533.description: Said to have been tamed by Lyris Titanborn herself, this fierce wolf easily bears its rider across nearly any terrain. While the beast is a frenzied fighter on the battlefield, one word from its rider will have it waiting docilely for the next command.

11534.hint: Awarded by completing the "Prisoner of Fate" quest.
11534.name: Mirrormoor Mudcrab
11534.description: "These mudcrabs developed their shine as both a defensive tactic and mating ritual. By angling their bodies, they can reflect blinding rays at would-be predators or signal their availability to potential mates."âMirrormoor: More Than an Illusion

11535.hint: Acquired by completing the "Jubilee Confetti Conveyor" achievement.
11535.name: Jubilee Steed
11535.description: "The Imperials do love their regalia, don't they? Even I have to admit it's a rather dashing look, for a horse. Anyone who comes in astride that steed is certain to make an entrance."âAbelle Gernand of Kvatch

11536.hint: |cFFFFFFDaedric Anchor effects appear only when paired with the Molag Bal Illusion polymorph.|r
11536.name: Shackled Titan
11536.description: "This titan failed the Dark Lord once, and paid the price for it. After he ripped off its wings, Molag Bal bound it to his dark will, making it a usefulâif groundedâmount for his more faithful servants."âWorm Cultist Valoel

11537.name: Piebald Camel
11537.description: "It appears Sabhir has earned your admiration. This is not the first time his stunning spots have stolen hearts. Shh, don't let him see you looking. He has enough of an ego as it is."âStablehand Ghazaleh

11538.name: Storm Atronach
11538.description: With lightning in your blood and thunder in your heart, the mere appearance of a storm atronach sunders enemy lines. Take charge of the battle with this polymorph, and see why so many fear the oncoming storm.

11539.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Necrom Armiger style.

11550.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Necrom Armiger style.

11551.name: Mystic Magicka Molt
11551.description: Harnessing the power of magicka is an artâone that requires care. This source can be quite volatile at times, leaving arcane energy crackling just below the skin of the unwary user. Anyone can become a conduit if they are not careful.

11552.name: Guild Conjured Wisp
11552.description: "Look, it may not have much personality, but it's entrancing, in its own way. It's happy to see you, I think. The students at the Mages Guild were very proud of this conjuration. The least you can do is act impressed."âMage Student Hrantin

11558.name: Frostfall Recall
11558.description: You hoped that aetheric scroll would let you recall faster. Instead this mysticism's gone frostily awry. Pack some warm clothes.

11559.name: Icefist Runegathering
11559.description: Punching things with an icy fist may not solve every problem out there, but you've figured out a way to gather runestones that takes advantage of this technique. Smashing!

11560.name: Personal Plant Thief
11560.description: In seconds, this well-trained prairie dog can pilfer flora you need for your crafting. Be careful, this charming little rogue might steal your heart!

11561.name: Heiruna
11561.description: Oh, the ignominy of being an agent of justice trapped inside a small floating doll! Now Heiruna intends to plot vengeanceâin your retreat. After adding Heiruna to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

11562.name: Mizzik Thunderboots
11562.description: With no mysteries for this Khajiit of action to solve, he's at loose ends. Perhaps he can discover some curious doings around your abode? After adding Mizzik to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

11563.name: Skordo the Knife
11563.description: This Orc mercenary usually keeps busy, but now he wants some actual quiet time. Not to reflect, thoughâhis well-used gear needs some attention. After adding Skordo to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

11564.name: Hermaeus Mora
11564.description: A Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Hermaeus Mora, the Inevitable Knower.
11564.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Pact with the Inevitable Knower."

11565.name: Cumberland Cavalier Cuirass
11565.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Cumberland Cavalier style.

11579.name: Eyes of the Prophet
11579.description: "Weep, my child, for you have been blessed with a great and terrible gift. You alone know what is to come. Many are the seers whose words fall on deaf ears, only for calamity to strike. Pray for the present, and grieve for tomorrow." âWise Woman Asani

11580.name: Vortex Body Veil
11580.description: "A tip: don't leap into every portal you come across. A memorable excursion saw me stepping from one into the middle of the Nibenay Bay. I was drying the pages of my tome for weeks after."âAzandar al-Cybiades

11638.name: Vinedusk Assassin Sash
11638.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Vinedusk Assassin style.

11639.name: Statuette: Telvanni Magister
11639.description: A miniature statue of a Telvanni Mage, carved to venerate a Magister long past but not forgotten.

11640.name: Painting: The Endless Library
11640.description: A painting depicting just one of the innumerable studies within the Endless Library of Hermaeus Mora.

11641.name: Tharn's Lucent Revelry Senche
11641.description: "Trust the Tharns to find a way to make a senche even more regal than it already was. I feel underdressed. Do you think it outranks me?"âLegionary Liodes Salvius

11642.name: Worm Cultist Senche-Raht
11642.description: Legend says that Mannimarco himself indoctrinated this Senche-raht to the way of the Anchorite. It's unknown if Zalzagh knows whether this is true, or if they have any recollection of life before joining the Worm Cult.

11643.name: Seaghost Pillion Moose
11643.description: "I've always preferred moose to elk or horses. In battle they're more reliable, they're cussed strong, and for overland travel they can't be beat. Plus, their noses are just so soft!" âYvon Serielle, Daggerfall

11644.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.
11644.name: Ashbone Sabre Cat
11644.description: "Yes, this one will do nicely. As vengeful and accursed as my master. It bears the mark of Malacath wellâour enemies will cower before us! May it lap the blood of its prey on the broken path we ride."âOgmash the Mighty

11645.name: Ashbone Echalette
11645.description: Even at this small size, this echalette is rather vicious. It's not afraid to use its tiny tusks to ram perceived threats, other echalettes, or really anything that moves. It's not a very effective tactic, but it is strangely cute.

11646.name: Goldcrest Ancestor Lizard
11646.description: "Look at the scales on this one! I did not know Useful Lizards could be so beautiful. Perhaps that is its use? Spreading beauty throughout the marsh? I will wallow with it and see if the Hist grant any more insight."âThinks-too-Much, Stormhold

11647.name: Ashen Scar Fellrunner
11647.description: Prized for their striking plumage, Ashen Scar fellrunners are also highly intelligent. They bond quickly with their caretakers but are known to be quite ornery when stared at for too long. It's best to avoid eye contact when possible.

11648.name: Alavelis Ringed Guar
11648.description: Less fearsome than they look, the native guar of Alavelis have developed peculiar markings. Some believe they are a mimicry of the poisonous beasts of the Telvanni Peninsula, though the guar themselves have no such defense.

11650.name: Oathsworn Pit
11650.description: Help Bazrag bestow Malacath's legendary revenge on the Wood Elves who sought to slaughter the Oathsworn in their ancestral training grounds.

11651.name: Bedlam Veil
11651.description: When the Blind Path invades Bedlam Veil, Fa-Nuit-Hen calls on brave warriors to repel the invasion and discover what the cultists so desperately seek.

11652.name: Thorn Gecko
11652.description: "He's not the cuddliest pet, sure, but old Spike here is as loyal as they come. I just throw him some grubs every now and then, and he follows me anywhere I go. I like to think he likes the company and not just the snacks."âTrapper Marcien

11655.name: Gladesong Arboretum
11655.description: The soothing sound of a waterfall accompanies the wind as it sings softly through the majestic trees in this druidic settlement. Carved stone shelters provide comfortable living spaces and open onto inspiring vistas.

11656.name: Pyrodraconic Camel-Lizard
11656.description: "Of course it's not a real Dragon. That's beside the point. Intense hue recoloration, brimstone expectoration, and a fusion of Wood Elf and Telvanni magical techniques? Tell Otheri the contract is fulfilled, and more."âMagister Varkenel

11657.name: Mistral Thunderbug
11657.description: Owners of this electrifying little friend must learn to handle the occasional shock from time to time. Thunderbugs are quite expressive, though their main form of communication is through sparks and sharp jolts.

11658.hint: Acquired by completing the "Replicable Results" achievement.
11658.name: Mirrorscribe Face Markings
11658.description: "Those who seek the truth must learn to bear its scars. What was constrained to ink and parchment may shatter the mind when brought forth from the shelf. All writing inevitably links author and reader, for all time, for good or ill." âCipher Ascien

11659.hint: Acquired by completing the "Infinite Archive Challenger" achievement.
11659.name: Mirrorscribe Body Markings
11659.description: Every choice has a consequence. Like revelatory words emblazoned on a page, the truth begs to burst forth once it's uncovered. Some who know these deeper secrets carry signs of their forbidden knowledge, inside and out.

11660.name: Magicka Everlasting Face Marks
11660.description: Apprentices in the Mages Guild bond over stories of the day they fully understood the concept of "everlasting magic." Some go so far as to have a distinctive sigil with a background pattern tattooed on their faces.

11661.name: Magicka Everlasting Body Marks
11661.description: "As a member of the Mages Guild, you learn techniques that help you channel magicka more efficiently. That experience changed my life. Now I have the unbound flow depicted on my body so that I'm reminded of that joy each time I trace the marks."âFairwen

11662.name: Plumed Cavalier
11662.description: "You envy my hat, do you? The plume! So sleek! Plucked from a fellrunner named Hasty Hastir before it could haste away. The brim adds intrigue and romance, perfect for one's day off. Don't you agree?"âAkkhiri

11663.name: Mages Guild Sigil Makeup
11663.description: Inspired by the Mages Guild, these markings use ingredients mixed into ink by an alchemical master. An illusion-working around the eyes finishes this mystical effect.

11664.name: Midnight Rising Makeup
11664.description: "The midnight sky knows me. Its stars and moons lend meaning to my life. The tenebrous interstices reflect nothing back at me. So, any significance I give to it is both true and false. Does that answer your question about my facial art?"âRendorien

11686.hint: |cFFFFFFDaedric Anchor effects appear only when paired with the Shackled Titan mount.|r
11686.name: Molag Bal Illusion
11686.description: Assume the fearsome visage of the Prince of Schemes. Ride to war atop the Shackled Titan to terrify your enemies. The battlefield is yours to dominate!

11687.name: Tower of Unutterable Truths
11687.description: Only Hermaeus Mora knows why the previous curator fled this towering edifice filled with proscribed enigmata. Now the One Who Knows seeks a new cataloger who enjoys the panoptic views of Apocrypha and never, ever opens the books secured within.

11689.name: Vampiric Soulrazer Knight
11689.description: The Soulrazer Knights of High Isle were intimidating enough on their ownâbefore a vampire twisted that power to suit their needs. Now, you too can burn with a glorious, bloody purpose.

11690.name: Queen Ayrenn's Diamond Gown
11690.description: Don this gown, and feel the sense of grace that washes over you. Skillfully tailored with the finest silks money can buy, and adorned with diamonds and a woven belt, this stunning gown could truly only have been made for an Elf queen.

11691.name: Companion Revelry Tomeshell
11691.description: "Look, I know tomeshells need a place to live too, but that's one of the rarest volumes in the archive! Sure, it looks flashy now, but Mora knows what state the book will be in whenever this one decides to move on."âCipher Caldaafin

11692.name: Winterhold Chestnut Pony
11692.description: Every child in Winterhold asks for one of these ponies at some point, and a very lucky few will receive one. Their small stature is perfect for young riders, and even older adults cherish them as cheerful and hardy pets.

11693.name: Mead-Dancer Honeybee
11693.description: "Bees are simple, really. They respect power. That's why they follow a queen. Just act like you're supposed to be in charge and they'll work for you. Show any weakness, any hesitation? That's when you get stung."âHei Honey-Hands

11863.hint: Awarded for defeating the final form of Tho'at Replicanum in the Infinite Archive.
11863.name: Bust: Tho'at Replicanum
11863.description: Bronze bust commemorating completing Arc 4 in the Infinite Archive.

11864.hint: Awarded for defeating the Tho'at Replicanum in the Infinite Archive.
11864.name: Trophy: Tho'at Replicanum
11864.description: Trophy taken from Tho'at Replicanum in honor of completing Arc 1 in the Infinite Archive.

11865.hint: Purchased from Filer Tezurs in the Infinite Archive.
11865.name: Filer Kor's Truesight
11865.description: To recognize your efforts within the Infinite Archive, Filer Kor grants you access to a third Vision choice.

11866.hint: Purchased from Filer Tezurs in the Infinite Archive.
11866.name: Aramril's Training
11866.description: Thanks to Aramril's training, the strength of your Visions improves.

11867.hint: Purchased from Filer Tezurs in the Infinite Archive.
11867.name: Tentacular Motivation
11867.description: Hard-earned knowledge, along with a bit of motivation of the tentacular kind, grants you faster movement throughout the Infinite Archive.

11868.hint: Purchased from Filer Tezurs in the Infinite Archive.
11868.name: Sweeter Deal
11868.description: Some experiences are their own reward. That said, who would pass up unlocking a third Verse choice?

11869.hint: Purchased from Filer Tezurs in the Infinite Archive.
11869.name: Ghostly Gratitude
11869.description: Benevolent spirits indebted to you improve the strength of your Verses.

11870.hint: Purchased from Filer Tezurs in the Infinite Archive.
11870.name: Destozuno's Safety Net
11870.description:
Even those who prefer to live dangerously may enjoy gaining 1 additional Thread of Fate. More Threads mean more danger, after all! 

The additional Thread will not attach immediately. It will be present during your next foray into the Infinite Archive.

11871.name: Gold Road
11871.description: A forgotten Daedric Prince has returned! Explore West Weald, a new zone in chaos, and defend the Colovian city of Skingrad, now beset by a dangerous new cult, Daedric invasions, and the encroaching wilds of neighboring Valenwood.

11872.name: Titanborn's Tresses
11872.description: Many have taken inspiration from the heroics of Lyris Titanborn. From her armor and skill on the battlefield, to the way she wears her hair, many across Tamriel strive to emulate her likeness in any way they can.

11873.name: Sandsquall Durzog
11873.description: The adaptable durzogs that roam Tamriel's deserts have thick skin to protect from abrasive sands and feathers on their neck and back to help with cooling. Their sandy coloring and decreased need for water make them efficient predators in the dunes.

11874.name: Grudge-Rock Welwa
11874.description: These petulant welwas hail from Wrothgar and more than live up to their name. Hardened by their difficult landscape, the creatures delight in punishing their riders for the smallest slight, whether it's a late feeding or a slightly too-tight saddle.

11875.name: Master of Schemes
11875.description: Look at these fools, plotting your downfall. Luckily you've already put plans into motion. Plans within plansâenough to impress even Molag Bal! But these buffoons don't understand the artistry of your endeavors. Perhaps you should enlighten them.

11876.name: Drinweth, Valenwood Armorer
11876.description: You and your groupmates can tend to the grove of your mind by summoning Drinweth, who will allow you to change and save builds outside of your home. A challenging past with various martial forces means she won't aid you in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

11877.name: Tzozabrar, Dwarven Deconstructor
11877.description:
Tzozabrar will intake items you don't need, expelling useful materials no doubt scavenged from a Dwarven construct. Tonal interference makes it unusable in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.

After it's summoned, you and your groupmates can use its services.

11878.name: Strid River Crab
11878.description: Often found crawling up the banks of the Strid River, these crabs have recently made their way upstream into West Weald. While they taste delicious, many collectors prefer to keep them as pets thanks to their dazzling color.

11879.name: Cream and Coffee Sheep
11879.description: Rarer than their alabaster cousins in High Rock, these spotted sheep are beloved for their gentle demeanors and extra soft wool. Many inexperienced farmers can't resist their sweet faces, and these sheep have been known to grow fat on extra treats.

11880.name: Anchorborn Welwa
11880.description: Born in the blasted wastes of Coldharbour, Molag Bal's ferocious welwa pursue their prey with terrifying tenacity. It is said that only the chains of the Dark Anchors themselves can hold the beasts back once they've scented their quarry.

11881.name: Meownimarco
11881.description: This feline fixes you with a gaze that seems to say, "Your attempts to pet me are presumptuous! Do you think mice can stop the most powerful catromancer Tamriel has ever known? This form is my first step toward immortality! Witness my true kitty power!"

11882.name: Twilight Bantam Guar
11882.description: This bantam guar's coloring provides camouflage. This is both a blessing and a curse, as it has a habit of wandering off if left unattended. With a trusting attitude, few natural defenses, and no innate survival instincts â¦ don't leave it unattended.

11883.name: Aristocratic Astrologer Face Art
11883.description: "I asked the artist who will ink my face to use some aetherial dust in the ink when she mixes it. So, not only will a tasteful flourish enhance my visage, but a bit of wonder will forever be a part of me. I cannot wait."âGrandee Husni

11884.name: Aristocratic Astrologer Body Art
11884.description: Nobles drawn to the study of stars may choose to have this passion etched on their skin using ink containing aetherial materials. These markings in particular not only showcase stars but frame them with decorous symbols.

11886.hint: Acquired by completing the "Adventurer Across a Decade" achievement.
11886.name: Fractured Glory
11886.description: Sometimes the most beautiful things are those which have shattered and been pieced back together. Bear your cracks proudlyâthey are the hard-won trophies of all the things that could not break you.

11887.name: Nightmare Pillion Courser
11887.description: "Beware lone roads and moonless nights. Beware the haunted hooves. Beware the burning-coal eyes and the fiery trail that follows each dogged step. Most of all, beware of the path of the steed's terrible riders."âFolk Legends of Tamriel

11888.name: King Emeric's Diamond Regalia
11888.description: Originally designed for High King Emeric himself, this outfit features high-quality silks and fabrics, granting the wearer a chance to pass like a king through the streets of Wayrest.

11889.name: Prince Irnskar's Gala Regalia
11889.description: Prince Irnskar's outfit radiates the loyalty and courage befitting the Nords. Though perhaps not what one might traditionally wear to a gala, rumor has it the prince himself hunted the beasts to make his cowl.

11890.name: Boralis Wolf Pelt
11890.description: "Be wary of spending too long in the wild, traveler. It may be freeing to give in to your more feral instincts in the moment, but too long away from civilization may reveal truths that were better left unspoken."âWidow Granger, Northsalt Village

11891.name: Sotha Sil Novelty Mask
11891.description: The Father of Mysteries is known for his striking mask, which represents a union of the organic and inorganic. Followers don this mask as they unravel his esoteric teachings, while travelers to Vvardenfell don it for complex jokes after visiting a tavern.

11892.name: Skin of the Anchorite
11892.description: The followers of Molag Bal give themselves over to the Prince's will. For most, this means forfeiting their souls. For others, their sacrifice burns them from the inside out.

11893.name: Anchor Chain Fragment
11893.description:
A piece of broken chain of cold, black iron used by the legions of Molag Bal during the Planemeld.

The first of three components required to create the Molag Bal Illusion Imp.

11894.name: Dark Anchor Pinion
11894.description:
A miniature replica of an Anchor Pinion used by the forces of Molag Bal during the Planemeld.

The second of three components required to create the Molag Bal Illusion Imp.

11895.name: Effigy of the Dominator
11895.description:
A frightening effigy of Molag Bal. Its burning eyes bore into you hungrily. Is he watching you even now?

The third of three components required to create the Molag Bal Illusion Imp.

11896.name: Crematory Ash
11896.description:
An urn of cold ashes pilfered from Coldharbour and magically sealed to prevent the escape of any detritus â or wailing ghosts.

A component required for the Planemeld's Master markings.

11897.name: Incandescent Brimstone
11897.description:
Blazing with cold-fire, it is unclear whether the source of this stone is Coldharbour's blighted substrata or the remains of some Daedric creature.

A component required for the Planemeld's Master markings.

11898.name: Seething Censer
11898.description:
Anything placed within this black iron censer is "burnt" to ash in cold-fire, dissolved by a frigidity so unnatural that it is akin to a furnace.

A component required for the Planemeld's Master markings.

11900.name: Malkhest's Accursed Mirror
11900.description: No amount of time spent in the Infinite Archive can prepare you for that moment when you pick up an everyday item and suddenly change into a murder-glass monstrosity!
11900.hint: Acquired by completing the "Attentive Eye" achievement.

11901.name: Ulfsild's Tome of Legends
11901.description: Archmage Ulfsild penned many tomes as she researched the origins of magic. One such, the Tome of Legends, may delight you with its accompanying illusions. Care to know more? Crack open the tome!

11902.name: Butcher Haefal's Accursed Knife
11902.description: This knife is the greatest of all time! Sharp, well-balanced, keeps its edge, changes you into a goat. And around here, nobody notices extra goats.
11902.hint: Acquired by completing the "Leading the Charge" achievement.

11903.name: Clap Hands
11903.description: Inspired by the music you hear? Clap your hands in time with the beat to show your appreciation!

11904.name: Pyromancer's Quandary
11904.description: "Ever played with magical fire? I mean, really played with it? Not just your standard yellow-orange flames. We're talking colors. But which colors? So many choices. Even I can't decide sometimes."âThagbrugug, Budding Pyromancer

11905.name: Make Cheese
11905.description: You've mastered the art of making fine cheeses. Show off your enviable skills by using the cheese press!

11906.name: Stomp Grapes
11906.description: After growing the appropriate grapes and harvesting them, vineyard workers must crush them and collect the resulting juice. Why not join these blessed folk in making glorious wine!

11907.name: Sommelier Swirl
11907.description: Is your wine too cloudy? Has it gone bad? Give it a swirl and see!

11910.name: Arcanist's Crest
11910.description: An uncomplicated style to keep you looking good whether you're searching the stacks of Apocrypha or delving for esoteric knowledge in the depths of a dungeon. Wear it with pride, Arcanist.

11911.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Laureate, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.
11911.name: Unkindness of Ravens Body Art
11911.description: "Let me straighten something out: I love ravens, and my tattoos reflect that. They do not mean I'm a cultist of Nocturnal. Would a cultist say this? Maybe. But I see envy in your eyes. You should get stunning body art like this, too!"âEttiene Fronc

11912.hint: Acquired by completing the "Scions of Ithelia Delver" achievement.
11912.name: Bloodmarks of Malacath
11912.description: Malacath demands utter devotion from his followers. Only the most ardent are rewarded with the chance to bloody their skin in his honor. The scars and wounds are a sign of one's worthiness.

11913.name: Sheogorat Face Branding
11913.description: Not all who visit Cheesemonger's Hollow return the same. Sometimes those who escape remember nothing of the experience and must forever puzzle over how these cheese and butterfly tattoos showed up on their faces.

11914.name: Sheogorat Body Branding
11914.description: "I'm the rat. Sheogorath's rat. Sheogorat. I live amid the cheese. So much cheese. I have rats on me, too. In me. You can't have them. Get your own. Not even the butterflies can have my cheese. They want it, though."âColmarion, also known as Sheogorat

11915.hint: Acquired by completing the "Prepared Foresight" achievement.
11915.name: Archival Access Body Tattoos

11924.name: Keshu the Black Fin
11924.description: War hero and governor of Gideon, Keshu seeks to better the Saxhleel people while searching for peace and good companionship for a time. After adding Keshu to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

11925.name: Kor
11925.description: Hunter, Dark Brotherhood assassin, big brotherâKor is all this and more. Invite him into your abode, and he'll share observations about his life. After adding Kor to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

11926.name: Hildegard
11926.description: When this fledgling Dark Brotherhood assassin isn't using her werewolf abilities to complete contracts, she reflects on her dual nature. After adding Hildegard to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

11959.name: Dark Brotherhood Crew Steed
11959.description: The steeds of the Dark Brotherhood are conditioned to run blindly ahead in the darkness, fully trusting their riders. When the situation demands it, the horses will even run with multiple riders clinging to them on all sides, never flinching or faltering.

11960.name: Dark Brotherhood Sabre Cat
11960.description: Few creatures are more apt mounts for the Dark Brotherhood than sabre cats. Light on their feet, agile, and with a hunting instinct to match their rider's, many Dark Brotherhood members believe a sabre cat mount is a gift from Sithis himself.

11961.name: Dark Brotherhood Kagouti
11961.description: "Sithis teaches silence, yes, but stealth is not always the most important thing when you have enough speed and power on your side. That's why I choose to ride a kagouti. I find their ferocity more than makes up for the noise."âDark Brother Bols Uveleth

11962.name: Dark Brotherhood Durzog
11962.description: Unlike other durzogs, which can become vocal when they sense their prey is near, those trained by the Dark Brotherhood have been bred for speed and silence.

12058.name: Statuette: Malacath, Furious One
12058.description: "Hold your grudges well. Keep them close to your heart. Let them punctuate every blow you make as you fulfill upon your promise of vengeance. And display this statue in your dwelling so that all may know the cost of crossing you."âLucky Lashgikh

12059.name: Statuette: Imperial Warrior
12059.description: Discipline and resolution. Protection and honor. These traits and more embody the spirit of the Imperial warrior. Display these noble qualities in this artful statuette!

12060.name: Painting: Infinite Archive
12060.description: "Those whom Hermaeus Mora calls to the Infinite Archive may serve himâor may choose to leave. But who, upon understanding the limitless knowledge they may access, dares refuse the Lord of Secrets without feeling bereft forever after?"âMage Allierwen

12061.name: Vivec's Promise Butterfly
12061.description: Like the Warrior-Poet himself, this striking butterfly is bisected by two distinct color palettes. The Tribunal's faithful consider it a good omen to see one of these creatures, and a blessing from Lord Vivec himself if one chooses to follow you.

12062.name: Majestic Alpine Cat
12062.description: These cats of Skyrim are used to harsh conditions with little respite. As a result, they're quite hardy, known for their large size and thick, gorgeous fur. They're prized by local villages for their mousing abilities and teeth-rattling purrs.

12172.name: Tanlorin
12172.description: Brash, energetic, and covered in magical tattoos, Tanlorin hopes to make High Elf society better for outcasts like them. One toppled warmonger at a time. Call this companion to your side and root out corruption across the provinces of Tamriel.

12173.hint: Obtained by completing the quest "A Moonlit Shadow."
12173.name: Zerith-var
12173.description: The world has changed much since his day. Zerith-var, necromancer of the Order of the Hidden Moon, knows he has been sent to this time for a reason. Call your tamiit to your side to seek Azurah's twilight path together.

12227.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "A Bloom on the Horizon."
12227.name: Garland Ring Humming Pick
12227.description:
A delicate clockwork gadget fashioned from second-hand materials and made to look like a hummingbird. Its long, thin copper tongue makes short work of even the toughest locks.

Permanently grants the passive "Tanlorin's Finesse" to the bearer.

12228.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "The Twilight Path."
12228.name: Ja'kh's Bell of Bounty
12228.description:
A walnut-sized bell ornately carved from jade. Detailed with electrum bezels and embossing, it once heralded the presence of a mischievous and much-loved cat named Ja'kh.

Permanently grants the passive "Zerith's Guidance" to the bearer.
