14684.hint: Acquired in the Season One Tamriel Tome.
14684.name: Whirlwind, Spring Green
14684.description: Applies to Whirlwind, Steel Tornado, and Whirling Blades. Select in Skills menu.

14685.name: Handbill: Holgunn One-Eye
14685.description: A portrait of Holgunn One-Eye, commander of Davon's Watch.

14686.name: Handbill: Lady Arabelle Davaux
14686.description: A portrait of Lady Arabelle Davaux, a former member of the Ring of Daggers, who keeps her hand in affairs as needed.

14687.name: Handbill: Battlereeve Urcelmo
14687.description: A portrait of Battlereeve Urcelmo, head of the First Auridon Marines and member of Queen Ayrenn's inner circle.

14691.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Quenneth Lumena's Warrant".
14691.name: Quen's Heist Attire
14691.description: "A thief is only as good as their gear. You want to get caught? Leave your shoelaces untied and wear the clunkiest armor you can find. Or you could be smart. And don something like this."âQuen, Glenumbra

14692.name: Steadfast Stendarr Battlebear
14692.description: "Nothing wakes you up faster than staring into the golden eyes of a massive armored bear. Its rider asked why I slept in the streets, then tossed coins my way. Later, I heard they'd hauled off the lord who'd dispossessed me."âOverheard in Daggerfall

14693.name: Beast of Divine Reprisal
14693.description: The beast is not just the mount but the rider as well, flesh and bone and blood fueled with hatred for the unfaithful. The fire that burns within the Beast is muzzled, barely, in service of the Divine plan.

14697.name: Season One Premium Tome
14697.description: Grants ownership to the Season One Premium Tome.

14699.name: Jadefang Clannfear
14699.description: "I sealed a pact with a crafty green Clannfear before it vanished. At my summons it will appear again. I paid dearly to contract with the Dreadriders of the Jadefang Dremora clan. I hope this bargain is worth its steep price."âMagister Dolan's Journal

14700.hint: Acquired in the Season Two Tamriel Tome.
14700.name: Azureblight Recall
14700.description: "The defeat of Maarselok may have ended the Azure Blight, yet I find lingering effects color my magic. Let us hope no ill effects result."âUndaunted Eralane Tedalane

14701.name: Voidcaller Scarecrow Garb
14701.description: It's common for Khajiiti priests to add wards around harvest scarecrows. Stifling the song of the Void and protecting crops. In mockery of this tradition, some Voidcallers of Namiira dress like scarecrows and take perverse glee in terrifying the faithful.

14702.name: Fortune's Favor Finery
14702.description: When Black Fredas arrives, Orsinium merchants don special garb then follow a chance-chosen path to sell good-luck trinkets. Some claim seeing such a merchant prevents minor mischances on this ill-omened holiday.

14703.name: Oracle Society Harbingers Gown
14703.description: "If you wish to join us, be sure to wear your best. Insights into the Divine plan are only available if you look like you can afford them. See my gown? Something along these lines. The Eight must have their tithe, after all."âOracle Society Sponsor

14704.name: Harbingers Fervor Attire
14704.description: Those who wear this battle garb are as much Dibellan devotees as any Passion Dancer. But for these Harbingers, their art is violence. And they are masters of their craft.

14705.name: Timeworn Key Ear Drop
14705.description: Some may look at this mysterious key you dangle from your ear and wonder. Is it a working key? If so, what does it unlock? If not, why? The curiosity may drive them to ask. And that's when you know you have them.

14706.name: Harbingers Half-Mask
14706.description: "The half-mask given to me at my induction ceremony feels heavy, somehow. As if it bears the weight of my decades of service to the Divines."âHarbinger Beredic's Journal

14707.name: Harbingers Recall
14707.description: A door opens for you. Thanks to your devotion, you know exactly where it goes.

14708.name: Cath Bedraud Crypt Marble
14708.description: "Your meditations in Cath Bedraud didn't settle your emotions, apprentice? Hmmm â¦ a moment. Now, look. Yes, you embody the marble inside the crypts. And does it feel? No, it stands, a bulwark against grief. As you must be."âNecromancer Nolollas

14709.name: Feathered Hat of Akatosh
14709.description: With its bright emblem of Akatosh, this feathered hat lends a carefree air to those wearing it. Deeply held beliefs don't need to weigh the spirit down, after all!

14710.name: Play Classical KemenÃ§e
14710.description: Stir the souls of your audience by playing this stringed instrument with skill and passion.

14711.name: Fervent Sweep
14711.description: "A simple sweep, yes? With ends in purples and blues? Divines-inspired, you say? Color me intrigued â¦ and envious that you can pull off this style!"âRukharr, Coiffeur Artisan

14712.name: Dibellan Braided Bun
14712.description: Dark flowers add an enticing fragrance to this elegant updo favored by Dibellan priests. Some prefer to wear it only for special occasions, but don't let that limit you!

14713.name: Steadfast Stendarr Battlebear Cub
14713.description: "After I helped feed Alliance War veterans at the inn, I found this golden bear cub waiting for me outside. Only later did I find out it had scared off some unscrupulous individuals before I came out. Bless Stendarr!"âFaustina Vinorman

14714.hint: Acquired by purchasing the Season Two Premium + Bonuses Tamriel Tome.
14714.name: Patched Tabby Cat
14714.description: "You're on a lucky ship if one of these white-and-tabby cats are on board. How do I know? Experience. Ships without them? I could write harrowing tragedies. Ships with them? Smooth sailing."âCaptain Sigum

14715.name: Divine Judgment Body Marking
14715.description: "By the grace of the Eight, I bring judgment to those who need it. Akatosh, Arkay, Dibella, Julianos, Kynareth, Mara, Stendarr, and Zenithar. All mark my body â¦ and my soul."âHarbinger Lynessa

14716.name: Divine Judgment Face Marking
14716.description: This ornate circle marks eight circles across the face. Eight Divines. And Eight judgments in service of the Divine plan. Asked and answered.

14717.name: Eyes of Reprisal
14717.description: Your eyes see only retribution. Revenge. Reprisal. Judgement.

14718.name: Harbingers Cathedral Body Marks
14718.description: "I first built the temple on my body, brick by brick, in my soul. Each stone, every needle prick, blessed by the Divines. This edifice stands within me and without, protecting me."âHarbinger Beredic's Journal

14719.name: Harbingers Cathedral Face Marks
14719.description: A warrior bearing the cathedral across their back is enough to silence a rowdy tavern. The Harbingers have spread the word. And even the loudest Undaunted braggart knows what judgment looks like.

14720.name: Reprisal's Rise Face Tattoo
14720.description: Some scars are from accidents. Others from battle. These? They mark you as a beast of reprisal.

14721.name: Reprisal's Rise Body Tattoo
14721.description: Your blood burns. You must act. The fury of the Divine swells within, beast of reprisal. Who will fall to your judgement this eve? You do not know. You do not care. It is all a part of the plan.

14722.name: Harbingers Gaze
14722.description: "The Divines sent me trials. I succeeded. Then they sent me tribulations. I endured. I am a Harbinger of the Divine. When I fulfill my sacred duty, they see what I see."âHarbinger Beredic's Journal

14723.name: Cleave of the Divine
14723.description: Draw strength from the Divines as your axe bites home!

14724.name: Flame-Father's Mining
14724.description: Call upon the ferocity of Dagon's destruction to rip ore straight from the ground.

14725.name: Myrkwasa Braided Camel
14725.description: "None but camels. That's all I will ride. And of those, I favor the look of the traditional Myrkwasa braids found on this particular camel. No, no, do not persuade me otherwise. Only camels will I ride. And for now, only this one."âKhosbin the Wise

14726.name: Ald Carac Nix-Ox
14726.description: Before it became a battleground, Ald Carac provided shelter to uniquely colored nix-oxen. Those who helped establish the gladiator camp spent some time taming these creatures. Now more live outside Ald Carac than anywhere near it.

14727.name: Suncleft Grotto Ornaug
14727.description: Named after the grotto in Galen where it was first tamed, this bright yellow ornaug dazzles the eye. Many sailors seek out this beast as a companion both in port and while aboard, a faithful guardian that also happens to be an incredible swimmer.

14729.name: Voidcaller Scarecrow Sabre Cat
14729.description: "Kissed by the Great Darkness, that straw cat is, ja'khajiit. It seeks out those who hear the call of the Void. If it shows itself, seeking a rider? Best get on. Or be ready to suffer the pain of the Void at its claws."âVoidcaller Joboraska

14730.name: Pale Pass Moose
14730.description: Even ogres lurking around Pale Pass try not to cross paths with the moose native to the area. Knowing this, merchants paid to have several captured and trained to saddle. Now warriors who favor heavier gear seek these impressive steeds out.

14731.name: Padomaic Crest Vvardvark
14731.description: "Though Varkenel missed the mark on creating a pure-white vvardvark on his first attempt, I admit to preferring this pale pink version. Perhaps I shall take these off his hands and return home to the central highlands."âMagister Sela Otheri

14732.name: Sanguine Red Silk
14732.description:
In the halls of the Daedra, their crude mockeries of Tamrielic traditions extend to the courtesies of courtly dancing as well.

A component required for the Thorn's Bite Revelry Gown.

14733.name: Sanguine Spool of Thread
14733.description:
Darkly beautiful and ringed with bloody thorns, this fashionable accoutrement lures in dance partners while also pricking those who get too close.

A component required for the Thorn's Bite Revelry Gown.

14734.name: Sanguine Soul Gem
14734.description:
Victims of this deadly poison are found with reddened lips; the mark of one last dalliance with forbidden romance.

A component required for the Thorn's Bite Revelry Gown.

14735.name: Cathedral of the Divine Fawn
14735.description: When done with more serious workings, Harbinger priest-mages use leftover materials to create acts of devotion. The resultant stained-glass fawns sedately accompany visitors around Harbinger enclaves. Watching, of course, but adorable just the same.

14736.name: Cath Bedraud Crypt Ghost
14736.description: "After a long day of necromantic studies, the sound of skeleton servants became too distracting. At Cath Bedraud I found a quieter companion to keep me company in my studies."âFrom the journal of Ogrogog

14737.name: Flameskull of Divine Reprisal
14737.description: Each flame skull is enchanted by a Harbinger devotee with rare necromantic talent. Every construct used to be a beast rider, a former agent of reprisal. Even beyond death, they serve the Divine plan.

14738.name: Mask of Elegant Chaos
14738.description: This dark mask, though beautiful to gaze upon, hides your expressions from those who hope to understand you better. Exactly what you want.

14739.name: Band of Symmetry
14739.description: Art can create order from chaos. This band, crafted by skilled artisans, proves that.

14740.name: Ne Quin-Al Wrap
14740.description: "Wrap yourself in this garb, child. Just as Jone and Jode wrap us in their blessed moonlight. In this way you carry the wonders of the Two-Moons Dance throughout your travels. And you are never alone."âMoon Priest Nadeza

14741.name: Reveries Formal Wear
14741.description: Members of the House of Reveries know how to make a statement, and formal occasions are no exception. While many performers may still adopt a mask to conceal their identities at high society events in Summerset, their refined taste is never in question.

14742.hint: Acquired in the Season Two Tamriel Tome.
14742.name: Maarselok Slayer Mammoth
14742.description: Capture the glory of your victory against the Dragon Maarselok! This mammoth not only provides you with easier transport, but also showcases trophies from the dread blue Dragon of the Tenmar Jungle.

14743.name: Lilmoth Turtle
14743.description: "Fate brought my Lilymoth to me. While heading toward Blackrose Prison, my battlebear saw her before I did and stopped to sniff her. Not wanting her to be trod upon by my companions, I picked her up, and she's been with me ever since."âFa the Ready

14744.name: Bravil Retriever Pup
14744.description: Who needs more adorable puppy antics in their life? You do! Trainers recommend you invest in some chew toys, as well. You don't wish to jump into battle with Daedra with puppy-chewed leather gear now, do you?

14746.name: Curse You!
14746.description: May dire misfortune fall upon all who oppose you!

14747.name: Mirror Mishap
14747.description: What is this mirror trying to tell you?

14748.name: Finders Keepers
14748.description: You found a shiny coin! And now, so have some covetous crows!

14749.hint: Acquired in the Season Two Tamriel Tome.
14749.name: Spider Hunter Silks
14749.description: "Dreams of the Swarm Mother. So many spiders. Spindleclutch calls. I will answer in my own time. Do you think the spiders will like my outfit? I do so want to impress them. Right before pulling them apart, leg by leg."âDenthilde of the Eight Legs

14750.hint: Acquired in the Season Two Tamriel Tome.
14750.name: Shagrath's Web
14750.description: "Weave outcomes favored by the God of Spiders, my dear novice, and she bestows upon you her blessed web of protection. Whether you choose to show others her favor is up to you."âPriestess Marieneth

14752.hint: Acquired in the Season Two Tamriel Tome.
14752.name: Blightguard Jawplate
14752.description: Crafted from Maarselok trophies, this intimidating jawplate speaks volumes about your combat prowess and adventuring spirit.

14753.hint: Acquired in the Season Two Tamriel Tome.
14753.name: Maarselok Hunter's Horns
14753.description: "Why put my victory trophies from Maarselok on the wall when I can stick them on my head? Bit of alchemical glue and they're nearly like real horns. Haven't quite figured out how to remove them, though. But why would I?"âKailstig the Axe

14755.hint: Acquired in the Season Two Tamriel Tome.
14755.name: Maarselok Slayer Piercings
14755.description: Undaunted love trophies. Some adorn walls. Others find their way into active battle gear. These piercings show off just how masterful you are at defeating dread Dragons.

14756.name: Harvestfall Fledgling Gryphon
14756.description: Romp through fallen leaves with this wondrous little fledgling! Just don't be surprised if she chases a few squirrels as part of the fun. And keep her away from bears, which she may confuse as friends instead of aggressive foes.

14757.hint: Acquired in the Season Two Tamriel Tome.
14757.name: Maarselok Dragon Imp
14757.description: "Imps! Those tricksters. That one over there? Turned into a small version of Maarselok. I faced that blighted Dragon myself weeks ago. Didn't stop me from starting like a spooked camel when I saw the small version."âUndaunted Ordzazir

14758.name: Vulkhel Black Squirrel
14758.description: When an illness caused Vulkhel Guard's native black squirrels to die almost completely off, locals began healing and breeding them. Now some end up as gifts to animal-lovers passing through town.

14759.name: Aconite Spider
14759.description: "I quite like my new spider friend. She favors rats, which suits my household just fine. In fact, I hear from our neighbors that they've seen nary a rat on our street for months now."âLady Piernette Helane

14760.name: Whiterun Barred Owl
14760.description: "Follow the flight of the owl. If it leads you to Whiterun, rest there. If it leads you into the deep woods, hunt there. If it instead follows you, consider yourself blessed. By whom? Jhunal, maybe. But who can really say?"âElder Eorbold

14761.name: Belkarth Black Pig
14761.description: Made famous by the bard song "The Fire-Eating Pig," these black-bristled porcine companions love cuddles and carrots. More than one person claims theirs also saved lives, though not from a runaway hearth fire as the ditty so vividly describes.

14762.name: Taskmaster's Trials Daedrat
14762.description: With their cunning intelligence and ambitious drive, these Daedrats serve Peryite. The Taskmaster sometimes lends one of these skilled skulkers to adherents who need a bit of help â¦ and to keep an eye on them.

14763.name: Nighthallow Moth
14763.description: "You know death nears when these moths gather around spent candles. Fluttering as if light still sputters from their wicks. But if you see only one, like mine, consider yourself lucky. You'll find delicious fruit nearby."âGarby the Grocer

14771.name: Season One Premium Tome Bonuses
14771.description: Grants the bonuses conferred by ownership of the Season One Premium Tome: two Caches of Tome Points and a unique cosmetic.

14772.hint: Note: Though this storyline takes place after the Abah's Landing Thieves Guild story, you can play either quest in any order.
14772.name: Daggerfall Thieves Guild
14772.description: Quen needs your help establishing a new Thieves Guild in Daggerfall. Aid her in bringing three rival gangs together and completing a daring heist to steal a powerful relic from the legendary Nowhere Vault of Sage Voernet.

14773.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Werewolf Form" achievement.
14773.name: Werewolf Form, Black
14773.description: Applies to Werewolf Transformation, Pack Leader, and Werewolf Berserker. Select in Skills menu.

14774.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist II: Werewolf Form" achievement.
14774.name: Werewolf Form, Ashen
14774.description: Applies to Werewolf Transformation, Pack Leader, and Werewolf Berserker. Select in Skills menu.

14775.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist III: Werewolf Form" achievement.
14775.name: Werewolf Form, White
14775.description: Applies to Werewolf Transformation, Pack Leader, and Werewolf Berserker. Select in Skills menu.

14776.name: Sheogorath Takes a Holiday
14776.description: When the Daedric Prince of Madness decides to take a holiday, it falls to you to serve as his guide and keep his insane desires from destroying Nirn. Take a tour across Tamriel alongside the charmingly dangerous Sheogorath!

14777.name: Molten Weapons, Cooled
14777.description: Applies to Molten Weapons, Igneous Weapons, and Molten Armaments. Select in Skills Menu.

14778.name: Grotto of Desires
14778.description: Frolic in forbidden festivities in Sanguine's Grotto of Desires! Dance your days away in the Great Hall. Dally in the wine-red waters of this beautiful grotto. Or, if you prefer spicier fun, indulge your fantasies in expansive side chambers.

14779.name: Sheogorad Chateau
14779.description: On the outside, this Hlaalu-themed chateau blends into the Sheogorad archipelago. But on the inside, oh ho! Rooms are dizzyingly upside-down! Cheese stacks to the ceiling! What other paradoxical surprises await in this house built by the Prince of Madness?

14781.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Last Laugh."
14781.name: Mad God's Tomeshell
14781.description: Once a favorite of Sheogorath, this mischievous tomeshell has caused enough trouble to annoy even the Daedric Prince of Madness. Best if you give it a new home.

14788.name: Sheogorath's Blessed Cheese
14788.description: When the Mad God gives you cheese, take it.
14788.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "A Taste of the Finer Things".

14789.name: U49 PTS Premium Tome
14789.description: Grants ownership to the U50 PTS Premium Tome.

14790.name: U49 PTS Premium Tome Bonuses
14790.description: Grants the bonuses conferred by ownership of the U50 PTS Premium Tome: two Caches of Tome Points and a unique cosmetic.

14792.name: Statuette: Hircine the Hunter
14792.description: A remembrance of past hunts. Or a great addition to your altar to Hircine.

14793.name: Statuette: Golden Knight
14793.description: The chosen of Meridia stands ready.

14794.name: Painting: Solitude
14794.description: This moody painting depicts Solitude on an overcast day.

14795.hint: Awarded for completing Solo Moon Hunter Keep.
14795.name: Trophy: Mylenne Moon-Caller
14795.description: Trophy taken from Mylenne Moon-Caller in honor of a solo victory in Moon Hunter Keep.

14796.hint: Awarded for completing Solo Moon Hunter Keep while under the effect of a Misfortune.
14796.name: Bust: Mylenne Moon-Caller
14796.description: Bronze bust commemorating a solo victory in Moon Hunter Keep.

14811.name: Ill-Omened Egg
14811.description: Not every egg hatches into a chick. Sometimes it changes you into a chicken!

14812.hint: Obtained rarely by defeating Balorgh in Solo March of Sacrifices.

14812.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Tarcyr style.

14813.hint: Purchased from Veya Thenim for Undaunted Crests.

14813.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Tarcyr style.

14814.description: Applies to Werewolf Transformation, Pack Leader, and Werewolf Berserker. Select in Skills menu.

14815.name: Spear Shards, Fiery Torment
14815.description: Applies to Spear Shards, Blazing Spear, and Luminous Shards. Select in Skills Menu.

14817.name: Obsidian Shield, Gold Road
14817.description: Applies to Obsidian Shield, Fragmented Shield, and Igneous Shield. Select in Skills menu.

14819.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Summon Shade" achievement.

14820.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Evasion" achievement.

14822.name: Surge, Vibrant Yellow
14822.description: Applies to Surge, Critical Surge, and Power Surge. Select in Skills menu.

14823.name: Harvestfall Quasigriff
14823.description: "Irastimil Direnni made a few tweaks with this particular autumnal-hued quasigriff. Note the gait? Still, as a bird-beast creature, it retains its quasigriff status. Shush, you. I'll brook no disagreement on this."âMagister Varkenel

14975.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Jadefang Clannfear Rider style.

15006.name: Antiquities: A Primer
15006.description: A primer from Amalien of the Antiquarian Circle on how to scry, explore, and excavate for precious treasures from the past.

15007.name: Gravedigger Buckled Hat
15007.description: "Rain. Snow. Bright sun. The dead don't care what the weather is like. They just need burying. And that's why you'll find us gravediggers wearing hats. We're out here in all sorts, Kynareth knows."âGravedigger Marguerite

15008.name: Oracle Society Harbinger's Mask
15008.description: The Oracle Society is a secretive sub-faction of the Harbingers. Member faces and names are a closely guarded secret due to connections with the highest levels of Tamriel society.

15010.name: Floating Desires Petal
15010.description:
As this petal falls it trails the echoes of Revelry, Daedric power still lingering in bloody resonance.

A component required for the Grotto of Desires Sanguine-themed house.

15011.name: Wine-Soaked Argonian Effigy
15011.description:
A ritual effigy to the marsh-water Prince of swamp celebrations. Worn down by time and soaked with an estuary's worth of wine.

A component required for the Grotto of Desires Sanguine-themed house.

15012.name: Gilded Imperial Revelry Icon
15012.description:
Still smelling faintly of rare herbs, this icon stood for years in a hidden temple to the Prince of Indulgences, before the sacking of Imperial City forced its removal.

A component required for the Grotto of Desires Sanguine-themed house.

15013.name: Crimson Silk Veneration Cushion
15013.description:
This beautiful pillow is said to have ceremonial importance in esoteric and libidinous Sanguine Rituals.

A component required for the Grotto of Desires Sanguine-themed house.

15014.name: Acts of Indulgences Place Setting
15014.description:
To the Lord of Revelry, a gluttonous gorging is just as much veneration as an erotic tableau. Reverential prayers run along the underside of each piece of cutlery.

A component required for the Grotto of Desires Sanguine-themed house.

15065.hint: Acquired from the Deep Plunder Box during the High Seas of Tamriel event.
15065.name: Galen Seawater
15065.description:
This frothing seawater still sings with the adventurous spirit of the Systres islands.

A component required for the Suncleft Grotto Ornaug mount.

15066.hint: Acquired from undersea bosses during the High Seas of Tamriel event.
15066.name: Captured Systres Zephyr
15066.description:
A swirling gust of wind that once danced atop the waves in Gonfalon Bay.

A component required for the Suncleft Grotto Ornaug mount.

15067.hint: Acquired from the Flight of the Albatross achievement during the High Seas of Tamriel event.
15067.name: Arcing Ornaug Energy
15067.description:
A carefully collected jolt of power from the Ornaugs of the Systres Islands. It dances gleefully within its vessel.

A component required for the Suncleft Grotto Ornaug mount.

15071.name: Ostentatious Pirate Wig and Hat
15071.description: Adventure, plunder, and more await you on the high seas. Meet the moment like a Baron Captain of the All Flags Navy, with panache, by donning this dramatic hat and wig combination.

15166.name: Season Two Premium Tome
15166.description: Grants ownership to the Season Two Premium Tome.

15167.name: Season Two Premium Tome Bonuses
15167.description: Grants the bonuses conferred by ownership of the Season Two Premium Tome: two Caches of Tome Points and a unique cosmetic.
